name: IG Petrochemicals Ltd
gLine: Plasticizer plant ramp: 40,000-50,000 tonnes next year, up to 75,000 capacity
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 63% to ₹770 crore and EBITDA margin 18% vs 5.8%, on spreads of $300-350 and plant utilisation of 90-91% across three operating plants, with a fourth plant starting.

name: Sanathan Textiles Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated EBITDA: north of INR560 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q2 consolidated EBITDA INR155cr (+43% QoQ) on Punjab ramp to 90%+ utilisation, but Punjab phase-2 first portion slipped to December and FY27 EBITDA guidance was effectively raised to 560+ while prior 520-540 was not reiterated with clarity.

name: Juniper Green Energy Ltd
gLine: Mar-27 EBITDA run rate: INR 2,750 crores on ~3.9 GW peak (Mar 2027)
thesis: Record Q2 EBITDA INR 340 crores at 91% margin and 2.8 GW operational, but commissioning pace and PPA conversion are the swing factors, and no FY27 guidance was reiterated with numbers beyond the 2 GW target.

name: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 33% to 35% (FY27)
thesis: Flex operator raised FY27 revenue growth to 33-35% from 28-30% on 41% H1 growth, with margin held at 19-20%; but H1 FCF was negative INR 104 crore as capex runs ahead of revenue, and supply for FY28 is largely secured.

name: Jindal Steel Ltd
gLine: Coal self-sufficiency: 65-70% from own mines (next period)
thesis: Record Q2 gross revenue INR 19,448 crore and 2.38 Mt volume, with net debt/EBITDA down to 1.51x; management reaffirmed the 10.5-11 Mt FY27 volume range but gave no fresh capacity-discipline numbers beyond ramp-up.
top: Blast furnace ramp to 12,000 tpd by Dec

name: Timex Group India Ltd-$
gLine: EBITDA margin: about 20% (longer term) (full year, in a year or so)
thesis: Q2 revenue INR359 crore (+47% YoY) and EBITDA INR66 crore (+54%), but gross product margin fell ~1.1pp on FX and metals; Baddi capacity at ~100% utilisation with 6m to 12m expansion planned.

name: Bodal Chemicals Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR3,000 plus crores (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated EBITDA INR128 crore (14.4% margin) on H acid and dye intermediate price spike; management guides ~INR3,000 crore FY27 revenue at ~12% margin, but declines capacity expansion on dye intermediates and says utilisation is at optimum.

name: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 40%-45% (~INR7,000 cr) (FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue ~INR2,000 cr (+73% YoY) but management cut FY27 growth guide to 40-45% from 35%+ framing, and EBITDA margin guide trimmed to 10-10.5% from 10.5-11%; PCB commercial start slipped to ~Sept 2027 volume.

name: Time Technoplast Ltd
gLine: EBITDA growth: more than 20% when volume grows 15% (FY27-28)
thesis: Volume guided at 15% minimum for three years with capex net ~250 crore post non-core asset sales; H1 revenue +29% and PAT +25%, but transcript is garbled and volume/EBITDA figures are unreliable.

name: Transformers and Rectifiers (India) Ltd
gLine: Working capital days: below 120 days by end FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 standalone revenue INR709 cr (+66% YoY) and EBITDA margin 16.1%, with capacity expansion at Changodar (to 35,000 MVA) due around Diwali, but working capital at 154 days and FY27 guidance held rather than raised.

name: Gland Pharma Ltd
gLine: Capex programme: Rs2,000 crore plus new Rs1,000 crore greenfield (FY27-FY30)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 23% to Rs18,336m with CDMO 45% of sales, but capacity is 92% utilised and management is adding ~Rs3,000 crore of capex, with Cenexi EBITDA negative at EUR -6m.

name: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd
thesis: Luxury Mumbai developer reports Q2 pre-sales INR470 crores (+83% YoY) and H1 EBITDA margin 38.8%, but collections of only INR209 crores against INR879 crores pre-sales (about 24%) keep cash flow weak.

name: Varmora Granito Ltd
gLine: Full-year revenue growth: ~15% value, ~10% volume, if exports revive
thesis: Morbi tile maker's Q2 utilisation jumped to 89% (Q1 63%) as ~10-11 PVT/ceramic plants shut and no net capacity added in H1, but management is pricing-led and the export/freight recovery is unproven.

name: Indo Rama Synthetics (India) Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume: around 4 lakh tonnes, then 4.75 lakh+ next year (FY27/FY28)
thesis: Q2 EBITDA margin 8.8% (H1 9.9%) on pass-through of raw material spikes, utilisation 68% in FY26 and PET chip plant at 60%, plus INR200 crore specialty capex; no polyester capacity in pipeline per management.

name: Bharat Forge Ltd
gLine: India manufacturing quarterly sales: well in excess of INR5,000 crore by end of next year (end CY/FY next year)
thesis: Bharat Forge Q2 FY27 standalone revenue up ~30% to INR2,526 crore with EBITDA margin 25.9%, but consolidated margin ~16% and US/Europe still loss-making; capex expansion (Baramati ~INR1,300 crore, +100,000 t forging) is under way and defence delay pushed revenue into FY28.
top: Baramati plants running very close to full

name: Indian Hotels Company Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: 15% to 17% (FY27)
thesis: IHCL raised FY27 consolidated revenue growth to 15-17% from 12-14% after H1 growth of about 18%, with standalone EBITDA margin up 400 bps to 38.9%, but the upgrade is demand and rate-led rather than supply-led.

name: Steel Strips Wheels Ltd-$
gLine: Exports FY27: INR600-750 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +61% to INR1,930 cr and EBITDA/wheel INR404 vs INR242, but management attributes part of the gain to raw-material pass-through invoicing, and capex rises to a INR1,400 cr greenfield plus the INR600 cr+ FY27 plan.

name: RIR Power Electronics Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 33.98 cr (+25% QoQ, +32.5% YoY) with backlog up 38.9% to Rs 17.4 cr per CEO, but Odisha SiC epi commercial start has slipped on state clearances and management refused forward numbers.

name: TVS Motor Company Ltd
gLine: EV capacity: about 80,000 planned (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 volumes and EBITDA hit records (EBITDA +47% to INR2,219 cr, margin 13%), but the company only guided to good single-digit industry growth in Q3, with EV capacity moving 60-65k toward 80k and a demerger of the consumer finance arm.
top: Q3 industry growth cut to good single digit

name: Prince Pipes and Fittings Ltd
gLine: Receivable days: 35-40 days (going forward)
thesis: H1 FY27 volume up only 7% YoY against 12-15% FY27 guide, requiring 16-21% in H2; Q2 revenue +38% and EBITDA margin 12% held, but volume target looks stretched.

name: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd
gLine: IHT/OHT capacity: 15,000 tons within this year (FY27)
thesis: Record Q2 EBITDA of Rs 105 crore and ~Rs 7,800-8,000/ton, but ~Rs 200/ton was one-time inventory gain; Dadri ramp and mix drive a Rs 7,000-7,500 FY27 guide, with 20% H2 volume growth at risk from wire-rod shortage.
top: Raw material shortage hits October output

name: Senores Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Growth beyond FY27: around 25% annually over 2-3 years (2-3 years)
thesis: Q2 revenue INR192 cr (+25% YoY) and 30% operating EBITDA margin, but no new ANDA commercialised in the quarter, Zoraya/Amerisyn costs (~INR4 cr) with no revenue yet, and FY27 guidance reiterated without numbers.
top: Emerging market margin fell to ~4% in Q2

name: ArisInfra Solutions Ltd
thesis: Partner capacity rose 9.1 to 11.7 mn MT with no capex and utilisation only 42-45%, while NWC fell to 54 days and deposits fell INR 13 cr; growth guidance held at 30-35% for FY28.

name: Kajaria Ceramics Ltd
thesis: Volume up 10% with price hikes of 12-13% in North/South and Morbi cost squeeze; management held margins near 19% and guided no further price hikes, while Morbi capacity sits 40-50% offline.

name: GRP Ltd
gLine: Plastics revenue FY27: roughly 20% growth (FY27)
thesis: Q2 EBITDA margin held near 11% despite a 529bp gross margin fall, but the new Pyrova capacity is not yet at run-rate and rCB is not commissioned; the mid-teen margin target is unproven.

name: Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: ~INR13,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: Record H1 FY27 with 38.3% EBITDA margin on captive ore and pellets, but Chemaf debt, copper and steel timelines slipped and FY27 copper target was cut to 5,850t from 8,000t.
top: Steel plant commissioning slipped a quarter

name: India Cements Ltd
thesis: Document is an UltraTech Cement Q2 FY27 call transcript filed under India Cements' exchange code, so it does not read on India Cements; UltraTech shows prices up about 5% from Q2 average and utilisation near 71%.

name: Petronet LNG Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 PBT ₹1,659 cr (+53% YoY) propped by ₹658 cr operational/commercial efficiency gains while Qatar supply stays mostly cut; capex guided ~₹9,000 cr FY27 and FY28 flat, with only ₹1,626 cr spent in H1.
top: Efficiency gains ₹658 cr replace trading split

name: JK Cement Ltd
gLine: RMC FY27 top line: Q4 may touch INR100 crore per quarter
thesis: Q2 grey volume up ~19% H1 to 11.3 Mt on Central India expansion, but Q2 cost/t rising toward INR2/kcal with INR80-90 hit per quarter in Q3 and Q4; price up ~INR20/bag but INR10-15 more needed.

name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 volume +10.1% and EBITDA/kg INR46.5 (vs ~INR39 last Q2), with pharma/FMCG mix shift; management held FY27 EBITDA/kg at INR45-46 and volume growth at ~10%, but lubes fell ~12-15% and capex guidance was cut to INR75-80 crores from ~INR90 crores.

name: Aurum PropTech Ltd
gLine: Housing.com revenue growth: INR 100-150 crore revenue growth over next 4-6 quarters (4-6 quarters)
thesis: Proptech platform (ex-Housing.com) reports 64% YoY revenue growth to INR 130.2 crore and 29.8% EBITDA margin, but Housing.com breakeven now guided at 12-18 months, a shift from prior 4-6 quarters.

name: P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd
gLine: Revenue FY27: INR13,000 cr+ (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR2,666 cr (+22%) and adjusted PAT margin 4.4% (from 3.3%), but store additions are back-loaded and the stock turn on new stores is ~1.1x, not yet proven at scale.

name: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd
gLine: BESS commissioning FY27: >12 GWh (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR1,007 crore (+67.5% YoY) and EBITDA INR874 crore on BESS peak-power sales; FY27 BESS guidance raised to >12 GWh, but solar commissioning cut to ~1.5 GW on grid (GNA) delays.

name: Ather Energy Ltd
gLine: Installed capacity: 11.4 lakh units annual by Q2 FY28 (Q2 FY28)
thesis: Capacity raised to 11.4 lakh units by Q2 FY28 (Hosur +6k/month this quarter, AURIC +12k) as demand outruns 33k/month output; gross margin 24% but 2.7pp of it is temporary SKU and incentive levers.

name: Msafe Equipments Ltd
thesis: Rental-led scaffolding and formwork lessor with Q2 FY27 PAT up 55% to Rs 8.49 cr and utilisation near 80%, but the transcript is garbled and capacity expansion is raising debt needs to Rs 65-70 cr.

name: Wheels India Ltd
gLine: Aluminium wheel capacity: 130,000 wheels/month by end of March
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 36% to INR1,598 crore with EBITDA ~8%; aluminium wheels ramping 80k→130k/month by March, with PBT-positive targeted from December and 10-12% EBITDA at 100k/month by Q1 FY28.

name: Raymond Ltd
gLine: Aerospace Bangalore capacity revenue potential: INR700-750 crores (current facility)
thesis: Aerospace revenue up 72% to INR139 cr with margin 21%, but management guided aerospace growth down to mid-20s and Andhra greenfield timing reiterated for Q3 FY28, not deferred; consolidated margin 15.1% in Q2.

name: The Phoenix Mills Ltd
gLine: Retail rental growth FY27: ~15%, likely 1-2 pts higher (FY27)
thesis: Annuity EBITDA up 21% to Rs 669 cr with no new mall added in two years; FY27 rental guidance of ~15% now seen 1-2 pts higher, but office occupancy and new-mall timing are the swing factors.
top: FY27 rental growth guide raised 1-2 pts

name: Welspun Corp Ltd
thesis: Record Q2 EBITDA of INR782 crore (+25% YoY) and a record ~INR50,000 crore order book, but Indian domestic DI pipe demand is weak and management is calibrating US ordering; FY27 EBITDA guidance of INR2,850 crore was held, not raised.
top: New capacity: US +225k t, Jordan JV, Saudi

name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd-$
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 57% YoY to INR1,191 cr with EBITDA margin 34.2%, but growth is price and volume driven with capex frame held at INR700-1,000 cr/yr; R32 and Chemours commissioning slipping into Q3 per management. Medium-term margin guidance held.

name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
gLine: Mobile volume FY27 ex-Vivo: around 34 million (H2 33-34 million) (FY27)
thesis: Dixon's H1 mobile volume 17.2 million and H2 guided 33-34 million ex-Vivo, but margins compressed by PLI expiry and memory pass-through lag; washing machine EBITDA fell to about 8.3% from 10.5-11%.

name: Chemplast Sanmar Ltd
gLine: Interest cost per quarter: Rs40-45 Cr (next quarters)
thesis: Document is a Q2 FY2022 maiden post-IPO call (dated 2026 in metadata); H1 EBITDA Rs498 Cr up 118%, spreads historically high, and capacity expansion of 35,000t paste PVC with CCVL asset-light SPVC option.
top: SPVC capex Rs750-800 Cr for 3 lakh t

name: WeWork India Management Ltd
thesis: Flex operator adding record 11,700 desks with occupancy up 357bp YoY to 83.7%, revenue +31.6%, EBITDA margin 21.2%; capex front-loaded and FY27 guide of INR500-odd crore held, FY28 pointed near INR600 crore.

name: Horizon Industrial Parks Ltd
gLine: Cost of debt: Rated average debt ~8.18%; refinancing cut ~71 bps on INR 635 cr (post deleveraging)
thesis: Leasing 4.4 mn sq ft in H1 (68% of 6.5 mn FY27 target) and 2.7 mn sq ft completions (~50% of 6 mn) keep guidance on track, but no fresh numbers were given on positive P&L or cost of debt, and the in-city yield target was not repeated.
top: Re-leasing spread 12% on 1.2 mn sq ft

name: Hero MotoCorp Ltd
gLine: EV capacity: over 80,000 per month (Q2 FY28)
thesis: Hero is supply-constrained on VIDA EV (capacity 30k/month, target 45k by Q4) with EV drag down to ₹168 cr from ₹232 cr QoQ, but margins guided only to "stable" in Q3 and the 14–16% target pushed out to "next few quarters".

name: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 27% plus/minus 2% (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR696 crore (+22% YoY) and EBITDA margin 27.2%; capacity ramp to INR3,500 crore at full use via TPU line (Q3 FY27) and new SCF line (June 2027), with FY27 margin guide raised to 27% ±2%.

name: Shaily Engineering Plastics Ltd
gLine: FY28 pen volume: around 15% growth on USD 50 million base (not guidance) (FY28)
thesis: Healthcare pen volumes 10.4M in Q2 with 36M FY27 guidance to be exceeded, but pricing erosion of 10-15% is built into contracts and utilisation is only 52.5%, so supply discipline is not yet tested.

name: Ravindra Energy Ltd
gLine: Operating renewable capacity: 500 MW by March 2027 (Mar-27)
thesis: Solar IPP/EPC is funding a heavy e-truck push: EIM sold 142 vehicles in Q2 vs 58 in Q1, but losses still weigh on consolidated PAT (H1 INR 20.7 crore vs 46.6 crore).

name: Paramount Communications Ltd-$
thesis: Q2 FY27 operating margin 7.3% (up from 6.6% in Q1, 1.3% a year ago) with H1 revenue INR 1,089.8 cr up 24.1%, but working capital drifted to 108 days and the ~8% margin target is hedged as "We are hopeful".

name: UltraTech Cement Ltd
gLine: Net debt/EBITDA: below 1x by end of March
thesis: Q2 FY27 volumes +13.8% vs industry near 10%, with trade prices exiting September ~3% above Q1 average and ~5% higher spot into October; capacity utilisation 71% and sold-out South, supporting a supply-tight pricing read.

name: Nitin Spinners Ltd
gLine: Spinning utilisation: 95% plus by end March 2027 (FY27)
thesis: Spinning utilisation over 98% and new capacity commercial by December 2026, but management says the EBITDA margin is 17.8% and guides no change to the 16-20% band, with cost pressures and slow fabric pass-through.

name: MTAR Technologies Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: ~INR500 cr total (INR400 cr in FY27) (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR406.8 cr (+200% YoY) and EBITDA margin 24.4%, but FY27 guidance of ~80% growth was held rather than raised, and the product-division figures were restated mid-call by about INR60 cr.

name: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd
gLine: Operating EBITDA margin (long term): 14.5% to 16% (long term)
thesis: Q2 FY27 volume up 26% to 15.49 lakh t and operating EBITDA margin 13.8%, but ~INR8,864 crore of capex still to deploy and the Maharashtra 9 MTPA plan adds a new capacity bet after FY29.

name: Epigral Ltd
gLine: Caustic/chlor-alkali pricing outlook: Caustic global price expected to rise in Q3 and Q4
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 28% to INR752cr but EBITDA margin squeezed by coal/energy-driven caustic costs; chlor-alkali pricing lagging, CPVC/ECH capacity commissioning within a quarter, ~INR400cr capex untouched.
top: CPVC and ECH plants commissioning within a quarter

name: Max Estates Ltd
gLine: OCF FY27: Rs 2,752 crore (as stated in call) (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 pre-sales of Rs 2,100 crore (274 units) with H1 at Rs 3,200 crore, but H1 collections of ~Rs 1,100 crore are below the Rs 2,500-2,700 crore FY27 target and the call gave no clear FY27 project deployment figure; supply-side discipline is limited to Rs 18,700 crore launched inventory and no capex cut.

name: Awfis Space Solutions Ltd
thesis: Flex operator reiterated FY27 guidance (22-25k gross seats, cash EBITDA INR190-200cr) with H1 cash EBITDA INR93cr, but capex and Transform pace need watching; supply additions steady, premium-tilted, occupancy up to 76.2% portfolio.

name: Sai Life Sciences Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: 700 Crores for this year (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY26 call (labelled Q2 FY27 in metadata) shows CDMO capacity adds of ~550 KL, 80–90% expansion, with ~77% utilisation and 700 Cr FY capex; growth guided at 15% CAGR over 3–5 years.

name: Dev Accelerator Ltd
gLine: Operational centres and seats post-pipeline: 4.16 million sq ft across 49 centers (Expansion plan)
thesis: Flexible-workspace operator reports record Q2 revenue INR 80.2 cr (+54.8% YoY) and cash EBIT margin 23.8%, but net debt rose to INR 185 cr and a 2.8 mn sq ft pipeline is still unopened, so the supply ramp is the key test.

name: Aye Finance Ltd
gLine: Operating expense ratio: 8.5% this year; ~8% next year (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Aye Finance Q2 FY27: AUM up 26% YoY to INR7,597 cr, credit cost 3.82% within 3.5-4% guide, NIM 15.6% above 14.25-14.75% band; supply-side metrics (branches flat, opex ratio 8.6%) support margin, but H2 growth depends on festive disbursements and a 3.5% credit cost exit.

name: Rajputana Stainless Ltd
gLine: Melting capacity: 48,000 t to 60,000 t (Q4 FY27)
thesis: Capacity fully utilised (~99%) with a 25% melt expansion to 60,000 t slated for Q4 FY27, funded internally, while H1 operating cash flow of ~INR4.5 cr lagged PAT of INR43.9 cr as receivables rose.
top: H1 OCF ~INR4.5 cr vs PAT INR43.9 cr

name: Reliance Industries Ltd
gLine: O2C EBITDA annualised: well over Rs.80,000 Crores (FY27)
thesis: Record O2C-led quarter with consol EBITDA Rs.62,409 Cr (+24% YoY) on refining and petchem cracks; management tracks H1 FY27 annualised EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Cr, but driven by supply disruption rather than structural capacity addition.
top: Middle East and Russia refining outages

name: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 25% plus (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up ~40% YoY to INR795 cr with EBITDA margin 14.4%; ibuprofen prices flat and capacity expansion (12k→18k MTPA) targeted only for FY28, but management raised FY27 revenue growth to ~25%+ from 15-20%.

name: Sterlite Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY29 EBITDA margin: about 30% (FY29)
thesis: Record Q2 FY27 revenue INR2,529 cr (+145% YoY) and 27.1% operational EBITDA margin; FY29 margin target raised to ~30%, but utilisation undisclosed and receivables/working capital drifting up.

name: Bank of Maharashtra
gLine: Credit pipeline disbursal: INR10,000 crores by March '27 (FY27)
thesis: Credit grew 23% ex-IBU and GNPA fell 47bp to 1.25%, but ECL front-loading of INR500cr and FCNR(B)/OFCB fund-raising at 6.1–6.5% lift cost of funds risk; drought stress unproven.

name: NTPC Ltd
gLine: FY28 capacity addition: 9.6 GW group (FY28)
thesis: NTPC cut FY27 group RE additions from about 9.5 GW to about 8 GW on transmission delays, while H1 added only 2,398 MW and 17.32 GW of thermal remains under construction with 4.8 GW more to tender.
top: Group RE FY27 target cut ~9.5 → ~8 GW

name: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Ltd
gLine: Hubs and spokes launch: 8 hubs and 14 spokes by Q1 FY28 (Q1 FY28)
thesis: Q2 revenue up 26.7% to ~INR 255 cr with 16.5% volume growth and EBITDA margin 44.1%; FY27 guide now "at least 20%" growth vs prior high double digit, with 8 hubs and 14 spokes capex of INR 155-160 cr.
top: FY27 growth cut to at least 20%

name: Keystone Realtors Ltd
gLine: Collections FY27: INR 3,000-3,100 crores (FY27)
thesis: Record Q2 presales INR 1,423 cr (+84% YoY) and EBITDA margin 14.5%, but OCF guidance cut from INR 1,000 cr to INR 700-800 cr and launches slipping into FY28 with no capacity-discipline signal beyond launch timing.
top: OCF FY27 cut to INR 700-800 cr

name: Anlon Healthcare Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR105.6 cr (+102% YoY) and EBITDA margin recovered to 23.9%, but utilisation is only 65-67% consolidated, the 25-30% margin target was reset to 23-25%, and receivables are stretched.

name: Shadowfax Technologies Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR1,538 cr (+57% YoY) with adjusted EBITDA margin 5%, but FY27 guidance was not revised and the company is adding capacity ahead of peak, with rental cost up 3.2% to 3.5% of revenue.

name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Ltd
thesis: Clean Max H1 FY27 EBITDA rose 56% to INR1,047 crore with 600 MW commissioned and capex at ~95% of budget; reiterated FY28 minimum INR3,000 crore EBITDA, but H1 operating cash flow turned negative on a vendor payment.
top: H1 operating cash flow negative on vendor payout

name: Apcotex Industries Ltd
gLine: Capex outflow remaining: Rs. 155 crores to be outflown by next year (FY28)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to ~11.7% from 12.1% as inventory losses (~1.5%) and aggressive export pricing offset volume growth of 7%; NBR commissioning still on track for ~April 2027, but nitrile latex expansion decision deferred.

name: Carysil Ltd
thesis: Carysil Q2 FY27 revenue up 14.6% to INR275.7 cr with granite sink utilisation 92% and stainless 91%; EBITDA margin fell to 19.4% on freight and raw material, FY27 guidance held at 15% growth and 18-20% margin.

name: Aarti Industries Ltd
gLine: Zone IV first 18 months bottom line: Rs 250-350 crore (18 months)
thesis: Record Q2 FY27 EBITDA Rs 418 crore (+44% YoY) on energy-led pricing, but working capital and net debt above Rs 4,650 crore, FY27 capex Rs 700-800 crore kept, and Zone IV capitalisation of Rs 1,800-1,900 crore by March 2027.
top: MMA ran almost full capacity Q2

name: Shilchar Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA: Rs200-250 cr (absolute, not margin) (FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue Rs192.61 cr (+43% QoQ) and EBITDA margin 20.8%; management targets Rs750 cr FY27 and Rs1,000 cr FY28 with Phase-3 (6,500 MVA) in April 2027, but gives no margin number and utilisation is still ramping.

name: PVR Inox Ltd
gLine: Depreciation impact: lower by INR35-40 crores a year (FY27)
thesis: Strong Q2 with EBITDA up 44% to INR 475 crores and margin 22.3%, but supply growth is back-loaded and FY27 capex guidance was raised to INR 300-320 crores (from ~350 prior); film hire guidance not discussed.

name: Astral Ltd
gLine: Plumbing EBITDA FY27: ~Rs1,050 cr (plumbing); ~Rs1,250 cr total
thesis: Astral H1 FY27 plumbing volume +10.1% and EBITDA margin 17.4% but Q2 consolidated margin 13.7% under pressure from high-cost inventory; management guides plumbing FY27 EBITDA ~Rs1,050 cr with H2 weighting, unverified by numbers.

name: V-Guard Industries Ltd
gLine: Volume growth H2 FY27: mid-teens (H2 FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue +38% and EBITDA margin 9.1% (vs 8.1%), but gross margin fell to 34.3% with a 3-4% pricing gap still open; management says H1 margin 9.6-10% and capex about INR150 crore for the year.

name: Bajaj Auto Ltd
gLine: Chetak capacity: 80,000 per month by Q4 (Q4 FY27)
thesis: Record Q2 FY27 volumes, EBITDA margin steady at 20.9% on 3-3.5% of revenue input inflation, only ~30% of Q2 inflation recovered via price; exports run-rate 750k/quarter and capacity expanding 625k to 775k/month.

name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd
gLine: Apollo brand and roofing growth: 15%-20% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 volume of 960,000 t was a record, but volume guidance was dropped and EBITDA growth of 20% kept, with Rs 6,000/t EBITDA claimed sustainable on branded and roofing mix while Dubai and SG Premium stay disrupted.

name: Pyramid Technoplast Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 volume recovery with utilisation at about 70% (up from 62%) and H1 EBITDA margin 9%, but the FY27 margin guide was reframed toward 11-12% and reliance on subsidy and solar savings is high, with transcript quality poor.

name: International Gemological Institute Ltd
gLine: Full-year revenue growth: outperform; similar to H1 (~27%), no number (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 volumes +26% and consolidated EBITDA +39%, but India EBITDA margin fell 340 bps to 69.5% and management raised FY27 outlook only qualitatively ("similar to H1" ~27% revenue growth) with no hard number.

name: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Ltd
thesis: Leela posted 30% RevPAR and 36% EBITDA growth in Q2 on pricing power, but supply is pipeline-led (1,000+ keys, Srinagar/Bandhavgarh slipping to end-CY27), with H2 EBITDA guidance held at high-teens.

name: Amanta Healthcare Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR420-430 crore annualised (full year) (FY27)
thesis: SteriPort Line 3 commissioned September but running ~55% and SVP capex slipped to Q1 FY28 with FY28 SVP revenue only INR16 crore; FY27 guidance of INR370 crore revenue and INR120 crore line top line quietly replaced by INR420-430 crore total.

name: Kiri Industries Ltd
gLine: Price realisation uplift: Q3 and Q4 significantly higher than Q1 and Q2 (Q3-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated loss of 39 crore after a 57 crore non-cash treasury mark-to-market hit, while dye/H-acid price pass-through is guided to lift Q3-Q4 with a one-quarter lag; China H-acid supply disruption is the key driver.
top: China H-acid output below half of need

name: RPG Life Sciences Ltd
gLine: Acquired API top line H2 FY27: INR 25-30 crore (H2 FY27)
thesis: Growth is mostly organic and volume-led in domestic formulations (H1 volume +6.8% vs market 3.4%), but Q2 DF slowed to 11.6% on inventory cuts and supply disruption; API acquisitions add capacity and capex is held below 7-8% of sales.

name: L&T Finance Ltd
gLine: Gold branches: 800 by end FY27; 2,000 long term (FY27 / Lakshya 2031)
thesis: Record PAT ₹975 Cr (+33% YoY) and credit cost down to 2.46%, but rural disbursements were deliberately throttled on drought, and Q2 personal-loan and collection softness is being explained away.

name: Speciality Restaurants Ltd
gLine: Same-store sales for Oriental brands: 10% to 15% (not specified)
thesis: Restaurant operator with revenue up 18.2% to INR 129.78 crores and same-store sales up 8.1% in Q2; no supply-side discipline signals, and the call does not revisit the prior FY27 store-addition or cash guidance.

name: Gokul Agro Resources Ltd
gLine: Volume growth: 10% next year, 10-15% thereafter (FY28 onward)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 3.68% (up ~74bp YoY) on price realisation, but management guides no volume growth this year and Sept destocking-style inventory build from import duty change; capex adds ~8 lakh tpa by Oct 2027.
top: Full capacity; no volume growth this year

name: Gamco Ltd
gLine: Hospitality revenue: INR100 crores per property (2-2.5 years post start)
thesis: A diversified NBFC-turned-asset holder: H1 FY27 revenue up 79% to INR254 crores with Q2 EBITDA margin only 9%, funded by rising borrowings (D/E 1.6x) and development-stage real estate, hospitality and warehousing with no capacity-discipline evidence.
top: Q2 profit fell from Q1 PAT INR32 crores

name: Aditya Vision Ltd
gLine: Store count FY27-end: around 230, up to 235 (FY27)
thesis: Aditya Vision's Q2 FY27 revenue rose 28% to Rs 586 crore with 214 stores, but October demand is slow, the 8-10% EBITDA guide is held, and 230+ store adds are guided.

name: Yasho Industries Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 volume up 62% YoY but EBITDA margin fell ~300bp QoQ to ~20-21% on freight and energy costs; management guides only "20% plus" and no longer 24%, with capex and FY28 contract timing intact.
top: EBITDA margin guide cut to 20% plus

name: CreditAccess Grameen Ltd
thesis: Microfinance lender (not metals; subsector set to Other) with NIM guided up and ROA raised to 5.2-5.8%, but credit cost rising into Q3 from drought and a 50 bps price cut is being passed on.

name: Restaurant Brands Asia Ltd
gLine: India store additions: 80-100 restaurants potentially in future (future)
thesis: India QSR delivered 14% SSSG and 7.8% company EBITDA with stores at 607/619 and ~70.4% gross margin held; Indonesia turnaround is early and capital is being earmarked, with no India growth capex plan funded from new equity.

name: Rolex Rings Ltd
gLine: Auto components revenue FY27: INR575-600 cr (FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue INR389 cr incl. ~INR18 cr one-time US duty refund; underlying growth ~32% with utilisation only 65%, so supply headroom remains and margin normalises to ~21% as freight eases.
top: US component revenue more than doubled

name: One 97 Communications Ltd
gLine: UPI MDR upside: 2.5 bps on GMV, ~Rs 700 crore at current scale (FY28)
thesis: Paytm Q2 FY27 shows 28% reported growth and MDR-on-UPI upside of about 2.5 bps (~Rs 700 crore on GMV), but the call gave no capacity or supply-side read; the prior LTV/customer-addition guidance was not repeated.

name: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd
gLine: AUM: INR 1.2 lakh crore for the year (FY27)
thesis: Wealth manager reports H1 FY27 PAT up about 23% to INR 238 crore and record net flows of INR 4,186 crore, but has no capacity or pricing supply signals; AUM guidance trimmed to a 2-3% mark-to-market dependent outlook.

name: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd
gLine: Cost of funds: further 20 bps cut by year end (FY26)
thesis: Q1 FY26 call (Aug 2025) for India Shelter: AUM up 34% YoY to Rs 8,712 cr, spreads 6.4%, but 30+DPD rose ~100bps and management held FY27 guidance; document provided is the Q1 transcript, not Q2 FY27.

name: RBZ Jewellers Ltd
gLine: Marketing spend: INR20-25 crore this year (FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue up 55% YoY to INR 225 crore but PAT margin fell to 7.3% from 12% on bullion-led gross margin dip, Surat store carrying cost and promotion spend; supply-side metrics thin.
top: Gross margin down on bullion sales

name: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: Advances growth FY27: 20% to 22% (FY27)
thesis: Small finance bank with steady asset quality (GNPA 2.36%) and NIM up to 4.24%, but ROTA ambition rests on NIM and opex, and management reaffirmed FY29 targets while flagging fee-income risk from IRDAI draft.

name: Gopal Snacks Ltd
gLine: Non-palm product share: 4.5% by end FY27; 6.5% next year (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 22.9% to INR 461.5 cr and EBITDA margin 9% (vs 6.4% LY), but utilisation at 37-38% and FY27 margin guide held at 8.9% with double-digit exit deferred; no capacity cut, supply still underused.

name: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd
gLine: Net profit margin: 7% to 7.5% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue Rs 1,898 cr (+31%) with capacity fully utilised; FY27 guide Rs 2,150-2,200 cr reiterated, Gujarat plant and Andhra heavy-structure line adding ~60k tonnes, but order book ~Rs 1,700 cr is capacity-capped and margins guided flat at ~9.3%.

name: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +11% to INR2,266 cr, EBITDA margin 17.2% (+60bps), but 6% price hikes sit mostly in H2 and store additions were 100+ in Q2 with H1 net adds ~86.

name: Brigade Hotel Ventures Ltd
gLine: Net debt to EBITDA FY28-FY29: 3.5 to 4x (FY28-FY29)
thesis: Hotel REIT-style operator: Q2 total income up 10% to INR142 crore with ADR up 11% to INR7,876, rate-led; capex slipping to ~INR400 crore in FY27 and H2 FY28 openings pushed to year-end, so supply is disciplined.

name: Seshaasai Technologies Ltd
gLine: eSIM revenue: Not in FY27 plan; hope to begin by turn of year (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 4,053m (+15% YoY) and gross margin 42.5% (+89 bps QoQ, still -331 bps YoY); no explicit FY27 guidance restated, IoT growth reiterated at ~45%, capex not updated.

name: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Ltd
gLine: H2 FY27 sales growth: 40%-45% (H2 FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 23.8% (H1 26.3%) on 46% revenue growth, but the company is a retailer with no capacity-discipline disclosure; management is hedged on H2 and said FY27 margin could move ±200bps.

name: Sai Parenterals Ltd
gLine: Gross margin: above 45% in coming quarters (next quarters)
thesis: Q2 gross margin jumped to 47.5% on inventory clean-up and H1 revenue of Rs 376 crore is half of the Rs 750 crore FY27 target, but capex-heavy build-out keeps debt at Rs 357 crore and receivables are stretched.

name: Lohia Corp Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 30% to 35% (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR594 cr (+42% YoY) and order book ~INR2,000 cr (+93% YoY), but management guides FY28 growth only 10–15% and capacity tops out near INR2,500 cr; EBITDA margin held near 19–21% target.

name: LMW Ltd
gLine: Machine tool growth: ~50% for current year (FY27)
thesis: LMW's Q2 revenue rose 30% to ₹1,153 crore with TMD utilisation only ~60%, MTD at 75–80%, and management calling the textile cost environment "very tough" with no price pass-through yet.

name: Greaves Cotton Ltd
gLine: Company-wide pricing benefit: Full benefit reflected by Q4 FY27 (Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue +44% to INR1,176 cr but consolidated EBITDA margin only 6.2% (Q1 5.8%) as commodity inflation outran pricing; price pass-through lags to Q3-Q4 FY27 with no numeric margin guidance raised.

name: Balkrishna Industries Ltd-$
gLine: Pirelli offtake volume: 800,000 Pirelli-branded tyres per year by 2030 (ramp from 2027) (CY2030)
thesis: Pirelli offtake of 800,000 car tyres/yr by CY2030 is a conversion-margin contract using existing Bhuj PCR capacity (6,700/day, ~80% kept for BKT); no new capex stated and no margin or revenue numbers given.

name: Symphony Ltd
thesis: Symphony's Q2 standalone EBITDA margin held near 13% with asset-light launches of RAC, BLDC fans and purifiers, but no hard numbers were given and the Australia capital guidance was not addressed.

name: Rajratan Global Wire Ltd
gLine: Consolidated volume FY27: ~160,000 tons (vs 133,000 FY26) (FY27)
thesis: Capacity expansion is being added on top of near-full utilisation (Thailand ~100%, Chennai rated 40k t), but margins are flat-to-down and price relief is deferred to the next quarter or two.

name: Timken India Ltd
gLine: Bharuch utilisation at year end: 70% to 75% (FY27 year end)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR 969 crore, up 25.4% YoY, with PBT margin 16.1%; new Bharuch plant running at about 60% against a 70% target, and cost inflation is being passed through with a lag.

name: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd
thesis: Credit cost fell to 2.19% from 2.40% and GNPA to 1.20% from 1.37%, but no capital-cycle or supply signal; growth is retail-led with AUM up 10.4% QoQ and management pitching margin expansion over ~2 years.

name: Sanghvi Movers Ltd
gLine: FY27 debt to equity: 0.7-0.75 (FY27)
thesis: Crane rental utilisation held at 78% H1 with India yield 2.24%, but Saudi capex of INR80-90 cr deferred to FY28 and FY27 guidance reaffirmed while order book is only INR1,582 cr with 8-10% expected to spill over.

name: Antelopus Selan Energy Ltd-$
gLine: Capex FY27: Rs.250 crores (FY27)
thesis: Onshore E&P ramping: October output ~2,000 BOEPD against a 2,500 exit guide for FY27, with Q2 volumes flat QoQ, realisations down 7% and EBITDA margin ~71% at ~$88 oil.

name: Trishakti Industries Ltd
gLine: Gross block: more than INR 1,000 crore by FY30 (FY30)
thesis: Crane rental fleet at ~100% utilisation with ~INR 370 crore deployed and INR 95 crore in CWIP, but debtor days drifting up and management pushing a 2030 INR 1,000 crore gross-block target with debt-led funding.
top: Gross block target INR 1,000 cr by FY30

name: Somany Ceramics Ltd
thesis: Somany Q2 FY27 margin rose to 11.7% on utilisation and full price pass-through, but volume only ~5.5% and FY27 guidance trimmed to margin +2–2.5pp; Morbi export shutdowns support domestic supply discipline.

name: Marico Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: Teens growth; comfortably cross INR15,000 crores; opportunity to push to mid-teens (FY27)
thesis: Marico raised FY27 EBITDA growth to mid-20s (24-25%+) from ~20% and revenue to teens with upside to mid-teens, driven by softer copra and mix; India volume now guided double-digit, with A&P rising 44% in the quarter.

name: Info Edge (India) Ltd
gLine: Naukri sales growth: sales to keep growing higher than 10% YoY; internal target 14-15% billings
thesis: Naukri billings healthy at 13% reported (14-15% underlying per management), 99acres turning cash-positive with 21% billing growth, but CEO Hitesh Oberoi stepping down with no named successor and Shiksha billings down 27%.

name: Kuantum Papers Ltd
gLine: Price increase Q3-Q4: 7% to 11% by year-end (Q3-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 12.4% (EBITDA INR35 crore) on lean season and input costs; management guides H2 margin ~14% and a 7-11% price hike, versus the prior 16-18% FY27 exit target now looking unattainable.

name: Gravita India Ltd
gLine: Lead volume growth: 18% to 20% CAGR for next three years (3 years)
thesis: Q2 FY27 volumes up only 3% and lead volumes down ~11% on scrap shortage; copper EBITDA of INR84,671/t is flattered by one-off high-value orders, management guides INR65-70k sustainable, below prior INR55k-to-60k path, and copper utilisation is 50% in H1, short of the 60% target.

name: Punjab & Sind Bank
gLine: Deposit growth: 13% to 14% (FY27)
thesis: Advances grew 19.28% to Rs.1,25,919 crore with NIM 2.77% and ROA 0.88%, but CASA slipped to 28.83%, ECL adds ~Rs.700 crore net worth hit, and capital raise of Rs.7,000 crore is pending.

name: Shalby Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: double-digit growth (FY27)
thesis: Hospital EBITDA margin fell to 18.2% from 19.5% and consolidated EBITDA flat at INR46.4 crore on 9.8% revenue growth; capex cut to INR10 crore in H1 from INR160 crore last year, but prior margin and ROCE guidance went unaddressed.

name: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd
gLine: Advances growth: 22% plus (FY27)
thesis: Record INR451 cr profit and 27.25% business growth, but NIM guided down to 4.10% ±5bp and ECL gap of about INR81 cr (INR304 cr held vs INR385 cr needed) keeps the cost of growth rising.

name: Krystal Integrated Services Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin band: 6.25% to 7.5% (medium to long term)
thesis: Facility-management services firm growing revenue 46% in Q2 but EBITDA margin slipped to 6.0% from 6.32% on employee cost; no capacity or capex discipline signal, growth is contract-led manpower.

name: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: >20% (FY27)
thesis: Emcure's Q2 FY27 beat with revenue +24% and EBITDA margin 20.4%, and FY27 revenue growth guidance was raised to above 20% from mid-teens; net debt of INR1,317 crore is above the ~INR1,450 crore target, with no capacity-discipline evidence either way.

name: Ceigall India Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 standalone revenue +23.8% and consolidated EBITDA margin 17%, but order inflow is 5,400 crore of a 6,000 crore target and H1 operating cash flow was negative; a transcript-quality read with heavy translation noise.
top: Consolidated operating cash flow negative in H1

name: Black Buck Ltd
thesis: Core revenue up 31% YoY and telematics device sales at record, but vehicle finance break-even reiterated only qualitatively and tolling GTV flat near Rs 7,000 crore; supply-side signals are thin for a capital-cycle read.
top: Telematics device sales at new high

name: Yash Highvoltage Ltd
gLine: Greenfield + Brownfield revenue potential: INR900-1,000 cr combined by 2030-31 (FY31)
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up 95% to INR194.5 cr with gross margin 48.3% and order book INR760 cr, but capacity is still ramping: greenfield localized core not yet type-tested and volume growth ~40%.

name: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Ltd
gLine: H2 revenue vs H1: H2 revenue to be higher than H1 with similar margins (H2 FY27)
thesis: Aero tooling and precision components show strong H1 growth (+85% revenue, 38% EBITDA), but utilisation is ~65% with capacity still available, and capex has not been raised beyond the Saudi JV and special process cells; order book INR855 cr is largely LTAs and award letters, not firm POs.

name: JSW Cement Ltd
gLine: North Q4 EBITDA per ton: INR650-700/t (Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q2 volume up 26% to 3.93 Mt and North hit EBITDA breakeven, but cement realisation fell 3% QoQ and net debt/EBITDA rose to 3.2x; October price hikes are not yet visible in trade prices.

name: Urban Company Ltd
gLine: Consolidated NTV growth Q2+Q3 combined: 50% to 55% (Q2 and Q3 FY27)
thesis: Urban Company's Q2 FY27 shows NTV up 39.1% to ₹1,432.3 crore and loss-making Native and International narrowing, but the ₹2,500 crore fundraise and continued aggressive spending keep losses elevated.

name: Pace Digitek Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs 3,300-3,500 crore (FY27)
thesis: BESS capacity doubled to 5 GWh with 10 GWh due Q4, but FY27 revenue guidance raised to Rs 3,300-3,500 cr and Q2 container output ~100 vs 210 guided, with H1 operating cash flow negative Rs 542 cr.

name: Digilogic Systems Ltd
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up 91% to INR34.96 cr and PAT up 151%, but margin gains are attributed to FD interest income; order book only INR20 cr with H2 back-end loaded and FY27 25-30% growth reaffirmed without a new number.

name: Devson Catalyst Ltd
gLine: New 5,088 MTPA capacity operational: Q1 FY28 (Q1 FY28)
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up only 1.14% to INR31.69 cr as Hormuz cut exports to 6.72% of sales from 42.95%; catalyst sales doubled to INR25.31 cr, offsetting a ceramic ball slump; a 5,088 MTPA expansion is slated for Q1 FY28.

name: Surya Roshni Ltd
gLine: Steel capacity FY28: 14 lakh tons volume, EBITDA/ton INR4,600–4,800 (FY28)
thesis: Steel pipe EBITDA/ton recovered to INR4,185 in Q2 from INR4,006 in Q1 but remains below the INR4,600–4,700 FY27 guide; management still promises ~INR5,000 by Q4, and the buyback decision stays pending.
top: Steel EBITDA/ton guide below prior INR4,600–4,700

name: Sunteck Realty Ltd
gLine: Launch pipeline FY27 ex-Dubai: INR70 billion (FY27)
thesis: Real estate developer with no capacity utilisation or supply-discipline metric; H1 presales +19% YoY, management reiterates 25% FY27 presales guidance on a H2-weighted INR7,000 cr launch pipeline, while BD spend rose to ~INR400 cr in H1.

name: Heritage Foods Ltd
gLine: Milk procurement price trajectory Q3: Expected to stay elevated, around 11% YoY, no expected drop
thesis: Heritage Q2 FY27 revenue +19% to INR13,196m and EBITDA margin 5.6% (+98bp QoQ), but raw milk procurement cost +11% YoY with management expecting no relief in Q3 and only ~8% price pass-through.
top: Weighted price hike ~8% vs milk cost +11%

name: Bank of India
gLine: Global deposits growth FY27: 16-17% (FY27)
thesis: Bank of India guides FY27 advances 15-16% and deposits 16-17%, ROA above 1% by March 2027, and CASA ratio slipped to 34.16%; ECL front-loading from Q3 is the key unquantified risk.

name: Solar Industries India Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: average 29% by year-end (FY27)
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue INR7,187 crores (+70% YoY) and EBITDA margin about 28.45%; management says it will beat FY27 guidance of INR14,000 crores but declined to revise guidance and gave no capex or capacity numbers.

name: DLF Ltd
gLine: Rental exit run-rate (DLF): INR 175-180 crore per quarter at full potential
thesis: Pre-sales of INR 3,800 crore and a INR 15,000 crore unsold inventory base, but reported revenue is held back by completed-contract accounting until FY28 project completions; the INR 738 crore revenue figure was a one-time fair-valuation gain, not operating.

name: Sejal Glass Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated income up 33% to INR139.86 cr with EBITDA margin 18.35%, but Taloja/Erode still near break-even and utilisation levels low; guidance on 25-40% growth held, Q2 guide of INR140-145 cr met at ~INR140 cr.

name: VA Tech Wabag Ltd
thesis: Record order book Rs 20,207 cr (4x revenue) and H1 intake Rs 5,200 cr, but EBITDA margin 13.8% H1 and Q2 14.5%; guidance reiterated, no FY27 numeric revision, Middle East shipping delays flagged.

name: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd
thesis: H1 FY25 orders up 17.5% to INR 1,104 cr and sales up 20.3% to INR 1,193 cr, with gross margin up 3 points to 39.5%; but no capacity-utilisation figure was given and management only said capacity is being ramped.
top: Capacity ramp-up; Kolkata plant on track

name: Sportking India Ltd
gLine: Odisha plant FY27 revenue contribution: INR150 to INR200 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 19.8% vs 10.4% a year ago; management sees H1 spreads (about INR141/kg Q2 vs INR133 Q1) holding for 6 months, with 150,000-spindle Odisha plant starting commercial output in 30-40 days.

name: Mahindra Logistics Ltd
gLine: PAT positivity for MESPL: next few months and quarters (near term)
thesis: Consolidated gross margin flat YoY at 10.1%; MESPL (Rivigo) turned EBITDA positive at INR2.3 crore, but management pushed contract-logistics 100 bps gross margin target out as medium term with manpower costs not fully passed through.

name: Bharat Parenterals Ltd
gLine: Varenyam Bio construction completion: Q2 calendar 2028 (FY28)
thesis: Group turned profitable in Q2 on Innoxel licensing (33% EBITDA margin), but standalone H1 revenue was flat and margins fell on input costs; FY27 guidance held with Innoxel margin flagged as below band.

name: Artemis Medicare Services Ltd
gLine: Raipur breakeven: 12 to 15 months (12-15 months)
thesis: Gurgaon margin hit a record 23.8% at 68% occupancy, but Raipur (300 beds, ~INR 9-10 cr quarterly loss, 10% occupancy) and an open oncology pricing risk (0.5-0.8% EBITDA) dominate the call.
top: Oncology drug price cap risk, 0.5-0.8% EBITDA

name: KFin Technologies Ltd
industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
gLine: PAT margin: 25% to 30% (FY27)
thesis: KFin's Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin rebounded to 40% incl. Ascent (45.8% ex-Ascent) and management held FY27 guidance, but Q2 is seasonally strong, H1 PAT growth was only ~3%, and Ascent remains loss-making with a slower Middle East book.

name: Kalyani Cast-Tech Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR170 crore (order book target)
thesis: Container and wagon maker: order book about INR133 crore targeting INR170 crore FY27 revenue, Rewari at 75-80% utilisation, 10,000 TEU Shivlakha plant ramping with 500 units built since June.
top: First half 'not started as per our expectations'

name: Azad Engineering Ltd
gLine: Annual revenue run-rate: >Rs1300 cr by end FY28 (FY28)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue Rs187.8 cr (+31.6% YoY) with EBITDA margin 37.5%, but capacity ramp only from Q3/Q4 and working capital still stretched (receivables Rs402 cr, inventory Rs425 cr), so cash conversion is unproven.
top: Inventory up Rs98 cr in H1 to Rs425 cr

name: Anand Rathi Share And Stock Brokers Ltd
gLine: Broking revenue growth: 15-20% (medium term)
thesis: Broking-led growth with MTF book at INR14,993m (57% of FY target) and zero MTF NPAs; no supply-side levers, but management guides 15-20% top-line and 20-25% to 30% bottom-line growth.

name: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd
gLine: Module utilisation: 45% to 60% range
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA Rs557cr at 35.3% margin with cell utilisation 89% but module utilisation only 44%, and a 6 GW integrated expansion (capex ~Rs5,500cr) adds 6 GW of modules and cells through March 2027.

name: Admach Systems Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: INR15-16 crores (FY27)
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up 48% to INR42.2 cr with ~23% EBITDA margin, order book INR77.4 cr, but no capacity-discipline or utilisation data and management gave no hard capex numbers beyond ~INR15-16 cr.

name: OnEMI Technology Solutions Ltd
gLine: AUM growth FY27: 60% plus (FY27)
thesis: Credit cost fell to 6.2% of average AUM from 9.3% a year ago, cost of borrowing down to 13.76%, and AUM up 68% YoY to Rs 9,317 crore while guidance was raised.

name: GSPL Transmission Ltd
gLine: Expansion capex completion: ~INR 3,000 cr by March 2028, balance by Apr-Jun 2028 (FY28)
thesis: Regulated gas pipeline operator with flat H1 profit (PAT +1%) and a INR 3,500 crore expansion mostly back-ended to FY28; volumes up 12% YoY on a re-based contractual metric, with subsidiaries GIGL and GITL still loss-making.

name: Bata India Ltd
gLine: New COCO stores: double-digit new store openings next year
thesis: Bata's 2QFY27 growth of 7.5% was ASP-led (5-6% ASP, volume only marginal) with no capacity signal; margins guided range-bound and the doubling-by-2030 ambition has no numeric year-by-year path.

name: NCC Ltd
thesis: Q2 console revenue up 32% to Rs 6,042 crore and H1 margin 9.1%, but FY27 guidance held at 8-10% growth despite H1 up 21%, implying a weak H2; order inflow at only ~50% of the lower band.
top: FY27 growth guide held despite H1 +21%

name: Pidilite Industries Ltd
thesis: Q2 standalone UVG 10.7% and H1 UVG 11% held, but EBITDA margin fell to 20.4% on VAM at ~$1,630 avg; management reaffirms 20–24% corridor, upper end for H2 after 12–15% price hikes and October round.
top: Price hikes 12–15% in Q1, more in Oct

name: Banswara Syntex Ltd-$
gLine: Double-digit growth and overall double-digit EBITDA: at least double-digit growth; EBITDA double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Integrated yarn-fabric-garment player reaffirmed FY27 guidance despite 3 divisions showing volume declines and net debt up INR43 crore in H1 on working capital; top-line growth is price and mix, not capacity.
top: Net debt up INR43 crore in H1

name: South Indian Bank Ltd
gLine: ROA medium term: 1.25% to 1.30% (medium term)
thesis: Asset quality at multi-year best (GNPA 1.24%, slippage 0.09%) with NIM rising to 3.33%, but management signals opex growth above guidance and ROA target pushed to 1.20-1.25% within a year.
themes: Segment mix shift retail vs corporate

name: Punjab National Bank
gLine: Domestic NIM FY27 trajectory: further improvement; 7-9bp addition in Q3 (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Domestic NIM rose 10bp QoQ to 2.74% and management guides 7-9bp more from repo hike, but credit cost guided 0.25-0.30% after ECL transition needing only ~INR 5,000 crore more; recovery target trimmed to INR 12,000-13,000 crore.

name: UNO Minda Ltd-$
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 38% to INR 6,655 cr with EBITDA margin 11%; management held FY27 11% ±50bp margin guide despite unrecovered commodity pass-through, and capacity keeps expanding (alloy wheels to 9 mn, ~INR 1,415 cr new projects).

name: LT Foods Ltd
gLine: Organic EBITDA margin: 10 to 11% in the coming 2 years (2 years)
thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin slid to 11.0% (from 11.5% in Q1) on freight and ad spend; management reiterated 13-13.5% long-term margin but gave no timeline, and Middle East volumes were hit by supply disruption.

name: Firstsource Solutions Ltd
industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
gLine: FY27 constant currency revenue growth: 10.5% to 13% (FY27)
thesis: Firstsource raised FY27 constant-currency revenue floor to 10.5% (from 10%) and reaffirmed 12.25–12.75% EBIT margin; no supply-side or capex signal, growth and margin story is management-led with H2 back-loading.

name: Central Bank of India
gLine: ECL provision requirement: Rs.5,000 to Rs.5,500 crores (Apr 1, 2027)
thesis: Strong Q2 FY27 headline growth (advances +29.8%, deposits +14.4%, NIM 3.01%, ROA 1.03%) but CASA missed guidance at 44.65% and cost-to-income at 58.95% missed sub-56% target; ECL transition adds ₹5,000-5,500 crore hit risk.

name: Bajaj Consumer Care Ltd
gLine: Aarohan 2.0 direct distribution expansion: 10% year-on-year (next six quarters)
thesis: Consumer hair-oil FMCG with no capacity signal; H1 revenue up 28% to INR674 crore and gross margin fell to 59.9% in Q2, cushioned by cost cuts, with a ~5% price increase planned for Q3.
top: Another ~5% consumer price increase in Q3

name: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd
gLine: FY27 gross collections: 24,000-25,000 crore
thesis: Residential pre-sales of ₹7,225 cr in Q2 (+20% YoY) and ₹13,804 cr in H1, with FY27 pre-sales guidance held at ₹36,000 cr and ₹4,500–5,000 cr BD spend; supply discipline is not the story, demand and launch timing are.

name: Wonderla Holidays Ltd
gLine: Chennai optimal utilisation and sustainable profitability: 2 to 3 years (2-3 years)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA up 90% to INR30 crore on young Chennai park (INR28 crore revenue, 1.9 lakh footfall), but existing parks grew only 8% and management guided Chennai to optimal utilisation in 2–3 years, with no new park capex decision yet.

name: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Ltd
gLine: Tirex capacity: 3,000 chargers by end of this year (end FY27)
thesis: Q2 volume up 16% (core lube 47,000 KL vs 40,500 KL), margin 11.8% just below 12-14% band, working capital build from price inflation; management guides H2 lube growth at 2x-3x industry and Silvassa slipping one to two months.
top: Silvassa readiness slips to Q1 FY28

name: Snowman Logistics Ltd
gLine: Indore ICD: operational by December 2027
thesis: Snowman's warehousing is near 85% utilised with ~23,000 pallets under construction, but margins keep sliding on 5PL mix, wage hikes and unpassed-through costs; Q2 pallet-count growth was ~10% y/y.

name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +18.2% to Rs 2,263 cr with price-led gross margin restoration (~80% of cost increases passed through), but capacity is outsourced and no capex is quantified, so supply-side read is neutral.
top: Price increases ~80% of cost passed on

name: Prataap Snacks Ltd
gLine: Medium-term EBITDA margin: 9-10% sustainable (2-3 years)
thesis: Q2 revenue up 26% YoY on 17% volume, but EBITDA margin fell to 2.4% as gross margin dropped to 25.5% from 29.8%; H2 margin targeted near H1's ~3%.

name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd
thesis: Home First grew AUM 27% YoY to Rs 18,010 cr with spread steady at 5.2% and credit cost 40 bps; supply-side signals are limited to branch adds, and management is holding its spread and opex guidance rather than raising it.

name: Aether Industries Ltd
gLine: Semiconductor revenue at maturity: INR300-400 crore (2029)
thesis: Aether's CEM/CRAMS book is ramping at the Magnum site with 14 of 16 blocks lined up, but capex is held at INR350-370 crores and inventory days rose to 172 from 151 in March.

name: Modis Navnirman Ltd
gLine: Revenue from projects completing in H2: approx INR200 crores (by 31 March 2027)
thesis: Redevelopment developer reports H1 FY27 revenue INR127.64 cr (+53% YoY) and sales INR202 cr, but H1 operating cash flow was negative (INR16.51 cr) and management gave no capacity or capex metrics.
top: H1 operating cash flow negative INR16.51 cr

name: Indegene Ltd
thesis: Q2 revenue up 5.6% QoQ to INR11,223m with EBITDA margin 16.7% after 150bp wage hit; margin recovery to 19%+ by Q4 rests on a $10m outcome-based deal weighted to Q4 and unverified.

name: Swiggy Ltd
gLine: Quick commerce sequential NOV growth: double-digit QoQ (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Swiggy guides Q3 quick-commerce NOV to double-digit QoQ and 100 bps Adjusted EBITDA improvement, while Toing losses are range-bound and food EBITDA holds the 5% GOV path; supply discipline is only partial as store additions track throughput.

name: Tata Capital Ltd
gLine: NIM plus fee trajectory: Q3 stable to marginally better; Q4 distinct improvement (Q3-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Consolidated AUM up 26% YoY to INR3,08,030 cr with credit cost down to 0.9%, but NIM+fee dipped ~10 bps in Q2, motor finance still shrinking, and management reaffirmed FY27 AUM guidance of 23-25% (26% delivered in Q2).
top: Revolving credit and insurance rules risk

name: Physicswallah Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 record revenue INR1,242 cr (+18%) and Pre-Ind AS EBITDA INR233 cr at 18.8%, but offline is loss-making (H1 EBITDA loss ~INR108 cr) and NEET recovery is incomplete; FY27 guidance reaffirmed without numbers.

name: Susan Electricals India Ltd
thesis: Susan Electricals is shifting mix toward HT/MV covered conductors (HT ~30% of Q2 sales vs 0.75% in H1 FY26) while H1 EBITDA margin slipped to ~11.8%, with receivables and capacity expansion still pending.

name: Kanohar Electricals Ltd
thesis: Q2 revenue INR208.6 cr (+112% YoY) and 35% EBITDA margin, but capacity utilisation is only ~10.5% per quarter on 19,200 MVA; FY27 guidance held at INR950 cr and FY26-level margin (~28%) despite a 32% H1 run-rate.

name: Glass Wall Systems (India) Ltd
thesis: Order book Rs.957 cr (Sep-26) with management targeting Rs.500 cr+ inflow in H2 to hold 18-month visibility; capacity at 55-60% utilisation, so supply is not the constraint, but export bookings are stalled and margins were lifted by a one-off escalation claim.

name: LCC Projects Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: around 20% or more (2-3 years)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +34% YoY to Rs 886 cr with EBITDA margin 15.5%, but receivables jumped to Rs 674 cr (WC days 123) and FY guidance of Rs 4,300-4,400 cr needs a steep H2 ramp; order book Rs 8,154 cr.

name: Sahajanand Medical Technologies Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin expansion: 150-200 bps per year, ~20% by FY2029 (FY2027-FY2029)
thesis: Record Q2 with revenue up 24.7% to ~INR373 cr and EBITDA up 36.6%, but supply-side evidence is mixed: Surat PTCA utilisation fell and Telangana DES sits at 20%, while capex is held at ~INR70 cr for FY27-28.

name: Shree Cement Ltd
gLine: Tax rate FY27: 31% to 32% (FY27)
thesis: India volume +18% YoY to 9.31 Mt at 56% utilisation, but EBITDA/t fell to INR966 on fuel; capex H2 guided INR700-800 cr versus prior ~INR1,500 cr full year, implying a cut.

name: SKF India Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: close to INR 200 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 sales +16% YoY on volume, but EBITDA margin fell to ~14.5% as steel and supplier cost hikes ran ahead of customer price recovery; management expects catch-up by December quarter, with capex at ~INR200 crore in FY27 and new lines from December 2026.
top: Customer price increases not yet billed

name: Sagar Cements Ltd-$
gLine: FY28 volume: 8 to 8.25 million tonnes (FY28)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA/t only ₹265 with loss of ₹52 crore; management now guides FY27 EBITDA ₹350–375 crore (~₹525/t) versus ₹410 crore prior, on ~₹500/t realisation gain from late-September price hikes.

name: Elecon Engineering Company Ltd
thesis: Elecon H1 FY27 revenue +11% with Q2 EBITDA margin 23.1%, but guidance cut to mid-to-high single/medium double-digit growth for H2 from prior low double-digit, with utilisation ~60% and no capacity-discipline signal.

name: Birlanu Ltd
gLine: Parador cost-out (BCG) value envelope: EUR 9-14 million EBITDA (FY27-28)
thesis: India business revenue +17% to Rs 588 cr with EBITDA margin 6.8% (+400bp), but Parador keeps taking losses and a further Rs 90 cr provision lifts cumulative to Rs 164 cr; no capacity discipline signal, pricing-led growth.
top: Parador provision Rs 90 cr, cumulative Rs 164 cr

name: WSFx Global Pay Ltd
gLine: Trade remittance go-live: by December and January (Dec-Jan)
thesis: Q2 turnover INR2,914 cr (+41.2% YoY) and PBT INR5.33 cr (+9.6%), but PBT margin compressed as commissions rose to ~58% of revenue; no capex or capacity discipline signals, and prior guidance was not quantified.

name: Veerhealth Care Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: ~100 crore (FY27)
thesis: Small contract personal-care maker targets ₹100 cr FY27 revenue from ~₹25 cr Q1 run-rate, but capacity is 65-75% utilised and funding, customer concentration and receivables are unverified.

name: Havells India Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 35% with EBITDA up ~30%, but cables contribution margin fell (~15% H1 vs prior-year peak) and Lloyd margins stayed weak; management gave no numeric guidance and pricing of 5–7% more is planned for Q3.

name: CCL Products (India) Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 volume up 10-15% but EBITDA up only ~9.5% to INR217cr; management guides 15% volume and similar EBITDA growth, utilisation ~70% consol with FD tighter and FD expansion of ~6,000t under evaluation.

name: Menon Bearings Ltd-$
gLine: FY28 revenue growth: more than 30% (FY28)
thesis: Menon Bearings reports record H1 FY27 revenue of INR194.9 crore (+47%) and EBITDA margin near 20-22%, but supply-side evidence is thin: capex is small (~INR9.5 crore over 12-15 months) and management guides to >30% growth with no numeric capacity plan.
top: US inventory build-up stated to be unwinding

name: Ipca Laboratories Ltd
gLine: Institutional business FY27: INR325 crores to INR340 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated sales up 14% to INR2,910 crores and EBITDA margin 22.97%, with FY27 guidance held; Unichem margin dipped to 11.3% on freight costs, and no capacity or capex signals were given.

name: Balaji Amines Ltd-$
gLine: Specialty Chemicals / group revenue: INR3,500-4,000 crores at FY28-29 top line (FY28-FY29)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA rose 58% YoY to INR106 crores at a 22% margin, but volumes fell 6% YoY and fell sequentially below the prior-year base; expansions slipped to FY-end and utilisation is still 15-20% on the new methylamine unit.

name: Zydus Wellness Ltd-$
thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated sales up 74.6% to INR 11,227m on Comfort Click acquisition, but Comfort Click growth slowed to 12% LFL and management gave no numeric margin guidance beyond a 14-15% Comfort Click EBITDA steady state.

name: Apollo Pipes Ltd
gLine: Kisan EBITDA breakeven: Rs 3,000-4,000/t within 6-9 months (6-9 months)
thesis: Q2 volume up 13% YoY to 24,501 tonnes and revenue up 31%, but margins remain thin (Kisan EBITDA about Rs 3,700/t vs ~Rs 9,000 in Q1); management still pins plumbing EBITDA at Rs 10,000/t and is expanding capacity from internal cash flow.

name: Cyient Ltd
gLine: TAO Digital revenue (next 12 months): $100 to $110 million
thesis: DET organic revenue grew only 1.6% QoQ and 0.4% YoY in constant currency, with EBIT margin up to 14.2% on cost cuts; the headline beat leans on TAO Digital M&A and FX.

name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
thesis: Airtel's Q1 call shows ARPU-led growth with supply discipline in radio capex, but FWA was pulled back on acquisition quality and B2B growth is capex-heavy; the 4-5% ARPU architecture view is restated as a multi-year wish, not guidance.
top: Radio capex moderated over last couple years

name: Indian Bank
gLine: Deposit growth: 11-12% (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 PSU bank call: advances growth raised to 13-14% and deposit guide to 11-12%, but NIM tailwind is modest at 5-6 bps and ECL top-up of Rs.2,500 crore so far with Rs.3,500 crore total expected.

name: V2 Retail Ltd
gLine: Pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin FY27: 7% to 8% (more than 7.5%)
thesis: Q2 revenue +28% and gross margin 31.1% (+310bps) on lower discounting, but SSSG -14.9% reported and H2 store adds cut to 60-70 with FY27 SSSG guide effectively trimmed to 5-7% and debt rising to INR528 crores.

name: Paisalo Digital Ltd
gLine: App go-live: live in Q3, metrics from Q1 FY28 (Q3-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Paisalo grew AUM 33% and PAT 27% in Q2 with NIM at 5.7% vs ~6% target, cost of funds down to 10%, and management leaning on yield-timing and AI-efficiency explanations; no capacity or industry supply discipline evidence.

name: Bigbloc Construction Ltd
gLine: Utilisation H2 FY27: up to 75% (H2 FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 3.98% (H1 5.93%) with utilisation 69%, but input costs up 8-12% and only 5-7% passed on; management guides 75% H2 utilisation, no numeric debt or margin targets reiterated.

name: Mitsu Chem Plast Ltd
gLine: IBC plant start: Operational by Q3 FY27 (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue up only 3.67% YoY to Rs 95.8 cr while EBITDA margin hit 12.41% on mix and cost; capacity utilisation is ~64% with management claiming ~Rs 425 cr achievable without new capex, against a Rs 1,000 cr FY28 target with no bridge.
top: Rs 1,000 cr FY28 target lacks bridge

name: Varun Beverages Ltd
gLine: International capex: $90-100 million (CY27)
thesis: India volume +22.5% in Q3 with realisation only +0.5%, while packaging cost hit ~300 bps of gross margin; management says gross margin likely troughed this quarter, though 20%+ India growth prior guidance was not explicitly restated with numbers.

name: Housing & Urban Development Corporation Ltd
thesis: HUDCO Q2 FY27: loan book up 29% to INR1.86 lakh crore and disbursement above INR35,000 crore, but management reiterated a ~2% spread with 3% NIM despite a 15bp MCLR hike and a cost of funds around 7.07%.

name: Synergy Green Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: 17-18% in H2 (H2 FY27)
thesis: Capacity utilisation 75% in H1 with 80% FY27 target and 85% H2 implied; FY27 revenue 33% growth reiterated, but H1 PBDIT margin 8.9% vs ~16% guided due to input cost inflation, so margin guidance is at risk.

name: The Anup Engineering Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: 840-860 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue weak on under-absorption, but order inflow recovered to ~283 crore in Q2 and pending order book ~941 crore; management guides FY27 revenue 840-860 crore and EBITDA 120-128 crore, implying Q4 margins of 20%+.
top: No new capacity capex for two years

name: Computer Age Management Services Ltd
industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
gLine: CAMSPay growth: early 30% per year for next 2 years (2 years)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +10% to INR415 cr and EBITDA +13.5% to ~INR191 cr with MF AUM only +12.5%; non-MF +21-22% at ~19% margin, but cost growth held near 7% and FY27 guidance largely reiterated, not raised.

name: Devyani International Ltd
gLine: Biryani By Kilo brand contribution: 14%-15% short to medium term
thesis: Devyani Q2 FY27: consolidated revenue up 10.4% to INR 1,519 crore and operating EBITDA up ~34% to INR 125 crore, but supply signals are expansionary (KFC +50 stores) and price hikes are small at 1-2% YTD.

name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Ltd
thesis: Fifth straight quarter of underwriting improvement: Q2 underwriting profit Rs 99 crore vs loss of Rs 40 crore, CISR 98% (improved 2.9 pts), but no numeric FY27 guidance was repeated and reported growth is inflated by 1/n multi-year accounting.

name: Delhivery Ltd
gLine: Aggregated EBITDA margin expansion: 130-150 bps conservatively FY26 to FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 volumes up 32% and PTL tonnage up 14.2%, with Express growth now at the low end of 20-30% guidance and Local ARR ahead of the revised 160-175 Cr path, though margins were flagged as the watch item.

name: Rashi Peripherals Ltd
gLine: Sustainable standalone EBITDA margin FY29-30: around 2.75%
thesis: Rashi Peripherals Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue up 49% YoY to ₹6,185 cr with PAT up 121%, but inventory build, D/E at 0.76x and a QIP overhang temper the read; supply-side signals are thin.

name: Allied Blenders and Distillers Ltd
thesis: ABD crossed 10m cases with volume +11% and gross margin 45.3%, but EBITDA margin fell 66bp to 12.4% on ₹53cr West Asia supply-chain hit; capex ₹1,600cr is being built with capacity added alongside growth.

name: Ventive Hospitality Ltd
gLine: Q3 FY27 revenue and EBITDA growth: mid-teens (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Hospitality REIT-style operator: Maldives back to growth (revenue +20%, EBITDA +25%) after Q1 diesel hit, India EBITDA +8% reported (+11% adjusted); capex funded from cash, supply pipeline of ~360 keys in FY28.

name: B.R.Goyal Infrastructure Ltd
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue ~550 cr (+61% YoY) with toll collection mix rising to ~50% of order book; EBITDA growth only ~28% and margin ~6.4% vs prior guidance of 10-11%, which management did not reiterate.

name: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Ltd
thesis: Core gases segment margin rose to 39% from 38% and on-site plant commissioned, but merchant plants slipped a year to H2 FY28 and consolidated margin fell to 36% on freight and EPC mix.

name: Chembond Chemicals Ltd
gLine: Q4 sales and profit: Q4 expected to be high sales and profit quarter
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up 32% to Rs 182.25 cr but material cost jumped to 56% of sales from 46%, cutting PBT margin to 11% from 14%; management gave no timeline for normalisation.

name: GNG Electronics Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 40% (FY27)
thesis: Refurbished-laptop remarketer raised FY27 guidance to 40% revenue growth and 150bps PAT margin uplift, but ~125-150bps of margin is inventory gain and inventory/receivable days are stretching.

name: Studds Accessories Ltd
gLine: Export growth short term: 30% to 35% (short term)
thesis: Q2 EBITDA margin fell to 12.4% (from 14-15% guided) on styrene costs, though capacity rose to 11 million units and utilisation is 83-85%; price increases net ~9% and another hike depends on Q4 styrenics.

name: Pine Labs Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: higher than 23%-23.5% (FY27)
thesis: Pine Labs grew revenue about 24% and adjusted EBITDA about 27% in Q2, but management defers any margin guidance change while investing in sales staff; CM and cash-flow ranges were reiterated, not raised.

name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
gLine: FY27 AUM growth: 26–27% (FY27)
thesis: Bajaj Finance Q2 FY27 is a consumer lender with AUM up 26.5% to ₹5,84,624 crore and 26–27% FY27 growth guided, but credit-cost overlays, gold stage-2 slippage and NIM compression are the watch items; no supply-side discipline evidence.
top: NIM compression 10–12 bps Q1 to Q2

name: Sundram Fasteners Ltd
thesis: Q2 revenue up about 30% with exports up 57%, but EBITDA margin fell to 15.7% (H1 15.9%) on RM inflation; management says the margin hit is already in the P&L and should expand in H2 on export mix.

name: Tata Elxsi Ltd
gLine: H2 FY27 revenue vs H1: H2 better than H1, implying higher YoY revenue in H2
thesis: Tata Elxsi Q2 FY27 revenue INR 1055.7 cr (+2.3% cc QoQ) and EBITDA margin 21.9%, but no capacity signal; utilisation ~78% vs 81-82% peak, with management giving no numeric guidance.

name: Onward Technologies Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% to 18% (FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue INR170.2 cr (+22.4% YoY) with EBITDA margin 15.6%; FY27 guidance raised to 15–18% growth and 13.8–14.3% margin, but DSO stretched to ~80 days and offshore/US hiring drives the ramp.

name: KEI Industries Ltd
gLine: EPC EBIT loss: INR 5-7 crores per quarter for next 1-2 quarters (next 1-2 quarters)
thesis: Q2 sales +38.5% to INR 3,776 cr with EBITDA margin 10.62%, while Sanand EHV capacity is still ramping; management reiterated 25%+ growth but the 11% margin guide was softened and an EPC exit is underway.

name: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd
gLine: Keys by FY30: 3,000 keys (from ~1,900) (FY2030)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA more than doubled to Rs 22 cr at 26% margin on occupancy 50%→58%, but ADR was flat (~3%); management guides only qualitatively and gave no margin target, so the prior 30% target is not repeated.

name: Granules India Ltd-$
gLine: Peptide CDMO annual revenue run rate: ~$50M in three years (3 years)
thesis: Granules pivots to complex generics, controlled substances and peptide CDMO with ~2,000 crore capex over 3-4 years, but gives no hard numbers and EBITDA lags gross margin gains.
top: Operating cash flow INR650m vs INR3,874m

name: UCO Bank
gLine: Cost-to-income: around 50% for full year
thesis: UCO Bank Q2 FY27 shows strong loan growth (24.7% YoY) and falling GNPA (1.96%), but NIM guidance held only by repo-linked loans, and Q2 slippages rose QoQ to Rs 549 crore, partly from agri marking.

name: DCB Bank Ltd
gLine: ROE FY27: above 13.5% (FY27)
thesis: Clean Q2 FY27 print (ROA 1.03%, ROE 14.6%) but NIM fell on FCNR liquidity carry; management guided NIM up in Q3–Q4 and held ROE guidance from prior call, with new capital still unclosed.
top: NIM down QoQ on excess liquidity

name: AU Small Finance Bank Ltd
thesis: Deposits +29% YoY and CASA ratio up 72 bps to 29.5%, but NIM fell 9 bps QoQ to 5.8% on higher investment book; credit cost guided ~90 bps with H1 at 81 bps incl. CGFMU, and management sees no stress yet.

name: SIS Ltd
gLine: India margin trend: continue expanding over next two quarters (next two quarters)
thesis: India margin rose to 5.4% (from 5.2% in Q4) with labour code wage pass-through; management guides 15-18% growth and expects margin trend to continue two more quarters, while international working capital and net debt (1.24x) stretched on one delayed collection.

name: MAS Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Cost of borrowing: up 20 to 25 bps (FY27)
thesis: MFSL consolidated AUM grew 23.3% to INR 17,042 crore with capital adequacy 22.12%, but asset quality (GS3 2.63%) drifted up, wheels is weak, and borrowing cost is guided up 20-25 bps.

name: Dynamic Cables Ltd
gLine: New plant revenue potential: INR240-250 crore initially, ramp over 3-4 quarters
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up 31% to INR712 cr with margin 10.44%, but growth is price-led (volume ~6% in Q2); new plant ~INR240-250 cr revenue potential, ramp over 3-4 quarters, order book INR829 cr.

name: Bandhan Bank Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 PAT Rs622 cr (5.5x YoY) with ROA 1.2% already at the low end of Q4 exit guidance, but deposits and CASA lagged, housing disrupted, and ECL transition of ~Rs2,200 cr is a capital hit.

name: 360 ONE WAM LTD
gLine: Tangible ROE: 18-20% over ~3.5 years, push toward 20-25% later (3.5 years)
thesis: Wealth flows strong at ₹12,482 crore ARR net flows and ARR retention up to 79bps, but carry (~₹60 crore) flatters retention; ex-carry retention flat at 67bps and TBR is soft.
top: ARR net flows ₹12,482 crore vs ₹10,815 crore

name: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +47% YoY and EBITDA margin 9.2% (up from 7.6% in Q1), but supply-side disclosure is thin: FY27 capex held at ~INR200 crores and no FY28 capex number given, while copper and wage pass-through lag persists.

name: Signatureglobal (India) Ltd
gLine: Launches: another 2 million+ sq ft launch in Sector 71 plus Dwarka Expressway launches in H2 (H2 FY27)
thesis: Pre-sales guidance of Rs 100 billion held with ~40% achieved in H1 on one launch; collections and OCF guidance asserted but H2-dependent, with cash surplus of about Rs 4.8 billion in H1.
top: Pre-sales guidance held at Rs 100 bn

name: Suraj Estate Developers Ltd
gLine: Net debt FY-end: close to INR600-odd crores (FY27)
thesis: Q2 presales up 35% to INR206 crores and H1 at INR347 crores, but FY27 INR700 crore presales guidance needs ~INR353 crores in H2; net debt rising to INR710 crores with a INR600 crore year-end target.
top: Q2 presales +35% YoY to INR206 crores

name: Jana Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: PAT growth: 100% YoY (raised from 80%+) (FY27)
thesis: Q2 record PBT and PAT guidance raised to 100% growth, but deposits (17% YoY) and CASA lag the 23-25% guide; credit cost guided below 2% with the CGFMU guarantee claims as a key dependency.

name: Raymond Lifestyle Ltd
gLine: Branded Apparel EBITDA margin: double digit plus in a couple of years (FY28-FY29)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +13% and EBITDA +4% to INR270cr at 12.7% margin, but H2 needs a sharp margin step-up on festive timing and price pass-through; supply discipline is not the story, demand and pricing are.

name: Vishal Mega Mart Ltd
gLine: Full-year SSSG: double-digit for the full year
thesis: Q2 FY27 SSSG 5.4% (about 9% festival-adjusted) with growth from market share, no price rises planned beyond festive, and store additions of 100-plus a year; margins held via cost reengineering but EBITDA fell to 7.7% from 8.5%.

name: Vikran Engineering Ltd
gLine: Consolidated revenue FY27: INR950-1,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: H1 FY27 standalone revenue up 27% to INR424 crore but consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 9.5% as NOPL solar sat idle awaiting debt disbursement; management still guides FY27 14%+ margin and INR2,300 crore standalone revenue, with H2 needing ~INR1,875 crore.

name: Meesho Ltd
gLine: Long-term fixed cost base: about 3% of NMV (longer run)
thesis: Meesho's contribution margin jumped on logistics efficiency (about INR4 per order) while management keeps reinvesting; adjusted EBITDA still about -1% of NMV and GPU server costs elevated, with the 25% NMV CAGR target held.

name: Om Power Transmission Ltd
gLine: FY30 revenue target: INR 2500 cr (FY30)
thesis: Q2 revenue up 56% to INR 128.29 cr with order book near INR 839 cr after October wins; but receivables rose to INR 237 cr (~45% retention) and margin 15.2% was flagged as non-steady, with management anchoring 12–13% EBITDA.

name: Atharva Poly-Plast Ltd
gLine: Engineering revenue share FY27: 22% to 25% of revenue
thesis: Engineering-led polymer molder at 67% utilisation with 88% target and no capex until FY28-29; H1 revenue +77.5% YoY but EBITDA margin 20.3% vs 11.5% in H2, with management blaming a one-month polymer pass-through lag.

name: Purple Style Labs Ltd
gLine: Break-even cash cost base: INR360-370 crore GP (FY28)
thesis: Luxury designer-wear retailer H1 FY27 GMV up to INR397 crore from INR310 crore (+28%), with EBITDA still a ~INR7 crore loss and a cash-cost base of about INR360-370 crore to break even.
top: Inventory INR208 cr → INR196 cr YoY

name: Robokidz Eduventures Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: 30-35% every year (multi-year)
thesis: Small-cap education-lab operator with H1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin ~22.9% and receivables-driven working capital (~INR73 cr vs INR60 cr H1 revenue), with management admitting it may need external capital in FY28.
top: Working capital ~INR73 cr vs H1 revenue INR60 cr

name: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd
gLine: NIM FY27: 4% plus (FY27)
thesis: Stable, high-ROA retail/gold-led bank: NIM held at 4.26%, credit cost 0.43% and ROA 2.1%, but management flagged funding-cost and repricing pressure ahead and guided advances growth of 18-20% for FY27.

name: Vedanta Ltd
gLine: FY27 Zinc India mined metal: 1,140 - 1,160 kt (FY27)
thesis: Record Q2 EBITDA ₹9,938 cr (+106% YoY) driven mainly by LME/market and regulatory tailwinds, with ₹4,372 cr of market-led uplift and net debt cut to ₹3,675 cr; supply additions (Gamsberg Phase II, Debari) are on track but guidance is mostly unchanged.

name: NOCIL Ltd
thesis: Q2 volumes fell 3% YoY and 7% QoQ on supply constraints; revenue rose 33% on price, EBITDA margin 8.4%, while management held the FY27 revenue range toward the top and ~10% margin.
top: Q2 volumes -7% QoQ on supply constraints

name: Tata Chemicals Ltd
thesis: Soda ash oversupply persists with China inventory near 1.89 million tonnes and a US producer cutting 1.5 Mt; standalone EBITDA up 22% but consolidated EBITDA fell on UK gas costs and Kenya suspension.

name: Siyaram Silk Mills Ltd-$
gLine: Revenue growth: 14%-15% (FY27)
thesis: Fabric volume up ~2.5% and value ~11% in Q2, with 4–6% cumulative price hikes; revenue guidance raised to 14–15% but EBITDA ~14% kept and retail store target trimmed to 70 from 61 open, and no capacity discipline data disclosed.

name: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 IPP generation: exceed last year's generation; cross 420 crore units (FY27)
thesis: H1 FY27 record EBITDA of INR1,326 crore (+4% YoY) driven by better power realisations; management guides H2 thermal profitability "substantially higher" but gives no numeric FY27 guidance, and H1 IPP generation of 202 crore units points to ~420 crore units for FY27 versus 415 prior.

name: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Subscription revenue trajectory: accelerated growth from H2, not at 30% level
thesis: Q2 EBITDA margin fell to 3.2% (INR 708m) as FIFA and new-initiative marketing spend lifted costs; management says ex-investments margin would be mid-to-high single digit, with no numeric FY27 guidance.

name: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Ltd
gLine: Opex ratio: 3.0% to 3.1% near term; 2.8% in 2-3 years
