thesis: Chola grew disbursements 47% and AUM 25% YoY with credit cost already at ~1.4% target; management held FY27 guidance, flagged 0.5% rate-hike cost drag and a possible INR5,000 crore raise.

name: Pitti Engineering Ltd-$
gLine: Sustainable blended EBITDA margin: 17%+ at Q2 raw material prices (steady state)
thesis: Pitti reaffirmed FY27 lamination 82,000 t and ~₹370 cr EBITDA on Q2 run-rate, but margins fell ~100 bps to 15.8% and a new ₹450 cr capex (modular, to FY31) was announced, with casting volume guidance left unreconciled.

name: HLE Glascoat Ltd
gLine: India GLE revenue FY27: INR260-280 crore (FY27)
thesis: Order book hit record INR1,087 cr (+51% YoY) but Q2 consol EBITDA margin only 11.2% and working-capital days rose to 102; FY28 targets reiterated without new numbers.

name: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 32% to INR20.3bn with H1 EBITDA ~26.2% and EBITDA guidance held; backlog flat at INR214.4bn, capacity capex ~INR10bn with only ~20% spent, and mild price pressure.

name: Hester Biosciences Ltd
thesis: Standalone revenue up 28% in Q2 and PAT up 131%, but H1 Animal Healthcare revenue down 14% and management gave no numbers on utilisation or capex, only "approximately 65%" utilisation and a possible capex rise.

name: Bank of Baroda
gLine: Credit growth FY27: 13-15% (FY27)
thesis: Bank of Baroda raised FY27 credit growth guidance to 13-15% and deposits to 11-13%, but NIM, slippage and credit cost guides were held; ROE guide 15-16% against 19.28% reported; ROA full year near 1%.

name: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd
gLine: Deposit growth: 12% plus (FY27)
thesis: Bank cut FY27 credit growth guide to 14%+ (from 12%/18-20% mix), deposits 12%+ and CASA 42%+, GNPA below 2%; H1 RoA ~1.0% implies 1.4% H2 needed, reliant on recoveries and OTS, with ECL hit unquantified.

name: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Gross debt: zero by end of FY 2027 (FY27 end)
thesis: Pharma call with no supply-side signal: growth driven by India/EM branded push and Flovent launches, but H1 operating cash flow turned negative after ~INR520 crore litigation payments and field-force hiring, with gross debt INR867 crore.

name: Subex Ltd
thesis: Subex Q2 FY27 revenue INR 85.6 cr (+7.7% QoQ, +24% YoY) with EBITDA margin 20.8%, but management declined to quantify FY27 growth or margin; no capacity or supply-side content in a software business.

name: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: ~Rs 550 cr group (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 1,405 cr (+55% YoY) and EBITDA margin 18.2%, with utilisation near 88% in casting, but capex rising to ~Rs 550 cr and working capital up Rs 140 cr versus the Rs 350 cr guide.

name: Datamatics Global Services Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: Closer to 9%–9.5%, from high single digits (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +11.5% to INR 546.6 cr and EBITDA margin 21.1% (+301 bps); management reaffirmed high-single-digit FY27 growth, with H2 guided to ~9–9.5% and margin held near 20%, but no capacity or capex metrics were discussed.

name: Yes Bank Ltd
gLine: FY28 ROA confidence: 1% with minimal reliance on non-core (FY28)
thesis: Q2 FY27 core ROA ~0.9% and cost-to-income 64.3%, but Supreme Court reinstatement of INR 8,415 cr AT-1 cuts pro forma CET-1 ~240 bps to ~11.4%, with capital actions unresolved.

name: Karnataka Bank Ltd
thesis: Advances up 25% Y-o-Y to ₹92,015 crores and GNPA down to 2.27%, but NIM slipped to 3.17% from 3.20% and management kept FY27 guidance vague, with no capex or supply lens for a bank.

name: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 shows steady asset quality (GS2+GS3 8.1%, credit cost 1.6%) and 22% disbursement growth, but management flagged a higher cost of funds trajectory, NIM pressure near 7% and drought exposure; no supply-side capacity signals.
top: Cost of funds to trend upward

name: Indus Towers Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 tenancy ratio rose 1.62 to 1.63 on 7,900 co-locations vs 2,900 towers, but management gave no forward tower or capex numbers and revenue growth stayed near 4%; Africa still unquantified.
top: Repeated evasion on capex and Africa metrics

name: IDFC First Bank Ltd
gLine: Cost-income ratio: 55% incremental for FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 core PAT ~INR1,036cr with incremental cost-income ~55% and ROA ~0.93% stock; NIM dipped to 5.58% on FCNR drag, guided ~5.8% by Q4, credit cost 1.38% reported.

name: GTPL Hathway Ltd
gLine: Operating EBITDA margin: +150–250bp vs FY26 by FY27-end (FY27)
thesis: Cable/broadband operator with weak supply-side signal: subscriber adds slowed, consolidated EBITDA flat at INR1,103m (9.6% reported margin), while management guides to 150–250bp operating margin recovery by FY27-end and relies on acquisitions and HITS conversion.

name: Solara Active Pharma Sciences Ltd
gLine: Net debt: net debt improved to ~INR500 crore from INR614 crore at Mar-26
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA doubled to INR77 crore on base-business margin of 23.6%, but gross margin slipped to 47.2% and the Ibuprofen strategic review was pushed out another 12 weeks, with no supply-side capacity decision.

name: Polycab India Ltd
thesis: Polycab posted record Q2 FY27 with revenue up 53% and EBITDA margin 14.4%, but capacity is still expanding (EHV plant now FY28), mgmt is not pricing-responding to UltraTech's entry, and working capital at 11 days is flattered by LC-driven payables.

name: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 MFI turnaround holds: AUM INR5,364 crores (+10% QoQ), GNPA 2.5%, cost of debt 10.6%, but El Nino/drought stress in Maharashtra is the open risk with clarity only by Dec-Jan.

name: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 14.3% with Bakery margin held at 13.1%, but management now sees Q3 margin pressure and mid-teens FY27 growth is only partly reaffirmed; the 14% Q4 margin target is still stated.
top: Q3 margin pressure, Q4 14% target kept

name: Lodha Developers Ltd
gLine: FY27 PAT growth: beat 20% growth; well above INR 4,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: H1 FY27 PAT up 63% to INR 2,386 crore and pre-sales INR 96bn up 7%; management says it will comfortably beat the 20% PAT growth guide, with FY27 pre-sales guide of INR 24,000 crore held despite a launch-GDV cut.
top: PAT guide to be beaten comfortably

name: Dodla Dairy Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 5.4% as milk procurement cost rose to INR43.2/l versus INR realisation of INR61.9/l; management guides 7.5-8% for Oct-Dec quarter on INR2.5/l price hike, but spread compressed to INR18.7 from INR20.

name: Five-Star Business Finance Ltd
gLine: AUM growth: comfortably cross earlier guidance; revised guidance possibly after Q3
thesis: Five-Star's disbursements hit a record INR 2,078 crore (+74% YoY) and credit cost eased to 1.80%, but NIM is guided to compress 10-15 bps as cost of funds rises and GNPA stays sticky near 3.48%.

name: Concord Biotech Ltd
gLine: Injectables top line: Rs 300 crore over next 3-4 years (3-4 years)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +25% to Rs 309.1 cr with API +30%, but gross margin down ~400bp to 76.2%, utilisation low at Unit II 21% and Unit IV 5%, and no capacity cuts; growth reliant on contracts still pending.

name: DOMS Industries Ltd
gLine: Capex H2 FY27: INR100 crores to INR125 crores (H2 FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 margins held at 12.4% (H1 too) as ~15% RM inflation outran pricing; management is deferring margin recovery to 16-17% for "a couple of quarters" while debt rises to ~INR200 crores and FY27 18-20% growth is reaffirmed.

name: Acevector Ltd
gLine: Uniware revenue growth: 15%+ from Q4 FY27 onwards
thesis: Asset-light value-fashion marketplace with no capacity capex; Q2 revenue up 17% to INR151.2 crore but adjusted EBITDA loss widened to INR8.6 crore from INR2.2 crore a year ago, with no supply-side metrics.

name: Shree Vasu Logistics Ltd
thesis: Strong H1 FY27 print (revenue +37% to Rs145cr, PAT 8.4cr from 3.1cr) but no supply-side disclosure: no capacity, utilisation or pricing data, and the call was thin with an unidentified caller and retail questioners.

name: Oriental Aromatics Ltd-$
gLine: Full-year PAT: Rs 50 crore on turnover of Rs 1000 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue record Rs 318 cr (+17% YoY) and consolidated margin 7.9%, but Camphor volumes fell 8% YoY on overcapacity and Mahad sits at only 50-55% utilisation, with no new capex committed.
top: Camphor volumes down 8% YoY in Q2

name: Cipla Ltd
gLine: Tax rate: 27% to 27.5% (FY27)
thesis: Cipla held FY27 EBITDA margin 18.5–20% and $1bn US exit run-rate despite US revenue of $172m; the bridge rests on unapproved launches and a new US MDI plant still ramping supply.

name: Tata Consumer Products Ltd
gLine: India food and beverage EBITDA: 17% to 20% ballpark in next 3 years (3 years)
thesis: Q2 FY27 India tea volume flat and revenue -1% as price hikes of 8-10% catch up with tea inflation; margins guided 50-70 bps still in play but India margin contracted on input inflation, with salt and tea price increases yet to flow through.

name: Gabriel India Ltd-$
gLine: Consolidated capex: INR1,000-1,500 crore per year (3 years)
thesis: Consolidated revenue up 23% to INR1,608 cr with EBITDA margin 8.8%, but growth is mostly from JV/M&A restructuring and capacity additions (seating JV, new plants) rather than clear supply discipline; sunroof margins remain depressed.
top: FORVIA seating JV, new plant in Chennai

name: Muthoot Capital Services Ltd
gLine: Monthly disbursement: 400 plus crore in November (Nov onward)
thesis: Q2 FY27 AUM ~INR3,530 crore (+25% YoY) with GNPA 4.61% and forward flow down to 0.50%, but management says it will not pursue growth at the expense of asset quality; prior FY27 AUM guidance not restated.

name: EFC (I) Ltd
thesis: Asset-light workspace platform reports revenue up 30% to ₹332 cr and EBITDA margin ~40%, but Design & Build grew only ~16% in H1 against a 50–60% annual target, with no capacity or seat-addition data given.

name: Mphasis Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth (constant currency): low double digits (FY27)
thesis: Mphasis raised FY27 revenue guidance to low double digits on record pipeline (+23% YoY) and $466M TCV, but OCF-to-PAT is tracking poorly and margins sit at ~14.8%, the bottom of the band.
top: FY27 revenue guide raised to low double digits

name: Praveg Ltd
gLine: Top-line growth: Top line always better than last year; sizeable growth in Q3 and Q4 advertising vs last year
thesis: Praveg's H1 FY27 EBITDA fell to INR0.97 crore (1.06% margin) and net loss reached INR33.37 crore, with management pointing to Q3-Q4 event, wedding and Lakshadweep ramp rather than any supply discipline.

name: Transport Corporation of India Ltd
gLine: Cold chain growth: about 40% (FY27)
thesis: Freight top line up ~12% and about two-thirds pricing-led, but margins flat and PAT flat as JV dividends fell; Seaways margin guided at 35-40% with new ships adding capacity in FY28.

name: Tips Music Ltd
gLine: Digital revenue share: 70%-75%
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 35% to INR120 cr with 70.5% EBITDA margin, but content spend front-loaded (INR71 cr H1 vs INR90-100 cr FY guide) and YouTube Shorts deal still unsigned; supply discipline is not visible, growth is volume-led.
top: Q2 revenue +35% YoY to INR120 cr

name: Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Ltd
gLine: Exit of further keys: exit about 650 keys in total this year (FY27)
thesis: Net key reduction of 103 in Q2 (6 resorts exited, 5,762 keys) while targeting ~1,000 gross keys in six months; resort revenue +15% and TRevPAR +6% show yield gains, but standalone PAT fell 16%.

name: PTC India Financial Services Ltd
gLine: ROA full year: 4.16% budget, expected above 3.49% H1 (FY27)
thesis: PFS loan book rebounded 25% QoQ to INR3,684 crore on record sanctions of INR3,098 crore, but Stage 3 is a Kundli Manesar-driven net NPA rise to INR105 crore and the INR5,000 crore target leans on undisclosed pipeline.
top: Loan book +25% QoQ to INR3,684 cr

name: InterGlobe Aviation Ltd
gLine: Q3 FY27 capacity growth: early single digit YoY (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Q2 PRASK +31% beat the >25% guide and Q3 PRASK guided >25%, but CASK ex-fuel up ~15% and a Rs19bn net loss show fuel and rupee outrunning pricing; capacity cut and FY27 growth cut to early single digits.

name: HealthCare Global Enterprises Ltd
thesis: Q2 revenue up 16% with EBITDA margin 19.7%, but a trade-margin cap on 137 oncology drugs trims EBITDA by a mid-to-high single digit annualised; North Bengaluru breakeven still Q4 FY27.
top: Trade-margin cap hits EBITDA mid-high single digit

name: Bajaj Healthcare Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: INR65 crores to INR80 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 18.9% to INR175.9 crores with EBITDA margin 18.2%, but domestic API fell and working capital built on West Asia inventory; capex guidance raised to INR65-80 crores versus INR40-50 crores prior.
top: FY27 capex raised to INR65-80 crores

name: Clean Science and Technology Ltd
gLine: HALS capacity: close to 12,500 tons
thesis: Base-business margins squeezed as phenol/acetone costs rose 50-100% YoY and China holds prices; HALS volumes doubled but utilisation only 30-35%, with Performance Chemical 2 now guided to Q4 start.
top: Chinese holding prices; CLEAN absorbing costs

name: Eternal Ltd
gLine: Food delivery margins: broadly flattish over next 1-2 years (1-2 years)
thesis: Q2FY27 call is a demand and growth-investment story, not a supply-discipline one: management is reinvesting to hold food margins flat and accelerating quick-commerce dark-store expansion, with no capacity-cycle signals.
top: Competition intensity up in food delivery

name: Krsnaa Diagnostics Ltd
gLine: Cash-based revenue share by FY27 end: 40-45% (~INR400 cr) (FY27)
thesis: Diagnostics PPP operator: H1 FY27 revenue INR507 cr (+27%) but EBITDA margin fell to 26% from 28%, receivables rose to ~INR470 cr with only INR200 cr collection visibility in Q3, and EBITDA-positive/margin-recovery claims lack numbers.
top: Receivables ~INR470 cr, Q3 visibility INR200 cr

name: CarTrade Tech Ltd
gLine: OLX revenue growth: growth rate will cross 30%, 35% in the coming quarters (coming quarters)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue at a record INR 213 crore (+10% YoY) with PAT up only 3%; management guides Q3 as best-ever quarter but gives no numeric growth guidance, and cash distribution is blocked by tax rules.

name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 beauty and fashion growth held (NSV +28% beauty, +47% fashion), EBITDA margin 8.7%, but no supply-side signal and no numeric reaffirmation of prior guidance; Nykaa Now city target dropped from 25 to "25 cities" framing only via analyst.

name: C.E. Info Systems Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth H2: H2 can't be better than H1; no number given (H2 FY27)
thesis: Mapmyindia Q2 FY27: revenue +15.8% YoY, EBITDA +60%, H1 EBITDA margin cited at 37.2%, comfortably above the 35% guide; no capacity or capex signals, government receivables (~INR100 cr) the main watch item.

name: Cyient DLM Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 30-35%
thesis: Q2 revenue up 26.5% to INR3,931m with order book at record INR28.1bn (book-to-bill 1.6x), but EBITDA margin fell to 8.7% on expensed sales and product-development spend; FY27 margin guide trimmed to ~9%.
top: FY27 margin ~9%, below prior 9-11% core path

name: SBFC Finance Ltd
gLine: Capital: We should be good till at least an AUM of INR 20,000 crores before we need to raise further capital. (long term)
thesis: SBFC Q2 FY27 shows credit cost easing to 1.37% from 1.44% and opex down 22 bps to 4.07%, with MSME growth still muted at 6% QoQ disbursement and gold competition rising.

name: JSW Infrastructure Ltd
gLine: FY27 logistics EBITDA margin: 28% (FY27)
thesis: Port volumes up only 2% YoY to 29.4 Mt with Fujairah at nil and port EBITDA margin down to 49.4% from 53.1%; capacity expansion (186 to 300 Mtpa by FY28) remains on track but near-term execution and FY27 guidance are under pressure.

name: Laxmi Dental Ltd
gLine: Lab transition timeline: by end of FY2028
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR79.5 cr (+10% YoY) with EBITDA margin 19.2%, but scanner sales fell to INR3.5 cr from INR8.9 cr and no FY27 guidance was reiterated; supply-side signal is mixed.
top: Scanner sales INR8.9 cr → INR3.5 cr

name: Anthem Biosciences Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue Rs594 cr with CRDMO Rs509 cr and EBITDA margin 50.6%, but H1 growth weak and no full-year number; FY27 capex ~Rs1,200 cr Unit 4 'intact' and Unit 4 Phase 2 deferred to post-approval.

name: Saatvik Green Energy Ltd
gLine: Cell utilisation FY28: above 90% (FY28)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 77% QoQ to INR 9,026m but EBITDA margin fell to 7.7% and D/E rose to 1.37x; Odisha module ramp and cell line are the swing factors, with FY27 margin guidance at risk.

name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
gLine: Monthly PAT on Sharon GPU deal: INR 50-60 crore per month once live (FY28)
thesis: Sharon AI GPU cluster (8,200 GPUs) slipping toward Dec go-live with NVIDIA testing still open; core revenue up only 3.5% QoQ and customer count down to 1,709 from 2,216.

name: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd
gLine: H2 FY27 capex: around Rs 450 crore (H2 FY27)
thesis: Exchange franchise is strong: Q2 FY27 transaction charges up 9% to ₹3,035 crore with 92% cash share, but cash ADT fell 13% QoQ and equity futures ADT down 11.7% YoY on tax changes.

name: Swastika Infra Ltd
gLine: FY27 full-year growth: in line with previous year (FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue up 42% to INR188 cr but H1 only up 5% after a weak Q1; order book INR1,420 cr (2.8x FY26 revenue) with management guiding FY27 growth only in line with FY26 and margins normalising to ~14%.

name: Jio Platforms Ltd
gLine: Capex: Not exceeding FY26 level for next 4–5 years (FY27–FY31)
thesis: Jio posts Q2 revenue ₹40,475 Cr (+11.4% YoY) and EBITDA margin 54.1% (+250bp), with ARPU ₹218.8 and capex plateauing; supply signals are positive but no numeric guidance was given.
top: Capex capped at FY26 level for 4–5 yrs

name: ACC Ltd
gLine: Green power share: 61% (company level) (FY27)
thesis: Management is expanding capacity by ~30 Mt (INR14,500 crore) to reach 149 Mt by FY29 while Q2 utilisation was only 61-62%, though cost guidance of INR4,250/t was reaffirmed.

name: Asian Paints Ltd
gLine: Gross margin band: 41% to 43% (H2 FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 volume +6.4% and H1 PBDIT margin 19.6% held the band, but gross margin slid toward 41-43% as inflation outran 12% pricing; VAE benefit remains phase-1 only.
top: Price hikes lag inflation in Q2

name: Finolex Industries Ltd
thesis: Q2 volume up 28% to 83,407 MT on channel restocking, but EBITDA flat on higher-cost inventory; mgmt holds 14-15% FY margin and capex at ~INR150 crore, with utilisation only ~68%.

name: Finkurve Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Branch additions FY27: 60 to 70 branches; ~150 by December (FY27)
thesis: Gold-loan NBFC with AUM up ~95% YoY but QoQ AUM growth slowed to ~3%, NNP rose to 2.4%, collection efficiency fell to ~90% from ~98%, and growth now funded mainly via off-book co-lending; management reiterated 50–60% AUM growth without numbers for the quarter.

name: Can Fin Homes Ltd
gLine: FY28 disbursements: INR16,000 crore (FY28)
thesis: Q2 FY27 disbursements fell to INR2,375 crore on IT migration (Project Tejas), but management held FY27 guidance of INR13,000 crore and 13-14% AUM growth; NIM/spread guided 2.75%/3.75% protected via 10bp hike.
top: Q2 disbursements INR2,375 crore on IT cutover

name: Elgi Equipments Ltd
gLine: Top-line growth FY27 Q1: similar to last year's growth, maybe a little better (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 call (May 29, 2026): price correction of 2.5–3% planned for June as ~80% of projected material cost rise already hit in Q1; FY26 volume growth only 3–4%, and Europe only breakeven in Q4.

name: CSL Finance Ltd
thesis: Wholesale-led AUM growth with SME retail still in consolidation; Q2 disbursement record Rs 385 crore but gross NPS rose to 1.13% from 0.51% a year ago, against a prior "no absolute increase in NPA" guidance.

name: ICICI Bank Ltd
gLine: NIM trajectory: marginal decline in Q3, then rising from Q4 (Q3-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 growth was flattered by ~$18bn FCNR(B) leverage: loans +30% YoY but +24% ex-international-branch loans, NIM fell to 4.18% from 4.36%, with management guiding margins down again in Q3 before recovering from Q4.

name: Indraprastha Gas Ltd
gLine: Volume growth aspiration: double digit, 10%+ (FY28)
thesis: IGL posted negative EBITDA of INR31 crores in Q2 as spot LNG rose to about 15% of supply and management says it is not slowing capex, leaning on volume growth over margin protection.
top: Negative EBITDA INR31 crores in Q2

name: Welspun Enterprises Ltd
thesis: H1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 11% to Rs1,808 crore with EBITDA margin 32.4% (vs 23.9%), but a transcript this garbled leaves order and guidance figures unreliable; management reiterated 10-20% growth, 18%+ margin and Rs8,000-10,000 crore order inflow.
top: Anta-Simaria asset sale in Q3 FY27

name: Tech Mahindra Ltd
gLine: Q3 sequential revenue headwind (European auto): about 0.5% (Q3 FY27)
thesis: IT services growth at 7.2% CC with 14.8% EBIT margin and $1.023bn deal wins; supply-side levers (utilisation, pyramid, fixed-price release) are management's margin story, but no capacity or pricing discipline data beyond that.

name: Emerald Finance Ltd
gLine: MSME loan book: INR150 crores-plus by end of FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Emerald Finance H1 FY27 PAT up 49.8% to Rs10.18 Cr, but gold-loan volumes down 30-35% and partner funding cuts show distribution income is shrinking; no capacity or capex discussion.

name: Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd
gLine: Bed additions FY28: 635 beds added in FY28 (analyst cited) (FY28)
thesis: India IP volumes up 4% YoY and margin above 26%, but no bed additions and no capacity discipline cues; UK revenue dipping QoQ with cost synergies masked, and insurance losses narrowing to INR22 crore combined.

name: Quess Corp Ltd
gLine: Unallocated ESOP cost: almost INR20 crores in year 1 (FY27)
thesis: Quess Q2 FY27 revenue +15% YoY with ~21k GS net adds, but Professional Staffing margin slid to 10.5% on front-loaded IT investment; management still guides PS margin 11-12% for FY27 and exit near 12%.

name: L&T Technology Services Ltd
gLine: ETR: 26% to 26.5% (next quarters)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBIT margin reached 16.3% (+60 bps QoQ), two quarters ahead of the mid-16% aspiration, on $317.1M revenue (+2.7% QoQ cc) and $203M TCV; capacity signals are absent, so the read is demand and mix, not supply.

name: Tejas Networks Ltd
gLine: Quarterly positive EBITDA: Focus on achieving quarterly positive EBITDA; no date given
thesis: Q2 revenue INR406 crore (+55% YoY) and order book jumped to INR2,315 crore on BSNL 4G, but EBITDA stayed negative at INR-108 crore and debt rose to INR4,384 crore.

name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd
gLine: Digital sourcing share: 15% from 6.0%
thesis: Motor loss ratio held near 65.4% H1 and management says no further Shishupal reserving, but Q2 combined ratio rose to 104.5% and H1 PAT fell 5.8%, so the capital-cycle signal is mixed and supply-side evidence is thin.

name: Indian Energy Exchange Ltd
gLine: IEX electricity volume growth FY27: about 15% (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 electricity volume 39.7bn units (+12.7% YoY) and RTM ~42% share, but management gives no new numeric guidance and the market-coupling delay pushes out the structural catalyst by 1.5–2 years.

name: IIFL Capital Services Ltd
gLine: Employee cost run-rate: INR192-194 crore per quarter (next quarters)
thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated operational revenue INR722 crore (+14% QoQ, +22% YoY) and operational PBT INR206 crore pre-MTM; BSE mark-to-market loss of INR32 crore, no supply-side or capacity signals in a broking franchise.

name: Craftsman Automation Ltd
gLine: Net debt to EBITDA (consolidated, FY27): 1.7x-1.8x (FY27)
thesis: Capex-heavy build-out with net debt/EBITDA guided to 1.7-1.8x and Aluminium margins (6.5% EBIT) hit by ramp-up and metal costs; recovery hinges on unconfirmed customer price resets.

name: Infobeans Technologies Ltd
gLine: Hiring net addition: 10-15% net addition range
thesis: Mid-size IT services firm reports 28% YoY revenue growth and 22% H1 growth ex-ERC, but no supply-side signal exists; the read is demand-led with rising receivables and no capacity or pricing data.
top: Trade receivables rising with terms stretched

name: Bajaj Housing Finance Ltd
thesis: Housing lender with AUM up 25% YoY to INR1.58 lakh crore and ROA 2.2%, but management flags ~25 bps NIM compression ahead as repo hikes pass through COF faster than acquisition pricing; guidance kept unchanged.

name: Trualt Bioenergy Ltd
gLine: Average utilisation: at least 75-80% (forward)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR811 cr (+606% YoY) and EBITDA margin fell to 14% on maize up 25-30%; ethanol volume 10.78 cr L in Q2 vs guided 11-12 cr L, and CBG ramp is slipping to January.

name: Infinity Infoway Ltd
gLine: International revenue: from this financial year (FY27)
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue Rs 16.81 cr (+106% YoY) and EBITDA margin 50.68%, but ZeroTouch revenue is "very nominal" so far and the disclosed numbers are mostly self-reported with no capacity or utilisation data.
top: Order book Rs 78 cr as of 30 Sep

name: Tata Motors Ltd
gLine: Q3 CV industry demand growth: very high single-digit to beginning of double-digit
thesis: Q2 FY27 wholesales +42% YoY to 135,100 units with 590bps commodity headwind largely offset; capacity is supply-chain constrained, not in-house, and management guides Q3 growth to a high-single to low-double digit pace.

name: Shiprocket Ltd
thesis: Shiprocket's Q2 FY27 shows operating-led profit improvement: EBITDA margin 2.1% vs 0.9% a year ago and core contribution margin ~21%, but no supply-side capacity or pricing evidence; transcript is garbled and figures are unreliable.

name: Deepa Jewellers Ltd
gLine: Revenue CAGR FY27-FY29: 40-45% (FY27-FY29)
thesis: B2B gold jewellery maiden call: Q2 revenue +25% YoY to Rs 626 cr but EBITDA margin 7.24% on SKU-mix dip; management guides 40-45% CAGR and +80-120 bps margin, with little supply-side capex discipline evidence and heavy promoter-driven claims.
top: Inventory and receivable days up YoY

name: State Bank of India
gLine: Corporate credit growth: 16% for rest of half year (H2 FY27)
thesis: Core NIM up to 3.11% and credit growth guidance held at 14-15%, but treasury MTM loss of ~₹1,277 crore and ₹850 crore upfronted opex muddied Q2 operating profit (+7% YoY).

name: Max Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Core opex growth: 8% to 10% (FY27)
thesis: Axis Max Life H1 FY27 VNB up 21% with margin 25.4% (+210bps); management now leans to ~26% margin but Q2 APE slowed to 8% and Axis Bank counter-share dipped to 62-63%.

name: Tata Steel Ltd
gLine: India NSR Q2 vs Q1: about Rs 1,500/t lower (2Q FY27)
thesis: Q2 India NSR guided Rs 1,500/t lower and UK NSR up GBP 70-80/t, with Netherlands DSP shutdown cutting EBITDA to EUR 4m; India margins still 27% but iron-ore cost and EU capex now under regulatory review.

name: SRF Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 35% to Rs 4,904 Cr and operational EBIT up 26% to Rs 816 Cr, led by Chemicals and Films, with capacity additions (PVDF, Chemours, HFO) on schedule but no numeric capex or utilisation guidance.

name: SG Mart Ltd
gLine: Service centres: 25+ by 2030, possibly 30-35 (2030)
thesis: H1 FY27 EBITDA INR131 crore with management needing INR170 crore in H2 for ~INR300 crore FY27 guidance; capex INR250 crore in H1 and INR1,500 crore more planned, funded internally, with working-capital days cited at 18 against prior 27-day guidance.
top: Capex INR1,500 crore more over 2-3 years

name: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd
thesis: Record H1 revenue of Rs 73,524 Cr (+22%) led by acquisitions and wiring harness, but Q2 margin fell to 8.8% and capex of Rs 1,971 Cr (59% of EBITDA) is running well inside the Rs 6,000 Cr FY27 guide.

name: Eveready Industries India Ltd
gLine: Net debt: Debt-free within about 2 years; management said it could be sooner (2 years)
thesis: Eveready Q2 FY27 revenue +10.7% to INR 428.2 cr with EBITDA margin 12.6%, but zinc costs up 36% and management says H2 will be harder; Jammu alkaline plant only began billing in September.
top: H2 harder than H1, commodities hardening

name: Suzlon Energy Ltd
gLine: WTG contribution margin FY27: 22%-23% (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 14.8% (H1 15.1%) against prior 17-18% FY27 guide; management now says 15%+ with 1% upside, while order book 6 GW and 1,300 MW erected stock support H2 volume ramp of 1.5-1.65x H1.

name: Brigade Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Residential revenue recognition FY27: INR5,000 crores rough order of magnitude (FY27)
thesis: Brigade reiterated INR9,000 crore FY27 presales with H1 at ~INR2,900 crore, needing ~INR7,000 crore in H2 on launches; Q2 realisation up 29% YoY to INR13,841/sq ft, but launch-dependent H2 is unproven.
top: Realisation up 29% YoY to INR13,841/sq ft

name: Godrej Properties Ltd
thesis: Q2 bookings fell 6% YoY to INR8,008 crores but sustenance rose 83% to INR5,054 crores; H2 guided to INR22,500-25,000 crores bookings, with FCF positive targeted in H2 and FY28 ROE of 20%.

name: Rushil Decor Ltd
gLine: Jumbo laminate utilisation FY27: 80% to 85% by March (exit rate) (Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 record revenue Rs 2,953m (+25% YoY) with consolidated EBITDA margin 9.5%, but jumbo laminate utilisation only 41% and management gave no FY28 guidance and is still reviewing new capex.

name: SG Finserve Ltd
gLine: Debt-to-equity: 4x (mid-term)
thesis: Supply-chain NBFC growing AUM to INR5,700 cr (+25% QoQ) on 4x leverage revision; no equity dilution planned for 2-3 years, but mandate implies equity or debt raise near INR11,000 cr AUM.

name: LTM Ltd
thesis: IT services read with no capacity signal: utilisation flat at 86.4%, headcount up 949 q/q, growth guided to strengthen in H2 but FY27 only "endeavor" to match FY26; TCV softer as deal mix shifts to short-tenure AI deals.

name: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 16% YoY to INR 2,145m and EBITDA margin 34%, but H1 growth 10%, US still weak, and no supply-side or capacity signals; capex held at INR123 crore.

name: Laurus Labs Ltd
gLine: Peptide commercial revenue: around 2029 timeframe (FY29)
thesis: Record H1 revenue INR4,233 crores (+31%) and Q2 EBITDA margin 34.5%, but management guided FY27-28 capex at INR3,000 crores with H1 spend only INR864 crores and gave no peptide capacity economics, so supply-side visibility is thin.
top: H1 capex INR864 cr vs INR3,000 cr plan

name: SBI Life Insurance Company Ltd
thesis: Life insurer H1 FY27 VoNB up 19% to INR32.7bn at 27.9% margin, with IRP growth only 12% vs 14-15% guide, which management says it will still deliver despite H1 running at 12%.

name: HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd
gLine: Individual market growth: Grow in line with industry in FY27
thesis: Life insurer grows ahead of industry with VNB +12% and NBM 24.7%, but persistency softening in unit-linked and proposed commission cuts cloud the bancassurance channel; no supply-side capacity signal.

name: Indigo Paints Ltd
gLine: Gross margin recovery: Expected to improve substantially from Q3; reclaim gross margin leadership in Q3-Q4 (Q3-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q2 EBITDA margin collapsed to 8.9% (from 15.3%) on high-cost raw-material inventory and mix; management says the hit is over and Q3 October sales were a record, but gave no numeric guidance.

name: Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: INR1,200 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q2 cost inflation of ~INR180-190/t and Q3 guide of INR100-120/t more, offset by ~INR20/t price hikes; FY27 capex raised to INR1,200 cr from INR900 cr, with East expansion pushed 6-8 months.
top: FY27 capex INR900 cr → INR1,200 cr

name: Bikaji Foods International Ltd
gLine: Snacking growth Q2+Q3: 17% plus value growth
thesis: Q2 FY27 gross margin fell to 34.4% with ~1.7-2% standalone hit from pricing lag; management guides Q3 pressured and Q4 exit at 13%+ EBITDA, with Diwali shift muddying growth.

name: Uniparts India Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~24% above FY26 (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue ₹379 crore (+37% YoY) and 23.4% margin; management now guides FY27 revenue ~24% above FY26, below the earlier "couple of points above 21%" framing, with H2 growth slowing to about 10%.

name: Tata Technologies Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 22.2% CC to US$178m with EBITDA margin steady at 16.1%, but Germany/ES-Tec softness and Q2 subcontracting rise keep margin expansion unproven; no capacity supply signal as this is an engineering services business.

name: Arkade Developers Ltd
thesis: Mumbai developer with H1 FY27 pre-sales of Rs 306 crore and revenue down sharply YoY; launches slipped to Q3, prior FY27 pre-sales and launch targets still unproven, with no capex or supply discipline data.

name: Fabtech Cleanrooms Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 70-80% (internal plan); 20-30% conservative external (FY27)
thesis: H1 FY27 consolidated revenue up ~75% to ₹133 cr with order book doubled to ₹468 cr, but receivables of ₹129 cr and management pushing the 2H recovery with no capacity discipline or utilisation data.

name: Digitide Solutions Ltd
thesis: Q2 revenue INR 760 cr (-2% QoQ) with EBITDA margin up 45 bps to 10.4% and headcount down ~7% QoQ, but India BPM still weak and no numeric FY27 guidance reiterated beyond the ~200 bps margin target.

name: Sugs Lloyd Ltd
gLine: Year-end debt: around INR300 crore by end FY27 (FY27)
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue INR213 crore (+73%) with order book INR1,067 crore (~3.5x FY26 revenue), but operating cash outflow INR12 crore, debt guided to rise to INR230-240 crore and FY28 INR1,000 crore target reiterated without a bridge.

name: BMW Ventures Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue, PBT and PAT growth: ~25% average growth (FY27)
thesis: Steel distributor with Q2 FY27 revenue up 46% to ₹731 crore but gross margin 8.8% and EBITDA up only 11%; growth leans on a fabrication pitch, with 25% FY27 growth guided and no capacity-discipline evidence.

name: Nanta Tech Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 45-50% (FY27)
thesis: Nanta Tech H1 FY27 revenue up 97.7% to INR42.6 cr with margin 23.3%, but no in-house robot capacity (outsourced to Aimtron) and FY27 growth guidance was loosened to 45-50% from 40-50% while prior 15-dealer target was not repeated.

name: Highness Microelectronics Ltd
gLine: Goa facility commissioning: 9 to 12 months (Goa main factory)
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue INR12.01 cr (+63%) and 32.1% EBITDA margin, but operating cash outflow INR14.58 cr, receivables rising, and prior guidance on glass cutting line and FY27 revenue not reaffirmed with numbers.

name: Hindustan Unilever Ltd
thesis: HUL posted 15% USG and 7% UVG on 8% price, with EBITDA margin 22.6% (down 40bp QoQ) and gross margin down ~400bp YoY; pricing is pass-through, not expansion.

name: Hikal Ltd
thesis: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 9.8% on Rs837cr revenue; H2 recovery depends on FDA reinspection and crop CDMO ramp, with ~Rs20cr annual remediation cost still in fixed costs and pricing headwinds from solvent costs up over 100%.

name: Sonata Software Ltd
thesis: International EBITDA fell to 15.4% from 20.2% and utilisation dropped to 88.5% from 91.8% on a delayed large-deal ramp; management says ramp is "largely behind us" but gave no numbers, and no capacity signal is given.

name: OnMobile Global Ltd
gLine: Entertainment and Comm revenue growth: 2% to 5% (FY27)
thesis: Core revenue up 3.4% QoQ to INR 128 crore but down YoY; management is funding the ONMO+ console launch with marketing and expects to raise external capital, so consolidated EBITDA stays thin at INR 2.4 crore.

name: Globus Spirits Ltd
gLine: Capacity utilisation: meaningfully higher than 80-85% (FY27)
thesis: Q2 manufacturing EBITDA fell to INR4.6/litre on grain and fuel inflation; management held the INR5-7 annual guide and expects tighter ethanol supply to lift utilisation, but gave no numbers for it.

name: Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd
thesis: Domino's LFL steered to 5-7% FY27 with Q4→Q1→Q2 uptick, but gross-margin levers absorb ~140bps of ~200bps cost inflation and capex/guidance on Popeyes is not quantified; transcript is garbled and largely qualitative.

name: Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd
thesis: Solar EPC execution fell to 456 MWp in Q2 from 889 MWp in Q1 on developer land delays; EBITDA margin 15.12% with T&D at 9-10% diluting the mix, against prior ~15% FY27 guide.

name: Arvind SmartSpaces Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 call was largely unguided on numbers; management reiterated the prior margin basis and said inventory of ~INR2,700 crore reflects land and construction spend, with BD of INR4,000-5,000 crore a year to sustain growth.
top: BD pace of INR4,000-5,000 crore a year held

name: CL Educate Ltd
gLine: Overhead cost savings H2 FY27: ₹20-22 cr for FY27 remaining H2 (FY27 H2)
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue fell about 4% to ₹305 cr, but EBITDA rose to ₹57 cr (18.6% margin) on ₹12.5 cr overhead cuts; no capacity or pricing read-through, and prior VIRSA and MarTech tech-share guidance was not addressed.

name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: FY27 ROA: overshoot upper end of 1.8%-2%

name: Angel One Ltd
gLine: Consolidated OPM (near term): 40% to 45% (near term)

name: eMudhra Ltd
thesis: Q2 core strong (H1 PAT +27%, margin 16.3%), but TLS certificate incident cuts FY27 guidance: revenue ~INR 800 cr from ~825 cr, PAT ~INR 125 cr from ~137 cr, with TLS exit.

name: One Mobikwik Systems Ltd
gLine: FY28 PAT: INR100 crore if UPI MDR implemented (FY28)
thesis: Q2 FY27 PAT INR 11.8 crore (up 55% QoQ) and EBITDA margin 7.5%, but consumer UPI GMV soft QoQ and FY27 PAT guidance of INR40 crore was not restated; FY28 PAT target lifted to INR100 crore on UPI MDR.

name: SPR Auto Technologies Ltd
gLine: Capex: sizable, not quantified (FY27)
thesis: Volume growth strong (industry production +17%) but margins slipped to 17.9% consolidated on RM pass-through lag and mix; capex "very sizable" yet unquantified, and guidance on growth normalising to 7-8% CAGR.
top: Capex raised across all segments, unquantified

name: Bluspring Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Net debt to EBITDA: acquisition debt to 150 crore by year end
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 49% to INR1,250 crore and EBITDA margin 5.4% (+188bp), but growth is acquisition-led; organic growth 16%, and foundit burn only modestly reduced with break-even targeted for Q4.

name: HDB Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Disbursement growth: Q3 better than Q2, Q4 better than Q3; growth trajectory moving upwards
thesis: NBFC consumer and enterprise lender with disbursements up 18.7% YoY and PAT up 34%, but loan book growth of 11.7% and CV delinquency stretch keep the growth-recovery call unproven; NIM guided to hold at 8.2%+.

name: Shanti Gold International Ltd
gLine: Volume growth: 25-30% (medium term) (FY28-29)
thesis: Q2 revenue up 73% to INR746 cr and volume up 25% on Marol ramp, but EBITDA margin fell to ~5.7% and management cut margin guidance to 5-7% from 7.5-8%, with working capital debt-funded.

name: National Securities Depository Ltd
industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
thesis: Depository with no capacity or pricing lever: demat adds of 15.6 lakh and market share 17.2%, while costs of tech and talent keep rising and IPO-linked revenue carries the quarter; no fee hike yet.
top: No issuer fee hike; settlement pricing stalled

name: Atlanta Electricals Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 23% but EBITDA margin fell to 15.3% (from 17.3%) on firm-price orders and monsoon disruption; INR180 cr finished goods stuck, order inflow slowed to INR421 cr.

name: Fractal Analytics Ltd
gLine: Gross margin: recover significantly in Q3 and Q4
thesis: Revenue up 5% QoQ to INR 957 crore (20% YoY, 10% cc) with gross margin down 225bps to 44% on FDE investment; TMT +6% QoQ but no supply discipline signals, capacity being added ahead of demand.
top: Revenue per employee down in USD

name: Novus Loyalty Ltd
gLine: Consolidated revenue: Rs 500 Cr by FY29; Rs 600-650 Cr by FY30 (FY29-FY30)
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue about Rs 98 Cr (vs ~71 Cr H1 FY26, ~35-40% growth), but H1 was lifted by unbilled work and inventory build, and management guided H2 in line with H1 with no capacity or capex discussion.
top: Unbilled work and voucher inventory build

name: Triveni Power Transmission Ltd
gLine: Medium-term revenue growth: >25% YoY over 5-7 years (5-7 years)
thesis: Order book up 57% YoY to ₹626 crores and H1 capex largely complete, but Q2 product revenue fell on timing and management refuses to quantify guidance or utilisation; EBITDA margin 36.1%.
top: Order book up 57% YoY to ₹626 cr

name: SBI Funds Management Ltd
gLine: Recurring share of Q2 one-time cost increase: 50-60% recurring
thesis: Asset manager with steady AUM share (15%) and stable yields, but Q2 cost step-up (~INR 50 cr QoQ, half said to recur) trims margin; no capacity or supply dimension applicable.
top: Q2 cost base as new run-rate

name: Tonbo Imaging India Ltd
gLine: H2 revenue vs H1: materially better than H1 (qualitative)
thesis: Tonbo's H1 FY27 revenue of ₹219 cr is lumpy (Q1 ₹36 cr, Q2 ₹183 cr) with no formal guidance; management pushes annual framing while order book stands at ₹250 cr and ₹408 cr is under negotiation.
top: Order book ₹250 cr, ₹408 cr under negotiation

name: Bajaj Electricals Ltd-$
gLine: Top-line focus / EBITDA: Exceed prior high EBITDA (~INR 320 cr) in 2–3 years (2–3 years)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up only 1.5% with consumer EBIT 4% (5.9% like-for-like); fans degrowth is the drag, BLDC capacity not ready for 3–6 months, and FY28 margin target now explicitly soft.

name: Bharat Electronics Ltd
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up 26% to INR 12,824 crore with order book INR 68,717 crore; management held all FY27 guidance but QRSAM and NGC order timing is the swing factor and is pushed to March or April.

name: Kirloskar Brothers Ltd-$

thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +24% YoY to Rs12,767m with order intake +68% to Rs20,472m, but gross margin fell ~400bps on commodity costs and UK services mix drag; supply-side signals are thin, with no capacity commentary.

name: Century Enka Ltd
gLine: VAP share of yarn revenue: about 50% (near term)
thesis: Q2 EBITDA margin fell to 5.88% from 15.46% in Q1 as inventory gains reversed; management reiterates 7-10% normalised range, but imports, PTCF slipped to Q4 and capex is not quantified.

name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
thesis: Record Q2 order inflow of ₹1477bn (+28% YoY) and order book ₹8535bn (+28%), but EBITDA margin fell to 8.7% from 10.0% as the low-margin PP&M mix rose; NWC cut to 1.7%.

name: Britannia Industries Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 16.6% with 3.5% price hike taken, but management conceded input inflation (palm oil +17% YoY, milk +16%, laminate +18%) is ahead of pricing and gross margin is under pressure; no numeric margin guidance.
top: Palm oil +17% YoY, cost gap remains

name: ITC Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 standalone net revenue +3% and EBITDA -17% on cigarette tax shock (Cigarette segment PBIT -27%), while non-cigarette segments grew 18% revenue and 23% EBITDA; paper pricing recovering with segment PBIT margin up 320 bps LTL.

name: Punjab Chemicals & Crop Protection Ltd-$
gLine: MoU product revenue FY28: INR15-20 cr (FY28)
thesis: Q2 revenue up 28% to INR326.7 cr but gross margin fell to 34.1% from 39.5% and PAT dropped on missing other income; receivables jumped past INR450 cr on extended credit terms, with capacity utilisation above 80%.

name: Ador Welding Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 12%-13% sustainable level (medium term)
thesis: Ador H1 revenue up 23% to INR654 crores but Q2 gross margin fell to 34.2% on steel inflation; management targets EBITDA margin of 12-13% with pass-through lag, while capex stays modest at INR30-35 crores a year.

name: Oriental Rail Infrastructure Ltd
gLine: Q3 wagon deliveries: at least about 600 (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Q2 wagon output missed its 500 target at 390 (down from 500 promised) on a plant technical delay; management says Q3 will be 600/quarter, but no wagon tender is in hand and FY28 capacity expansion is still unfunded in guidance.

name: Canara Bank
thesis: Canara Bank Q2 FY27: advances up 19.46% YoY vs 11-12% guide, NIM 2.55% qtr, GNPA 1.33% and credit cost 0.47%, but ECL transition provision now seen at ₹12,000-15,000 crore and treasury MTM hit ~₹600 crore QoQ.

name: Century Plyboards (India) Ltd-$
gLine: MDF margin recovery: FY29 onwards back toward 20% (FY29)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR1,780 crore (+28.5% YoY) and plywood margin 15.7%, but MDF margin ~8% H1 with management guiding only to double-digit by year-end amid a 30%+ industry capacity wave, so MDF recovery is pushed to FY29.

name: K.P.R. Mill Limited
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin jumped to 27.5% from 20.8% on flat revenue, with yarn/fabric volume flat at ~36.6k MT and inventory cut to ₹1,024 Cr from ₹1,844 Cr; no capacity or guidance given.

name: eClerx Services Ltd
industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
gLine: H2 CapEx: roughly INR 90 crores per quarter, same as H1 (H2 FY27)
thesis: Revenue growth and margin guide intact at 24-28% EBITDA, but ACV down about 10% YoY in H1 with deal wins falling; management concedes FY27 ACV goal will be difficult and H2 capex is flat, not doubled.

name: Captain Polyplast Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin improvement from benchmark cost revision: at least 1 percentage point (Q3 / by March)
thesis: Q2 EBITDA margin fell to 9.66% from 10.29% on HDPE/LLDPE cost spike; management relies on a government benchmark-cost revision (not yet done) plus 0.5pp Ahmedabad benefit by March, with the 1-1.5pp total spread over three years.

name: Intellect Design Arena Ltd
thesis: Intellect's LTM income up 17% to ₹3,388 cr with Q2 at ₹878 cr, but the transcript shows no capacity or capex signal, and the pipeline grew only 9% with a lost SaaS customer and a heavy-promotion tone.

name: S H Kelkar and Company Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: 12% to 13% year-on-year (2-3 years)
thesis: Fragrance and flavour maker with H1 revenue up 14% to Rs 1,299 crore, but net debt rose to Rs 911 crore on inventory build and management hopes the September peak reverses by March 2027.
top: Net debt Rs 911 crore at Sept

name: Sheela Foam Ltd
gLine: Consolidated FY27 revenue: around INR5,000 crores (pro forma incl. Furlenco) (FY27)
thesis: Raw-material shock (polyol +65%, TDI +33%) is being passed through with volume trade-off; H1 EBITDA margin 9.6% flat, FY28 13-15% target now called "difficult" if prices stay high.

name: Newgen Software Technologies Ltd
thesis: Q2 revenue up only 5.4% to INR422 crore with license down 19.2% YoY and India down 12.6%; management held double-digit FY growth and ~20-22% margin guidance on H2 recovery without numbers.

name: HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd
thesis: HDFC AMC Q2 FY27 shows steady AUM growth (avg AUM INR9.69tn, +10% YoY) and tight cost control, but active equity market share slipped to 11.1% and management offered no new numeric guidance.

name: Dalmia Bharat Ltd
gLine: Q3 input cost increase: INR75/t (INR75-80 per Q&A) (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 weak on East fixed-cost under-absorption (~INR140/t) and INR50/t Central dilution; Q3 cost and price turn guided up, but volume growth was 4% ex-Central and Jaypee dilution rising to INR100-125/t with leverage at ~2x peak.

name: UTI Asset Management Company Ltd
thesis: Standalone core PAT up 31% YoY to Rs 136 crore on revenue up only 2%; management reiterated employee cost guidance but flagged equity outflows, Flexi-Cap weakness and cash of roughly 45-50% of market cap with no special dividend.
top: Equity net sales Rs 5,720 crore in Q2

name: Fairchem Organics Ltd
gLine: Margin aspiration: 15%-18% EBITDA margin (not specified)
thesis: Utilisation is only ~60-65% and management refused to quantify it, while margins rose on duty-driven RM cost relief and China dumping easing; the prior 70-75% exit target is effectively unsupported by the call.

name: Tracxn Technologies Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue Rs21.3 crore, up 1.1% QoQ with EBITDA negative Rs5.9 crore as management invests in sales capacity; no supply-side capacity signal, and the prior FY27 guidance was not repeated.

name: Honasa Consumer Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 was the fastest-growth quarter since listing with 12.7% EBITDA margin; management reiterated margin trajectory but gave no numeric quarterly guidance and the transcript is garbled, so supply-side evidence is absent.

name: Pune E - Stock Broking Ltd
gLine: Profit growth: Double-digit profit growth (FY27)
thesis: Consolidated H1 FY27 revenue up ~30% to INR34.2 crores and PAT up ~37% to INR14.3 crores, but no capacity or supply metrics; growth driven by MTF book and new fee businesses still tiny, so the call is mostly narrative.
top: Regulatory tightening on F&O and MTF

name: Unicommerce Esolutions Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +15% to INR59.1cr but adj EBITDA margin fell to 17% from 22.2%; management reiterates Uniware 15%+ and Shipway 20%+ growth from Q4 and Shipway EBITDA breakeven Q3, with no capacity or supply signals as this is an asset-light SaaS model.

name: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd
gLine: WS revenue next year: at least INR200 crores
thesis: Q2 FY27 PAT ₹63.3 cr (+80% YoY) on ₹285 cr revenue, but management withdrew no numbers, flagged a weak Q3, and kept FY27 guidance unchanged while raising ~₹700 cr QIP for working capital and expansion.
top: FY27 guidance unchanged, revisit at Q3

name: Epack Prefab Technologies Ltd
gLine: Revenue CAGR FY28-29: 25% to 30% (FY28-FY29)
thesis: H1 revenue up 19% to INR867 crore and order inflow up 71% to INR1,124 crore, but gross margin fell about 2.3pp and working capital stretched to ~60 days, so cash conversion, not demand, is the issue.

name: Tata Power Company Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated EBITDA up 5% to ₹4,245 cr (12.8% ex one-off); RE capacity added 539 MW in quarter, 765 MW H1, against FY27 guide of 2,500-2,700 MW, with H1 capex ~₹10,000 cr and net debt up to ₹62,681 cr.
top: H1 RE additions 765 MW vs 2,500-2,700 MW FY guide

name: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Revenue per quarter: above INR100 crore in Q3 FY27 (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 standalone revenue up 9.3% to Rs81 crore with Aequitas and Group Pharma acquisitions adding consolidated Rs96 crore; organic growth still short of the 1.5x IPM target, so the Q3 pivot is unproven.

name: Supreme Industries Ltd
thesis: Piping volume turned to +24% in Q2 after a weak Q1, but H1 volume only about +1% and management cut FY27 volume guidance to about 10% overall, with margin guide held at 14–14.5% despite Q2 margins near 13%.

name: Praj Industries Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 margins ~6.2% with management saying they've bottomed; GenX breakeven now "within next 12 months" (vs FY27 target) and domestic greenfield backlog stalled by ethanol feedstock/funding issues.

name: DCM Shriram Ltd
gLine: Demerger timeline: Board approval soon; targeting Q1 FY28
thesis: Chlor-alkali margins squeezed as caustic prices corrected and power/coal costs rose; utilisation 88-89% and chlorine integration ~70% offer partial support, but no numeric guidance on ECU or debt was repeated.

name: HCL Technologies Ltd
thesis: Services grew 3% QoQ and Advanced AI revenue hit $219M (+78% YoY) with EBIT margin 18.2%; but software fell 11.2% YoY and FY27 guidance trimmed at the top end to 2.5–4%.

name: Birlasoft Ltd
gLine: H2 FY27 financial performance: better than H1 (H2 FY27)
thesis: IT services mid-tier with flat-to-slow growth (QoQ +2.1% cc), Q2 EBITDA margin 15.2% held despite ~170bps wage hit, but H1 TCV ramp is soft and management admits order book missed plan; no supply-side capacity signal.
top: Deals pushed to Q3/Q4, order book below plan

name: IIFL Finance Ltd
gLine: Home finance ROE FY28: 16% to 18%
thesis: Gold-loan-led growth with AUM up 38% YoY to INR1.24 lakh cr and PAT INR805 cr, but gold NPAs rising, home-loan yields falling, and a 10-20% equity dilution pending.
top: Home loan portfolio yield down 10bps QoQ

name: REC Ltd
gLine: Disbursement FY27: over INR2 lakh crore, comfortable to achieve INR2.1 lakh crore
thesis: REC targets 10-12% loan growth and INR2.1 lakh crore disbursements in FY27 with H1 loan book up 6% and disbursements of INR90,000 crore, while management concedes NIMs will face pressure from 3.22% levels.

name: PNC Infratech Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin on remaining revenue: 12% on INR5,800 crore (FY27)
thesis: Management held FY27 revenue INR6,000 cr, FY28 INR7,500 cr and inflow guidance despite H1 revenue of INR2,664 cr, with H2 needing ~INR3,336 cr; BESS project exited and standalone debt rose while cash sits in holdcos.
top: FY27 revenue guidance held at INR6,000 cr

name: AvenuesAI Ltd
thesis: Payments volume grew but take rate fell ~4% QoQ to 5.06 bps and H1 operating cash flow was negative INR 192 crore; management kept FY27 EPS guidance despite H1 EPS of ~4.5 against 8.75–9.5.

name: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd
thesis: Asset manager with 9.02% MF share flat QoQ, but equity yield compressed to 52bps and unique investor count slipping as NFOs were stopped; Q2 PAT hit by INR 96.76 cr SEBI AT1 settlement.

name: H.G. Infra Engineering Ltd
gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR10,000-11,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q2 consolidated EBITDA margin 25.6% is flattered by HAM monetisation; standalone margin 11.9% and H1 PAT margin 1.7% show weak execution, with FY27 revenue push and 13-14% margin guidance resting on delayed appointed dates.
top: Contract assets up to INR2,100 crores

name: Orient Electric Ltd
gLine: Revenue CAGR: more than 15% (medium term)
thesis: Price hikes of 3–6% in Q2 on top of Q1 hikes are only covering 80–100% of inflation; gross margin fell to 29% (H1 29.4%) and management says the 32% long-run target is unchanged but without a timeline.

name: Greenpanel Industries Ltd
gLine: Full-year MDF volume growth: mid-teen (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 volume fell 3.4% YoY and consolidated EBITDA margin dropped to 7.5% from 9.6% as prices were cut; management says oversupply lasts two years, with 800,000-900,000 cbm of new capacity coming, though it also guides mid-teen MDF volume growth.

name: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd
gLine: Greenfield Gurugram Sector-56 EBITDA loss: peak loss INR 40-50 crore; breakeven about one year
thesis: Q2 revenue +20% YoY and EBITDA margin flat at 26.8% despite 14% more beds; occupancy steady at 77%, with oncology drag lapping from Q3 and greenfield drag guided at INR 40-50 crore.
top: Board approves INR 415 cr brownfield expansion

name: Route Mobile Ltd
thesis: Gross margin recovered to 22.4% from 20.9% on new-product mix (RCS/WhatsApp up 36.7% YoY, >10% of revenue), but adjusted EBITDA margin is only 10% against a 12% target, and volume growth slowed to 47.6bn transactions.

name: Jet Freight Logistics Ltd
gLine: FY27 top line: Rs 580-600 Cr (FY27)
thesis: Asset-light air freight forwarder with no supply discipline metrics; H1 FY27 revenue ~Rs 297 Cr, PAT margin ~1.5%, and management guides FY27 revenue Rs 580-600 Cr with no capacity or utilisation data.

name: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Ltd
gLine: Maintenance capex per unit: INR10-20 crores per unit average (4-5 years)
thesis: Hospital chain with a Dombivli ramp-up near EBITDA break-even in Q2 (loss INR0.2 cr vs INR9.5 cr in Q1), but management attributes much of it to seasonal medical admissions and declined to revise the two-year breakeven guidance.
top: Dombivli EBITDA loss INR9.5 cr → INR0.2 cr

name: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Ltd
gLine: Capital return: ~50% of cumulative adjusted FCF over rolling 5 years; buyback INR49.3 cr at INR425
thesis: Q2 FY27 margin recovered to 20.4% (+331 bps YoY) and Paramount migration is done, but group retention at ~90.5% and India TPA Q2 revenue up only 1.2% mean the growth recovery is still unproven.

name: Patel Retail Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: 100 bps and above over time (medium term)
thesis: Q2 FY27 PAT fell to INR9.9cr from INR10.1cr and EBITDA margin compressed to 6.8% from 8.6% on COGS inflation, while capacity utilisation sits at only 55-60%, well below the 80-82% prior target.

name: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations up 17% YoY to INR 121.6 crores and PAT up 21%, but SIP folios and accounts are shrinking and management won't disclose net flows; AUM INR 1.17 lakh crores.

name: Paluck Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR130-140 crores (~25% growth) (FY27)
thesis: Small telecom O&M and equipment-rental firm guiding FY27 revenue INR130-140 crores (~25% growth) and PAT INR17-18 crores, with H1 operating cash flow negative about INR9 crores and receivables up ~80% YoY.

name: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd
thesis: ARCIL H1 FY27 acquisitions up 18% to INR1,707 crores with Q2 up 43%, PAT up 54%, but management gave no guidance and recoveries and write-backs were lumpy; supply-side evidence (capacity, capex) is absent.

name: Blue Star Ltd
gLine: Data-centre order inflow FY27: Rs. 4,000 cr order booking (about Rs. 2,000 cr already in hand)
thesis: Blue Star Q2 FY27 revenue up ~21% on RAC demand but Segment 2 margin fell to 2.3% (from 6.2%); management reiterates 6.5% FY27 target but gives no FY28 guidance and says cost pressure has not softened.

name: Trent Ltd
thesis: Trent Q2 FY27 standalone merchandise revenue +23% and EBITDA +37% with EBIT margin 11.6% vs 10.5%, but PAT up only 9% on base effects; no capacity or supply-side metrics disclosed, so the read is demand-led growth in a retail roll-out.

name: Wipro Ltd
gLine: IT services revenue QoQ CC: -1.5% to +0.5% (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Wipro Q2 FY27 IT services revenue flat QoQ at $2.61B with Q3 guided -1.5% to +0.5% CC; TCV fell on two deals slipping to Q3 and margin rose to 16.5% on rupee and operations, but supply signals are thin.

name: TTK Prestige Ltd
thesis: Strong Q2 with ~23.4% domestic sales growth and ~70.9% EBITDA growth, but management flags rising commodity costs hitting gross margin and says the ~INR 200-250 crore soft-spend programme continues, leaving about INR 150 crore to spend.
top: Commodity costs well above Q4 FY26 levels

name: Vimta Labs Ltd-$
thesis: Q2 revenue up ~10% YoY but flat QoQ on a pharma R&D lull and food sample collapse; capex ran ~INR112-115 crore in H1 versus INR80 crore FY27 budget, with no numeric revenue guidance.
top: H1 capex ~INR112-115 crore vs INR80 crore FY27 budget

name: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd
thesis: Volume up 26.5% YoY to 696,654 units but Op. EBITDA margin fell 330 bps to 9.4% on material cost up 420 bps; PAT down 26.9%, a margin-led not demand-led miss.

name: Alldigi Tech Ltd
industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
gLine: T&D revenue growth (3-year): early double-digit growth (next 3 years)
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up only 4.2% to INR303.6 Cr while EBITDA rose 20.8% and margin hit 28.9%; growth is moderate, margin-led, with domestic BPM deliberately shrunk and receivables rising.
top: Revenue guidance withdrawn for next quarters

name: Sasken Technologies Ltd
gLine: Software services growth: single digit growth on a sustained basis
thesis: Software services margin rose to 32.2% and revenue grew 34% YoY, but product solutions revenue fell 42% QoQ on memory shortages, and management now guides to single-digit software growth.

name: Refex Industries Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 36% to Rs560 cr but EBITDA margin 16% and PAT Rs60 cr; wind execution guidance cut from Rs1,700-1,800 cr to Rs1,300-1,400 cr, ash volume ramp to 90,000 tpd still targeted.
top: Wind execution cut to Rs1,300-1,400 cr

name: Ashoka Buildcon Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin H2 FY27: 9.0% to 9.5% for H2; 10-10.5% EBITDA margin cited for year end (H2 FY27)
thesis: Management now guides FY27 revenue roughly flat to ~10% versus prior 10-15%, H2 EBITDA margin ~9-9.5% after H1 ~7.1%, and order inflow target trimmed to INR4,000-5,000 crores from 6,000-8,000 crores.

name: Orient Cement Ltd
gLine: Capacity by FY29: 149 MTPA (FY29)
thesis: Transcript is an Ambuja Cements (Adani) Q2 FY27 call filed under Orient Cement's listing; management reiterated 149 MTPA by FY29 with ~INR14,500 crore capex and utilisation only ~61-62% in Q2.

name: Indian Railway Finance Corporation Ltd
gLine: PAT growth: near 10% annually (multi-year)
thesis: IRFC is a railway lender pivoting to non-railway lending; management guides AUM near INR5 lakh crore by FY27-end and ~10% PAT growth, with no supply-side or capacity data disclosed.

name: Eureka Forbes Ltd
gLine: Growth acceleration H2: step-up in growth over H1 (15.1%) (H2 FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue up 15% to INR890 crore with adj. EBITDA margin 13.6%, but gross margin down 138 bps to 55.1% and a 3-4% price hike is only effective mid-November, so Q3 margins take a transitory hit.

name: Mankind Pharma Ltd
gLine: R&D spend FY27: upper end, close to 3% of revenue
thesis: Mankind Q2 FY27 revenue up 17% to Rs 4,338 cr with EBITDA margin 27.1%; but India Rx volume growth 6.2% and chronic/price-led gains come with no capacity or capex-discipline signal, and working capital stretched to 51 days.
top: Consumer growth cut to single digit

name: Le Travenues Technology Ltd
gLine: Hotel investment per quarter (contribution + below): INR 10-12 crore range (next couple of quarters)
thesis: Core GTV grew 22% to INR5,304 crore but flights take rate fell 9.4% to 7% on discounts, hotels still loss-making (contribution -15% of revenue), and PAT was flattered by a Freshbus stake-sale gain.

name: Rikhav Securities Ltd
thesis: AGM transcript of a broker's FY26 year: profit after tax about INR19 crores on total income near INR32.5 crores, with no FY27 numeric guidance given, so prior FY27 targets are not addressed.

name: Kalpataru Ltd
thesis: Q2 pre-sales fell 5% to Rs 1,258 crore and H1 was flat at Rs 2,587 crore; management held the Rs 6,500 crore FY27 target and net debt flat, relying on a H2 festive push with three unlaunched projects.

name: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 AMC shows steady AUM (+14.4% YoY, 13.3% share) but flat SIPs and higher redemptions cut net flows; operating PBT +15.7% YoY while PAT fell 7.8% QoQ on lower other income.

name: Dr Reddys Laboratories Ltd
thesis: Reported revenue up only 1.5% YoY to ₹8,671 Cr on lenalidomide decline, but base business grew double digits and EBITDA margin rebounded to 20.6%; PSAI API volumes weak at 9.5% gross margin.

name: HDFC Bank Ltd
gLine: NIM trajectory: neutral to positive, upward from next quarter
thesis: Deposits up 18.8% reported (about 4pts from FCNR(B) window) with cost of funds flat QoQ at about 4.4% and NIM at 3.32%; management says trajectory is upward from next quarter, but LCR at 113% and CEO transition add uncertainty.
top: NIM bottom in Q2, upward from Q3

name: Berger Paints India Ltd
thesis: Q2 standalone EBITDA margin fell to 10.8% on raw-material inflation and a Rs 22 crore campaign spend, though H1 EBITDA margin 14.4% and gross margin 38.1% remain in the 38-41% band; management says price hikes recover ~90% by November.

name: Carborundum Universal Ltd
gLine: Consolidated Ceramics sales growth: 25% to 28% (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated sales +13.1% to INR 1,455 cr with standalone +28%, but Abrasives margin is compressing on phenolic-resin cost push, and management raised Ceramics guidance while cutting Abrasives margin to 8–8.5%.

name: Mastek Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: at least 160 bps in medium term (medium term)
thesis: IT services mid-cap with no capacity signal; 12-month backlog fell 7.7% QoQ to $286.2M on UK and US deal delays, though management still reaffirms FY27 better than FY26 and H2 recovery.

name: Radico Khaitan Ltd
gLine: P&A volume growth FY27: 30% (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 IMFL volume over 10 million cases (+7% YoY), P&A volume +36% and EBITDA margin 20.4%; P&A guidance raised to 30% but gross margin fell 109 bps QoQ on packaging and grain inflation.

name: Strides Pharma Science Ltd
gLine: Product launches: 4 to 6 launches in H2 (H2 FY27)
thesis: Q2 record revenue ₹1,430 crore (+17% YoY) but gross margin fell to 56.0% and working capital rose ₹307 crore; FY28 US $375m aspiration pushed out, with Ex-US now 102% of US.

name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd
gLine: Net debt / EBITDA: 2.76x pro-forma, reverting to 2.5x by end FY27
thesis: Acquisition of Evos (EV ₹-equivalent €2.56bn, 11.7x CY25 EV/EBITDA, 56% margin) is a debt-funded, no-capex value play; leverage rises to 2.76x before guided return to 2.5x by FY27-end.

name: Sharda Cropchem Ltd
gLine: FY27 registration capex: INR550 crores to INR600 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q2 revenue +13% to Rs 1,052 cr but volume fell 5.1% and growth was price/forex/mix; registration-led model shows rising capex and a pipeline that shrank, with FY27 guidance held.

name: R R Kabel Ltd
thesis: Wires & cables revenue +53% in Q2 but volume only high single-digit; FY27 volume guide trimmed to ~14-15% from ~18%, and FMEG lost INR 12 crore in Q2 with breakeven still promised for FY27.

name: Bharti Hexacom Ltd
thesis: Bharti Hexacom is a telecom operator (mobile and homes), not a cables company; this Q4 FY26 Airtel/Hexacom earnings webinar shows Hexacom homes net adds of 148,000, ARPU Rs 252 (about Rs 257-258 EDB) and capex of Rs 586 crore, with no supply-side or capacity signal.

name: GK Energy Ltd
gLine: Receivable days year-end FY27: 120 to 150 max days (FY27)
thesis: Solar pump installer H1 revenue up 38.9% to INR 907.8 cr with PAT margin ~12%, but receivables at 204 days (≈128 days after post-quarter collections) and FY27 3,000 cr target reliant on unconfirmed PM KUSUM.

name: Ambuja Cements Ltd
gLine: Cement volume growth H2 FY27: higher single digit, ahead of industry (H2 FY27)
thesis: Capacity plan raised to 149 Mt by FY29 and 155 Mt by FY30 with ~INR14,500 cr capex for 30 Mt, while utilisation is only ~61-62% in Q2, pushing supply up into a soft market.

name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd
gLine: LCV industry growth: double digit (FY27)
thesis: Auto capacity is the binding constraint: ICE+EV output rose to 82k/month by year-end from 66k with 92k next year, while core tractor guidance cut from +5% to flattish for FY27.

name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 sales up 11.8% but US sales fell 8.2% on lenalidomide erosion and EBITDA grew only 4.8%; R&D running below plan with H2 catch-up promised, and FY27 guidance held at high single digit.

name: Jindal Stainless Ltd
gLine: H1 EBITDA per ton / FY27 EBITDA per ton: INR20,000 to INR22,000 per ton (FY27)
thesis: Volume guidance cut to 4-6% from 7-9% and H2 implied growth is steep; EBITDA/ton raised to INR20,000-22,000 despite weak domestic volumes and Chinese 200-series import surge.

name: Indoco Remedies Ltd
gLine: Europe/UK growth: 20% plus for next 1-2 years
thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue up 7.4% to Rs 507 crore but standalone EBITDA margin fell to 9.2% from 12.4% on freight and material cost spikes; India down 6% with no capex discipline issue, debt repayment on track.

name: UFO Moviez India Ltd
gLine: Q3/Q4 advertising revenue: no numeric guidance; qualitative 'better quarter than expected'
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue ₹1,299m (+17% YoY) but EBITDA flat at ₹213m as low-margin product sales and fixed costs dilute; no capacity signal, management declines to guide Q3 revenue.
top: EBITDA flat YoY despite revenue growth

name: Syngene International Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue fell 9% YoY to Rs 833 Cr and operating EBITDA margin halved to 18% (22% a year ago), with no capacity cuts or pricing commentary; the presentation is a weak, supply-neutral read.

name: IRCON International Ltd
gLine: Standalone operating turnover FY27: Rs.9,000-9,500 crore (FY27)
thesis: Order book ~Rs.21,296 crore (about 2x revenue) with H1 inflows near Rs.1,000 crore, yet management still guides FY27 turnover up 5-6% to Rs.9,000-9,500 crore; margin guidance restated but not quantified against prior.

name: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd
thesis: Revenue grew 10% to Rs 429 crore but paying suppliers fell by 615 to 2.17 lakh on Silver churn, and management gave no churn timeline and a 10-15% hit to enquiries from Google/AI search changes.

name: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd
gLine: ESOP cost impact: ₹55–60 crore per year for next 2 years plus ₹14–15 crore per annum from new scheme
thesis: Equity MF AUM ₹2.09 lakh crore (+9% YoY) and flows improving on retention and ETF growth (+42%), but employee cost step-up and ESOP ramp (₹55–60 cr/yr) pressure margins; prior yield guidance held.

name: AWL Agri Business Ltd
gLine: Food and FMCG full-year volume: 8%-9%
thesis: Q2 FY27 normalised EBITDA up 11% to INR623 crore, but H1 volume growth 11% sits with Food margin 3.2% and an INR6,000 crore inventory build funded by working-capital lines; edible oil EBITDA/t INR4,100 in range.

name: Prudent Corporate Advisory Services Ltd
thesis: Equity AUM up 16.2% YoY to INR1.37 lakh cr with record net sales of INR4,137 cr, but insurance renewal commission cut proposal (IDE 5% vs IDA 10%) threatens ~12% of PBT.

name: Archean Chemical Industries Ltd
thesis: Bromine and salt volumes are behind plan, SOP guidance cut from 9,000-10,000 t to 3,500-4,000 t, and SiCSem capex is being committed with INR1,000-1,100 crore of debt to follow, while pricing and the road-driven cost relief remain unproven.

name: Veefin Solutions Ltd
thesis: Veefin's H1 FY27 revenue rose 116% to Rs 238.8 cr, but DSO was 88 days and operating cash flow was negative, with no supply-side capacity data to judge the business by.
top: Negative operating cash flow in H1

name: Enviro Infra Engineers Ltd
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up 54% but EBITDA margin fell to ~20.8% and PAT halved to INR28.5 crore; management reiterated FY27 revenue INR2,000 crore on an H2 ramp of INR1,300 crore while debt rose to INR704 crore.
top: Receivables INR155 cr → INR322 cr in H1

name: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd
thesis: Broking-platform read: Cost to Serve rose on AI compute and a one-time INR10-13 crore hit while Cost to Grow fell on IPL timing; no hard numbers on guidance, and CAS outcome is the swing factor for volumes.
top: MTF haircuts raised to 80% on crowded stocks

name: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd-$
gLine: Footwear volume growth: 5% to 10% yearly
thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue up 18% to INR282.95 cr, but standalone up only 6% as exports were pulled from India warehouse stock; PU utilisation 25% vs 40% breakeven, and no capacity cut or deferral.
top: US warehouse stock cleared to lift consol sales

name: Persistent Systems Ltd
gLine: Nagarro one-time expenses: approximately $50 million over three to four quarters (3-4 quarters)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue USD 487.6m (+7.8% QoQ cc) but EBIT margin slipped to 15% with utilisation down to 85.8%; Nagarro deal adds ~USD 50m one-offs and debt, and the supply-side read is hiring ahead of ramp-ups rather than discipline.

name: ICICI Life Insurance Ltd
thesis: Life insurer H1 VNB up 22.3% to ₹12.83bn with margin 26.0% driven by protection mix, but management flagged a consultation paper threatening credit-life and renewal-commission economics and gave no growth guidance.

name: Avenue Supermarts Ltd
thesis: Store base reached 518 with 18 added in H1 FY27 versus 85 in H1 FY26 (presentation); LFL growth slowed to 5.5% in Q1 and 9.5% in Q2, but no FY27 guidance is restated in this deck.

name: Capacite Infraprojects Ltd
gLine: CIDCO revenue run rate FY28: not less than INR50 crore per month (INR600 crore a year) (FY28)
thesis: Record Q2 revenue INR771 crore (+19%) but EBITDA margin 15.5% and PAT down YoY; order inflow INR2,487 crore YTD versus INR4,500 crore target, with commodity-escalation gap still open.

name: Latent View Analytics Ltd
thesis: Q2 USD revenue up 2% QoQ with FY27 tech guided down ~5% to $127M; margin pressured by bench and wage hikes, $200M target pushed out ~9 months to CY2028.

name: Shankara Buildpro Ltd
gLine: Non-steel share of revenue: 12-15% in around 2 years
thesis: Management reiterates 3.5% steady-state EBITDA margin and marketing-led growth; Q2 margin pressure from competition and marketing, with the western region now about 20% of revenue, though volume and margin numbers are garbled in the transcript.
top: Margin pressure from competition and marketing

name: Lupin Ltd
thesis: US pressure from Tolvaptan generics and Mirabegron LoE pushes margin guide toward lower end; FY27 US USD 1.1-1.2bn held, but FY28 floor cut to "at least USD 1 billion" and R&D moderation hinted.

name: Jindal Saw Ltd
gLine: FY27 volumes: Higher than FY26 (FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA fell to INR265 crore (from INR341 crore in Q1) on MENA delays and low-margin water mix; management expects H2 better than H1 and margins to recover from Q3, without quantified guidance.

name: Rico Auto Industries Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 margin collapse from air-freight and launch chaos: EBITDA just INR9.3 cr on INR852 cr revenue, loss after tax INR26.3 cr; FY27 revenue target of over INR3,200 cr kept but margin recovery is pushed to Q4 with no numbers.

name: Engineers India Ltd
thesis: Q2 FY27 PAT up 65% YoY to INR180 crore on consultancy mix shift to 68% and ~30% consultancy margin; order book record INR20,421 crore, H1 inflow INR7,428 crore vs INR8,000 crore target, management says INR8,100 crore as of today.
themes: Refinery and gas value chain capex

name: D. B. Corp Ltd
gLine: Newsprint cost Q3-Q4: prices down 2-3% (Q3-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue fell to INR614 cr (from 635) on festive shift and 21% newsprint cost hike; management guides only qualitatively, circulation flat at ~38 lakh with no cover-price hikes, and a capex-light cash pile of ~INR1,120 cr.

name: Music Broadcast Ltd
thesis: Radio revenue flat-to-down with cost cuts driving profit: Q2 revenue INR41 crores (+8% YoY, -8% QoQ), expenses down ~20% YoY; no supply-side or capacity signals, and management declined to guide beyond the current quarter.

name: CSB Bank Ltd
gLine: Cost of funds: around 6% next financial year (FY28)
thesis: Q2 FY27 ROA rose to 1.29% and NIM to 3.81%, but management trimmed the FY27 ROA ambition to 1.30-1.50% and gold share guidance to ~50%, with fee-income pressure from draft IRDAI rules.

name: SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd
gLine: Gross credit cost FY27: around 6% (FY27)
thesis: Credit cards: gross credit cost fell to 5.6% (down 98bps QoQ) but management guided ~6% for FY27, NIM to be range-bound as CoF rises, and receivables growth only expected from Q3.

name: PB Fintech Ltd
gLine: Insurance premium FY27: over ₹40,000 Cr for the year (FY27)
thesis: Insurance distribution faces IRDAI commission-cut overhang; management won't reiterate prior guidance, PB Health ~₹500 Cr run-rate reiterated, no numeric FY27 insurance or Paisabazaar EBITDA updates.
top: IRDAI commission cut overhang on insurance payouts

name: Go Fashion (India) Ltd
gLine: Closures Q3 FY27: 15 to 20 stores (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Go Fashion's Q2 FY27 revenue fell 3% to Rs 218 crore with gross margin at 60.8%, down on fabric inflation; store closures are slowing but SSSG is only flat and H2 hinges on festive timing and price hikes.

name: Metro Brands Ltd
gLine: Staff cost: front-end staff cost increase 0.5% to 1% (FY27)
thesis: Metro Brands Q2 FY27 revenue grew 12% with EBITDA margin up to 27.1% and gross margin up, but PAT margin flat at 10.6%; store net adds slowed to 34 opened and 13 closed in H1 on rentals and BIS supply gaps.
top: Inventory normalisation pushed to mid-to-end FY28

name: Dachepalli Publishers Ltd
gLine: FY28 turnover: Rs225-230cr (FY28)
thesis: H1 FY27 turnover up 74% to Rs70.06cr and PAT up 29% to Rs9.71cr, but margins fell below guidance on paper costs; management reiterated FY27 Rs150cr±10% and 14-16% PAT with paper 90% pre-bought.

name: GHCL Ltd

name: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Ltd

name: HMA Agro Industries Ltd

name: Netweb Technologies India Ltd

name: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Ltd

name: IRM Energy Ltd

name: TBO TEK Ltd

name: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd

name: Desco Infratech Ltd

name: Aditya Infotech Ltd

name: Prasol Chemicals Ltd

name: Granules India Ltd-$
gLine: Genome Valley utilisation: above 50% by year-end (FY27)

name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd-$
gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin (medium term): 32%-33%, plus/minus 1% (next 1-2 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR1,045 cr and EBITDA margin 34.2%, but supply-side read is mixed: HFC 15,000 t capacity on track for Q3 FY27, CDMO Phase 2 capex INR125 cr, and management guides margin 32-33% ±1%.
top: New capex INR90 cr advanced materials

name: Electronics Mart India Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 18% to 20% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +39% to INR 2,419 cr and EBITDA margin 9.9%, but much of the lift is a weak-base summer and temporary chip-price gains; FY27 guided at 18-20% revenue growth and post-Ind AS EBITDA margin 7.5-8%.

name: P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd
gLine: Other expenses FY27: ~INR400 cr, ~3% of sales (FY27)
