name: Epack Prefab Technologies Ltd
gLine: Data-centre order in Q2: At least one turnkey PEB order
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~25% to INR366 cr, order book INR1,380 cr; EBITDA margin fell ~100 bps to 9.4% on steel costs, with management guiding FY27 EBITDA margin 10.5% and FY27 revenue INR1,900-1,950 cr.

name: E2E Networks Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,568m (+334% YoY, +64% QoQ) on 1,024 B200 going live and near-full utilisation; capacity-led, but no guidance, and management pushed back on MRR, customer mix and loan quantum.

name: LEAP India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth YoY: 20%+ (FY27 and long term)
thesis: Pallet pooling leader LEAP grows revenue 19% and EBITDA 21% in Q1 FY27 while trimming asset capex to INR76 crore from INR110 crore, with utilisation up to 89.2% and no new capacity push.

name: SPML Infra Ltd
gLine: BESS revenue FY27: INR200-300 crore (FY27 (Q4))
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 74% YoY to INR286 crore with EBITDA margin ~10%, but order intake of INR1,293 crore is thin against a >INR5,000 crore FY27 target and BESS revenue depends on NTPC design approval by December.

name: Aarti Drugs Ltd
gLine: Volume growth FY27 (next two years): 10% to 15% volume growth (next two years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 growth was mostly price-led: API realisations up ~16-17% YoY while volumes rose only ~3.5%, with management admitting demand fell as buyers held stock, and Sayakha utilisation reached ~65%.

name: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin target: 30% in 2-3 years (2-3 years)
thesis: Hotel operator (asset-light, leased) reports Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to Rs 91 cr and EBITDA up 36% to Rs 25 cr; no supply discipline data, capex limited, pipeline ~400 keys in 12-15 months.

name: Sterling Tools Ltd-$
gLine: Standalone fasteners FY27 margin: Hold margin structures on full-year basis
thesis: Standalone fasteners at 90–95% utilisation with ₹88 cr capex mostly in H2 FY27, steel pass-through pending; SEM and STML loss-making with breakeven targeted FY28 at ~₹225–250 cr combined revenue.

name: Alicon Castalloy Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth (underlying, ex-material): 12% to 15% (FY27)
thesis: Alicon's Q1 FY27 revenue crossed Rs 500 crore with 9.5% EBITDA margin (vs 11.4% last year) as aluminium pass-through lags; management guides 12-15% growth and +1% margin, while capacity is ~90-100% utilised and new Rs 125 crore plant adds ~Rs 500 crore revenue by FY30-31.

name: National Aluminium Company Ltd
gLine: Alumina sales volume FY27: 1.6 million tonnes (FY27)
thesis: NALCO Q1 FY27 volumes at record and alumina realisation near $323 with Q2 guided ~$370, but input costs up INR15,000-16,000/t on metal and capex ramps to ~INR2,500 crore next year on a 1 Mt refinery and smelter expansion.

name: Sobha Ltd
gLine: Land payments FY27: INR1,500-1,600 cr if deals close (FY27)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 presales of INR3,656 cr (+76% YoY) and 9.7% EBITDA with guidance for 17-20% by Q4, but collections lagged and launch-driven demand is the story, not supply discipline.

name: GHCL Textiles Ltd
gLine: Normalised EBITDA margin (current year): 14-15% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 17% on inventory-aided spreads (~Rs155/kg vs Rs138 in Q4); management guides normalised 14-15% and says Q2 spreads slightly lower than Q1, with 98% spinning utilisation and no new yarn capacity beyond knitting.

name: Concord Biotech Ltd
gLine: API revenue FY31 scale: INR2,200-2,300 crores in 5-6 years (5-6 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR257cr (+26%) with API +42% and EBITDA margin 32%, but no capacity addition; Unit 3 utilisation ~55% and Unit 2 ~25% leave ample spare capacity, so supply discipline is intact and growth is partly FY26 spillover.

name: Jyoti CNC Automation Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: INR200-250 crores (FY27)
thesis: Standalone revenue +37% to INR509 cr and 86% utilisation with 10,000-machine expansion due September, but Huron revenue recognition switched to delivery-based, cutting consolidated EBITDA margin to 23.4% adjusted.
top: Export licence delays hold Huron revenue

name: Standard Engineering Technology Ltd
gLine: Core engineering revenue FY27: ~INR1,200 crores, 40-50% growth (FY27)
thesis: Record Q1 with revenue up 41% and EBITDA margin 17.5%, but the story is pivoting to unproven AI data-centre and GL Hakko ventures; core order book INR1,400 crores with no capacity or utilisation data disclosed.

name: Bluspring Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Long-term ROE and EBITDA margin: 20% ROE, 5.5-6% EBITDA margin, pulled to FY29 (FY29)

name: Aditya Infotech Ltd
gLine: FY27 price increase for the year: around 25%
thesis: CP PLUS-led Q1 FY27 revenue of INR1,402 crores (+89.5% YoY) with EBITDA margin 14.8%; capacity ~2.5 million units/month at 85-90% utilisation, with capex to roughly double capacity over three years, but price pass-through of 10-20% is the main margin driver.

name: BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 49% to INR 733 cr with pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin 7.5% (+273 bps); supply-side discipline is not evidenced, and management is guiding ~20% store CAGR with no capex or capacity figures.

name: Fujiyama Power Systems Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 70% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 125% to Rs 13,457m and EBITDA margin 18.9%, but supply-side evidence is mostly capacity additions (3.5GW panels, 4GW power electronics) with utilisation of new Ratlam plant only 40-50% and a Rs 1,436m fire loss.

name: KSH International Ltd
gLine: Working capital days: 30-35 net days achievable over multiple quarters (multi-quarter)
thesis: Winding-wire maker KSH is running at 73.5% utilisation on 43,445 MT, with EBITDA/ton at ~INR93,000 vs INR74,000 in Q4; management guides only to a comfortable ~INR75,000 and Phase 2 adds ~16,000 MT by March 2027.

name: Msafe Equipments Ltd
thesis: Msafe's Q1 FY27 PAT rose 44% to ₹7.27 cr on rental-led growth, but the transcript is heavily garbled and capacity additions (Mathura plant targeted May 2027, Delhi premises) are delayed and not yet producing.

name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY28 reported EBITDA: minimum INR3,000 crore
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 68-74% to ~INR462-494 crore with 500 MW commissioned and FY28 minimum EBITDA guidance of INR3,000 crore, but CTU curtailment of ~70% persists through FY27.

name: Susan Electricals India Ltd
gLine: HT & MVCC share of revenue: ~15% by year-end, ~50% by end FY27 (inconsistent) (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 279% to ₹95.36 Cr with PAT ₹6.39 Cr, but the transcript is internally inconsistent on HT/MVCC share (5-10% vs 10-15% vs ~50% target) and product margins, and capex is only ₹15-20 Cr against a claimed 60% capacity add.

name: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd
thesis: Record Q1 operating EBITDA of INR845 crore (26% margin) on TAN and ammonia price strength; two new capacities (Gopalpur TAN, Dahej nitric acid) due to start in Q2 FY27, within approved capex of INR3,850 crore spent.

name: Cosmo First Ltd
gLine: Consolidated topline growth FY27: about 20% (FY27)

name: Apcotex Industries Ltd
gLine: Incremental top line from announced capex: about 600 crores (2027)

name: Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd
gLine: Phase-2 to 66,000 MT: by September 2027 (Sep 2027)

name: Allcargo Terminals Ltd

name: Aeroflex Industries Ltd

name: Exicom Tele-Systems Ltd
gLine: Consolidated EBITDA breakeven: Q2 FY27 (Q2 FY27)

name: Pace Digitek Ltd
gLine: EBITDA/PAT margin BESS: PAT 10.5%-11% (FY27)

name: LG Electronics India Ltd
gLine: Export growth FY27: Qualitative: significantly increase exports, no number (FY27)

top: Sri City capex INR5.88bn in Q1

name: EFC (I) Ltd

name: Keystone Realtors Ltd

name: Diffusion Engineers Ltd

name: Sanathan Textiles Ltd

name: Senores Pharmaceuticals Ltd

thesis: Demand far exceeds supply: wholesale up 81% to 83,000 units, dealer inventory cut to 3 days, and capacity expansion (AURIC, 4.2 to 9.2 lakh units) is the key supply response, while commodity costs cut gross margin to 22.4%.

name: Aegis Vopak Terminals Ltd

name: M & B Engineering Ltd

name: WeWork India Management Ltd

name: Rubicon Research Ltd

name: Grasim Industries Ltd

name: The Phoenix Mills Ltd

name: Westlife Foodworld Ltd

name: Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd

name: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Ltd

name: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Ltd

name: TVS Motor Company Ltd

name: V-Mart Retail Ltd

name: Fairchem Organics Ltd

name: Clean Science and Technology Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 5% QoQ to INR203 cr on realisation gains, with HALS at 22% of sales; volume fell YoY on a two-week raw-material shutdown, and the 3,000 t HALS target was reaffirmed.

name: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Ltd

name: Innova Captab Ltd

name: Exato Technologies Ltd

name: Lohia Corp Ltd

top: Capex INR900 crore last year, continuing

name: Black Box Ltd
gLine: Revenue FY27: INR7,800-8,000 crore (+23-27%) (FY27)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,719 crore (+24% YoY) and order backlog of about US$950 million (+83%); FY27 guidance kept, with a 10% margin goal pushed to Q4 and beyond.

name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd
thesis: Auto and Farm margins absorbed 400-500 bps commodity pressure in Q1 FY27; Auto price hikes of 1.5% then 2.7% average are the offset, while capacity doubling by FY31 (ICE SUV to 60k/month by September) signals competitive capex.

name: Gufic Biosciences Ltd
gLine: Indore capacity utilisation: 40% to 45% by year-end FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Gufic's Indore plant is ramping from ~30% toward 40–45% utilisation by year-end with no new capex; Q1 revenue +15% YoY to INR260.8 cr and EBITDA margin 18.1%, but the revenue ceiling rests on management's own unverified estimates.

name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd
gLine: Pune CCS/bus bar revenue potential: ₹300-400 cr over ~3 years; 10-15% in year 1 (3 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +33.4% to ₹182.2 cr with margin gain driven by shunt strip-to-part conversion; bimetal utilisation only 40-45% and capacity still idle, so supply discipline is intact but growth is partly silver-led.

name: Pitti Engineering Ltd-$
gLine: Lamination volume FY27: 82,000 tons (FY27)
thesis: Pitti's sheet-metal utilisation rose to 73% from 70% and machining to 86% from 82%, with the Lamination target raised to 82,000 tons; but margins are flat near 16.8% and machining is the bottleneck.

name: Usha Martin Ltd
gLine: Plasticated LRPC volume FY27: 3,500 to 4,000 tons (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR 1,033 crore and EBITDA margin 20.1%, but wire rope volumes flat on Middle East volume down 28%; management reiterates 10-12% FY27 volume growth with capacity in place.
top: Steel and zinc costs passed through

name: Websol Energy System Ltd
gLine: TOPCon upgrade completion: by March 2027, cell capacity 1.2 GW to 1.35 GW
thesis: Q1 FY27 cell utilisation 92% and module utilisation 81% (from 39%) show the base being used, but EBITDA margin fell to 34% from 47% on module mix, with cell prices soft in the prior quarter and inventory building.

name: KEI Industries Ltd
gLine: Operating EBITDA margin: 11% to 12% (coming year)
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin up on mix and retail, with Sanand greenfield ramp at 50% and new ₹700cr LV/MV capex announced; management stays conservative at 20%+ growth despite industry running near 30%.

name: Poly Medicure Ltd
gLine: Standalone gross margin: 68-69% (near term)
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA margin 28% on price hikes and inventory gain, with management guiding back to 25-27% and consolidated revenue guide of INR2,300-2,400 crore held; Middle East shipments stalled (-32%).

name: Jupiter Wagons Ltd
gLine: Wheelset (Odisha) revenue at full commissioning: INR2,500-3,000 crore; EBITDA at least ~15% (FY28 onwards)
thesis: Consolidated revenue up 46% YoY to INR671 crore but EBITDA margin only ~10% and wagon production fell to 1,141 units from 1,347 as the company shifted to new private-wagon designs; order book ~INR4,500 crore.

name: Vardhman Special Steels Ltd
gLine: EBITDA per ton range: INR 8,000-12,000 next year (FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes 59,000 t (+6.5% YoY) with EBITDA ₹10,760/t and realisations rising; capacity capped at 3 lakh t licence, so supply growth hinges on pending 3.6 lakh t EC approval.
top: Rolling mill at 3 lakh t capacity

name: Pricol Ltd
gLine: Polymer turnover capacity: Rs2,000cr from Rs1,000cr (post capex)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 23.5% YoY to Rs1,083.6cr but EBITDA margin 11.41% on input-cost shock; management says lost ~1.5% margin is delayed, recoverable via indexation in Q2–Q3, with polymer capacity the constraint.
themes: Input cost inflation / West Asia crisis

name: Amber Enterprises India Ltd
gLine: Railway/Defence EBITDA margin FY27: 15% to 16%
thesis: Consolidated revenue +13% to INR3,888 cr and EBITDA +28% to INR337 cr, but PCB margins compressed to ~12% on a two-quarter CCL pass-through lag; electronics FY27 40%+ growth guide reiterated and ILJIN fire adds disruption risk.

name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd
gLine: Concurrent construction capacity: 32 platforms by end of calendar year 2026 (CY2026)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 39% to ₹1,815 crore with order book ₹13,596 crore; growth hinges on the pending ₹ NGC contract, expected to be signed this quarter, with revenue only from FY28.

name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd
gLine: Nykaa Now city footprint: over 25 cities by end FY27
thesis: Nykaa Q1 FY27 shows broad demand acceleration (GMV +34%, EBITDA +68%) with capital-light, asset-light model; supply-side signals are limited to capital discipline and modest store expansion, with no capacity-cycle evidence.

name: S.J.S. Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Decoplast revenue doubling: Double sales in 3 to 4 years (3-4 years)
thesis: Record Q1FY27 revenue Rs 2,610 mn (+24.5% YoY) and 27th straight quarter of outperformance, but adjusted PAT margin 19.3% and no peer or industry capacity data; supply-side evidence thin.

name: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 37% with only ~7pp from copper, but margins squeezed by copper lag and minimum-wage hikes; pass-through still pending with 3–6 month lag, greenfields only at break-even.

name: Veranda Learning Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: approximately INR670 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +42% to INR150 cr and PAT INR34 cr, but EBITDA margin slid to ~36% (34.7% ex-other income) and FY27 guide implies ~38.8% margin; supply-side read is capacity expansion (colleges doubled) expensed upfront, with demerger the main catalyst.

name: DIVGI TORQTRANSFER SYSTEMS Ltd
gLine: Revenue target: INR 1,000 crore first milestone; INR 2,000 crore addressable potential (not dated)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 141.8 cr (+85% YoY) and EBITDA margin 29.4%, but driven by a one-off Indonesia transfer-case order (~30% dispatched of 70,000 units); no capacity addition announced beyond a planned line upgrade.

name: Flair Writing Industries Ltd
gLine: Working capital improvement: ~10 days (by end of FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +10.6% YoY to INR319.2 cr with EBITDA margin 16.7% (down 46 bps YoY); gross margin hit by West Asia raw-material spike, pricing actions and reiterated 15% FY27 growth guidance.

name: Sudeep Pharma Ltd
gLine: NSS FY27: flattish with single-digit growth (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 27% to INR158.3 cr with EBITDA margin 34.7%, but specialty ingredients grew only 19% on LPG-driven utilisation cuts (sub-50% for half the quarter) and NSS is dragging margins.
top: Utilisation fell below 50% in LPG outage

name: CMR Green Technologies Ltd
gLine: Installed capacity: beyond 7 lakh tons by end FY27 (end FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up 25% with EBITDA steady at ~INR12/kg, but utilisation near 65%, negative operating cash flow and D/E at 0.86 keep the capital-cycle read cautious.

name: Hero MotoCorp Ltd
gLine: Full-year industry growth: approaching double digit (FY27)
thesis: Hero's Q1 FY27 volume grew 23% and revenue 36% on 8% mix benefit, but gross margin fell 300bp on ~4.5% commodity inflation; EBITDA margin 13.3%, with EV capacity rising from 15,000 to ~30,000 a month and targeted 45,000 by year-end.

name: NOCIL Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs 1,400-1,600 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 403 cr (+20% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.2%, but volumes fell 3% QoQ on supply constraints; FY27 guided Rs 1,400-1,600 cr revenue and ~10% EBITDA, with ADD on Sulphonamides in force and Pilflex 13 pending.

name: Shaily Engineering Plastics Ltd
gLine: Gross margin normalisation: back to normalised level by Q3
thesis: Healthcare pen revenue up 85% to INR142 cr (51% mix) on ~9 million pens in Q1, but utilisation only 50.2% and gross margin fell QoQ on pass-through lags; 36 million FY27 guidance said beatable.

name: Greaves Cotton Ltd
gLine: GEML EBITDA positive: Possibly positive in next 4 to 6 quarters (4-6 quarters)
thesis: Consolidated revenue up 31% to INR975 crore but margins down 2-2.5 pts on commodity inflation and Greaves.Next spend; management guides Q2 marginally better, H2 better, full-year margin held.
top: Margins down 2-2.5 pts on input costs

name: Finkurve Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Lending yield: stabilise around 20% to 20.5%, ~50 bps uplift (FY27)
thesis: Gold lender grew AUM 135% YoY but leverage rose from 0.7x to 2.9x D/E and ROA fell to 2.9%; management guides 50-60% AUM growth and yields ~20%, with gold-price-driven ticket size shrinkage and no supply-side capacity discipline discussed.
top: Ticket size shrinking with gold price

name: MM Forgings Ltd-$
gLine: EBITDA margin: 20-plus goal; 2-3% squeeze (medium term)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up to ~20,200 t (vs 78,000 t FY26 run-rate) with management guiding 23-25k t per quarter and ~INR1,800-1,900 cr turnover, but working capital and inventory are flagged as needing cuts.

name: TCPL Packaging Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 non-separator capex: INR 100-150 crore (FY27)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with PAT up ~79% to INR 40 crore and volumes up high single digit, but management is pivoting capex into a new battery separator venture (INR 125 crore) while folding carton utilisation is only ~70%-plus.

name: Filatex India Ltd-$
gLine: Peak net debt FY27: INR150-200 crore (end FY27)
thesis: Filatex Q1 FY27 volumes flat QoQ at 89,872 MT with production cut to 84,075 MT in April; margins held on pass-through, Ecosis chemical recycling (1 to 75 TPD) targets ~INR80-85 crore EBITDA, with stabilisation risk and no prior-guidance check.

name: UNO Minda Ltd-$
gLine: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar seating plant operations: commence by Q2 FY28 (Q2 FY28)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR 5,557 cr (+26% YoY) with EBITDA margin 10.3%; management holds FY27 11% ±50bp with bias to upper end, but ~40bp commodity pass-through dilution and capex of ~INR1,750 cr this year.

name: Gokaldas Exports Ltd
gLine: Africa EBITDA recovery to double digit: Q4 FY27 or early Q1 FY28
thesis: Q1 FY27 growth led by India (+16% YoY) and Africa (+45%) while Indian apparel exports fell 12%; capacity adds are funded but back-end loaded to FY28-29, and BTPL remains loss-making at about -7.5% to -8% EBITDA.

name: JK Cement Ltd
gLine: Q2 cost per tonne increase: INR150/t (fuel ~INR100, diesel/other ~INR50)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes grew 18% YoY on Central India capacity, but standalone EBITDA margin fell to 16.9% from 21.9% a year ago as fuel costs rise; management guides ~INR150/t cost increase in Q2 and no expansion delay.

name: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Ltd
gLine: Standalone FY27 revenue growth: 10% to 12% (FY27)
thesis: Standalone orders in hand INR 7,727 crore and manufacturing margin held at 12%, but FY27 revenue guided only 10-12% and Philippines ethanol lost INR 83 crore in Q1 at 65% utilisation.
top: Mfg capacity: INR 502 cr approved, ~INR 1,200 cr revenue potential

name: Sportking India Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: around INR3,000 crores (~20% growth) (FY27)
thesis: Cotton yarn spread rose to INR133/kg from INR107 with an 18.8% EBITDA margin; management guides next two quarters around these levels, with the 150,000-spindle Odisha expansion adding capacity from Q3.

name: Satin Creditcare Network Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 reported ROA 3.55% absorbs a INR36 crore management overlay (ex-overlay ~4.34%); credit cost 3.06% reported vs 1.97% ex-overlay, with NIM up to 14.36% and GNPA down to 2.2%.

name: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue INR156 crore (+17% YoY) with 31% EBITDA margin, but guidance is 40-45% growth and the order-book upside rests on QRSAM, MIGM and Pinaka orders not yet placed; no capacity discipline signal.

name: Adani Green Energy Ltd
gLine: BESS cumulative target: 50 GWh by FY30 (FY30)

top: Merchant risk moved to related party AESL

name: Restaurant Brands Asia Ltd
gLine: Marketing spend Q1 vs normal: Q1 6.6% of sales, normalising toward 5-5.5%
thesis: India SSSG 12.6% on traffic with no price hike; gross margin 70.8% targeted to 72% in 3 years, capex discipline, but no capacity or supply-side metrics beyond 80 stores/yr pace and Indonesia capex on hold.

name: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA growth: more than 20% (FY27)

top: Balance capex INR9,580 cr to deploy

name: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: high double digit (FY27)

name: Sapphire Foods India Ltd
thesis: QSR operator (KFC, Pizza Hut, Sri Lanka) posted positive SSSG across all three brands with KFC at 5%, but Sri Lanka margins are under pressure and Pizza Hut restaurant EBITDA is negative at -3.6%.

name: RateGain Travel Technologies Ltd

name: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd

top: Capex per bed INR75-80 lakh for 1,800 beds

name: D.P. Abhushan Ltd
gLine: Volume growth: ~10% p.a. FY27 and FY28 (internal) (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 58% to ₹853.6 cr but volume growth only 1–2%, with gold price doing most of the lifting; management targets ~10% volume growth for FY27 and FY28 and has slowed store additions.

name: Dee Development Engineers Ltd
gLine: Order inflow FY27: >Rs 2,000 cr

name: Premier Energies Ltd
gLine: 7 GW cell line first revenue: First revenue September; 50-60% utilisation by November; at least 70% by March quarter
thesis: Premier Energies' Q1 FY27 shows record revenue INR2,508 crore (+34% YoY) and 7 GW TOPCon cell line starting ~Sept, with DCR modules sold out into FY28 but non-DCR modules unprofitable amid ~250 GW module capacity against ~60 GW demand.
top: Non-DCR module capacity 200+ GW vs ~30 GW demand

name: Gala Precision Engineering Ltd
gLine: Effective tax rate: around 20% or less than 20%
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ~INR75 cr (+20% YoY), EBITDA margin 16.51% with FY27 guided at 17–19%; order book ~INR110 cr vs INR80–85 cr a year ago, but capacity ramp and working-capital study are still pending.

name: SPR Auto Technologies Ltd
gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin: high teens sustainable
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT up only 9% on 51% income growth as commodity pass-through lags a quarter and NCD interest weighs; management gave no numeric guidance and no capacity-deferral signal, while legacy volume grew ~16% vs industry.

name: Dr. Agarwals Health Care Ltd
thesis: Greenfield-led eye-care network adding 18 facilities in Q1 (16 surgical) with revenue +26% YoY to INR614 crore; supply expansion is aggressive, so the read is growth-positive but capital-intensive, not a capex-discipline story.

name: Raymond Realty Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: minimum 20% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 bookings up 129% to INR700 crore and EBITDA margin 13%, but management is an asset-light JDA-led developer with no capacity or utilisation data; supply-side evidence is absent and interest cost is rising with debt at INR1,095 crore gross.

name: Trualt Bioenergy Ltd
gLine: FY27 ethanol sales volume: ~44 crore litres (order book)

top: Maize at INR25.50 squeezes margin to INR6-7/litre

name: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd

thesis: Q1FY27 cell utilisation jumped to 83% from 68% and EBITDA margin hit 35%, with a 6 GW expansion (module Dec-2026, cell Mar-2027) adding capacity; per-watt margins were flat QoQ.

name: Wakefit Innovations Ltd

name: Milky Mist Dairy Food Ltd
gLine: Incremental H2 revenue: INR150-200 crore (H2 FY27)

name: Surya Roshni Ltd
gLine: Lighting EBITDA FY27: ~INR200 crore (FY27)
thesis: Steel pipe volume up 21% to 2.28 lakh tons and EBITDA/ton rose to ₹4,006, but management guided FY27 EBITDA/ton ₹4,600–4,700 and company EBITDA ₹670–680 crore, implying a steep H2 ramp.

name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd-$
gLine: Phenol run rate: close to 4 lakh tonnes per annum, short to medium term (short to medium term)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with consolidated EBITDA INR 554 crore (21% margin vs 11% a year ago) and Phenolics EBIT INR 418 crore, but management withheld spread data and the phenol debottleneck and PCB/BPA timelines are unproven.
top: Phenol run rate ~1 lakh t/qtr, 4 lakh t target

name: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Ltd
gLine: Base-case revenue growth: high-teen % growth (medium term)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +22% to INR43.8 cr with EBITDA margin 47.5%, but capacity doubling (540 KL fermentation) is now starting while the company pivots into an acquisition-funded CDMO story with no quantified guidance and heavy debt/equity plans.

name: Steel Strips Wheels Ltd-$
gLine: EBITDA per wheel FY27: more than INR310 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,509 cr (+27% YoY) with EBITDA/wheel INR314 vs INR262; management sees upside bias, but capex is ~INR600 cr and steel capacity is being added as industry sells out.

name: Steelcast Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume growth: 25% (possibly 30%) (FY27)
thesis: Steelcast Q1 FY27 revenue up 17% to INR124.8 cr with 66% utilisation in Apr–Jun; management guides ~25% FY27 volume growth and a INR120 cr greenfield foundry, but margin and price pass-through are lagged to 1 July.

name: Indo Count Industries Ltd
gLine: Long-term margin target: 15-16% stabilise
thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes up 12% QoQ to 23 mn meters and EBITDA margin rebounded to 13.1%, but management reiterated FY27 guidance without a supply cut and Bhilad flood disruption adds risk to H2 volumes.
top: Raw-material price hikes concluded, flow from Q2

name: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: FY28 revenue growth: 15% to 20% (FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 37% to INR756 cr and EBITDA margin 14.6%, driven by utilisation of 80–95% across most pharma assets; management says capex is a steady ~INR200 cr a year, with no capacity cut or deferral.

name: Marksans Pharma Ltd
gLine: QliniQ FY27 revenue: INR150-175 crores
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR841 cr (+35.6% YoY) and EBITDA margin 25.3%, but management says gross margin normalises to 55-56% and FY27 guidance is held at 15-20% growth and 20-21% EBITDA margin.

name: Neuland Laboratories Ltd
thesis: Q1FY27 revenue INR650.1 crore (+16.3% YoY) and EBITDA margin 35.5% on commercial CMS mix, but management gave no numeric FY27 guidance and flagged lumpiness from a handful of molecules.

name: Ganesh Housing Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs 1,000-1,200 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 280 cr was mostly a one-off Thaltej land sale and old inventory; PAT Rs 42 cr hit by one-time tax; FY27 guide Rs 1,000-1,200 cr revenue, PAT Rs 300-325 cr, with no supply-side or pricing evidence.
top: Thaltej One land sold, not developed

name: Axiscades Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA (normalised pro forma): Rs270 cr (FY27)
thesis: Reported loss masks a restructuring: continuing revenue up 94% to Rs183 cr with normalised EBITDA ~Rs41 cr, but management is leaning on unannounced acquisitions and a Rs1,255 cr divestment gain to meet FY27 guidance.

name: Lumax Auto Technologies Ltd
gLine: Mechatronics revenue FY27: around INR 400 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,364 crore (+33% y-o-y) and EBITDA margin 15.1% (+190 bps); management held FY27 guidance and capex at about INR 300 crore, with no explicit capacity-cut or discipline signals.

name: PPAP Automotive Ltd
gLine: Margin recovery: Improvement expected as pass-through settles by end Q2 / early Q3 (Q2-Q3 FY27)
thesis: Revenue up 34.1% to INR156.4 cr and EBITDA up 33.3% to INR12.4 cr, but margins are under raw-material pressure with only ~2% of a ~4% input rise passed through; utilisation is 73%, so no supply discipline signal.

name: Oil India Ltd
gLine: Crude production FY27: minimum 3.9 MMT, may touch 4 MMT

name: Sammaan Capital Ltd

name: Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Ltd

name: VRL Logistics Ltd

name: Dynamic Cables Ltd

thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 33% YoY mostly price-led (aluminium); volume only 5-6% with order book flat-ish at INR811 cr, and a new plant adds revenue only from Q4.

name: Aster DM Quality Care Ltd
gLine: MVT growth: grow in excess of 50% (near term)

name: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Ltd
gLine: R134A capacity: Commission this financial year (FY27)
thesis: Chemical segment EBITDA up 29% YoY to INR 458 crore on R32 fluorochemicals ramp; R32 at peak utilisation with 20,000 t expansion due Q2 FY27, but battery materials revenue still only INR 20-30 crore and Oman capex shifted to India.

name: NDR Auto Components Ltd
gLine: Bharat Seats revenue: INR3,500 crore by 2030 (FY30)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR221.45 crore with 11.88% EBITDA margin; management guides 11-12% margin and INR3,000 crore FY30 endeavour, but JV losses continue and capex is modest at INR40-50 crore a year.

name: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd
gLine: Oncology normalisation: normalise from Q3 FY27, fully normalised Q4 (Q3-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Network beds up 13% YoY with occupancy above 75% and ARPOB up 5%, but EBITDA margin fell to 24.8% as new capacity and Kalinga dilute; oncology drop and rising receivables (DSO 95 days) weigh on cash conversion.

name: Indigo Paints Ltd
thesis: Indigo Paints grew standalone revenue 18.7% with volumes up double digits and EBITDA margin up to 17.7%, but management says Q2 growth will be pushed harder via trade and influencer spend and gives no margin guidance.
top: Capex cycle closed; no major capex for 3 years

name: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd

name: Sansera Engineering Ltd

name: Hi-Tech Pipes Ltd
gLine: FY27 sales volume: 6.5-7 lakh tons (FY27)

name: AWL Agri Business Ltd
gLine: Food and FMCG revenue growth: 18-20% (FY27 remainder)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 18% to INR 20,048 crore and EBITDA up 34% to INR 693 crore; Edible Oil volume only 2% on channel destocking, with management guiding 5-6% for the rest of the year.
top: Edible Oil primary pipeline dried up

name: Inox Green Energy Services Ltd

top: Wind World India acquisition approved by NCLT

name: R R Kabel Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 54% to INR3,168 cr and op EBITDA margin 9% vs 7%, driven by volume (W&C +17%) and ~40% LME-led pricing; capacity additions are modest and utilisation in wires is only 65-70%.

name: Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd
gLine: Asset services full-year revenue growth: more than 20-25%
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 quarter: revenue INR909 crore (+18%) and PAT ~INR300 crore, with cost-to-income near 55% and FY guidance held; capital-cycle signals are not the story here, growth and flows are.
top: MPIS net new money record above INR3,000 crore

name: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA fell to INR 57 crore on a gas-cost shock; management absorbed INR 2/kg for 30-40 days of committed orders, margin back to INR 7-8/kg, and it targets 20% volume growth with capex capped at INR 200-250 crore.
top: Margin hit to INR 2/kg in first 45 days

name: Suraksha Diagnostic Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: not below 34% (FY27)
thesis: Diagnostics network expanding with 21% revenue growth and 36% EBITDA margin, but growth is volume-led on new centres; no capacity discipline signal, with 100-centre FY28 target and 50-50 new-territory push.
top: New centres under 2 yrs at 6.5% margin

name: Regaal Resources Ltd
gLine: Crushing volume FY27: above 400,000 tons (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 operating income fell 18% to Rs 202 crore on exit from low-margin trading, while value-added margin rose to 39.8% and utilisation was 71.4% on a doubled 1,650 TPD crushing plant; net debt Rs 735 crore with inventory-heavy working capital.

name: Tata Capital Ltd
gLine: Cost-to-income FY28: 33% to 34% (FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹1,547 cr (+56% YoY) on credit cost 1% and cost-to-income 36.4%; supply-side signals are absent for a lender, growth is disbursement-led (+33%) with AUM +22% and cost of funds up to 7.28%.
top: Gold loan entry via Yogloans acquisition

name: Aequs Ltd
thesis: Aerospace order book crossed USD1,004m (+13% QoQ) and revenue +40% YoY, but consumer utilisation fell to ~22% and operational EBITDA of INR148m still leans on a Q4 FY27 consumer breakeven that needs utilisation to rise to 40-50%.

name: Steamhouse India Ltd
gLine: Steam volume growth (current locations): 5% to 10% (near term)
thesis: Steam volumes up 16.7% YoY with utilisation 41.40% (from 36.06%) and EBITDA/ton ₹1,011, but ~70% of 345 TPH is contracted and capacity is being added toward 705 TPH.

name: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd
gLine: Investment portfolio yield: around 7% by exit of FY27 (Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 NIM 4.26% and PAT ₹756 cr (+45% YoY) but write-off recoveries fell to ₹103 cr from ₹216 cr; management says FY NIM guide 3.7–3.8% is not yet changed and growth is front-loaded.
top: Yield on advances to fall 10 bps

name: Balrampur Chini Mills Ltd
gLine: PLA plant utilisation (first year, Jan–Mar 2027): ~40% average capacity utilisation
thesis: Tight 2025-26 sugar inventory and firm prices lift the near-term base; 45.67 lakh quintals carried at INR 37.19/kg, while the 80,000-tonne PLA plant is still pre-commissioning with guided ~40% utilisation only in Jan–Mar 2027.
top: Sugar stock 45.67 lakh quintals at INR 37.19/kg

name: Tata Power Company Ltd
gLine: Renewable capacity addition FY27: 2,500-2,700 MW; cross 9 GW by FY-end (FY27)
thesis: Tata Power Q1 FY27 PAT up 11% to INR 1,401 cr with renewables capacity ramp to 2.5 GW in FY27 and capex of INR 5,300 cr in Q1 against INR 25,000 cr plan; curtailment near 5% and TP Solar supply-side discipline is a watch item.
top: Renewable capacity 6.7 GW → 9 GW by FY-end

name: Indian Hotels Company Ltd
gLine: Ginger conversions: Q1 15, Q2 20, Q3 25, Q4 40 conversions
thesis: Hotel-led Q1 FY27 with domestic RevPAR up 14% and standalone EBITDA margin 41.8%, but supply is not the story: no capacity discipline, and the read is demand-led occupancy strength plus a continued asset-light expansion push.

name: Deccan Gold Mines Ltd
thesis: Deccan Gold turned producer in Q1 FY27 with Jonnagiri selling 59 kg for Rs 87 Cr revenue and ~Rs 6.35 Cr share of PAT, while ~80 kg gold sits unsold in stock; guidance kept but unverified.

name: Kalyani Forge Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: sustain 15% or more; internal target 20% over coming quarters (coming quarters)
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin-led beat: EBITDA margin 16.2% vs 9.3% a year ago, but forging utilisation only 50-60% and capex of ₹30 crore is modest, so supply discipline is good and no capacity race is evident.

name: Adf Foods Ltd-$
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 25.9% to INR167.3 cr but EBITDA margin 17.7% flattered by INR19.7 cr US tariff refund; freight cost ~3% of revenue, and Surat plant only ~30% utilised this year.
top: 30% of ready goods unshipped in June

name: Divis Laboratories Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: Similar to last year (qualitative) (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 profit growth driven by inventory build (~₹500 cr change) and forex; management guides only double-digit growth, with no numeric margin guide and 3-month rolling safety stock at higher cost.
top: Inventory build ~₹500 cr vs ₹50-100 cr run-rate

name: PVR Inox Ltd
gLine: FY27 film hire cost: 45% to 45.5% of gross
thesis: Q1 FY27 footfalls up 8% and EBITDA nearly doubled to INR230 crores at 14% margin; capex trimmed to ~INR350 crores as capital-light share rises, with net cash of INR80 crores.

name: V2 Retail Ltd
thesis: V2 Retail grew revenue 58% to INR997 cr with SSSG about 7.5% and 56 net stores added, but gross margin fell to 28.6% and management is pushing 4-5% price hikes from Q3 with 170-200 store openings still planned.

name: Sejal Glass Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: ~1% over upcoming quarters (upcoming quarters)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR117.95 cr (+52.9% YoY) with PAT ~6.5%, but India utilisation is low (Taloja 55%, Erode 15%) and management guides FY27 revenue growth of 25%+ with PAT margin of 9-10% back-half weighted.

name: Adani Power Ltd
gLine: Capacity target: 45 GW (same timeline as 42 GW)
thesis: Adani Power Q1 FY27 PLF rose to 78% from 67% and continuing EBITDA grew 22% to INR6,983 crore, but capacity is largely contracted and the read is volume and PPA-driven, with 24 GW expansion and a 45 GW target.

name: L&T Finance Ltd
gLine: Cost of funds (FY27 WACB): 7.35% to 7.40% (FY27)
thesis: Consol PAT ₹902 Cr (+29% YoY) and RoA 2.48% with credit cost down 10 bps to 2.54%; supply-side signal is growth outpacing Lakshya, with capital-cycle discipline not the driver, and NIM+fees flat at 10.47% despite a 24 bps NIM drop.

name: Endurance Technologies Ltd
gLine: Q2 EBITDA margin: better than Q1 (no number)
thesis: Standalone EBITDA margin 11.2% (13.3% ex-commodity pass-through) with capex held near ₹800 crores; ABS capacity cut from 12 to 9 lakh units as machinery shifted to brake assembly, a supply reallocation rather than discipline.

name: CreditAccess Grameen Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹493 Cr (+720% YoY) on 0.72% credit cost, with management guiding to 3-4% credit cost and only gradual 50bps pricing cuts from Q3; supply-side discipline not discussed, cushion held.

name: Spencers Retail Ltd
gLine: Spencer's full-year online growth: ~25% cumulative (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% YoY to Rs 469 cr with consolidated EBITDA ~Rs 9.4 cr (2% of sales), but growth is volume-led on existing stores with no capacity additions and Nature's Basket still degrowing 13% YoY.

name: Chalet Hotels Ltd
gLine: Planned capex FY27-FY29: approx INR30 billion, largely internal accruals (FY27-FY29)
thesis: Hotel-led growth with RevPAR +6.5% on ADR +8.5%, but resort occupancy only ~51% and MMR (Powai, Vashi) dragged by construction; supply view is benign, capex ~INR30bn FY27-29 funded internally.

name: BMW Industries Ltd
thesis: Pipes and tubes utilisation about 40.1% annualised (up from ~34% in FY26) on 0.5 Mt added capacity, rolling mill ~83.5%; EBITDA margin fell to 20.3% on fuel costs while gross margin rose to 67.9%.
top: Eastern region capacity additions flagged by analyst

name: Rossari Biotech Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin steady state: around 15% at least (2 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 28% to Rs 697 crore on volume (~10%) and price, but EBITDA margin fell to 11.6% from 12.5%; management guides ~15% margin in two years and ~15% FY27 top-line growth, with capex slowed in India.

name: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 15-16% by FY30 (FY30)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR548.7 crore and EBITDA margin 13.1%, with management targeting 14% by Q4 despite a sharper input-cost hit guided for Q2; no capacity cut, and capex of about INR3,400-3,500 crore is being added.

name: Alivus Life Sciences Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 10% to 12% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 6.4% to INR640 crores with GPL down 52.6%, offset by non-GPL growth of 26.5%; capacity deliberately paced with Solapur delayed to early Q3 and FY27 revenue guided at 10-12%.
top: GPL inventory rationalisation drives Q1 dip

name: AVG Logistics Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: INR50 crores plus; further ~INR60 crores referenced (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +6% to INR132.48 cr but PAT +30% to INR6.46 cr; FY27 guide of 15-20% growth rests on fleet adds and a new contract pipeline, with no utilisation or pricing disclosure.

name: GPT Healthcare Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: ~21% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR126.2 cr, EBITDA margin 20.4%, PAT up 66%; mature-hospital occupancy 58.07% and ARPOB gains are mix-led, with Raipur losses (INR3 cr) and greenfield capex keeping capital intensity in focus.

name: Awfis Space Solutions Ltd
gLine: Gross seat additions FY27: 22,000 to 25,000 seats (FY27)
thesis: Flex operator growing revenue 27% with occupancy flat at 76% and cash EBITDA margin only 10.1%; supply growth is mostly leased, not owned, so capital-light claims rest on lease-cost pass-through timing.

name: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Baddi oral facility: go live near end of FY27 (FY27)
thesis: CDMO revenue up 18.6% YoY to INR964 cr with volume growth and API price recovery; API losses narrowed to INR-4 cr, with monthly EBITDA-positive target by Feb-Mar 2027 and no capacity cut.

name: Lenskart Solutions Ltd
gLine: International store additions: accelerate, maybe not this year
thesis: Lenskart is a retail eyewear story with store growth and same-store sales driving volume, but there is no supply-discipline signal: management is accelerating store adds (455 net new in nine months) and capex, so the capital-cycle read is expansionary.
top: 455 net new stores in nine months

name: Nephrocare Health Services Ltd
thesis: Dialysis platform grew revenue 23.7% to INR282 cr with 13% guest growth and utilisation at 74%; management kept 15-20% medium-term guidance and gave no capex numbers, so supply discipline is only partly visible.

name: Aye Finance Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursement up 22% YoY to INR1,219 cr and credit cost fell to 4.01%, but it sits above the 3.5-4% guide top-end and opex (8.9%) is still above its 8.25-8.75% band, so the quality beat is real but not yet fully priced.

name: Powerica Ltd
gLine: Genset margin recovery: improve from Q3 onward (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Genset EBITDA margin squeezed to 5.6% by commodity inflation with price hikes only now rolling in; data centre order book reached INR900 crores (INR1,100 crores by 7 August) but DG capacity is single-shift at 75-80% utilisation.
top: Data-centre order book INR900 cr → INR1,100 cr

name: Hexagon Nutrition Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20% to 25% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +43% to INR104.3 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 11.3% from 13.8% on raw-material and freight costs; capacity utilisation rose to 47% from ~30%, while inventory days climbed to ~142 from ~130.

name: Waterways Leisure Tourism Ltd
gLine: Annual revenue and earnings growth: A year of revenue and earnings growth
thesis: Single-ship cruise operator where Q1 FY27 profit was hit by fuel costs (~Rs14 Cr EBITDA hit), with capacity doubling via Cordelia Sky in Sept-Oct 2026; no supply discipline signals, pricing recovery deferred to Q3.

name: Knack Packaging Ltd
gLine: Volume growth FY27: not quantified (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +40.5% to INR2,648m and EBITDA margin 22.4%, but capacity is ~91% utilised with capacity expansion (43.3k to 70k tpa) not due until Oct 2027, and rented plants added in the interim.

name: Caliber Mining And Logistics Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 45% to 50% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Coal mining and logistics contractor: revenue up ~67% YoY to INR657 cr, but reported EBITDA margin fell to 16.8% (20.0% adjusted vs ~24% a year ago) on diesel spike; FY27 guide 45–50% revenue growth, 35%+ EBITDA growth.

name: Balkrishna Industries Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 capex additional spend: INR1,500-2,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 OHT volume up 16% YoY to 93,770 MT with EBITDA margin down to 20.61% on raw material inflation; ~5% price hike with further hikes unannounced, and ₹3,000 cr capex balance still on schedule.

name: Singer India Ltd
gLine: Appliances EBIT breakeven: next year
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 57% to Rs 144.5 cr and PBT up 225%, but growth came with a steep price correction, a Rs 32 cr working-capital build and a BIS-driven import transition still ramping.
top: BIS standard cutoff 12 Aug removes imports

name: Jyoti Resins & Adhesives Ltd
gLine: Capacity: 2,000 to 3,500 TPM; INR 600-650 cr revenue capacity
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 17% with ~10% volume and ~7% price, but EBITDA fell to ~14.4% on VAM spike; capacity expansion to 3,500 TPM is brownfield with ~INR 7 crore spend and receivables stretched above 150 days.

name: Orient Bell Ltd-$
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 42.8% to INR203 cr with record 39.7% gross margin and utilisation 73% vs 64% in Q4, helped by Morbi shutdown and a 15.9% ASP rise; management gives no guidance.

name: Trishakti Industries Ltd
gLine: Gross capex FY27: INR 400 crore programme; INR 130-140 crore remaining
thesis: Crane rental firm claims 100% utilisation and ~65% EBITDA margin, but ~200-day debtors, a 200%+ revenue jump, and an unquantified ₹400cr capex plan with aggressive UAE/KSA and wind expansion warrant heavy scepticism.

name: LT Foods Ltd
gLine: Organic EBITDA margin: 7% to 8% by end of FY27
thesis: Headline revenue up 26% to INR3,161 cr but PAT up only 9% and EBITDA margin fell to 11.5% from 12.1%; organic segment at 4% EBITDA margin is the drag, with management guiding a recovery to 7-8% by year end.

name: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Ltd
thesis: Volume-led Q1 FY27: core lube volume +17% YoY to 48,000 KL and revenue +33% to INR 1,320 cr, but margin held ~13% only via pass-through; full cost pass-through lands in Q2/Q3 while base oil stays tight.
top: Multiple B2C price hikes in quarter

name: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Ltd
gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin FY28-29: 23%-24% (FY28-FY29)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR161 cr (+58%) and PAT INR20.8 cr; capacity lifted to 11,000 MT with 4,500 MT running at ~90-95%, but FDC (5,500 MT) commercialisation slips to Q2 FY28 and realisations are quarterly-reset.

name: Sunrakshakk Industries India Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR900-1,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 120.6% YoY to INR276.33 cr but consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 8.18% from 10.19% QoQ on raw-material and crude-linked cost pressure; management guides ~6% FY27 PAT margin and says utilisation is only 50-55%.

name: Bajaj Healthcare Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 10% to 15% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 11.3% YoY to INR165.6 cr with gross margin 48.3%; management guides 10-15% revenue growth and 18-20% EBITDA margin, but API pricing flat and no capacity-discipline evidence.

name: BLS International Services Ltd
gLine: Visa & Consular revenue growth: 12% to 15% (next year)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR 891 cr (+25%) and EBITDA INR 252 cr (+24%), but Visa application volumes were flat at 11.3 lakh and growth came from net revenue per application (+11%) rather than volume.

name: HPL Electric & Power Ltd
gLine: C&I revenue growth: high double digit growth over next 12-18 months (12-18 months)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 35% to ₹515 cr with EBITDA margin down to 12.26% on metals and plastics inflation; management sees margin recovery only after a lag, with no capacity expansion signalled for metering.

name: Lemon Tree Hotels Ltd
gLine: Net EBITDA margin FY28: around 50% (FY28)
thesis: Lemon Tree Q1 FY27: net EBITDA margin fell 99bp to 43.8% on GST input-credit loss and SAR provision; occupancy up 314bp to 75.7% but gross ARR only +2%, with management guiding to a 50% margin next year.
top: Renovation spend tapering to ~1% of revenue

name: Gland Pharma Ltd
gLine: Revenue CAGR next 4 years: around 20%, under re-evaluation (FY28-FY31)
thesis: Gland Q1 FY27 revenue up 20% to INR18,003m with 28% adjusted EBITDA margin, but supply-side evidence is thin: capex is being raised (INR2,000 crore programme plus new CDMO capacity) and no pricing or utilisation numbers were given.
top: Capex raised: INR2,000 crore plus new CDMO capacity

name: Jubilant Ingrevia Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,300 crore (+25% YoY) and EBITDA INR209 crore (+36% YoY), with FY27 EBITDA guidance held at INR750-800 crore rather than raised; supply discipline not discussed.

name: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd
gLine: Standalone capex: INR70-80 crore (near term)
thesis: Consolidated EBITDA up 35% to INR175 crore at 26% margin, but PAT up only 6% to INR51 crore; management says major capex cycle is complete with only INR70-80 crore maintenance-type capex ahead.

name: Lodha Developers Ltd
gLine: Land sales per year: INR 2,000-3,000 crores annually (multi-year)
thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT INR 13.7bn (more than double, 26.9% margin) helped by ~INR 6bn land sale PAT; pre-sales flat-ish at INR 46.3bn with launches deliberately deferred, FY27 PAT guide ~INR 41bn reaffirmed.

name: Rainbow Children's Medicare Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: above 20% (Q2 and medium term) (Q2 FY27 and ~4 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 33% reported but 24% like-to-like, EBITDA margin 28.6%, and a 2,500-bed, INR 2,200 crore expansion plan keeps supply rising while new Bengaluru hospitals still lose money.

name: IRM Energy Ltd
gLine: EBITDA per SCM (next three quarters): INR 7-8 (Q2-Q4 FY27)
thesis: City gas distributor IRM posted record Q1 FY27 revenue of INR 326 crore (+24% YoY) and EBITDA of about INR 10/SCM on sourcing gains, but management guided EBITDA down to INR 7-8/SCM and said Q1 is not repeatable.

name: ESAF Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: Credit cost: around 2% by year-end (FY27 year-end)
thesis: Asset quality and profitability inflecting: slippages fell to INR 75 crores from INR 468 crores YoY, PAT INR 80 crores, with management guiding ROA to 2% by FY27-end and credit cost to 2%; the capital-cycle signal is credit normalisation, not supply discipline.

name: Suraj Estate Developers Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 10-15% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Mumbai developer with Q1 FY27 sales value up 74% to INR141 crores but collections down to INR86 crores from INR115 crores and net debt rising to INR614 crores; no supply discipline signal, just launch and leverage ramp.

name: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd
gLine: Opex (incl. leases) per quarter: ₹300-325 crore over next couple of quarters (next 2 quarters)
thesis: Ola Electric's Q1 FY27 volumes nearly doubled QoQ to ~39,200 with auto gross margin held at 30.5%, but cell production was paused for a 2–3 month capacity install and management gave no formal guidance, so supply-side evidence is mixed.

name: Laxmi Dental Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR74.7cr (+13.9%) and EBITDA margin 19.2%, but growth is mix-led from scanners; no capacity expansion beyond machinery and a Palghar land LOI, with lab utilisation already at 90-95%.

name: Behari Lal Engineering Ltd
gLine: High-value product share of revenue: ~70% in near future (near future)
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin expansion came from mix (high-value 60.4% of revenue, EBITDA/ton ~13,500), but melt capacity is unchanged until Unit 3 next year, with FY27 capex of INR80 crore (only INR5 crore spent in Q1).

name: Raymond Ltd
gLine: Aerospace mature EBITDA margin: ~25% (longer term)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin 15.9% (up from 15.7%); aerospace revenue +40% YoY to INR123 cr but margin fell to 21.2% from 23.7% on expensed R&D; capacity-led growth with a 2 yr-plus greenfield ramp.
top: Aerospace revenue +40% YoY to INR123 cr

name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
gLine: India cash cost: up 5-6% QoQ in Q2
thesis: India upstream aluminium EBITDA hit a record INR7,390 crores at 55% margin, but Novelis volumes fell 5% and tariffs of USD70 million weigh; capacity adds (Aditya refinery/smelter) only land FY29.
top: India upstream EBITDA record INR7,390 cr

name: Tata Steel Ltd
gLine: Depreciation step-up: Rs 300 cr/quarter, Rs 1,200 cr/year additional
thesis: Tata Steel Q1FY27 India EBITDA Rs 19,162/t (up from Rs 15,907 in Q4) on Rs 5,990/t realisation gain, but Q2 India NSR guided down ~Rs 1,500/t and Netherlands DSP shutdown and NINL 4.8 MTPA capex (Rs 33,873 cr) add volume and capex risk.
top: India NSR guided down ~Rs 1,500/t in Q2

name: Asian Paints Ltd
gLine: Price increase pass-through: 8-9% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume +9% and consolidated PBDIT margin 20.6% (+240bps YoY) on mix, but ~25% raw-material inflation vs ~7% price hikes and low-cost inventory tailwind fading into Q2; guides 8-10% volume and 18-20% PBDIT margin.

name: Vardhman Textiles Ltd
gLine: Spinning margin direction: 13-14% EBITDA-type margin as right way to view; moderation expected after current inventory runs out
thesis: Spinning margins rebounded on cotton-yarn spread near $0.90/kg and yarn exports up to ~110m kg, but management says margins will moderate as cheap inventory runs out and fabric utilisation is weak.

name: Baroda Extrusion Ltd
gLine: Revenue/profit growth FY27-28: 35% to 40% minimum rise
thesis: Small copper extruder (~Rs 48 cr quarterly revenue, EBITDA margin ~7.7%) with a planned Rs 20-25 cr extrusion press expansion; management talk is heavy on vision and light on numbers, with volume and capacity figures that contradict each other.

name: Lumax Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: INR 200-250 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 32.6% to INR 1,223 crore but EBITDA margin flat at 9.2% as OEM commodity recoveries slipped to Q2; FY27 10.5-11% margin guidance and 15-20% growth reiterated, capex raised to INR 200-250 crore.

name: Gujarat Industries Power Company Ltd
gLine: Khavda 600 MW revenue FY27: ~INR420 cr
thesis: Khavda 600 MW solar at 33% CUF guides ~INR420 cr revenue and INR350-360 cr EBITDA, with 500 MW ramp-up and ~INR950-1,000 cr blended EBITDA only once fully operational; debt rises to ~INR4,500 cr.

name: Hindustan Foods Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex projects: INR340 crores new projects plus INR150 crores carry forward (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 record PAT of INR42.8 crores (+33% YoY) with FY27 PAT guidance of INR200-220 crores reaffirmed; footwear hit ~INR6 crores and shoe utilisation was poor in Q1, though new capex of INR340 crores is announced.
top: Footwear cost pass-through lag ~INR6 cr hit

name: Eldeco Housing & Industries Ltd
gLine: Legacy inventory liquidation FY27: 40% to 60% of ~INR 75 cr
thesis: Q1 FY27 profit spike driven by one horizontal project (Imperia Phase 2, ~60% gross margin on 85% of revenue); bookings fell to INR 105.7 cr with no supply-discipline evidence, and FY28 guidance is only qualitative.

name: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd
gLine: ROA exit: 3%–3.5% by June 2028 (June 2028)
thesis: Credit cost fell to 2.40% from 2.51% and GNPA to 1.37% from 1.44%, with ROA at 1.98%; management gives a June 2028 exit guide of 3–3.5% ROA but no numeric guidance on opex or cost of funds.

name: Indo Borax & Chemicals Ltd-$
gLine: DOT volume FY27: 1,500 tons
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 70.36 cr (+31%) and EBITDA margin 28.1% on price hikes and utilisation, but management guides FY27 to 20% margin and a softer Q2; the Kronox acquisition dominates the call.

name: Ipca Laboratories Ltd
gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: 14% to 16% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated sales up 21% to INR2,788 crores with EBITDA margin 22.88%; management raised FY27 growth guidance to 14-16% and margin to around 23%, but gains were mostly from rupee and cost-line mix, not materials.

name: Somany Ceramics Ltd
thesis: Standalone utilisation rose to 83% from 72% and JV swung to ₹3 crore profit, lifting EBITDA margin to 11.6%; management says pricing is pass-through and volume guided to mid-single digit.

name: UCO Bank
gLine: Cost-to-income: below 50% or around 50% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 profit squeezed by a Rs 1,237 crore one-time DTA charge; underlying operating profit boosted by ~Rs 800 crore non-recurring TWO recovery, with credit cost 0.39% and CD ratio 82% supporting a 21% advances growth read.

name: IIFL Finance Ltd
gLine: Home finance FY27 book growth: 17% to 18%
thesis: Gold-loan-led growth with AUM up 38% YoY to INR1.15 lakh cr, but parent CRAR is tight and management is pursuing equity/subsidiary stake sales; credit cost guided 1.5-1.7% for FY27.

name: Puravankara Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 28% to INR1,439 cr with collections up 40%, but net debt INR2,836 cr and debt-cut target of INR700 cr is being softened by new land buys; FY27 presales guidance of INR11,200 cr held.

name: Health X Platform Ltd
gLine: RetailerShakti EBITDA: positive EBITDA in Q3 FY27 (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Health X grew revenue 58% YoY to INR440 crores with EBITDA still negative at -3.4% margin and gross margin 7.8%; management refuses EBITDA focus and gives no segment P&L, with no capacity-discipline or pricing evidence.

name: PG Electroplast Ltd
gLine: H2/FY27 RAC volume growth: 15-20% for 6 months; ~20%+ full year
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,034 cr (+35%) but operating margin 7.3% under commodity/rupee pressure; management targets ~8% FY27 margin and a compressor line plus 1.2 mn refrigerator plant adds capacity into a tightening import-restricted market.

name: Suyog Telematics Ltd
gLine: Total tenancies FY27 exit: 10,000+ tenancies (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR710m (+6.1% y/y on restated basis) with EBITDA margin cut to 59.3% after electricity moved into revenue; growth hinges on Vodafone Idea tenancy loading (150 done, ~700 more, 3,000 FY27 target) with BSNL billing stalled.

name: Wonderla Holidays Ltd
gLine: Chennai footfall to 1 million: Not in one year; a couple of years
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR243 crore with EBITDA margin 48%, driven by Chennai ramp (INR45 crore) and mature parks ARPU +8%; supply additions ongoing but no new capacity capex guidance beyond ~10% of revenue.

name: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd
gLine: STU + HVDC annual inflows: INR20,000-25,000 crore per year (STU) (annual)
thesis: Q1 FY27 earnings were driven by a ~INR570 crore EBIT from energy-solutions power sales on 3,325 MU of long-term take-or-pay supply, with much of it still open to market price; transmission capex ~INR3,500 crore per quarter, but no explicit guidance.

name: S H Kelkar and Company Ltd
gLine: Net debt reduction: Rs 25 crore per quarter from Q3 (FY27 onward)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14% to Rs 662 crore and EBITDA up 21%, but about Rs 15 crore of Flavour sales was pre-emptive stocking, and net debt rose Rs 65 crore to Rs 852 crore on inventory and capex.
top: Net debt up Rs 65 cr to Rs 852 cr

name: Bigbloc Construction Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: improve further over next two to three quarters from ~8% (2-3 quarters)
thesis: Bigbloc Q1 FY27 utilisation ~69% on 1.3 mn cbm capacity with EBITDA margin ~8% (INR 6 cr on INR 79 cr); pricing hikes promised but MP plant expansion pushed to FY28 start, keeping capacity-add risk alive.

name: Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem Ltd
gLine: Pharma molecules incremental revenue FY27: INR70 crores to INR80 crores
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,671m (+43% YoY) on volume, with management reiterating 25-30% growth and 20-22% EBITDA margin, while a new INR200 crore greenfield site is being built as Dahej nears saturation.

name: PB Fintech Ltd
gLine: PB Health annual run-rate: ~₹500 Cr, breakeven by Mar'27 (Mar 2027)
thesis: Insurance premium up 41% to ₹8,372 Cr and PAT up 92% to ₹163 Cr, but management openly prioritises fresh-business growth over margin, so no supply-side discipline signal; the read is growth-led and reinvestment-heavy.

name: Metro Brands Ltd
gLine: E-commerce growth: 20% to 30% healthy
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone sales +9% with SOR 3P drag and April–May softness, June recovered to mid-teens; gross margin near 60%, EBITDA ~30%, PAT guidance held at 13–15% with no supply-side signals.
top: June growth mid-teens after soft Apr–May

name: Aether Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: INR3,000-3,500 million
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 27% to INR3,266m and EBITDA margin 31%, but LSM volumes fell 22.5% as lines were moved to CEM, and capex guided to INR3,000-3,500m for Site 5 and R&D.

name: IKIO Technologies Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +41% YoY to Rs169cr and EBITDA margin 13%, but management concedes gross margin fell to ~41% on metals and semiconductor cost/lead-time shocks, and capacity is ahead of demand with only Rs20-25cr capex left.

name: Rishabh Instruments Ltd
gLine: Lumel Alucast adjusted EBITDA: breakeven for full year (end FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 4.2% to INR1,983m but EEI up 34% with ~24% margin; supply-side evidence is capacity expansion (CT capacity nearly doubling, Nashik plant), not discipline, and Lumel Alucast still loss-making.

name: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd
thesis: Q1FY27 PAT ₹143 cr (+23% YoY) and ROE 17.5% held, but Stage 3 rose to 1.5% and management guides only a Q3 turn; disbursement cut to ₹641 cr by a one-time recognition change.

name: EPACK Durable Ltd
gLine: AC industry growth FY27: ~20%, EPACK to outgrow
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~34% to INR886 cr with RAC volume up ~30%, but EBITDA margin fell to 6.21% (6.4% underlying ex-PLI) on forex loss and wage costs; utilisation guided to 55-60% and capex only INR60-70 cr more.

name: Rashi Peripherals Ltd
gLine: Q2 FY27 YoY revenue growth: similar to ~60%, price increase speed halves
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 62% to Rs 5,102 cr with ~30-35pts from price, but management concedes ~10% unit market contraction and channel inventory built up at T2 level.

name: Gopal Snacks Ltd
gLine: Sustainable EBITDA margin: 11% to 11.5%
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 422.3 cr (+31% YoY) with EBITDA margin 7.4%; management reiterates FY27 EBITDA 8-9% and 20%+ growth, with supply restored after Rajkot restart, but Nagpur utilisation sits below 30%.

name: Sai Life Sciences Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 12% to INR553 crore with CRO +26% and CDMO only +6%; management keeps 15-20% mid-term growth and INR1,100-1,300 crore capex, with H2 weighted to new Bidar capacity.

name: Indo Farm Equipment Ltd
gLine: New crane plant commercial production: November 2026 (FY27)
thesis: Crane volumes flat YoY in Q1 on full plant loading, with 3,600-unit new plant and dealers still at 25 against 50-plus target; tractor utilisation only 35–40% but no tractor capacity added, so growth depends on demand and dealer build-out.
top: Crane new plant 3,600 units, Nov start

name: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Ltd
gLine: Gross store additions FY27: more than 300 stores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 11% to Rs 2,046 cr and EBITDA margin up 50 bps to 16%, but gross margin fell ~150 bps on channel mix and provisioning; supply-side signals are absent and the company is guiding 300+ gross store adds.

name: Sambhv Steel Tubes Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth over FY26: 10-15% (FY27)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR732 crore and EBITDA INR100 crore with utilisation near limits, Kesda 3.6 lakh t stainless capacity due Q4 FY27 and FY27 EBITDA/ton guided 7,500-8,500 versus Q1 above 10,000.
top: Stainless capacity 1.16 → 4.76 lakh t by Q4 FY27

name: Amanta Healthcare Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: approx INR370 crores excl. SVP (FY27)
thesis: SteriPort Line 3 commissioning slipped one quarter to late August on civil delays, pushing ~INR70 crores of contribution into FY27 and leaving the INR370 crore base case intact; margin guidance of 25-26% for FY28 rests on capacity still to be built.
top: Price hike INR1.50 vs polymer cost INR2.25

name: Shankara Buildpro Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin steady state: 3.5% plus
thesis: Steel marketplace volumes up 10% YoY to 2.5 lakh tons with EBITDA margin 3.26%; management targets 3.5%+ steady state and 1.2 MT FY27, but Q1 volumes fell 13% QoQ and the April-May price correction cost about Rs 10 crore.

name: GK Energy Ltd
gLine: Interest expense: stay near INR 5 cr per quarter (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 71% to INR 505 cr and 24,118 pump installs (2x), but growth rests on PM-KUSUM 2.0 timing (expected Q3) that management could not firmly pin down; realisations per pump falling.

name: Atlanta Electricals Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 17-18% sustainable (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 48% YoY to INR466 cr on volume (4,381 MVA vs 3,605), order inflow record INR972 cr and order book INR3,117 cr; capacity-add risk acknowledged but pricing held near term.

name: Jain Resource Recycling Ltd
gLine: Copper value-added EBITDA uplift: +2% to copper margin / ~Rs 25 per tonne once stabilised (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 76% to Rs 2,725 cr but EBITDA margin ~4% vs 5.8% a year ago; management offers no numeric guidance, with copper EBITDA/tonne ~Rs 31,000 vs Rs 36,000 FY26 average.
top: No volume or EBITDA numeric guidance

name: Midwest Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR840 crores (granite 720, quartz 100-120)
thesis: Granite-led quarter with revenue up 35% YoY, but quartz Phase 1 sold only ~5,000 tons with FY27 quartz volume guidance cut from 150,000 to 120,000 tons and EBITDA margin hit by diesel.

name: Corona Remedies Ltd
thesis: Corona Remedies Q1 FY27 revenue +21.9% YoY to INR422 crore, EBITDA margin 22% (+190bps); growth is mostly volume-led and FY27 guidance of 15% organic plus 20% PAT was held, with raw-material risk flagged.

name: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: 25% to 27% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR118 cr (+119.5% YoY), gross margin 35.46%, EBITDA margin 28.76%; management guides FY EBITDA margin 25–27% after marketing ramp, with 9 COCO stores planned this year and no capacity-discipline issue since the business is retail.

name: Sai Parenterals Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 182 cr (incl. Noumed) with gross margin 41.8% and EBITDA 14.9%; IPO capex re-routed into a 60% stake in a project under construction, with FY27 guidance of Rs 750 cr and 17% EBITDA held.
top: IPO capex redeployed into Saicriti 60% stake

name: One Point One Solutions Ltd
industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
gLine: Consolidated revenue: Roughly double FY27 revenue (qualitative, from analyst Q&A) (FY27)
thesis: Consolidated revenue INR 158.3 cr (+129% YoY) mostly from first full quarter of Netcom acquisition; base standalone revenue +11.6% YoY with 30.4% margin, no capacity or pricing data disclosed.

name: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY27 profitability: Entire year profitable on consolidated basis (FY27)
thesis: Insurance distributor reports first adjusted-EBITDA-positive quarter (Q4 FY26) with revenue up 57% to INR 1,098 crore and corporate overheads down to 23% of revenue, but no capacity or supply metrics and guidance is qualitative.

name: MV Electrosystems Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR400 crore (FY27)
thesis: Post-IPO rail propulsion ramp from ~10 units in September to ~40/month by January on a 564-unit order book (INR989 crore); no deliveries in the prior two months, so the thesis rests on unproven execution.

name: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd
gLine: Birla Tyres EBITDA breakeven: this financial year (FY27)
thesis: Q1FY27 consolidated revenue INR1,432 Cr (+28% YoY) and EBITDA margin 22%, but the call is heavy on new capex (~INR2,000 Cr) and LFP/anode plans with no disclosed margins, and utilisation is 80% with management guiding to 90%+.

name: Hindustan Zinc Ltd
gLine: Fertilizer plant completion: Q1 FY28 (Q1 FY28)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with EBITDA INR8,074 crore (59% margin) and zinc COP USD851/t, but volumes hold at 1.1 Mt guidance and growth capex is re-scheduled; silver and by-product tailwinds drive most of the upside.

name: Reliance Industries Ltd
gLine: Refining structurally short; cracks reasonably strong: qualitative
thesis: Q1 FY27 O2C revenue up 17% on wider refining and ethane-cracking spreads, but management refused to call the spike steady-state; net debt ~Rs 1,23,000 Cr and capex ~Rs 39,000 Cr in the quarter.

name: Bosch Ltd
gLine: 2-wheeler industry growth next quarter: resilient 8% growth
thesis: Bosch Q1 FY27 revenue rose 22% y/y to INR58,419m and EBITDA to INR8,180m with margin near 14%, but management gave no capacity, utilisation or numeric guidance; supply-side evidence is absent.

name: Viyash Scientific Ltd
gLine: Animal Health API growth: 20%+ (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 946 cr (+20% YoY), EBITDA margin 21.6%, but API flat QoQ on customer wait-and-see; management guides Animal API +20%, company 13-15% growth this year.
top: API customers delayed orders in June

name: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 17% YoY and EBITDA up 26% with margin +60bps, but copper up 40% YoY and polymer costs up sharply with pass-through lagging 1-2 quarters; capex ~INR 1,614 crore held in line with guidance.

name: Rico Auto Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: more than INR3,200 crores (~INR3,250 cr) (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~39% to INR755 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 4.6% and PAT turned to a INR3.4 cr loss on air freight and aluminium settlement lag; capex being curtailed after 54 projects.

name: RACL Geartech Ltd
gLine: Heat-treatment plant trial production: January 2027; full commissioning by end FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue ₹132.6 cr (+22% YoY) with ~59% Europe mix; heat-treatment replacement (~₹40 cr) and ₹35 cr expansion capex add capacity, but no capacity utilisation figure was disclosed.
top: Royal Enfield run-rate 7.5–8k sets/month vs 10k nominated

name: Viceroy Hotels Ltd
gLine: Courtyard occupancy: 80% to 85% over next 2 FYs (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Hotel-owner Viceroy Q1 FY27 revenue up 77% to INR44.9 cr and EBITDA margin 26.3%, but PAT just INR1.4 cr as finance cost quadrupled; supply is expanding (Phase 2 Marriott rooms offline, Greenfield 200-key) with no capacity discipline.

name: Aarti Industries Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA of Rs 385 cr (+79% YoY) was flattered by inventory and FX gains (guided Rs 50-60 cr), volumes fell 12% QoQ, and management declined to hold the run rate; Zone IV ramp is delayed.

name: Sanghvi Movers Ltd
thesis: Q1 revenue +39% YoY to Rs 380 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 35% from 40% QoQ; core crane margin 47% vs 53%, with receivables ageing (DSO 116 days) and FY27 EBITDA guidance held at Rs 525-575 cr.

name: Paramount Communications Ltd-$
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15%-20% (FY27)
thesis: Paramount's Q1 FY27 margin recovery is mainly US normalisation after tariff relief; existing plants run near 100% utilisation, so growth waits on Narmadapuram (~INR 500 cr FY28 revenue, debt-equity below 0.3x).

name: Marico Ltd
gLine: EBITDA growth: High-teens, aspire to 20% (FY27)
thesis: Marico's India volume grew 11% with copra input costs ~35% below peak, but management flagged input-cost pressure from crude and edible oils into Q2 and guided EBITDA growth of high teens, aspiring to 20%.

name: Apollo Pipes Ltd
gLine: Q2 volume growth YoY: double-digit (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume flat YoY with consol normalised EBITDA 7% after inventory write-downs; management guides Q2 double-digit YoY growth and 7-8% margin, while capex is trimmed to about Rs.200 crores over two years.
top: PVC prices fell Rs.32/kg in April

name: Bank of India
gLine: FCNR(B) mobilisation by 30 Sep: $1.2 billion
thesis: Clean Q1 FY27 with ROA ~1%, NIM 2.52% and GNPA 1.81%, but deposit cost relief is coming from bulk and FCNR funding, and the FY27 guidance was held rather than raised.

name: Ind-Swift Laboratories Ltd
gLine: Export sales FY27: ₹750 crore, ~45% CDMO (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin jumped to 17.91% from 5.33% on 21% revenue growth, but capacity utilisation was only about 70% and the call offered no hard supply-side data beyond a planned ₹250 crore capex spend.
top: CDMO ramp slower: ₹5-6 cr in Q1, ₹100-130 cr for two products

name: Jindal Stainless Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes fell 7.3% YoY on gas shortage, utilisation at 69-70%, yet management held FY27 volume and H1 EBITDA/t guidance of INR18,000-20,000 while flagging gradual recovery.

name: Bank of Maharashtra
gLine: Equity raise: INR5,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 growth strong (advances +27% YoY, deposits +13%) with NIM 3.85% above 3.75% guidance and credit cost 0.99%, but NII growth (14.5%) lags advances and CASA growth is slowing, with a ~1.45% GNPA and funding reliant on refinance.

name: NTPC Ltd
gLine: Portfolio capacity: 150 GW by FY32, 250 GW by FY37 (FY37)
thesis: NTPC plans 150 GW by FY32 and 250 GW by FY37 with ₹17 lakh crore capex, but FY27 RE addition of 7-8 GW is at risk from transmission and curtailment, with thermal technical-minimum issues.
top: Group capex ₹17 lakh crore to FY37

name: Fiem Industries Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: INR100 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 18.6% to INR770 cr with margin flat at 13.5%, but 4-wheeler ramp pushed out a year and input-cost pressure of ~120 bps is expected to be recovered with a lag.

name: Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: around 15%
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR924 cr (+53% YoY) on 889 MWp executed; INR5,300 cr unexecuted order book includes ~INR2,400 cr solar EPC and ~INR200 cr BESS, with no formal guidance given and consolidated margin diluted by T&D acquisition.

name: Minda Corporation Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: INR 400-odd crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,846 cr (+33% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.5%, but ~INR 106 cr exceptional gain inflates PAT; no capacity-discipline signal, FY27 capex ~INR 400 cr spread across verticals.

name: Greenlam Industries Ltd
gLine: Plywood utilisation: ~50% for FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +18% to INR797 cr and EBITDA pre-forex +48% to INR81 cr, but laminate volume fell 6% on export slippage and domestic volume fell 7.5%; capex falls back to laminate-only expansion with no new large capacity beyond it.

name: HealthCare Global Enterprises Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 21-22% in next 2 years; 24-25% long term (2 years / 4-5 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% to INR6,951m on 11% volume growth, ARPP only +2%; adjusted EBITDA margin 19.4% (+120bp) with management targeting 21-22% in two years and 25% in four to five.

name: Share India Securities Ltd
gLine: Revenue/profit growth: around 20% growth (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT Rs 124.41 cr (+48% YoY) led by MTF book (~Rs 470 cr) and subsidiaries, but prop still ~52% of profit and management guides ~20% growth with no capacity or supply-side metrics.
top: PMS AUM Rs 150 cr in first quarter

name: Shalby Ltd
gLine: Hospital FY27 EBITDA margin: up to 20% for full year (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA flat at ₹49 cr on 11.6% revenue growth as margin fell to 14.5% from 16%; hospital standalone margin down to 18.4% from 21.6%, with management guiding to 20% for the full year without numbers on capacity.

name: Aartech Solonics Ltd
gLine: Next quarters revenue and margins: Expected to be very healthy
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue rose about 1.5x year on year to Rs 728 lakhs and PBT rose to Rs 119 lakhs from Rs 73 lakhs, but the call gave no capacity, utilisation or pricing data and pipeline conversion remained vague.

name: Hitachi Energy India Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 orders INR 5,096.5 cr (ex-HVDC +26.1% YoY) and revenue +68.6% YoY, but no capacity-discipline signal: the 20th plant (Karjan) starts in June 2026 for December 2028 commissioning, and gross margin fell YoY on mix.

name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd
gLine: BT out rate: around 5% to 6% (near term)
thesis: Housing finance book growing 25.7% YoY with stable asset quality (30+ DPD 3.2%) and spread guided at 5–5.25%; no capacity or pricing-supply signals, growth driven by home loans and ticket size.

name: Delhivery Ltd
gLine: Local (intra-city) ARR exit: 250 Cr original target, now 160-175 Cr (FY27)
thesis: Delhivery Q1 FY27: revenue ~Rs3,000 Cr (+28% YoY) with PTL yield up to ~Rs12/kg and FY27 guidance narrowed to 20-30% growth, but profitability hit by two new contracts and labour costs; supply-side signals are light.

name: Modis Navnirman Ltd
gLine: Redevelopment projects to add: two to three projects in this year
thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer: Q1 FY27 revenue up 27.9% YoY to INR58.26 cr, but EBITDA margin fell from ~22.3% to ~19.8% on war-driven material and labour cost hits; no capacity or capital-cycle signals.

name: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 376.6 cr (+85% YoY) with EBITDA margin ~9.3% flat QoQ; compressor utilisation only ~50% and AC capacity 1.0→1.8m sets with 50-60% FY28 utilisation planned, so capacity additions outrun demand visibility.

name: Uniparts India Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: a couple of percentage points above FY26 growth of 21% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR347 crore (+27% YoY), EBITDA INR90 crore (~26% margin); no capacity additions discussed beyond maintenance-type capex of INR12 crore, growth driven by construction and new wins, with FY27 growth guided a few points above FY26's 21%.

name: Khazanchi Jewellers Ltd
gLine: Full-year growth: around 30% (FY27)
thesis: Revenue up 45% to INR586 crore with EBITDA margin 6.82%, but volume growth only ~15% and no supply-side disclosure (capacity, capex quantum, grams sold withheld); management guides 25-30% growth and 5,000 crore by 2030.

name: Waaree Energies Ltd
gLine: Retail revenue FY27: INR9,000 to INR10,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Solar module leader reports Q1 FY27 revenue up 79% to INR7,932 cr with module utilisation near 50% in India and cell integration rising from ~20% to ~65%, while reaffirming FY27 operating EBITDA of INR7,000-7,700 cr.

name: Jash Engineering Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs156 crore (+17% YoY) with PAT turned positive at Rs5 crore; Rs932 crore order book and FY27 Rs875 crore target reiterated, but Middle East and Singapore shipments of about Rs15 crore are stuck.

name: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Ltd
gLine: East India 320 TPD on-site plant revenue: contribute from Q2 FY27 (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 987m (+18% YoY) and EBITDA margin 39%, driven by ramp of Kurnool and Uluberia 2 merchant plants; capex Rs 2,500m FY27 and Rs 2,000m FY28 with no contracted demand for North India merchant plant.

name: Travel Food Services Ltd
thesis: Travel F&B operator grew system-wide sales 18% and PAT 35.6% on flat traffic, but LFL slowed to 0.8% (7% ex-disrupted markets) and EBITDA margin fell to 35.8% on pre-opening costs for 87 new outlets.

name: GNG Electronics Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 30% (raised from 25%)
thesis: Refurbished-PC reseller posts 32% revenue growth and 24.65% gross margin on inventory built ahead of price rises; supply-side evidence is thin and margin gains rest on stockpiling and unverified trust-premium claims.

name: Hy-Tech Engineers Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: ~20% minimum YoY (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% to INR430m but EBITDA margin fell to 19.6% from 21.5%; management attributes it to price pass-through lagging into Q2 and guides ~20% growth and 24-25% margin, with capacity at 60-70% utilisation.
top: Input cost pass-through deferred to Q2

name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd
gLine: Further price hikes: 2% to 3% in current month (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~24% to INR4,215 cr but consolidated margin fell to 9.6% as raw-material and strategic spend hit; price hikes of ~3% in June plus 2-3% planned lag pass-through, and capex of INR1,700 cr is largely new energy.

name: Steel Authority of India Ltd
gLine: Iron ore third-party sales: 8 million tonnes target (FY27)
thesis: SAIL Q1 FY27 EBITDA up over 50% to INR4,356 crore (INR10,464/t) on better NSR and cost, despite crude output down to 4.8 Mt from 4.9 Mt due to advanced repairs; inventory rose 0.2 Mt.

name: Sundrop Brands Ltd
gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin (ESOP-adjusted): ~7% today, 12% by FY30 target (3 years)
thesis: Consolidated revenue +15% YoY with EBITDA steady near 7% (ESOP-adjusted ~5.7%); growth is demand and investment-led, with no capacity or supply-discipline signal, and a 12% FY30 margin target that is aspirational.

name: Max Financial Services Ltd
thesis: Axis Max Life VNB margin rose to 23.2% (from 20.3%) and VNB grew 33%, driven by protection mix and yield curve, while solvency sits at 198% after Axis's ₹381 crore infusion.

name: NIIT Ltd
gLine: Q2 FY27 revenue growth: double-digit YoY (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14% to INR957m with EBITDA near breakeven at -INR14m (vs -INR63m); no capacity metric, supply side is a skilling investment cycle, guidance is qualitative for Q2 (double-digit growth, near-breakeven EBITDA).

name: ACC Ltd
thesis: Ambuja cut low-margin non-trade volume (trade -2%, non-trade -21% YoY, total -7%) to chase value; net cost fell to INR4,241/t and FY27 cost target INR4,250 held, but utilisation is ~65%.

name: Bharat Forge Ltd
gLine: Organic capex India: ~INR1,800 crore (18 months)
