thesis: Q1 FY27 margin hit by 160bp energy/logistics costs (reported EBITDA 26.2% standalone, ~28% normalised) while management guides a ₹1,800 cr organic capex and ₹2,500 cr fundraise, adding capacity ahead of demand.

name: Sagar Cements Ltd-$
gLine: Volume growth FY28: double-digit (FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up ~13% but EBITDA/tonne fell to ₹451 on West Asia energy costs; management still reiterates ₹500–550/t for FY27 and 7 Mt volumes, with no new capex through FY28.

name: Triton Valves Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: ~15 cr
thesis: Q1 FY27 group sales up ~38% YoY to ~186.5 cr with tax-credit-boosted PAT, but EBITDA margin compressed on copper pass-through and climate control is weak; no capacity discipline, capex raised to ~15 cr.

name: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Ltd
gLine: Gold loan AUM: INR5,000 crores by FY27 end
thesis: Cholamandalam Q1 FY27 shows 22% disbursement and 23% AUM growth with net credit cost down to 1.5% from 1.8%, but Stage 3 rose to 3.29% and management has no supply-side or capacity signal, so it is a credit-quality and growth read, not a capital-cycle read.

name: Sunteck Realty Ltd
gLine: Collections growth FY27: similar 25% to 30% growth (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 20% to INR787 crores and EBITDA margin 35%, but collections (INR409 crore) and revenue (INR191 crore, +2% YoY) show a cash-led story; FY27 presales guided 25-30% growth, Dubai launch deferred.
top: Presales up 20% YoY to INR787 cr

name: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd
gLine: FY27 launch pipeline: around INR3,000 crores (Wadala boutique office ~INR3,600 crores single phase)
thesis: Mumbai luxury/mid-market developer with Q1 revenue up 23% to INR320 crores and debt down to INR680 crores (D/E 0.47x), but Q1 sales of only INR146 crores and launches slipping, so supply-side evidence is thin.

name: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd-$
gLine: Top-line growth: 10-15% p.a. for next 3 years (3 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 growth was ~25% revenue, but only ~2% volume; PVC lines run at 75-78% utilisation with no new capacity sanctioned beyond a 5 lakh metre line due Feb-Mar 2027, and export OEM price hikes remain unpushed.

name: Oriental Rail Infrastructure Ltd
gLine: Consolidated FY27 turnover: around INR700 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16.7% to INR137.6 cr and EBITDA margin 15.2%, but wagon utilisation was ~50% in FY26 and management guided ~500 wagons in Q2 vs 300-odd in Q1, with 3,800-wagon order book and no operating cash flow in FY25-26.

name: Zydus Lifesciences Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: ₹1,500-1,600 crore (FY27)
thesis: Zydus Q1 FY27 revenue ₹80.2bn (+22% YoY), EBITDA margin 24.1%, FY27 guided at 24%+ margin and strong double-digit growth, with Saro launch costs and acquisition-driven opex rising in H2; supply-side signals are thin.

name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
gLine: Ethanol capacity utilisation: 100-110% of existing capacity by FY28 (FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA Rs91cr at 14.2% margin on strong ethanol realisations, but management guides FY27 EBITDA margin 10-11% and says Q2 is seasonally weak; capacity debottleneck to 100-110% by FY28 with no major capex until FY28.

name: Petronet LNG Ltd
gLine: FY27 and FY28 capex: INR 9,064 crore FY27; similar for FY28
thesis: Petronet's Q1 FY27 profit rose 33% on trading and inventory gains (INR 301 cr and INR 193 cr) while Dahej utilisation fell to 66% on an expanded 22.5 MMTPA base, with Qatar force majeure still in place.
top: Dahej utilisation 66% vs 92% a year ago

name: Karnataka Bank Ltd
thesis: Margin-led beat: NIM 3.20% (vs 3.07% Q4) and CD ratio 78.45% (vs 71.93% a year ago) show balance sheet turning, but management's answers on SMA-2 build-up (INR750 crore) and mid-corporate growth were evasive.

name: R Systems International Ltd
thesis: Revenue Rs 601.7 cr (+30.2% YoY, +4.7% QoQ) with adjusted EBITDA margin 20.1%, but organic growth is muted and management gives no numeric guidance; growth is largely acquisition and rupee aided.

name: DCB Bank Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 record PAT of INR 213 crores (+36% YoY) on cost-of-deposit down 14 bps and GNPA 2.43%, but CASA slipped to 21.65% and management admits growth relies on gold loans and a slow MSME ramp.
top: Cost of deposit down 14 bps QoQ

name: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd
thesis: Power Grid's Q1 FY27 PAT was flat at Rs 3,598 crore despite Rs 5,277 crore capitalisation; a Rs 560 crore regulatory drag and lower one-off interest weighed, with capex and capitalisation guidance intact.
top: Regulatory drag Rs 560 crore on profit

name: V-Guard Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: more than 15% (FY27)
thesis: V-Guard Q1 FY27 revenue +23.5% (≈14% price, ≈9% volume) with 10.5% EBITDA margin, but wires volumes near zero as customers defer after steep price hikes and new entrants arrive.

name: Cantabil Retail India Ltd
gLine: Store openings Q2: 28-30 stores
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +13% to INR178.8 cr with SSG 4.04% and 667 stores; no supply discipline signal as store adds accelerate to 30 in Q2, and management reiterates INR1,000 cr FY27 target that needs ~18-19% growth.
top: Q2 volume growth muted, H2 stronger

name: Arvind SmartSpaces Ltd
gLine: Launch booking value FY27: INR3,000-3,500 crore across 6 launches
thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 147% to INR432 crore and revenue jumped on one OC, but the read is a real-estate developer with no capacity or utilisation data; guidance held, OCF of INR81 crore vs full-year INR400-500 crore target.

name: Dr. Lal PathLabs Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens rather than early teens (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 19.1% to Rs 798 crore with EBITDA margin 31.0%, driven by CGHS price pass-through (2-3%) and mix; no supply-side capacity signal as management says capacity is never a constraint.
top: Margin guide tilts to mid-teens growth

name: Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd
gLine: ALOS: 3.9-4.0 days (not specified)
thesis: Narayana Q1 FY27 shows India hospital margin expansion (~400 bps ex-clinics) on no new beds, but insurance, clinics and UK losses dilute consolidated margin; no numeric capex or guidance changes given.

name: Thyrocare Technologies Ltd
gLine: Radiology PAT: INR6 crores PAT for the year (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 24.3% to INR240 crores with EBITDA margin 32.2%; no capacity additions or capex cuts discussed, and specialty build-out is capex-light so far.

name: Regency Fincorp Ltd
gLine: Blended cost of borrowing: 11.5% to 12% for the year; ~12.5% by year end per one answer (FY27)
thesis: Small Tier-2 MSME/digital NBFC; Q1 FY27 PAT ₹7.0 cr, secured book ₹230 cr, cost of funds guided down from ~13.25% to 11.5–12%, FY27 PAT target ₹25–30 cr, with no supply-side or capacity data disclosed.

name: Avenue Supermarts Ltd
thesis: Store adds targeted at ~15% of base annually with 15 of 85 FY26 openings leased; SSSG seen holding at FY26 level (7-8%) as quick commerce erodes metro throughput; DMart Ready cut to 11 cities.
top: Metro SSSG saturation and quick commerce drag

name: SIS Ltd
gLine: Labour code EBITDA/PAT impact: accretive over next 3-4 quarters
thesis: SIS Q1 FY27 revenue INR 4,604 cr (+29.7% YoY) with consolidated EBITDA margin 4.5%; flat QoQ, and labour-code wage pass-through is the main tailwind, but no supply or capacity signal.

name: Solara Active Pharma Sciences Ltd
gLine: Base business EBITDA margin: 25% +/- 1% (FY27)
thesis: Base business revenue INR307 cr (+24% YoY) with gross margin 51.3% and EBITDA INR72 cr, but ~INR30 cr of revenue is solvent cost pass-through and Ibuprofen still loses INR10-15 cr EBITDA each quarter.

name: Dalmia Bharat Ltd
gLine: Depreciation FY27 increase: INR100 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes +9% YoY and EBITDA/ton up 3% QoQ to INR1,055 despite fuel shock, but absolute EBITDA fell 11% QoQ and Jaypee adds 5.2 Mt with a 7–8 quarter path to Dalmia-average margins.

name: Artemis Medicare Services Ltd
gLine: Gurgaon EBITDA margin: 20-21% in FY27; 23-24% over 2-3 years (FY27 to 2-3 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 287.32 cr (+12.7%) and EBITDA margin 21.5%; Gurugram occupancy 65.7% with ~200-bed Tower IV and INR 800 cr three-year capex plan adds supply, with a INR 700 cr equity enabling resolution.

name: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Ltd
gLine: ARPOB growth: 4-5% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,196 crore (+36% YoY) with IP volumes +26.6%, but Kondapur ramp, new-unit losses and a 50% occupancy base keep supply absorption the key test; ARPOB guided to 4-5% growth.

name: Shriram Properties Ltd
gLine: FY27 PBT margin: 8-9% (FY27)
thesis: Record Q1 presales of INR484 cr (+10% YoY) and Rs1,560 cr handover pipeline, but Q1 revenue only INR271 cr (+4%) with PAT INR11 cr; FY27 is back-ended and margin recovery rests on handovers.

name: Global Health Ltd
gLine: Noida EBITDA breakeven: earlier than previous expectations
thesis: Medanta Q1 FY27 shows volume-led growth (IP +28%, ARPOB +5%) and Noida EBITDA loss cut to INR49m from INR236m, but no capex cut, no numeric guidance and a 3,350-bed pipeline keeps supply expanding.

name: Cyient DLM Ltd
gLine: Book-to-bill ratio for FY27: 1.5x for the year (FY27)
thesis: Record INR2,598 cr order book and 1.5x book-to-bill with revenue up 34% YoY, but working capital days rose to 161 from 145 and free cash flow is negative.

name: Senco Gold Ltd
gLine: New stores: 12-15 more in FY27 (remainder FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 67% with retail +50% and SSSG ~39%, but reported EBITDA fell to 7.0% (from 10.1%) and management retained 7.5-7.8% guidance; supply-side signals (inventory days ~152, hedging held at ~50%) are mixed.

name: Blue Jet Healthcare Ltd
gLine: Iodinated intermediate commercial batches: positive trend by end Q2 or beginning Q3
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR293 cr (+25% QoQ) on PI/API restart, but contrast media fell ~40% QoQ on ~INR30 cr goods-in-transit; plant utilisation steady at 70-odd percent with capex ~INR250 cr in FY27.
top: Goods in transit up ~INR30 cr QoQ

name: Honasa Consumer Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin expansion FY27: 150-200 bps
thesis: Q1 FY27 growth 32% with 30.5% volume growth, EBITDA near INR110 cr; inventory discipline (distributor stock under 30 days) and calibrated price hikes, but margin lift partly one-time and seasonal.

name: Happy Forgings Ltd
gLine: Industrial share of revenue (medium term): Industrials to double in 3-4 years; PV 12-15%; industrials+PV 45-50% of revenue (3-4 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs449cr (+27%) and EBITDA margin 31.3%, but forging utilisation only 59% with 4,000t press added; price hikes of ~4.5-5% on domestic book start from Q2.

name: RBZ Jewellers Ltd
gLine: Store break-even: capex break-even in a year or less
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR121 crore (+60% YoY) and EBITDA margin 14.9%, but factory runs at ~50% utilisation and management is expanding stores (INR10 crore Surat capex) and shifting to gold metal loans, with EBITDA margin pressure and no segment profit disclosure.
top: Gold metal loan shift to hedge inventory

name: International Gemological Institute Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: at least 100 bps by year end (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +23% to INR 3,708m and group EBITDA +29% to INR 2,238m (60.4% margin), with growth driven by LGD volumes; supply-side evidence is growers expanding capacity, but no IGI capex discipline discussed.

name: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd
gLine: Mehru EBITDA margin: around 18% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 margins strong (gross 47.2%, EBITDA 25.2% reported, 28.3% ex-Ind AS 29) but capacity is ramping slowly: Sangli trials only this month, approvals ~six months, FY27 guidance held at 20% growth with no raise.

name: Seshaasai Technologies Ltd
gLine: IoT revenue share FY27: 15% to 18% of revenue
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 21.1% YoY but down 6.9% QoQ with gross margin 41.7% (from 44.5%) as COMC rose to 58.34%; management reiterates 8–12% revenue growth and H2-weighted margin recovery without numbers; capacity utilisation 65–70%.

name: Physicswallah Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,054 crore (+24% YoY) with pre-Ind AS EBITDA -INR44 crore; management reiterates FY27 30% revenue and 100% EBITDA growth but NEET shift cut Q1 offline growth to 14%.
top: NEET shift cut offline growth to 14%

name: Advit Jewels Ltd
gLine: B2B/B2C mix target: 40% to 50% on B2B, B2C also
thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT up 37.9% to INR8.19 crore at 23.1% margin, but call is promotional with no capacity, utilisation or pricing data; B2C/store capex and franchise model still unformed.

name: Molbio Diagnostics Ltd
gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: ~25% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Molbio's Truenat point-of-care platform is capacity-rich (kits at 58%, devices at 42% utilisation) with guidance of ~25% revenue growth and 24–25% EBITDA; no prior guidance was supplied to check against.

name: Kanohar Electricals Ltd
gLine: Revenue FY27: approximately INR950 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹137.1 cr (+103.5% YoY) and EBITDA margin 28.3%, but no capacity cut or discipline signal; 18,000 MVA brownfield added for FY29 with ~1,725 MVA executed in Q1 on 19,200 MVA base.

name: Glass Wall Systems (India) Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~25% (FY27)
thesis: Facade maker's first call: Q1 revenue Rs.107 cr (+36% YoY) and EBITDA margin 21.3%, with FY27 guidance of ~25% growth, 23-25% EBITDA margin and Rs.982 cr order book, but no capacity discipline data and a loose order-inflow answer.
top: Order book Rs.982 cr, ~2x last year

name: Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY27-FY29 growth CAGR: 25% CAGR (FY27-FY29)
thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up 40% to INR 849 crore with core up 23% and emerging up 92%, but operational EBITDA margin fell to 30.1% and working capital days rose to 96; supply-side read is capacity at 75-80% utilisation with INR 240 crore capex funded from IPO.

name: Ester Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 debt repayment: around INR100 crores
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA up 103% to INR58.9 crore with film EBIT margin 9.8% and utilisation 84%, but management withheld firm FY27 guidance and Specialty Polymers revenue fell; other income flatters PAT.

name: Castrol India Ltd
thesis: Castrol India Q2 CY26 revenue INR1,871 crore (+25% YoY) and EBITDA margin ~26%, helped by one-off benefit from cheaper inventory; management says costs hit P&L more in Q3 and pricing is the lever, with a 21-24% EBITDA band.
top: Old low-cost inventory flattered Q2 margin

name: Banswara Syntex Ltd-$
gLine: Garment revenue run-rate: about INR100 crore per quarter for next 3 quarters
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 4% with yarn utilisation at 70% and garment dispatches slipped; management holds FY27 INR1,450-1,500 crore guidance and a 12% EBITDA target, with INR140 crore capex sanctioned, while Q1 consolidated EBITDA was 9%.

name: TIL Ltd
gLine: Turnover growth: Significant jump this year; tripling in 5-7 years (FY27 and 5-7 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue INR117.1 cr (+86%) with partial Tulip consolidation; standalone EBITDA margin 4.3% and management sees no margin fix for six to eight quarters, with no capex beyond bridging.
top: Debtor days stressed after March billing

name: Kanpur Plastipack Ltd
gLine: ESSEKAN premium PP yarn revenue: Rs 10 crore in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 59% YoY to Rs 22.19 cr on 31% price rise vs 18% raw material rise, but FIBC volume fell to 3,000 t versus 3,500 t a year earlier and four-week order visibility limits confidence.

name: Carborundum Universal Ltd
gLine: Consolidated Ceramics sales growth: 23% to 25% (FY27)
thesis: Standalone sales up 21.2% YoY to INR 846 cr on volume, with EMD exports rising, but Abrasive margins are squeezed by oil-linked and fuel cost push and Foskor and Awuko exits remain unresolved.

name: Vishnu Chemicals Ltd
gLine: Strontium utilisation: 65% to 75% by year-end (FY27 end)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 24.9% to INR433.4 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 15.1% from 16.1%; South Africa chrome mine still not producing, gross margin 44-45% vs 50% target by year-end.
top: Freight cost ~20% of revenue in Q2

name: Heritage Foods Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: high single digits (long term)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18% to INR13,381m but EBITDA margin fell to 4.6% as milk procurement rose 7% to INR46.61/l; no supply relief visible until the October flush, and pricing is being passed on.
top: Milk price up 7% YoY to INR46.61

name: Timken India Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR929 crore (+15% YoY), PBT margin 16.2%, gross margin 39.9% up 100bp YoY; Bharuch ramp slow at ~INR50 crore quarterly revenue, near breakeven, with utilisation 40-45% on SRB lines.

name: Eveready Industries India Ltd
gLine: Alkaline market share: 25% to 30% exit share in 2 years (2 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR407.7 cr (+9% YoY), EBITDA margin 15.1% on price actions, but alkaline Jammu plant just commissioned and management flags zinc inflation and possible further price/margin corrections.

name: Saregama India Ltd
gLine: New music content spend FY27: Rs 300-350 cr (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 263.6 cr (+27% YoY), adjusted EBITDA Rs 112.4 cr (+69%); music vertical guidance of 20-23% growth and 60-65% EBITDA margin held, but no supply-side discipline evidence and content spend rising to Rs 300-350 cr.
top: Music growth 20-23% and EBITDA margin 60-65% held

name: Suprajit Engineering Ltd-$
thesis: Consolidated revenue +24% to INR1,070 cr and EBITDA +57%, but standalone EBITDA flat at INR60 cr as India wage inflation squeezed ICM margin from ~15% to 13%; management calls it timing and guides held.

name: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd
thesis: Capex largely done (~Rs 350 cr FY27 guide), utilisation ramp to 75-80% before next capex; net debt cut to Rs 1,900 cr with Rs 500 cr reduction targeted this year, but margin gains partly offset by unpassed energy and shipping costs.

name: Info Edge (India) Ltd
gLine: Job Hai revenue: more than double from ~Rs.15 crores last year
thesis: Naukri billings up ~17% (about 15% normalised) with pricing and new AI products carrying growth, but Shiksha billings fell 23% and 99acres is only near break-even; no capacity lens applies to this asset-light platform.

name: Redington Ltd
gLine: Q2 FY27 revenue: Expect good strong quarter
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 34% to INR34,966 cr and PAT up 77%, but management says ESG growth is largely price-led stock-and-sell with channel holding 2-3 months of inventory, and Arena losses persist.

name: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Capital markets FY27 growth: growth for FY27 as a whole
thesis: Asset and private wealth now 55% of operating PAT (vs 42% FY25) with AMC AUM crossing ₹2 lakh crore, but wealth TBR revenue fell sharply YoY and alternates saw negative net flows in the quarter.
top: AMC AUM ~₹1.9 lakh crore, up 34% YoY

name: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd
gLine: Q2 realisation: similar to Q1, slight correction (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 on ~80,000t output and ~INR120,000/t realisation, but FY27 volume guidance cut from 400,000t to ~380,000t on transformer and gas-cleaning constraints at KNR-2; Q2 prices guided flat to slightly lower.

name: JTL Industries Ltd
gLine: Mangaon capacity addition: ~1 million tons by end H1 FY27
thesis: Record Q1 volume of 118,513 t (+17.8% YoY) and company utilisation of 55% rising to ~65% by year-end, but EBITDA/t of ~INR4,954 includes a ~INR200 Defence boost; capacity goes to 2 Mt by FY28-29.

name: Mobavenue AI Tech Ltd
thesis: AdTech platform reports Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 728m (+56.9% YoY) and PAT margin 16.1%, but no supply-side data; growth is company-driven with limited capacity or pricing disclosure beyond revenue per outcome of Rs 49.94.

name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd
gLine: A&P as % of sales FY27: similar to last year
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +11.8% to Rs 2,235 cr and EBITDA margin +20 bps to 10%, but management admits ~Rs 200 cr primary sales lost to supply disruption; pricing covered ~80% of inflation and Q2 start is strong.

name: Sheela Foam Ltd
gLine: Overseas EBITDA: combined EBITDA around INR120 crores; revenue above INR1,000 crores
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin fell as raw-material volatility hit gross margin, but management leaned on foam volume and overseas gains; standalone volume only ~6% and no capacity discipline signal.

name: GTPL Hathway Ltd
gLine: Operating margin: 25% (not specified)
thesis: Cable/broadband MSO with margins flat-to-down: consolidated EBITDA ₹109 cr (10.7%) and PAT ₹2.3 cr as D&A and finance cost rose ~₹6 cr; management guides HITS-driven margin uplift and ~₹400 cr capex with no hard ACT deal contribution numbers.

name: AU Small Finance Bank Ltd
thesis: Bank grew loans 23% and deposits 24% YoY with NIM 5.9% and credit cost 0.8%, but no capacity or supply signal; the quarter is demand-led growth in a bank, not a capital-cycle read.

name: Godrej Agrovet Ltd
gLine: Astec revenue growth FY27: at least more than 20% (FY27)
thesis: Crop Care revenue fell 16.2% on a dry June and cotton herbicide weakness, while Oil Palm and Animal Nutrition grew; management still targets double-digit consolidated PBT growth, though it defers the number to end-September.

name: MAS Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Direct distribution share: 70% to 72% in 1-1.5 years (1-1.5 years)
thesis: MAS Financial Q1 FY27 shows steady 21% AUM growth and a 25% PAT rise, but credit cost has drifted up to about 1.6% and management is guiding to a wide 1.25–1.75% range rather than a firm number.
top: Eligible demand dipped on energy-linked tightening

name: KPI Green Energy Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% against 20-30% expected, PAT down to INR95 crore from INR111 crore as depreciation and interest hit before IPP revenue ramps; margins under geopolitical cost pressure at KP Energy.
top: PAT margin FY27 guide to be lower

name: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd
gLine: Specialty share of revenue: 45% from 40% (medium term)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 17% to INR 450 cr on volume (patients +10%, tests +11%) with no price hike; EBITDA margin 25.2% (+210 bps), but supply-side discipline is mostly absent as 500+ net centres are being added.

name: Computer Age Management Services Ltd
industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
gLine: Employee cost growth YoY: around 5% (FY27)
thesis: CAMS Q1 FY27: EBITDA up 18% to INR183 cr with margin 46.4%, but non-MF margin fell to 13% on KRA price cut; management guides ~13% revenue and ~16% EBITDA growth for FY27 with cost growth held under 10%.

name: Stove Kraft Ltd
gLine: Induction cooktop share of revenue: at least 20% and a little above
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +41.3% to INR480.6 cr and EBITDA margin 11.2% (+71bp), but growth is driven by a demand spike in induction cooktops; management is guiding to a 2x induction year and gross margin up at least 1% YoY with no capacity-discipline evidence.

name: G R Infraprojects Ltd
gLine: Capex: ~INR300 cr FY27; INR200-250 cr FY28 (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 32.7% to INR2,423 cr but standalone EBITDA margin fell to 11.02% from 12.65%; FY27 growth guide held at 15-20% and margin at 10-11%, with order book ~INR25,300 cr.

name: Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Ltd
gLine: FY28 capex: INR950-1,000 crore
thesis: Q1 FY27 realisation up INR320/t QoQ versus cost up INR230/t, EBITDA up INR90/t; management guides Q2 cost inflation near INR100/t, capex held at INR900 crore, and says East capacity is not needed until FY28.

name: Brand Concepts Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~11% but PBT loss widened; management says PC plant at 80%+ utilisation, PP plant ramping, and sees inventory cut to ~130 days, with capex pause for two years.

name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
gLine: OSAT + PCB FY27 revenue: INR450-500 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR946 crore (+40% YoY) and EBITDA margin 15.6%, but operating cash flow was negative INR259 crore on inventory build of ~INR177 crore and metering receivables rising to INR1,311 crore; margin pressure flagged as a multi-quarter issue.

name: INOX India Ltd
gLine: Order inflow: slightly above INR450-500 cr per quarter (FY27)
thesis: Record INR532 cr order inflow and INR1,686 cr order book, but Q1 revenue of INR382 cr missed the INR410-415 cr target and EBITDA grew only 1.4%; mgmt reiterates 18-20% FY27 growth.

name: Entero Healthcare Solutions Ltd
gLine: Effective tax rate FY27: 22.5% (FY27)
thesis: Entero's Q1 FY27 shows EBITDA margin at 5.0% (+143bp YoY) and organic growth of 19.6% like-for-like, but it is a pharma distributor with no capacity-cycle signals; supply-side metrics are absent and the call leans on guidance reiteration.

name: JNK India Ltd
gLine: Chemdist revenue share FY27: 10% to 15% of JNK India revenue
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 80.6% to INR 186 cr with EBITDA margin 11.8% after Chemdist JV loss; order book INR 1,801 cr, but Q1 is seasonally 10-15% of FY revenue and the Chemdist-driven margin dip plus a cancelled export order temper the read.

name: Indegene Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 19% to 20% in H2 FY27; back by Q4 FY27 (Q4 FY27)
thesis: Indegene Q1 FY27 revenue up 26.5% YoY in USD to $112.5m with EBITDA 16.9%; management reiterates 19–20% margin recovery by Q4 FY27, but this is a services firm with no capacity data and it is a services/pharma commercial business, so the capital-cycle read is thin.
top: Margin recovery to 19–20% by Q4 FY27
themes: Gen AI in pharma commercial ops

name: Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd
gLine: Cost to income reduction: 30-40 bps a year (annual)
thesis: Aadhar's Q1 FY27 is a steady housing-finance print: AUM up 18% to ₹31,364 cr, spreads held at 5.8%, but a cheque-realisation accounting shift cut disbursement growth to about 19% on a like-for-like basis and Q1 credit cost rose seasonally.

name: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY28 revenue: INR2,700 crores (FY28)
thesis: Q1 revenue up 20.7% to INR460 crores with EBITDA margin flat at 8.6%; capacity additions (Gujarat, heavy structure, Andhra Phase 2) ramp into FY27-28 while order book rose to INR1,864 crores and FY27 revenue guidance held at INR2,150-2,200 crores.
top: Capex ~INR250 cr over 2 years, QIP upsized

name: Godavari Biorefineries Ltd
gLine: Bio-chem quarterly revenue: INR190 crore next quarter (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Bio-chemicals revenue up 19.4% to INR168.7 cr with EBITDA up 53%, but consolidated EBITDA fell to INR2.6 cr (0.5% margin) as sugar/ethanol loss widened to INR14.6 cr.

name: Black Buck Ltd
thesis: Platform growth steady (revenue from ops +42% YoY, adj EBITDA ₹55 cr +16%), but supply-side signals are absent; super loads still in heavy investment phase and fuel recovery uncertain.

name: Infinity Infoway Ltd
gLine: ZeroTouch share of revenue: 20% to 22% within about two years
thesis: Small-cap AI/ERP SaaS story with Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 689 lakh, EBITDA Rs 344 lakh; no capacity or pricing data, ZeroTouch has only pilot orders and 150 machines built, and the Rs 75 crore order book is unverified.

name: Piramal Finance Ltd
thesis: Growth-book AUM up 32% with Growth RoAUM 1.9% (vs 1.5%) and PAT up 67% to Rs 461 cr; reads as a lender scaling without supply-side capacity signals, with early IT-salary stress flagged.

name: Skyways Air Services Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue nearly doubled to INR1,216.53 crore on yield and volume, but management attributes much of the jump to fuel-linked pass-through; volume growth 23% is the cited driver with no capacity or capex signal.

name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
gLine: Own GPU deployment: ~1,500 GPUs by Jan/Feb 2027 (mid-to-end Q4)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 7.3% YoY to INR133.66 cr with GPU capacity (Sharon AI, 8,200 B300s) not billing until Q3; the story rests on unproven GPU leasing and heavy customer-advance funding.
top: Sharon AI GPU billing slipped to Q3

name: Bharat Electronics Ltd
gLine: Export revenue FY27: USD 300 million internal guidance (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 25% to INR 5,533 crore with order book INR 72,258 crore, but Q1 inflow only INR 3,754 crore; management reiterates FY27 inflow above INR 55,000 crore, 15% growth and 28% EBITDA margin.

name: Supreme Petrochem Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 profit rose on wide styrene-to-polymer deltas while volumes fell 24.5% to 70,842 t; management gave no volume guidance and is adding ~80,000 t of PS capacity by Dec 2028 (~INR 450 cr, internal accruals).

name: Escorts Kubota Ltd
gLine: Tractor industry FY27 volume: mid-single-digit growth
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume strong (domestic tractors +22.9%, share +36bp) but EBITDA margin fell to 11.2% from 13.1% on ~5% commodity cost hit; price hikes lag cost, Q2 cost pressure of 1.5-2% more, FY27 industry guided mid-single-digit growth.

name: Evonile Pharma Ltd
gLine: Revenue doubling in 4-5 years (organic base): ~2x in 4-5 years
thesis: Post-takeover Novartis India is rebuilding its commercial model: M&A-led growth, ~INR40–50 crore extra quarterly costs from Q2 and a margin dip, with no supply-side capacity signal.
top: Incremental cost INR40-50 crore per quarter

name: Flomic Global Logistics Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: Momentum for 3-4 quarters, no number
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18.4% to INR120 cr and EBITDA margin up 275bp to 9.34%, but management attributes most growth to freight rates (volume only +6-7%) and gives no capacity or capex data, so the read is cyclical freight-rate tailwind rather than supply-side evidence.

name: Shriram Finance Ltd
gLine: Growth next quarter: more than 15% (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Shriram Finance Q1 FY27 is a lender with excess post-capital liquidity, not a supply-side story; NIM 9.04% guided to fall to ~8.5% medium term, AUM growth 15.26% YoY, full-year 18% growth guidance held.

name: Ugro Capital Ltd
gLine: Closing AUM FY27: flat
thesis: Opex cut to ~INR 119 cr/qtr (from 217) and ~INR 2,551 cr disbursements, but on-book interest income fell 13% QoQ and co-lending/DA income halved to INR 75 cr; capital-cycle reset is real yet earnings quality still in transition.

name: Greenply Industries Ltd
gLine: Peak debt / D/E: ₹710-730 cr; 0.75x at FYE then 0.65-0.7x (FY27)
thesis: Greenply Q1 FY27 volumes grew double digits (ply +13.8%, MDF +24.7%) but utilisation fell to 92-93% and management admits lost sales; new MDF flooring line started 20 July with ply/MDF capex ~₹500 cr this year.

name: Ashapura Minechem Ltd
gLine: Bauxite EBITDA per ton: USD 5.5-6 near term (Next 1-2 quarters)
thesis: Guinea bauxite volumes fell to 2.34 Mt from 3.16 Mt in Q4 as freight shock hit; EBITDA/t rose to $6.3 from $5.9, but management guides ~$6 near term and expects no capex-led supply response.
top: Bauxite volumes 2.34 Mt, down from 3.16 Mt

name: City Union Bank Ltd
gLine: NIM: 3.65%-3.70% next few quarters (next few quarters)
thesis: Secured-lending bank with GNPA down to 1.73% and PCR 85%, but supply-side signals are absent (no capacity lens); credit growth 25% QoQ-headline with utilisation falling 73%→70% and NIM guided 3.65–3.70%.

name: Sterlite Technologies Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 23% (FY27)
thesis: Record INR13,100 crore Q1 order intake (1.7x FY26 total) and INR18,618 crore order book (2.4x QoQ), but capacity is now the constraint, with utilisation said only to be "improving" and no numbers given.
top: Q1 orders INR13,100 cr, 1.7x FY26 total

name: Tips Music Ltd
gLine: Content budget FY27: INR90-100 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR106.51 cr (+21% YoY) but PAT down 4% to INR43.89 cr as full new-release content cost (up 90%) was expensed upfront; management holds 20% revenue/PAT growth and 65-70% annual EBITDA margin.

name: Punjab National Bank
gLine: Cost-to-income ratio: 47%-48% by end of FY27 (FY27)
thesis: PNB Q1 FY27 shows NIM recovery (domestic 2.61%→2.64%) and cost-to-income down to 50.31% from 55.31%, but growth is supported by shedding low-yield IBPC and corporate loans, and no supply-side capacity signal applies.

name: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Tier 1 capital: No capital raise needed for at least 6 to 8 quarters
thesis: Asset quality at an 8-year low (GS3 3.45%, credit cost 1.5%, ROA 2.4%) with AUM growth 13%, but wheels only ~11-12% and management is holding a ~INR 5,500 cr liquidity buffer and overlays against El Nino risk.

name: Allcargo Logistics Ltd
gLine: Express pre-Ind AS operating PBT margin FY27: 5% to 6%
thesis: Allcargo Q1 FY27 revenue up 11.2% to INR546 cr with Express yield up 6.4% and volume up 6.7%, but the supply side is unchanged: no capacity addition or capex cut, just INR10-15 cr express upkeep and ~INR20 cr CL capex.

name: Action Construction Equipment Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: INR200-250 crore
thesis: Q1 FY27 best-ever Q1 with EBITDA up 19.7% to INR170.58 cr, but gross margin fell ~140 bps on commodity costs; management pushed ~10% cumulative price and is still building a 1,000-crane tower capacity decision pending September.
top: Full-year growth guidance deferred to September

name: Technocraft Industries (India) Ltd
gLine: Scaffolding volumes next two quarters: maintain or better Q1 volumes
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin spike is partly volume and rupee-driven; management refuses to raise sustainable margin guidance (Drum 30%, Scaffolding/Engineering 15%), and capex is maintenance-only this year, a supply-discipline positive.

name: Firstsource Solutions Ltd
industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +12.3% cc YoY with margin 12.4% but a healthcare BPaaS deramp (~1-1.5% of revenue) and INR717m exceptional charges; FY27 guidance held, no capacity signals.

name: Jai Balaji Industries Ltd
gLine: Ferroalloy capacity utilisation: 80% to 90%
thesis: DI pipe utilisation only ~30% on 5.5 lakh TPA with prices down 25-30% and no volume guidance, while ferroalloy utilisation above 80% and capacity expanding to 1.9 lakh MT, to be commissioned by Q3 FY27.
top: DI pipe utilisation ~30% on enhanced capacity

name: Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Ltd
gLine: Keys exited FY27 (further): 300 to 400 keys over next 3 quarters (Q2-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Mahindra Holidays Q1 FY27 shows resort revenue up 10% to INR126 crores and occupancy 86.7%, but profit down about INR22 crores YoY, with ~400 keys offline and a loss-making European unit under strategic review.

name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd
gLine: Apollo 8 mt EBITDA per ton: INR6,000 per ton (2-3 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume fell ~20% QoQ to 745,000 t, but EBITDA/ton held ~INR5,500 on price discipline; management reiterates 20% FY27 EBITDA growth and 15–20% volume growth, with July volume ~300k t.

name: NBCC (India) Ltd
gLine: Standalone FY27 revenue: INR 13,000-14,000 cr (FY27)
thesis: Standalone EBITDA up 62% to INR 160 cr (margin 8.77%) on marketing fees, but revenue grew only 10% and order inflow of INR 1,700 cr lags the INR 18,000-20,000 cr targeted for next 2-3 quarters.

name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd
gLine: Ethnic portfolio revenue growth FY27: 20% plus (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,026 cr (+11%) and EBITDA margin 8.2%, with TCNS like-to-like only ~2% and a sizeable TMRW loss; no capacity or supply-side signal, and cost inflation of ~4% is flagged to hit Q2–Q3 margins.

name: Quess Corp Ltd
gLine: Net headcount addition FY27: 30,000 plus (FY27)
thesis: Quess Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 4,182 cr (+15% YoY) with EBITDA margin 2.02%, but the Rs 176 cr Labour Code pass-through and Rs 261 cr tax refund flattered headline PAT; underlying General Staffing EBITDA ~1.5% margin, and capital-cycle signals are weak as this is a staffing business with no capacity to cut.
top: Labour Code: Rs 176 cr one-time pass-through

name: Mitsu Chem Plast Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: Quarter-on-quarter growth similar to recent quarters (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin jumped to 16.29% (from 5.87%) on mix and efficiency, but management still guides 10–12% sustainable; utilisation 64% in FY26 while a 3,550 MTPA expansion is announced, with cost pass-through of raw materials.

name: Varun Beverages Ltd
thesis: Volume up 19.8% and India up 14.4% in H1-quarter, but management gave no capacity-discipline signal; margin cushioned by early raw-material stocking and a Twizza mix drag of 76 bps.

name: Mahindra Logistics Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT of INR 25.4 cr (INR 21.4 cr ex tax-refund interest) on 23% revenue growth; contract logistics gross margin diluted 46 bps on start-up and manpower costs, with management guiding Express EBITDA breakeven this year.
top: Contract logistics GM down 46 bps YoY

name: Synergy Green Industries Ltd
gLine: Capacity utilisation of new 45,000 t: 80% for FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 utilisation of new 45,000 t capacity at 66% and PBDIT margin 7%, with FY27 guidance of 500 cr revenue (33% growth) and +300 bp margin resting on a sharp Q2-H2 ramp.

name: AAVAS Financiers Ltd
gLine: Disbursement growth: 22-23% (FY27)
thesis: Q1FY27 disbursements +41% Y-o-Y and NIM up 22 bps to 7.70%, but management now expects spread to fall below 5% for the year on PLR cuts and a home-loan push; no capacity or supply signal in a lender.

name: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd
gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR 20,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 9.62% YoY to INR 4,300 crore and EBITDA margin 3.99% vs 2.08%, but order inflow of INR 5,417 crore is thin against a INR 93,492 crore book and management guides ~15% revenue growth with no capacity or capex signal.

name: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Ltd
gLine: Business disbursements FY27: INR6,000-6,500 crores
thesis: Q1 FY27 microfinance recovery: AUM up 11% QoQ to INR4,887 crores, annualised credit cost 2.1% vs 3.2%, NIM 12.5% vs 9.9%, PAT INR12 crores vs INR5 crores; no capacity or supply signal in the call.

name: 360 ONE WAM LTD
gLine: Cost-to-income ratio: 49-49.5% in Q4; ~100-150 bps improvement for FY27 (Q4 FY27 / FY27)
thesis: Wealth flows strong at Rs 13,379 cr and CTI guided to 49-49.5% in Q4, but asset management net flows negative on one institutional outflow and retention down to 74 bps from 78.
top: Wealth flows Rs 13,379 cr vs Rs 6,957 cr

name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: FY27 ROA: 1.8% to 2% (FY27)
thesis: Ujjivan SFB Q1 FY27: PAT Rs317 cr, ROA 2.2%, ROE 18.2%; FY27 ROA guidance raised to 1.8-2% and credit cost trimmed to 0.9-1%, but opex deferral and rising ticket-size and pricing pressure make the lift partly timing.

name: Windlas Biotech Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR248 crores (+18% YoY) with CDMO +29% to INR207 crores, but Trade Generics fell to INR30 crores after codeine exit and management gave no numeric guidance; Plant 6 due end-H1 with ~INR1,100 crores revenue capacity claimed.
top: Trade Generics INR30 crores after codeine exit

name: Tarsons Products Ltd
gLine: Panchla/Amta contribution to standalone revenue FY28: 20-25% of standalone revenue (FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +21% YoY to Rs 86 cr standalone with gross margin down to 67.1% on 25-50% input cost spikes; capacity still commissioning with debt at Rs 380 cr gross and no major capex planned.

name: Vedant Fashions Ltd
gLine: Full-year SSG: high single-digit SSG for balance 9 months (analyst framing, management said 'fair understanding')
thesis: Q1 FY27 SSG +3.8% with EBITDA margin 44.6% and store closures accelerated, but management sees competitor store exits in 8 states and guides to a stronger H2 with net positive year; no numeric guidance given.

name: Harsha Engineers International Ltd
gLine: Advantek revenue: Rs 140 cr plus (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated engineering supply Rs 421 cr (+21% YoY) with EBITDA Rs 69.8 cr, down from Rs 77 cr QoQ on a raw-material pass-through lag; capacity expansion at Bhayla and China continues.
top: Raw material up ~8% YoY, pass-through lagged

name: Landmark Cars Ltd
gLine: Normalised EBITDA margin on new car sales: 1.5% (analyst framing, not confirmed by management) (Q2-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Auto retailer with a strong Q1 (revenue up 22%+, PAT nearly doubled) but no capacity discipline or numeric guidance; growth is volume-led, with a gross-margin definition shift and EV aftersales claims that management did not quantify.

name: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 small finance bank with 22% advances growth, NIM up to 4.21% and PAT up 29%, but no supply-side levers; growth is loan-led and profitability gains rely on deposit repricing that management says is largely done.

name: Arkade Developers Ltd
gLine: FY27 new launches GDV: ~INR 3,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer with pre-sales up 9% YoY to Rs 155 cr and FY27 launches of ~Rs 3,000 cr; no capacity/supply metrics, and margins guided to fall to 25-26% EBITDA from ~19%.

name: Manba Finance Ltd
gLine: AUM growth FY27: 35% to 40% (FY27)
thesis: Two-wheeler NBFC grows AUM 22% YoY to INR1,731 cr with disbursements +37%, but QoQ AUM rose only ~1%, GNPA 3.41%, and management guides 35-40% AUM growth plus a planned INR100 cr preference-share raise.
top: CAR fell from ~29.8% to 24.4%; INR100 cr pref raise

name: All Time Plastics Ltd
gLine: Capacity utilisation FY27: approximately 75% on 41,000 metric tons (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up 25% QoQ to 6,323 t with utilisation 65% vs 52%, but gross margin fell to 39.5% from 41.9% on polymer cost spike; FY27 utilisation target 75% on 41,000 t.

name: Sugs Lloyd Ltd
gLine: Peak FY27 borrowing: around INR130 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 32% to INR78.4 cr with 15.3% EBITDA margin, but receivables of INR149 cr and borrowings rising from INR68 cr to INR91 cr make working capital the swing factor against the INR1,000 cr FY28 target.

name: Tenneco Clean Air India Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: INR350-450 crore (indicative) (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 VAR up 18.4% to INR13,816m but EBITDA margin fell to 17.9% on non-indexed commodity inflation; capacity tight (ART above 90%, CAPT above 80%) with capex INR350-450 crore indicative.

name: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Ltd
gLine: Hub breakeven: within 3 months (per hub)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 9.1% to ₹19.4 cr while EBITDA margin fell to 12.5% from 29%; management reiterates 30% FY27 growth and a 10-hub build-out, with no volume or pricing split given.

name: OnEMI Technology Solutions Ltd
gLine: Cost of borrowing: minimum 100 bps reduction over next three quarters (next 3 quarters)
thesis: Kissht AUM up 61% YoY to INR 8,001 cr with credit cost cut to 6.80% from 8.85%, but revenue margin fell 249 bps and management leans on unverified 40% ROA-style delivery and falling cost of funds.

name: Xtranet Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR 500+ crore, ~35-40% growth
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (EBITDA 20.59%, +855bp) came from services mix shift, not volume; revenue up only 11% with order book ~INR 373 cr and FY27 target of INR 500+ cr (35-40% growth).

name: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 recovery-led quarter: recoveries up 151% to INR1,066 crores, but acquisitions fell to INR353 crores and standalone PAT of INR143 crores was flattered by INR120 crores of write-backs; no numeric guidance given.
top: Acquisitions INR353 crores, down ~INR150 crores YoY

name: Cipla Ltd
thesis: Cipla Q1 FY27 revenue INR7,119 cr (+2% reported, ~4% adjusted for presentation change); EBITDA margin 16.7% vs FY27 guide 18.5–20% held, with US exit-rate $1bn dependent on new launches.

name: India Glycols Ltd
gLine: IGL Spirits EBITDA FY27: >INR500 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated net revenue up 9% to INR1,130 crore and EBITDA up 13% to INR170 crore, but a Clariant-dividend-free quarter, a demerger-driven restructuring, and unquantified aspirations make supply-side evidence thin.

name: Whirlpool of India Ltd
thesis: Record Q1 revenue of INR 2,582 crore (+26%) with standalone EBITDA margin squeezed to 4.6% by war-led oil and forex costs and e-waste accruals; management gave no numeric guidance.

name: Century Enka Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: over Rs 100 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 15.5% flattered by Rs 46.24 cr one-time inventory gain; management reiterates 7-10% normalised margin, capacity flat until FY28, utilisation 85-90%.
top: Inventory gain Rs 46.24 cr flatters quarter

name: Ambuja Cements Ltd
gLine: Trade sales share: upwards of 75% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 cost per tonne fell INR206 to INR4,241 and FY27 cost guidance of INR4,250 held, but volumes fell 7% y/y with capacity utilisation near 65% as management chose price over volume.

name: EIH Ltd
thesis: Hotel supply additions are slow; Q1 RevPAR rose ~13% and EBITDA margin fell to ~29% on Rajgarh ramp-up, renovations and marketing, while Kolkata and Grand timelines slipped.

name: Arihant Superstructures Ltd
gLine: Deliveries FY27: 2,500 units by end of FY27
thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 15% YoY to INR 173 crore on flat INR 7,500/sq ft pricing, while blended margin fell to ~9% and management guides only modest growth with no new land buys.

name: TANFAC Industries Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: at least 30% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 6% to INR187 cr with EBITDA margin 15.3% squeezed by sulphur and power costs; HFC-32 (20 kt) commissioning targeted Q3 FY27 with 65% of capacity contracted, but no supply-side discipline evidence beyond a planned INR1,500-1,700 cr capex runway.

name: Elgi Equipments Ltd
gLine: Tariff/price recovery: Price correction to flow towards end of Q2 and fully in Q3
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~23% (7pts FX) and EBITDA up 28%, with growth mostly volume-led; raw material up 5-6% vs 3-4% assumed, with price correction only from late Q2 and fully in Q3.

name: Blue Dart Express Ltd
thesis: Blue Dart's Q1 FY27 growth was mostly yield-led: tonnage up ~7% and shipments ~2%, with management citing GPI and loss-lane price corrections, while air volume grew only ~2.6% and no capacity guidance was given.

name: Apar Industries Ltd
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 profit on oil-division inventory gains (INR94 cr provision still left INR329 cr EBITDA), while conductor volumes fell 6.7% on customers deferring clearances; supply discipline and guidance not discussed.

name: Indian Overseas Bank
gLine: Credit cost: 0.35% to 0.40% full year (FY27)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 profit of INR 1,659 crore (+49% YoY) helped by PSLC and recoveries; GNPA 1.33% and NIM 3.37%, but corporate book fell 10% QoQ after pricing exit.
top: Yield on advances up ~10 bps QoQ

name: Godrej Consumer Products Ltd
gLine: Full-year revenue growth: exceed guidance significantly
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated volume +9% and revenue +19%, but India gross margin fell ~450 bps on LPG/kerosene/LABSA cost spikes; management says India normative margins return by H2 and guidance is held or exceeded.

name: Radico Khaitan Ltd
gLine: P&A volume growth FY27: over 25% (FY27)
thesis: Radico posted record Q1 FY27 volume of 10 million cases and 20.7% EBITDA margin, with P&A volume up 36% and FY27 P&A guidance raised to 25%+, but no capacity addition is planned and the ENA supply position is comfortable.

name: Indoco Remedies Ltd
gLine: Standalone EBITDA margin: double-digit for the year (aiming)
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA margin rebounded to 10.3% from 3.8% on 26% fewer batches and headcount cuts, but COGS up ~2pp from war-driven input inflation, US sterile plant still unaudited, and Europe/emerging primaries slipped.

name: Sasken Technologies Ltd
gLine: Borqs break-even: about 12 million quarterly revenue
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹339 Cr up 24% YoY with software services margin up 240 bp to 30.6%, but Product Solutions margin fell to 5.9% and operating cash flow stayed negative; no supply-side signal.

name: Central Bank of India
gLine: Cost-to-income: reduce by 1.5% to 1.6%; target below 56% (next year)
thesis: Bank-level growth is strong (advances +28.6% YoY on a low base, NIM 3.06%, GNPA 2.60%), but quarter-on-quarter advance growth was only 2.85% and no bank-industry supply discipline is evidenced; the read is demand and underwriting, not supply.

name: Renaissance Global Ltd
gLine: Working capital release: approx INR250 crores in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +30% to INR690 cr and PAT up ~280%, but management is deliberately exiting INR300-400 cr of low-return customer-brand revenue to cut working capital by INR250 cr; growth guided lower.
top: Revenue run rate to fall INR400 cr

name: JSW Energy Ltd
gLine: Net debt / EBITDA: below 5x by 2030 (FY30)
thesis: JSW Energy added 873 MW organic-plus-acquired capacity in Q1 (about 1.1 GW YTD) toward a 3 GW FY27 target, with net debt/TTM EBITDA at 4.95x, but hydro generation fell about 26% YoY and PAT declined.

name: GPT Infraprojects Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 14% to 15% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue fell 9% to INR282 crores on West Bengal election labour disruption; management held FY27 30% growth and 14–15% margin guidance, which needs ~INR1,400 crores in the next nine months.

name: Skipper Ltd
gLine: FY27 order inflow: INR7,000 crores plus (FY27)
thesis: Skipper Q1 FY27 revenue +4.5% to INR1,310 cr with exports weak and 75,000 t capacity slipping to H2; reiterates 15% FY27 growth and INR7,000 cr order inflow, which needs a sharp H2 ramp.

name: PNC Infratech Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 34% to Rs1,518 cr with 24.7% EBITDA margin, but NHAI show-cause notice on Lucknow-Kanpur toll road, weak highway awards (107 km) and 110 NWC days temper the read.
top: NHAI show-cause notice on toll road

name: Gujarat Energy Ltd
gLine: Morbi minimum volume: 1.8-2 mmscmd floor (next quarters)
thesis: Q1 FY27 gas-trading EBT of INR726 crores on Brent-linked contracts and Morbi volume surge; management holds INR1,100 crore FY27 trading guidance, which looks conservative against the quarter.

name: Prime Fresh Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 7% to 7.5% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 15.7% to INR81.71 crores and EBITDA margin 9.83%, but management itself flagged one-offs, guides EBITDA 7-7.5%, and receivables are about a third of sales with INR7-8 crore slow-moving debtors.

name: SBI Life Insurance Company Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 VoNB up 29% to INR14.1bn but margin fell to 26.2% on a one-off GTI group contract (about 60bps drag per management); IRP growth 14% and management reiterated 26–28% margin guidance.

name: HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 APE +9%, VNB +9% to INR 879 cr at 25% margin; growth prioritised over margin, guidance held (industry-in-line growth, VNB ~ APE growth) with HDFC Bank channel share recovering but channel still subdued.
top: Competitive intensity in bank channel mellowed

name: Galaxy Surfactants Ltd
gLine: Full-year EBITDA per MT: INR 24,000 to INR 25,000 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA hit INR 252.5 cr, EBITDA/MT INR 35,458, but management guides the rest of the year to INR 21-22k/MT, implying a sharp normalisation; volume guidance held at 6-8%.

name: Orient Electric Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 23.5% with EBITDA margin 7% (+102bp YoY) despite gross margin falling to 29.8%; management refused a gross margin guide beyond the 32-34% aspiration amid commodity inflation.

name: Indostar Capital Finance Ltd
thesis: Vehicle-finance NBFC with disbursements up 44% YoY to INR1,235 crore and PPOP flat at INR93 crore, but PAT of INR11 crore rests on the old book running off over 2-3 quarters rather than on current-book evidence.

name: MSTC Ltd
gLine: TReDS platform operationalisation: Within FY27, subject to RBI approval (FY27)
thesis: MSTC's Q1 FY27 e-commerce revenue rose to Rs 89.49 crore (vs Rs 70.03 crore), but no supply-side capacity signal exists; the asset-light auction platform's growth relies on scrap cycles and unapproved new verticals (EPR, TReDS) awaiting regulatory go-aheads.
top: E-commerce revenue Rs 89.49 cr vs Rs 70.03 cr

name: Rolex Rings Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 21% to 22% (conservative) (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 4.3% to INR304 cr on labour-constrained output (utilisation 63-65%), with export auto components up ~30% and FY27 guided to mid-teens growth, EBITDA margin 22.6%.

name: Devyani International Ltd
gLine: KFC SSSG (medium term): 5% to 6% (medium term)
thesis: QSR franchisee Devyani posted record Q1 FY27 EBITDA of INR 255 crore (16.1% of revenue on its KFC/own-brand basis per call), with KFC SSSG +3.3% but Pizza Hut still shrinking (-2.2%) and no capex or capacity signal; supply-side read is neutral with store additions modest at 11 net KFC.

name: Chemplast Sanmar Ltd
gLine: PVC-VCM spread: EBITDA neutral at $120-130; PBT positive another $20-30
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA loss of INR115 crores on high-cost VCM; management sees PVC-VCM spread near $160 from September but gave no numeric profitability guidance, with CMCD order book and R32 ramp as offsets.

name: Medplus Health Services Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~22% but EBITDA margin fell to 3.5% on private-label mix, provisions and labour cost; capex put on hold while store additions held at 800 net.

name: Data Patterns (India) Ltd
gLine: Fresh order inflows FY27 over and above negotiated: around INR2,000 crores (FY27)

top: Order book INR920 cr vs negotiated INR1,726 cr unconverted

name: Ddev Plastiks Industries Ltd
gLine: BESS EBITDA margin (supply phase): 6% to 8% (initial phase)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA crossed INR100 crores at 10% margin on war-driven export price premium; utilisation fell to about 66% as 48,000 t Bhiwadi XLPE capacity ramps slowly, with FY27 volume growth guided at 15%.

name: Bikaji Foods International Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens to ~16%+ growth, delivered quarter-on-quarter
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue grew ~12.5% on 7.7% volume, but a 3-4 day plant/dispatch outage and labour exodus hit April-May, EBITDA margin ~13.5%, and management guides FY27 margin 13-13.5% with no new price hikes until Diwali.

name: KFin Technologies Ltd
industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
gLine: EBITDA growth FY27: 17% to 20% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 30% YoY (ex-Ascent ~10%) but EBITDA margin fell to 34.2% with Ascent (39.4% ex-Ascent); yield down ~2% QoQ on debt-to-liquid shift and a provisioned renegotiation.

name: Netweb Technologies India Ltd
gLine: Order execution cycle: 16 to 20 weeks
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR8,197m (+172% YoY) and PAT margin 10.3%, but inventory days jumped 86→110 and management declined to guide new capex, with a possible enabling resolution for working-capital equity or debt.

name: SBFC Finance Ltd
gLine: Branch additions: 10-15 branches in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: SBFC held spreads at 9.48% (+39 bps QoQ) and ROE at 14.73%, but AUM growth slowed to 6% QoQ, 0+ DPD rose 70 bps, and management is cautious on sub-10 lakh borrower leverage.

name: Cello World Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 527 cr with 22.2% EBITDA margin on price hikes of 12-13%, but volumes fell in Consumer Ware, steel SKUs cut from ~150 to ~20, glassware utilisation stuck at ~60%, and no FY27 guidance given.

name: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Ltd
gLine: Hotel keys by end FY27: 3,149 keys (12 hotels, 472 keys pipeline) (FY27)
thesis: Hotel operator with 92% occupancy and 8% revenue growth, but PAT fell 14% on finance costs and tax regime; supply is expanding via owned capex (~Rs 1,140 cr) while ADR growth is only 2% and pressure from West Asia disruption.

name: Raymond Lifestyle Ltd
gLine: Garmenting EBITDA margin: no firm guidance; double-digit is an endeavour
thesis: Garmenting grew 50% to INR296 crore with EBITDA margin 7.3% and plants full till December, but branded apparel grew only 4% and EBO network shrank 34 net stores; no capacity added, store cuts ongoing.

name: Sagility Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 organic growth 14.9% cc with low double-digit FY27 guidance held, but margin guidance 24-25% held despite 120bps minimum-wage hit; no supply-side capacity data, so read is demand-led with cost pressure.

name: Vikran Engineering Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue from operations: INR2,300–2,500 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 standalone revenue INR204 cr (+28%) with consolidated revenue only INR141.6 cr after NOPL consolidation; H2-weighted FY27 guide of INR2,300–2,500 cr and receivables (debtor days ~296) remain the key unproven items.

name: VMS TMT Ltd
gLine: Sales growth: 10% to 15% annually (annual)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% y/y to INR247.88 cr but EBITDA fell about 41% on imported scrap cost and forex; TMT utilisation near 80%, with management guiding margin recovery only from Q3.
top: EBITDA down ~41% y/y on scrap costs

name: Glottis Ltd
gLine: Revenue FY27: Exceed FY25 revenue (FY27)
thesis: Glottis is a freight forwarder whose revenue rose 39.5% YoY to Rs 2,345m while TEUs fell to 21,841 from 26,278, so growth is price/mix-led, with EBITDA margin 6.9% and no capacity-discipline evidence beyond its own fleet build.

name: Shiprocket Ltd
thesis: Asset-light shipping and D2C enabler: core transactions +31% with core EBITDA margin 12.8% (+50bps YoY) and emerging EBITDA improving to -24% from -38%, but no capex or supply lever to read.

name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
thesis: Bajaj Finance Q1 FY27 was strong: record ₹37,000 cr AUM addition, ROE 20.4%, and loan loss to AUF 1.54% (1.31% ex ₹296 cr overlay), but management held guidance and no capital raise is planned.
top: Record ₹37,000 cr AUM added in quarter

name: Kansai Nerolac Paints Ltd
gLine: Q2 deco price increase: additional ~3% (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 paints call: pricing ~5% consolidated with industrial price hikes still under negotiation, deco volumes low single digit by choice; FY27 margin 13-14% guided to be held, capex INR601 crore over ~2 years with ROCE target ~18%.

name: Thermax Ltd
gLine: Chemicals growth: at least 20%
thesis: Q1 FY27 was a bad quarter: INR 91 crore cost-to-complete hit on a legacy PSU project, ~INR 300 crore shipments slipped to Q2/Q3, revenue up only 7%; management reiterates FY27 as a good year with an INR 14,000 crore backlog.

name: Ashok Leyland Ltd
gLine: Capex: rising over next 2-3 years; INR900-1,000 cr in last 2 years (2-3 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 record revenue of INR9,634 cr (+10% YoY) but EBITDA flat at INR970 cr and margin down 100bp to 10.1%; inventory buffer masked commodity hit, Q2 guided as peak cost quarter.
top: Commodity cost hit ~50% offset by price

name: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Sustainable growth in general medicines and vaccines: 8% to 10% (medium term)
thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 15% to INR924 cr (about 9-10% underlying ex-CMO base), PAT up 24% (17% ex one-off), volume +3-3.5%, price ~6%; opex spike to be front-loaded and moderate.
top: Innovation sales 7% of revenue vs 4% last year

name: Talbros Automotive Components Ltd
gLine: Exports share FY28: 35%
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue of INR242 crore (+15% YoY) and EBITDA margin 17.6%, but supply-side evidence is thin: no capacity-discipline signal, margin pressure from steel/aluminium and wages, and forging guidance cut from ~INR400 crore to ~INR340 crore.
top: Forging FY27 revenue cut to ~INR340 crore

name: IFB Industries Ltd
gLine: Engineering capex: INR110 crore for full year (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16.65% to INR 1,529 crore with PBDIT margin 5.79%, but management could not pass through commodity or forex costs, and gross margin fell about 160 bps.
top: Commodity and forex not passed on

name: Tilaknagar Industries Ltd-$
gLine: Mid-teens annual volume growth: mid-teens over next couple of years
thesis: Tilaknagar's Q1 FY27 volumes and NSR rose, but EBITDA margin fell to 14.5% adjusted on glass inflation, with net debt rising to Rs 2,100 crore and a March 2027 target of Rs 1,700 crore.

name: Nava Ltd
gLine: 100MW solar commissioning: by end of September 2026
thesis: Q1 FY27 record consolidated income of INR1,269 crores led by Zambia power (MEL 89.3% PLF), but Phase 2 thermal slipped to Q2 FY28 and metals sales dipped on Orissa shutdown.
top: Phase 2 commissioning slips to Q2 FY28

name: Onward Technologies Ltd
gLine: Time and material mix: 80% to 90% T&M for FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue hit a record INR 151.2 crore (+11.5% YoY, +8.7% QoQ) and EBITDA margin rose 113bp QoQ to 12.3%, but there is no capacity or utilisation disclosure and management reiterated only double-digit growth.
top: Order book/ACV exceeds last year's revenue

name: JM Financial Ltd-$
thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ex-provisions after minority was flat at INR302 crores; Private Markets revenue doubled to INR462 crores on lumpy ARC resolutions while Capital Markets revenue fell to INR115 crores from INR182 crores.

name: Hikal Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 14% to 16% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 403 cr, EBITDA margin 9.2%, Pharma EBIT margin 3.2% at ~55-60% utilisation; crop volumes recovering but China pricing pressure persists and FY27 guide of 14-16% growth and 25-30% EBITDA growth is back-half weighted.
top: Crop pricing under pressure from China

name: Seamec Ltd
gLine: ANANT acquisition and deployment: Acquisition by end of Q1; deployment in Q3 (ONGC contract) (Q2-Q3 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 41% to INR 297 cr consolidated with ~42% EBITDA margin, but growth rests on Seamec ANANT acquisition (USD 70m, 50-50 equity/debt) and redeployment, with no fleet-addition capacity discipline or utilisation figure disclosed.
top: Fleet growth via USD 70m vessel buy

name: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: good double-digit (~10-11%) (FY27)
thesis: Q1FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 6.8% from 10.9% on ~20% RM spike; management guides 10-11% FY27 margins and 8-9% further price hikes, but supply-side discipline is absent given Rs.4,980 crore expansion and Rs.500-700 crore debt rise.

name: Shilpa Medicare Ltd
gLine: Tax rate: Normalise around 25%
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR469 cr (+43% YoY) and 30% EBITDA margin, but management gave no numeric guidance, gross margin dipped on raw material costs, and capex is being held back in Biologics and Albumin for three years.

name: Zydus Wellness Ltd-$
gLine: Effective tax rate FY27: about 25% including deferred; cash 12-15% of 25% this year
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated sales INR 14,299m (+66.7% with Comfort Click consolidation); domestic grew only 4.6% as seasonal brands fell 12% and Nycil was hit by rain, with no supply-side or capacity signals discussed.

name: ICICI Bank Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 PBT ex-treasury up 20.9% to ₹18,975 crore with NIM 4.36% and net NPA 0.35%, but management gave no loan or deposit targets and FCNR(B) leverage remains undisclosed.

name: Jindal Steel Ltd
gLine: Net debt to EBITDA: below 1.5x (Q2FY27)
thesis: Q1FY27 consolidated adj. EBITDA INR 2,667 cr (INR 11,937/t, +INR 1,843/t QoQ) on 15% lower volumes; ASP up INR 7,500/t and value-added share 61%→66%, but Q2 long-product prices falling and FY27 volume guide held at 10.5–11 Mt.
top: NSR up INR 7,000/t flats, INR 4,500/t longs QoQ

name: Tech Mahindra Ltd
gLine: Q4 operating margin: upwards of 15% (Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +6.6% cc YoY with margin at 14.4% and FY27 target of 15%; but Q1 was flattered by a one-time European auto pull-forward (~1–1.3% hit next quarter) and no capacity signal, so it is a demand-and-execution read rather than supply-side tightening.

name: Vodafone Idea Ltd
gLine: Site rollout pace: ~3,500 4G towers a month (next 2 quarters)
thesis: Q1 FY27 shows ARPU up 10.2% to Rs 195 and first positive net adds since merger, but capex fell to Rs 1,930 Cr against a Rs 45,000 Cr three-year plan, with supply-chain headwinds cited.
top: Q1 capex Rs 1,930 Cr vs Rs 45,000 Cr plan

name: Refex Industries Ltd
gLine: Wind execution FY27: Rs1,700-1,800 cr (FY27)

top: Wind order book Rs1,860 cr, Rs525 cr executed

name: eClerx Services Ltd
industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
gLine: CLX revenue growth: 0% to 2% full year (FY27)

top: BFSI flat QoQ, still shrinking YoY

name: Bajaj Finserv Ltd

name: Punjab & Sind Bank

name: TD Power Systems Ltd

name: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd
gLine: Full-year FY27 growth: strong momentum expected, no numbers
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 88% YoY to INR702 crores with 72% EBITDA margin, but management conceded a sequential normalisation from exceptional Q4 and bullion premium ratio fell from 1.03% to 0.35%.

name: Orient Cement Ltd

name: Snowman Logistics Ltd
gLine: Ankleshwar EXIM start: by end of September (Q2 FY27)

name: Aurum PropTech Ltd
gLine: Housing.com breakeven timeline: 4-6 quarters (internal target 3-4) (4-6 quarters)
thesis: Aurum PropTech reports third straight profitable quarter (PBT 2.1% of revenue) but is absorbing Housing.com, which burns about INR 200 crore annualised, with breakeven pushed to 4-6 quarters; no capacity cycle signals, so this is a turnaround and M&A story rather than a supply-side read.

name: Fredun Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Revenue FY27: ~INR800 crores ("somewhere around") (FY27)
thesis: Consumer-pharma growth story with no capacity-discipline or pricing evidence; Q1 FY27 revenue up ~90% on pre-booked orders, FY27 target ~INR800 crores, management guidance is qualitative and promotional.

name: LTM Ltd
gLine: Randstad deal closure: end Q2 or beginning Q3

top: New deals priced ~15% lower for same scope

name: L&T Technology Services Ltd

name: TCI Express Ltd

name: PSP Projects Ltd
thesis: Q1FY27 revenue up 65% to INR853 cr with EBITDA margin 6.42%; order book INR13,245 cr (up 103%) but ~70% within-group Adani, and management guides FY27 revenue INR4,400-4,500 cr with 7-8% margin only in H2.
top: FY27 revenue held at INR4,400-4,500 cr

name: Arvind Fashions Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin expansion: 30-40 bps (FY27 balance)

name: Max India Ltd
thesis: Max India's senior-living story is execution-led, not capital-cycle led: consol revenue Rs68.6 cr (+66% YoY) but EBITDA loss Rs25 cr, with AGEasy breakeven guided only by Q4 FY27.
top: Credit lines used for working capital

name: Laxmi Organic Industries Ltd
gLine: Dahej Phase 2 capitalisation: 85% of Phase 2 capex capitalised in Q2 (Q2 FY27)

name: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd
gLine: Margin recovery: Recovery measures more visible from Q2
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹12,310 crore (+54% YoY) and BEV revenue +107%, but EBITDA margin fell to 23.1% on input inflation and pass-through lag; capex and capacity not discussed.

name: Dodla Dairy Ltd

name: Go Fashion (India) Ltd

top: Fabric cost up 7–10%, no price hike

name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Ltd
gLine: Insurance revenue growth: 15-16% through the year, rising in FY28
thesis: Star Health Q1 FY27 shows underwriting profit Rs 111 crore (vs Rs 16 crore) and CISR 97%, but management gave no loss-ratio guidance and the story rests on retail pricing and claims levers rather than any supply-side signal.
top: Underwriting result Rs 111 cr vs Rs 16 cr

name: Supriya Lifescience Ltd

name: Prudent Corporate Advisory Services Ltd

name: Venus Pipes & Tubes Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: <17% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR320.5 cr but EBITDA margin flat at 16.1%; management guides sub-17% FY27 margin and 18% in two years, with welded utilisation only ~60% and seamless ~85-90%.

name: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Ltd
gLine: Paramount claims migration: balance claims and operations on Medi Assist stack within Q2 FY27 (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin 20.3% (up from 17.1% in Q2) with revenue up 24.1% and retention at 90.2%, but no capacity or capex angle; margin recovery to ~23% is pushed to end-FY27.

name: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Net debt by end Q2 FY27: close to INR 1,450 crore
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +22.8% to INR 2,580 cr with international +34.2% carrying growth; India only +10.2% and management guides India acceleration without capacity or supply-side signals.

name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Ltd
thesis: Niva Bupa's combined ratio improved to 100.2% from 103.2% on a 3.8pt loss-ratio drop, but group book is flat and management admits B2B pricing is claims-minus; FY29 mid-to-high-teens ROE reiterated.

name: Kalpataru Ltd
gLine: FY27 pre-sales: Rs 6,500 crore (~23% growth over FY26) (FY27)
thesis: Real estate developer with pre-sales up 6% to Rs 1,329 cr, but realisations fell on mix, net debt flat at Rs 8,229 cr (2.0x) and profits deferred to H2 FY27 under completion accounting.

name: Patel Retail Ltd
gLine: New stores FY27: 8 to 10 stores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to about 6.3% from prior levels on raw-material mix, with capacity utilisation only 50–55% and a 24-month store payback; supply discipline is not evidenced.

name: Dev Accelerator Ltd
gLine: Signed pipeline conversion: 2.31m sq ft signed for future consumption; 8,500 seats at Ahmedabad DM project (FY27)
thesis: Flex-workspace operator adding capacity: 1.13m sq ft operational, 91.93% occupancy, but Q1 consolidated revenue INR 53.8 cr with leverage flattered by excluding ~INR 226 cr lease liabilities, and supply is debt-funded expansion.

name: Urban Company Ltd
thesis: Urban Company Q1 FY27 NTV up 42% to ₹1,465 crore with Services NTV growth accelerating to 29%, but InstaHelp loss of ₹(132) crore keeps consolidated profitability and the breakeven target in focus.

name: Tata Motors Ltd
gLine: Q2 FY27 domestic CV volume: Double-digit YoY growth (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Standalone volumes up 26% to 108.7k with EBIT margin only 20bps lower at 9.4%, as 140bps price and 180bps operating leverage absorbed a 340bps commodity hit; Q2 guided to double-digit growth.

name: Dabur India Ltd
gLine: Acquisition target: 1 or 2 sizable companies in 3 years (3 years)
thesis: Dabur Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue +10.6% with India volume +5% and price-led hair oil growth; management says volumes will be under pressure from inflation and outcome hinges on the Middle East war.

name: John Cockerill India Ltd-$
gLine: Operating expenses (other expenses): slightly less than current quarter's ~INR70 crore
thesis: Standalone revenue ~INR149 crore (+82% YoY) but down sequentially; order book ~INR4,500 crore consolidated after ~INR1,200 crore wins, with margins hit by early-stage project costs.

name: RSWM Ltd
gLine: Power & fuel savings FY27: ~₹40 Cr from efforts; ~₹100 Cr target (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA rose 10% QoQ to ₹94 Cr (8.0% margin) on gross margin expansion to 39.8%, with utilisation in the mid-90s for yarn but fabric demand and margins weak and export volumes down.

name: Voltas Ltd

name: Tata Consumer Products Ltd
thesis: Consolidated revenue +12% to INR5,349 crores with EBITDA margin 13.6% (+70 bps), but India tea volumes +2% amid 7-10% tea cost inflation and India margins contracting on timing mismatch; growth portfolio +36% and FY27 margin guidance of 50-70 bps reiterated.

name: Siyaram Silk Mills Ltd-$
gLine: Retail revenue (ZECODE+DEVO): INR160 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 total income up 16.4% to INR466 crore and PAT up 144% to INR11 crore, but retail build-out (ZECODE/DEVO) drags FY27 EBITDA ~150 bps, with no capacity or utilisation data disclosed.
top: Inventory build ahead of festive season

name: Berger Paints India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 value growth 12.7% on volume ~8.4%, with decorative price rises (~5% so far, 7.5–8.5% guided for Q2) sticking, but industrial price pass-through lagged and gross margin slipped to 39.3%.
top: Dealer stocking ahead of price hikes

name: Bhagyanagar India Ltd
gLine: Average realisation FY27: above Rs 1,300/kg, ~30% higher YoY (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 5.43% and PAT margin 2.87% on 5,278 t volume (down 9.5% QoQ) as April–May supply shortage lifted realisations; management guides 5–5.5% margin and 12–15% volume growth.
top: Capacity 35,000 t online; 45,000 t next year

name: Digispice Technologies Ltd-$
gLine: Merger of DiGiSPICE into Spice Money / listing: completed by end of FY27 (March 2027) (FY27)
thesis: Spice Money (DiGiSPICE) is an asset-light payments/banking-agent platform; AePS market share dipped to 17.93% in Q1 but recovered to 18.3% in July, with revenue flat and PAT Rs 6.6 crore. No supply-side capacity data; the read is mainly qualitative growth narrative.

name: CCL Products (India) Ltd

top: Utilisation 65-70%, no new capacity for 2-3 years

name: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd
gLine: Eugia FY27 revenue: around 500 million plus, single-digit growth (FY27)

name: Stylam Industries Ltd
thesis: Stylam's third laminate plant is delayed to a 15-20 Aug to 1 Sep commercial start, with management guiding only 25-30% first-year utilisation (~INR250-300 cr revenue) and domestic turnaround pushed to Q3.
top: Plant start slipped from Nov-25 to Sep-26

name: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Ltd-$

thesis: Q1 FY27 margin spike from cheap pre-bought paddy/rice inventory and a ~30% price rise; management guides EBITDA 8-12% oscillation and says revenue could reach INR 2,000 cr, with no capex discussed and volumes flat for three years.

name: South Indian Bank Ltd
gLine: Opex growth FY27: 5%-6%
thesis: Q1 FY27 profit up 17% to INR378 crore on NII up 23% to INR1,025 crore, driven by deposit repricing and lower bulk deposits; management says NIM tailwind fades and fee income is soft.
top: Cost of deposits fell on repricing

name: Canara Bank

name: Solar Industries India Ltd
gLine: Net debt to EBITDA: below 2x (FY28)
thesis: Debt-funded ~$1.35bn acquisition of Omnia Holdings; management guides FY28 combined EBITDA of INR6,800-7,000 crores and net debt/EBITDA below 2x, but no supply-side or pricing data was given.

name: DLF Ltd
gLine: Exit rentals FY27 (group, INR crore per month): 7,300-7,500
thesis: Muted pre-sales (INR 657 crore) on Aureva deferral and Dahlias slowdown, but rental run-rate ramp and INR 15,200 crore net cash support the story; supply signal is land buying (INR 545 crore over two quarters).

name: Brigade Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Commercial leasing CAGR: ~20% over 5-6 years (FY31)

name: Sharda Motor Industries Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 gross profit grew only 8% (revenue +34% on catalyst pass-through) versus 8–10% addressable market; no numeric guidance, growth pinned on existing orders and SOPs, with no capacity-discipline evidence beyond modular Chakan 3.

name: Emerald Finance Ltd
