top: Gold loan distribution Q4 375 → Q1 290 Cr

name: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Ltd
gLine: Park additions: about one park every year; 12 parks by 2030 (FY30)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +20% to INR178 cr and EBITDA +24% to INR90 cr, but ARPU flat near INR1,395 and management admits softer ticket pricing to buy footfall; supply additions (Indore, Mehsana, Hello Park) are growing capacity alongside.

name: InterGlobe Aviation Ltd
gLine: Q2 FY27 capacity growth: flattish YoY (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDAR margin fell to 15.6% from 28% and net loss of INR 2.4bn as fuel CASK rose ~80% YoY, though yield up 21% lets pricing offset part of cost; Q2 capacity guided flattish with PRASK up >25%.

name: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: Back to 20-21% from Q3
thesis: Q1 FY27 turnover up 40.5% to Rs 239.5 cr but EBITDA margin fell to about 20% (vs 23% expected) on LPG and raw-material cost spikes; order book Rs 2,329 cr, 66% defence, with capex mostly deferred pending ministry approval.
top: Raw-material adverse variance Rs 13 cr in Q1

name: Adani Total Gas Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up 13% to 303 MMSCM and revenue up 27% to INR1,908 cr, but margins are being squeezed by spot gas (about 15% of consumption) and falling APM allocation; management gave no numeric margin guidance.

name: Antony Waste Handling Cell Ltd
gLine: Labour cost % revenue: normalise to 30-31% in next 3 quarters
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA fell 27% YoY to ₹45 crore (16.8% margin vs 24.4%) on labour, transport and one-off disposal costs; WtE plant down until October, with ₹22-24 crore impairment flagged.

name: Eternal Ltd
gLine: Quick commerce long-term adjusted EBITDA margin: 6% (high end of prior 5-6%)
thesis: Blinkit quick-commerce competition described as peaking in Q1 with subsidies now predictable; management raised long-term QC EBITDA guidance to high end of range and sees no near-term margin pressure, but NAOV flat YoY and capex per store reset to INR 2.5 crore.
top: Capex per store reset to INR 2.5 crore

name: Tega Industries Ltd
gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin: around 15% for full year (FY27)
thesis: Tega's legacy consumables grew 36% with margin at 24.1%, but the group is now mostly Molycop, which contributes 75% of revenue on one month of consolidation; equipment fell 44% and the call gave no capacity or pricing discipline data.
top: Molycop consolidated; net debt down INR32.18bn

name: Campus Activewear Ltd
gLine: Volume growth FY27: high single digits (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 growth of 12.2% rests on pricing and channel-accounting shifts; management is building festive inventory at record production, with volume tapering and no capacity addition signalled beyond ramp-ups.

name: eMudhra Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: around 25%, PAT 16-16.5% (FY27)
thesis: eMudhra Q1 FY27 grew total income 28% to INR 1,925m with EBITDA margin 26.2%, but Trust token supply stalled on CCA ePass recertification, with ~INR 5-7 crore volume lost and Q2 top-line likely still soft.
top: ePass token recertification pending with CCA

name: Tracxn Technologies Ltd
gLine: Top-line growth FY27: 15–20%, likely towards the higher end (FY27)
thesis: Tracxn Q1 FY27 shows a demand-side re-acceleration story: revenue up 2.9% QoQ with international ARR up 4.4% QoQ, but margins still negative and no capacity or supply signals; the evidence is management narrative, not yet in reported numbers.

name: Archean Chemical Industries Ltd
gLine: Salt volume growth: double-digit YoY growth from Q3 (Q3 FY27 onwards)
thesis: Bromine volumes 4,175 t (below ~4,500 t run-rate) with realisations ~INR300/kg, but bromine spot prices falling 30-40% in China and salt volumes down 12% on logistics; Q1 margin recovery is partly offset by execution misses.

name: Ideaforge Technology Ltd
gLine: Order book execution: INR256.8 cr delivered by Q3 FY27 (Q3 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR68.6 cr (vs 12.8 cr) with EBITDA INR4.3 cr positive; order book INR256.8 cr to be executed by Q3, but no capacity additions and most FTP order inflows slipping to H2 or FY28.
top: Order book INR256.8 cr to execute by Q3

name: EMS Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs 900-950 crore (at par with FY25) (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue Rs 125.72 cr (+50% QoQ) on fixed-cost civil EPC; management guides FY27 revenue ~Rs 900-950 cr with Q4 strongest, but no capacity or capex signal and margins rely on a back-ended ramp.

name: Signatureglobal (India) Ltd
gLine: Land capex: Rs 15-18 billion for the year (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 pre-sales about Rs 20bn (20% of Rs 100bn FY target), collections only Rs 6.7bn, and new launches guided at Rs 150bn; supply pipeline expanding while cash conversion lags.

name: DOMS Industries Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin (guided range): about 16% to 17% (FY28 onward)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +19.2% to INR670 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 12.3% from 17.6% on ~400bp gross margin hit; management prioritises volume over price and sees no further hikes this quarter.

name: Brainbees Solutions Ltd
gLine: Gross margin recovery: fully recover crude/rupee pass-through by end of Q2
thesis: India multi-channel revenue grew 17.7% but gross margin fell 280 bps in Q4 and recovered only 20 bps in Q1, with diapering price competition and crude-linked pass-through driving the squeeze; consolidated adj. EBITDA margin fell to 4.24% from 4.98%.
top: India gross margin down 280 bps in Q4

name: Orient Technologies Ltd
gLine: Annuity revenue share: 51% target in about three years (3 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin recovery to 7.57% EBITDA on revenue of Rs 201.92 cr (+9.7% QoQ), but management gave no numeric guidance, annuity mix only 23%, and call includes unverified figures and an evasive, promotional tone.

name: Bajaj Housing Finance Ltd
gLine: NIM change FY27 vs FY26: moderate 20-25 bps
thesis: Q1 FY27 AUM up 24% to ₹1.496 lakh cr with disbursements up 33%, but management guides NIM down 20-25 bps for FY27 on yield compression, not supply discipline; Q1 credit cost of 5 bps was flattered by an assignment and ECL recalibration.
top: NIM guided down 20-25 bps in FY27

name: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Ltd
gLine: Blended EBITDA margin: early-to-mid 30s, back from 26-27% pro forma (next couple of years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR893 cr (+12% cc) and 33% reported EBITDA (35% ex-acquisition costs), but TruBridge revenue reset to ~$300m from $340m with EBITDA held at ~$68m; no numeric TruBridge growth guidance.

name: Ventive Hospitality Ltd
gLine: Maldives margin recovery: Q3/Q4 to offset Q1-Q2 fuel hit (FY27)
thesis: Hospitality revenue up 9% to INR420 crores with India EBITDA up 16%; reported consolidated EBITDA fell about INR16 crores on Maldives diesel spike, with 1.2x net debt/EBITDA and no new capacity commitments beyond the pipeline.

name: Highway Infrastructure Ltd
gLine: FY27 turnover: INR 850 crore (INR 700 crore toll, rest EPC) (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA just INR 4.8 crore and PAT INR 1.1 crore on toll traffic hit; management guides FY27 turnover INR 850 crore with no supply-side or capex disclosure, so the read is weak and unverified.
top: Q1 EBITDA INR 4.8 crore, PAT INR 1.1 crore

name: SBI Funds Management Ltd
thesis: Asset manager Q1 FY27 operating revenue ₹1,149 cr (+15% YoY) and PAT ₹873 cr (+37% QoQ); management gave no numeric guidance, citing silent period, while margin gains came from asset mix rather than TER.

name: Gaja Alternative Asset Management Ltd
thesis: Asset manager with 100% fee and performance economics; Q1 FY27 PAT up 35% to INR27.2 crore, but performance income (INR29.7 crore) is lumpy and management declined to give forward guidance.

name: Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd
gLine: NPK tie-up volume: 8.5 lakh tons tied up with vendors
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA rose 12% to INR 851 crores on margin of ~17% despite revenue down 12%, but urea volumes fell on Gadepan shutdowns and a new 4th urea plant (~INR 10,000 crore) hinges on a government bid process due around October.

name: EPL Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: high teens for next few quarters (next few quarters)
thesis: Q1 FY27 reported revenue +25.3% (20% underlying ex pass-through) with EBITDA margin 18.8%; growth guidance raised to high teens but margin held at 20% underlying, while Europe margins contracted and working capital rose on inventory.
top: Capex stepped up ahead of growth

name: GHCL Ltd
gLine: Vacuum salt and bromine revenue at optimal utilisation: INR150-170 crore revenue, 40-45% EBITDA margin
thesis: Soda ash cycle still weak: management calls Q1 margin of 29.1% transient, guides to normalisation, and gives no greenfield timeline, with Chinese capacity cash-loss-making but no meaningful cut yet.

name: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Ltd
gLine: Kharsang gas pipeline: 24 km, completion by December next year (Dec 2027)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue rebounded to INR117.5 cr standalone on Kharsang volumes and $95.5/bbl realisation, but B-80 output is down on water cut, HPCL crude stuck and funding for the three-well B-80 programme depends on raising debt.

name: LMW Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 PBT up 151% YoY to ₹85 cr on flat sequential revenue, but machine tool and textile machinery volumes are soft, with textile utilisation around 60% and MTD capacity at 75–80%.

name: Lupin Ltd
gLine: US revenue FY27: USD 1.1-1.2 billion
thesis: Q1 FY27 record quarter (revenue INR 8,277 cr, +32%) but management guided US sales to USD 250-280m per quarter and FY EBITDA margin to 24-25%, signalling a sharp step-down from Tolvaptan and Mirabegron generic competition.

name: Patanjali Foods Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 29% to INR11,337 cr with EBITDA margin 4.80%, but growth is largely price-led (foods pricing ~12% vs volume ~5%), no capacity signal, and staples EBITDA negative at INR-59 cr.

name: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd
gLine: India PV volume growth FY27: higher double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Tata PV volumes up 46% to 182k with 14.3% share, but India EBITDA flat at ~4% as 4.5% commodity hit offsets gains; JLR PBT fell to GBP109m and Q2 commodity hit guided at 3%.
top: Commodity hit 4.5% in Q1, ~3% more in Q2

name: JSW Dulux Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 13% to 15% (FY27 onwards)
thesis: Paints demand strong with ~25% volume growth, but gross margin fell to 37.4% on high-cost inventory and gross-to-net reclass, with management guiding EBITDA margin 13-15% and no capacity discipline signals.

name: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd-$
gLine: IPP annual PLF / generation: better than FY26 (415 crore units)
thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹478 cr (+9.4% YoY) flattered by ₹110 cr one-off regulatory benefit; no FY27 guidance given, with management pointing to better July power prices (₹5/unit IEX vs ₹4.20) and hydro recovery.

name: Supreme Industries Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume fell ~14% to 1,57,536 t on polymer-driven channel destocking, yet management reiterated 12–13% FY27 volume growth and 14–14.5% EBITDA margin, with July described as "excellent growth".

name: Axis Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue and profit: growth 'very, very good' (qualitative)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 78% YoY to ₹48.98 cr with EBITDA margin 12.7%, but no capacity, utilisation or capex disclosure and management declined to give FY27 numbers, so supply-side read is thin.
top: Receivables ageing high, explained as year-end

name: Cera Sanitaryware Ltd
gLine: Brand-building spend FY27: INR 85 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +19.5% on volume, but EBITDA margin fell to 10.1% (vs 13.1%); management attributes ~4.35pts to one-offs and reiterates 13.5–14% FY27 margin and 18–20% growth, with sanitaryware utilisation at just 61%.

name: Kewal Kiran Clothing Ltd
gLine: Other income: around Rs. 30 crores annualised (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 279 cr (+19% YoY) and EBITDA Rs 52 cr (+29%, margin >19%) on 24% volume growth, but standalone slowing, no capacity signals, and cotton inflation flagged as a margin headwind.
top: Cotton inflation may hit GP margins

name: AvenuesAI Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: INR 11,000 to 13,000 crores (~35%+ growth) (FY27)
thesis: Payments-to-AI-fintech pivot: gross revenue up 109% but net revenue down 3% on take-rate compression, with EBITDA margin gains driven by expense cuts and FY27 EPS guided flat at INR 8.75–9.5 as incremental cash is reinvested into AI.
top: Take rates compressed; net revenue down 3%

name: Kwality Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: FY30 revenue: INR1500 crores (FY30)
thesis: Management guides FY27 sales above INR700 crores at 26-27% EBITDA margin, but the case rests on unfiled-to-approved registrations, a 208-day debtor cycle and hormone/biologics revenue not in guidance; supply-side evidence is thin.

name: ICICI Life Insurance Ltd
thesis: Life insurer VNB up 24.9% to ₹5.71bn with margin 26.7%, but growth is protection-led while non-par and agency lag; management gave no guidance and called margin 'not a fixation'.

name: Zim Laboratories Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth without EU-GMP: 10-15% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 3.7% on ₹942m revenue (+31% YoY) with a loss after tax; growth hinges on an EU-GMP final report still pending, with management guiding FY28 +30-35% only if EU approval lands.

name: Prince Pipes and Fittings Ltd
gLine: Debtor days: 30 days target (next couple of years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes fell 7% YoY to 40,729 MT with utilisation only 52-53%, but margin rose to 13% on mix; management says channel restocking resumed and capacity is ahead of demand.

name: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: Cost of funds rest of FY: around 7.5%
thesis: Microfinance credit cycle turning with slippages down to INR92 crores (from INR106 crores) and CGFMU claim of INR387 crores lifting coverage; PSL one-off (~INR46 crores) flatters Q1 ROA of 1.6%, which management guides lower for Q2-Q3.
top: Slippages INR106 cr → INR92 cr QoQ

name: Gateway Distriparks Ltd
gLine: Snowman pallet additions: around 24,000 pallets by end of year (FY27)
thesis: Gateway's ICD volumes are flat YoY on the West Asia war, with management still guiding double-digit growth and calling market share intact; rail EBITDA per TEU is under pressure and double-stacking share dipped to 39% from 40–42%.

name: Radiant Cash Management Services Ltd
gLine: Standalone revenue growth FY27: double-digit (10-12%) (FY27)
thesis: Radiant's standalone EBITDA margin fell to 13.5% from 15.9% on manpower costs, with price revisions of unspecified size only under IBA negotiation (targeted Q2); no capacity signal, and the cash-in-transit peer pricing remains unproven.

name: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: Credit cost: 3% to 3.5% (as we go along)
thesis: Q1 FY27 net loss narrowed to INR34 crore with GNPA 5.9% and credit cost 2.3%, but JLG growth of 5% YoY and the 25-30% loan growth target keep the recovery unproven.

name: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: Current level or around it, for most of the year (FY27)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 on a one-off spread spike: gross spread INR 28,145/KL vs INR 8,274 normal, with management hoping margins hold for 1-2 quarters; supply-side signals absent, capex plan pending.

name: Ceigall India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: minimum 15% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 10.2% to INR901 cr and EBITDA margin 13.4%, but order inflow only ~INR600 cr against a INR6,000 cr annual target and HAM equity needs rising to INR859 cr this year.
top: Order inflow ~INR600 cr vs INR6,000 cr target

name: Swiggy Ltd
gLine: Quick commerce contribution margin: 0 to -100 bps (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Swiggy traded contribution margin for growth: CM guided to 0 to -100 bps from -0.2% last quarter, with 4-week NOV growth of 10% versus 1% prior, while monetisation lifts take rate; supply-side signals (store adds) are growth-driven, not discipline.

name: Anlon Healthcare Ltd
gLine: PAT margin FY27 and FY28: 12-13% (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to about 17% on raw-material spikes and Remember India consolidation, with management guiding 25-27% for FY27 and FY27 revenue of 350-400 crore, unverified against an 87.6 crore first quarter.

name: Pine Labs Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue growth about 20% y/y with contribution margin dipping on upfront investments and low-margin device sales; management guides FY27 CM back to 73-74% and EBITDA margin not below FY26 23.5%.

name: Meesho Ltd
thesis: Meesho says logistics cost per delivered order fell about a rupee QoQ despite fuel and wage hikes, but NMV growth slowed to 2% QoQ and NMV per seller is down about 25% YoY.
top: Cost per delivered order down ~Rs1 QoQ

name: Ardee Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 top-line growth: 10% to 20% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 35% YoY to Rs 338.8 cr on 17,645 MT volume, but EBITDA flat at Rs 33.8 cr with margin ~10%; capacity expanded 50.9% to 1,56,950 MTPA yet utilisation guided lower at 65% and FY27 volume growth 10-20%.

name: Bata India Ltd
thesis: Bata Q1 FY27 turnover Rs979 cr (+4%) with 130bp gross margin gain, but management flagged 5-6% raw-material cost push, a 2,000-store EBO base and A&P rising to 3-3.5% of sales; no numeric forward guidance given.

name: Exide Industries Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +17.6% and EBITDA margin 12.4% (+20bp YoY) on broad volume growth; lithium-ion ramp is the main capex story with utilisation guided at 25-30% and Rs1,400 cr FY27 capex approved.

name: Kirloskar Brothers Ltd-$
gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: Strive for double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue +13% to Rs11,049m but EBITDA margin 11.8% on SPP UK services drag; standalone revenue +9% with management reiterating double-digit FY27 growth, while inventory build and 5.4% standalone order growth temper the read.
top: Stock adjustment Rs82 crore in Q1

name: Nestle India Ltd
thesis: Volume-led FMCG growth story with ad spend up ~40% and capex on MAGGI/Munch lines; no numeric guidance, management declined to forecast and said margins will be maintained, a soft read on near-term outlook.
top: Capacity short: ran out, adding more

name: Elecon Engineering Company Ltd
gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: low double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +11.9% to INR521 cr with consolidated order intake +23% and open book INR1,518 cr, but MHE margin fell and FY27 guidance is only low double-digit revenue growth as input-cost pass-through slows conversion.

name: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd
gLine: Ethanol revenue FY27: same as last year
thesis: Branded IMFL volumes up 40% to 0.79m cases, but ethanol realisations fell to ~INR54 (breakeven INR57-60) amid oversupply, dragging consolidated EBITDA margin to 11% from 14%.

name: Centum Electronics Ltd
gLine: EMS margin: about 10-11% EBITDA
thesis: Standalone revenue up 11% to INR205 cr with order book ~INR1,800 cr (+31%) and Q1 margin soft at 11.3% EBITDA; overseas exit done, but supply-side evidence is thin and the FY27 25%+ growth target is reiterated without numbers for the quarter.
top: BTS order inflow +150% to INR120 cr

name: Mold-Tek Technologies Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: at least 20%
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (~19-23% EBITDA, ~15% PAT) rests on MES cost cuts and automation, with Beryl still near break-even; FY27 Rs 240-250 cr reiterated and FY28 Rs 300-350 cr targeted contingent on an unannounced acquisition.
top: Work on hand Rs 4.5m civil vs 3.7m

name: Emami Ltd-$
gLine: Start-ups revenue FY27: INR750-800 crores (FY27)
thesis: Consolidated revenue +15% to INR1,039 cr and EBITDA +6% to INR226 cr, but input costs up 360bps and management guides to offset via pricing; no supply-side capacity signal.

name: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd
gLine: Realisation per kg (Q2 FY27 range): Above 700, possibly 720-750
thesis: Capacity-constrained egg powder exporter at near-full utilisation; realisation ~Rs770/kg (vs Rs722 prior), but management sees no volume growth until new capacity and feed costs squeeze margins for two or more quarters.
top: Utilisation near full, no volume room

name: Vaibhav Global Ltd
gLine: FY30 revenue: INR5,000-5,500 crore
thesis: Reported growth flattered by INR25 crore US tariff refund and FX; constant-currency revenue broadly flat, with Q1 EBITDA margin 11% helped by one-off. FY27 guidance of 9-11% reiterated.

name: Engineers India Ltd
gLine: Consultancy turnover growth FY27: at least 10% growth on INR3,850 crore base
thesis: Consultancy-led margin story: Q1 FY27 PBT up 55% to INR145 crore on consultancy segment profit of 24%, but turnkey revenue fell to INR302 crore from INR449 crore and order inflow was only INR514 crore against an INR8,000 crore annual target.
top: Q1 order inflow only INR514 crore

name: Yes Bank Ltd
gLine: Full-year advances growth: 15% to 17% (FY27)
thesis: Clean Q1 FY27 with NII up 17.5% and ROE 8.3%, but supply-side read is thin: no capacity framing, the capital raise is only an enabling resolution, and NIM at 2.7% is still far below the 3%+ aspiration.

name: KNR Constructions Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR2,200–2,300 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA of 15% was flattered by a one-off ~INR46 crore cash-surplus claim; ex-one-off margin ~5.5%, with receivables stretched (Telangana ~INR1,300 crore) and FY27 revenue guided INR2,200–2,300 crore.

name: Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd
thesis: Domino's LFL slowed to 2.5% in Q1FY27 with price hikes and LPG/cheese inflation absorbing margin; supply-side capex held at INR750-900 crore with supply chain investment past peak.

name: Captain Polyplast Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin trajectory: 10-15 bps blended improvement every quarter as Ahmedabad ramps
thesis: Q1 FY27 growth and margin improved (EBITDA +26.7%, margin 12.07%, +99bps) on micro-irrigation volumes and solar pump orders, but polymer costs up 30-35% and working capital is stretched into H2.

name: Parag Milk Foods Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: more than 10% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR945 crore (+11% value, +3% volume) with EBITDA margin 7.4% vs 7.7%; no capacity-discipline signal, core flagship volumes down 2% and B2B pricing pressure acknowledged.

name: CL Educate Ltd
gLine: VIRSA revenue growth FY27: 45-50%
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell about ₹17.5 crore on a full-quarter basis while cost cuts of about ₹18 crore lifted EBITDA margin to 16.6%, but PAT stayed negative and test prep volumes are still churning.

name: Apex Frozen Foods Ltd
gLine: RTE share of volume: at least 20% in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (EBITDA margin 12.7% vs 7.1%) came from price, not volume: realisation ~INR930/kg (+15%) while shrimp volume fell to 2,624 MT from 3,015 MT and utilisation stayed ~38%.

name: Matrimony.com Ltd
gLine: Q2 Matchmaking billing and revenue growth: double-digit YoY (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Matchmaking EBITDA margin rose to 26.9% and PAT grew 127% YoY to Rs 19.1 crore, helped by deferred revenue from 1-year plans; Q2 guided to double-digit billing and revenue growth and similar-to-slightly-higher profit.

name: Tube Investments of India Ltd
gLine: Standalone capex FY27: Rs350 Cr for TI; Rs100 Cr Shanthi Gears; Rs600-700 Cr group
thesis: Standalone margins squeezed by steel inflation in Q1 FY27, with management expecting full recovery via lagged price pass-through; engineering volumes up 17% and standalone PBT down to Rs213 Cr from Rs222 Cr.
top: Steel price recovery lagged, full catch-up expected

name: Newgen Software Technologies Ltd
gLine: Full-year EBITDA margin: around 20% (management said 15% and 20% in different answers)
thesis: Software vendor, not capital-cycle relevant: Q1 FY27 revenue +11% to INR357 cr, PAT +26%, but implementation revenue fell ~25% Y-o-Y on delayed project starts, and India growth stalled with a 4-5% cost base rise.

name: One 97 Communications Ltd
gLine: Long-term EBITDA margin: 15-16% terminal margin cited by CEO; 15-20% range referenced (medium term)
thesis: Paytm's Q1 FY27 call is a consumer and fintech growth story with no capacity or supply signals; management cites 8% EBITDA margin, 15-20% medium-term target, and cash build to ~INR 13,500 crore, with no hard numbers on UPI MDR.

name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
gLine: Solvency: 2.42% pre-dividend; ~2.32% after dividend
thesis: LIC's Q1 FY27 VNB margin jumped to 22.9% (from 15.4%) and VNB rose 61% to ₹3,136 crore, but ~2.9% assumption gains and a GST input-credit expense hit (−1.9%) flatter the margin, and APE grew only 8.2%.

name: Updater Services Ltd
thesis: Facilities and BSS services business with 9% revenue growth to INR764 crores and 5.5% EBITDA margin; no capacity or capex story, growth is labour-led and pass-through, with weak IFM margin of 4.5%.

name: Tata Technologies Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue $175.4M (+4.3% QoQ, +25.2% YoY cc) with EBITDA margin 16.1%; management reiterates double-digit FY27 growth but gives no supply-side (capacity or capex) signals and margin ambition is softened.

name: Mach Travel Solutions Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR144.33 cr (+538% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 6.09% from 7.17%, management admits markup cuts for aggressive market share and working-capital strain requires bank OD.
top: Working capital strain, bank OD being sought

name: Western Carriers (India) Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: approx INR100 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 12% to INR465 cr and PAT INR9 cr on domestic volume growth of 37%, but EXIM freight spikes, 111 working-capital days and an unchanged 4.1% EBITDA margin show pricing has not been passed through.
top: EXIM freight 3-4x; no price hike discussed

name: Enviro Infra Engineers Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR359 crore (+49% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 21.07% from 26.65%, and management cut FY27 margin guidance to 21-22% while working capital remains "bloated"; no capacity-discipline signal.

name: Carraro India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: up to 10% YoY if situation stabilises (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to INR5,447m but EBITDA margin 10.4% on unrecovered commodity and freight costs; management guides pass-through over 12 months with no quantified margin target beyond ~50bp uplift.
top: Commodity cost gap not yet recovered

name: Belrise Industries Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth (company): mid-teens (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 manufacturing revenue +20% YoY to INR21,979m but EBITDA margin 11.5% and mgmt offers no supply-side data; capacity expansion (four new facilities) and INR17,000m QIP deployment point to a capex-heavy, acquisition-led growth phase.
top: Four new facilities ramping, fixed costs ahead of revenue

name: HDB Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Business loan book growth: turn positive from Q2, growth from Q3
thesis: Consumer-led NBFI with record Q1 PAT ₹785 cr (+38% YoY) and Stage 3 down to 2.34%, but book growth 11.3% YoY and Asset Finance growth still weak; management refuses to guide credit cost beyond ~2.3%.

name: Gem Aromatics Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 3.3% and PAT was a Rs7.9 cr loss as new Dahej capacity sits idle ahead of commercial ramp; management gave no FY27 numbers, deferring guidance to calendar year-end.
top: Dahej capex ~Rs265 cr of Rs270 cr capitalised

name: Ivalue Infosolutions Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 gross sales up 5.7% to INR 641 crore with PAT up 52%, but growth is lumpy and management reaffirmed 20% FY27 growth without supply-side evidence; ILM down about 60% as budgets shifted to DCI.

name: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Ltd
thesis: Asset manager with revenue up 20% YoY to INR116.2 cr on yield gains (TER-to-BER shift, cost control) while quarterly average AUM grew only 7% and management sidestepped flows, SIP attrition and market share.

name: Fractal Analytics Ltd
gLine: TMT sequential growth next quarter: healthy sequential growth (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 20% YoY but only 9% in constant currency, with TMT down 22% and growth ex-TMT at 37%; margins expanded (adj. EBITDA 16.8%) but there is no capacity or pricing signal, and the CFO is exiting.

name: Symbiotec Pharmalab Ltd
gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: 20% (plus or minus 5%) (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue INR218 cr (+7% YoY) and EBITDA INR45 cr, with the API core steady at 60%+ gross margin; new CDMO and injectable businesses drag INR23 cr opex and INR11 cr depreciation before revenue starts in H2.
top: Capex INR200-250 cr per year for 2-3 years

name: Pidilite Industries Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +22.2% on 11.3% underlying volume growth with price hikes of 2–12%; gross margin fell 90bp to 52.5% yet EBITDA margin rose to 26.4%, flattered by low-cost inventory that management says will unwind in Q2.
top: Low-cost inventory benefit to unwind in Q2

name: Hindustan Unilever Ltd
thesis: HUL delivered 10% USG (5% UVG) with EBITDA margin ~23% inside guided range, but capacity and supply signals are absent; growth is demand-led with palm-oil-driven soaps volume down and no capex commentary.

name: WPIL Ltd
gLine: JJM receivables realisation: Substantial inflow in Q2
thesis: Consolidated revenue INR501 cr (+32% YoY) and 15% EBITDA margin, but standalone domestic projects starved of Jal Jeevan funds: INR43 cr revenue and 5% standalone EBITDA margin, with INR300-350 cr receivables unpaid in Q1.

name: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Ltd
gLine: Legacy Sudarshan growth: 12% to 13% (FY2027)
thesis: Acquired Heubach/Clariant pigment group posted business EBITDA of Rs128 Cr (6-7% margin) with guidance of EUR700m turnover and EUR35m EBITDA held, not raised, pending Q2; volume growth unclear and supply discipline not discussed.
top: Working capital stretched by safety stock

name: Muthoot Capital Services Ltd
gLine: GNPA retail FY27: sub-4%, NNPA sub-2% (FY27)
thesis: Vehicle NBFC shifting to retail with co-lending wound down; GNPA cut to 3.94% via ARC sale of INR203 crore at ~45.6% valuation, while AUM guidance of INR4,000-4,200 crore for FY27 is reiterated and pre-tax ROA of 2.5% is far above the ~1% now.

name: Pennar Industries Ltd-$
gLine: Revenue and profit growth Q1 to Q2: double-digit growth (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 3.6% to INR884.55 cr while PBT rose 16% to INR46.8 cr; mix improving but PEB India margin hit, legacy steel/rail shrinking, and cash tied up in working capital.
top: PEB India margin drop >200bps, steel pass-through lag

name: Praj Industries Ltd
gLine: Praj GenX EBITDA breakeven: by end of FY27
thesis: Praj's Q1 FY27 shows order intake of INR 10 billion and backlog of INR 45.9 billion, but first-gen ethanol greenfield slowdown, funding delays and rising material costs keep conversion and margins weak.

name: DCM Shriram Ltd
gLine: Caustic soda ECU price: INR30,000 or higher
thesis: Chemicals revenue up 33% with ECU up 7% and utilisation at 82%, but PVC volumes fell 25% on a duty waiver and Chinese imports; Q1 PAT ex one-offs up 28% to INR147 crore.

name: Vimta Labs Ltd-$
thesis: Q1 FY27 total income up 13.7% YoY to INR1,129m with EBITDA margin 36.4%, but flat QoQ, food testing hit by Middle East trade disruption, and management declined to give utilisation numbers.
top: Food testing hit by trade disruption

name: Shakti Pumps India Ltd-$
gLine: Revenue: INR5,000 crores in three years (FY29) (FY29)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 37.9% to INR859 cr and volumes up 57.6%, but EBITDA margin ~9.6% on ~10% YoY raw-material and realisation squeeze; capacity build (0.5 GW, 2.2 GW) with utilisation at 63%.
top: EBITDA impact ~10% YoY from costs and realisation

name: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd
gLine: ROA: 1.25% plus
thesis: Q1 FY27 profit fell to INR424 crore on higher standard-asset provisions and costlier bulk deposits used to fund competitive corporate lending; management kept FY27 guidance (NIM ~3.5%, GNPA <2.25%) but signals credit growth of 18-20% and a 1.25%+ ROA.

name: Datamatics Global Services Ltd
gLine: 3-year revenue target: About INR 3,000 cr over 3 years, from ~INR 2,000 cr (3 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 9.9% to INR 513.9 cr and EBITDA margin up 343 bps to 19.7%, but no capacity or capex signals; growth tied to AI deal wins and management reiterates high-single-digit FY27 guidance.

name: Page Industries Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +7.9% and PAT -4% on ~3 days of undelivered billing and input costs; management reiterates double-digit FY27 volume and 19-21% EBITDA margin, with a May price hike (2.2%) only partly covering input inflation.

name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA per kg: INR44-45 for full year (aiming), exceed INR42-43 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA per kg rose to INR46.7 (vs ~INR40.7 FY26) on Hyderabad unit consolidation and mix, while volume grew only ~6% as lube fell 17% on base-oil shortage; price pass-through of raw material held.

name: Globus Spirits Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 manufacturing ran at a record 89% utilisation with no capacity adds planned, and margin guided at INR5–7/litre; growth in ENA and P&A is funded from internal cash flow.

name: D. B. Corp Ltd
gLine: Newsprint price outlook: Up in Q2; expected to fall from Q3 and Q4
thesis: Print ad revenue up ~10% to INR 4,320 mn and EBITDA margin up 250bp to 26.1%, but circulation fell to ~38 lakh copies and realisations are flat while newsprint rose ~13% YoY.

name: Man Infraconstruction Ltd
thesis: Real estate developer with Q1 FY27 revenue up 8% to ₹218 cr and PAT up 29% to ₹72 cr, but Q1 pre-sales only ~₹290 cr against a ₹5,000 cr two-year target; no capacity or supply metrics apply.

name: Persistent Systems Ltd
gLine: Combined leverage (Net Debt/EBITDA): 1.9x-2.5x at close, to 1x by FY2030
thesis: Persistent is buying Nagarro for EUR1.27bn EV (9.12x EBITDA) on debt, plus a ~$125m annual net-new deal; no capacity or supply signal, so this is an M&A and deal-wins story, not a capital-cycle one.

name: Bajaj Consumer Care Ltd
gLine: Gross margin trajectory: Tough in Q2, easing over Q3 and Q4 (Q2-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR341 cr (+28%) with EBITDA margin 24.7%, but management guided gross margin under more stress in Q2 from high-cost inventory and gave no numeric guidance; supply-side signals are thin.

name: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 orders hit a record INR 915 crore but EBIT fell to INR 32 crore on commodity-driven gross margin squeeze from legacy fixed-price orders; management gave no numeric guidance and pricing actions are yet to fructify.
top: Gross margin hit by legacy fixed-price orders

name: Repco Home Finance Ltd
gLine: Q2 disbursements: Rs1,200-1,250 Cr (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Housing finance lender (Repco) with Q1 disbursements flat YoY at Rs843 Cr and spread guided down 10-12bp on BT-out defence; supply-side signals absent, asset quality improving only slowly.

name: Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Ltd
gLine: FY27 turnover: Rs 1,250 cr, possibly Rs 1,350-1,400 cr (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to Rs 280 cr on 25% lower chemical volumes and fertiliser volume down 13%; management guides FY27 Rs 1,250 cr (possibly 1,350-1,400) while Unit 5/6 capacity is added and acid plants are run at low load.

name: Maximus International Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: above INR 200 crore (conservative) (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~52% to INR59.91 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 7.64% from 9.81% on Middle East war input costs; plant utilisation only ~45% of 50,000 KL, so supply is not the constraint.

name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
gLine: Telecom revenue FY27: INR6,700-7,000 crore
thesis: Dixon's Q1 FY27 revenue rose to INR15,557 crore but margins compressed on PLI-1 expiry and input pass-through; management guides no margin recovery this fiscal, with recovery pushed to FY28.

name: HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd
gLine: FY27 non-cash ESOP cost: INR79 crores to INR80 crores
thesis: HDFC AMC Q1 FY27: QAAUM up 13% to INR9.35tn with share 11.2%, but debt outflows and a TER-to-BER shift held yields and margins flat-to-up; no capacity or capex lever applies to this asset manager.
top: Debt QAAUM outflows, debt AUM down 6% QoQ

name: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd
gLine: Non-convenience fee: return to INR150 crore per quarter
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18.1% to INR1,370 crore led by catering (+34%), but EBITDA fell 2.8% to INR386 crore and margin dipped to 28.2% on one-offs, HR cost and a 30% resin-driven squeeze in Rail Neer; no supply-side capacity signal from IRCTC itself.

name: Borosil Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27 (ex other income): about 18%
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 9% to INR253.6 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 14.6% from 17.8% on West Asia fuel/packaging inflation (~INR10 cr hit); price pass-through lags into Q2, and FY27 capex guided INR125–150 cr.

name: Epigral Ltd
gLine: Long-term growth: 15% to 20% CAGR over 3-5 years (3-5 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +15% to INR709cr and EBITDA margin 25% (vs 27%), but chlor-alkali ECU fell to ~INR31-32k from INR35-36k and CPVC utilisation ~50-55% with new CPVC capacity coming, while management adds epoxy and MPP capex of INR600cr.

name: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd
gLine: Alternate (PMS/AIF) revenue contribution: similar range, ±1-2% in coming quarters
thesis: Q1 FY27 AMC shows average AUM up 42% to ₹6.28 lakh crore on EPFO/ESIC mandates, while equity yield guided at 63-64 bps and ESOP lifts employee cost by ~₹10 crore a quarter.

name: CMS Info Systems Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: about 27% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 services revenue INR625cr, INR25cr short of plan from a cash supply squeeze (currency fulfilment ~70% then ~80%); FY27 revenue guide trimmed but EBITDA margin guide raised to ~27%.

name: Eureka Forbes Ltd
gLine: A&SP spend growth: ahead of revenue growth in FY27
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 15.3% to INR701 cr on volume-led water purifier growth, but service bookings softened after 3–12% AMC price hikes and adjusted EBITDA margin fell 46bp to 10.5%.

name: HMA Agro Industries Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue INR 2,072 crore (~90% YoY) and PAT INR 31.9 crore, but no capacity, utilisation or pricing disclosure; growth attributed to buffalo meat exports with unexplained other income surge.

name: NIIT Learning Systems Ltd
gLine: Q2 revenue growth YoY: 9% to 11% (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 reported growth of 25% is mostly acquisitions and a lapping RECO contract; organic constant-currency growth is 5% YoY and 2.9% QoQ, with FY27 high-single-digit guidance and margin 18-20%.

name: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd
gLine: DICE revenue: INR15-16 cr FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Zaggle Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 28% to INR423 cr but adjusted EBITDA margin fell to 8.2% from 10.1% as capitalisation was reversed into P&L; cash-flow fix is a 15-18 month story with no numbers.
top: Capitalisation moderated, costs pushed to P&L

name: TBO TEK Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin expansion came from operating leverage on a travel platform with no capacity cycle; Middle East flat, Europe +24%, and management gave no hard numeric guidance beyond "QoQ and YoY growth" aims.
top: Take rate lower in tough quarter

name: One Mobikwik Systems Ltd
gLine: FY27 PAT: INR40 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹7.6 cr on payments GP ₹77 cr and lending GP ₹43 cr, but payments revenue dipped as card-linked categories were paused; UPI GMV is non-monetised.
top: Net payments take rate 12-14 bps guided

name: Allcargo Global Ltd
gLine: Cost base (employee and admin) in USD terms: flat over coming couple of years
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA turned to INR33 crore from a INR17 crore Q4 and a loss last year, but volumes are still below prior levels and management gave no hard numbers beyond a flat dollar cost intent.
top: LCL and air volumes up about 5% QoQ

name: Park Medi World Ltd
gLine: Revenue FY27: Rs.2,080 crores (+24%) (FY27)
thesis: Capacity is ramping to 4,740 beds by FY27 and 5,740 by FY28 while occupancy fell to 56% from 68%, so supply is outrunning demand; FY27 guidance of 24% revenue growth and ARPOB +10-12% is management's case.

name: Titan Company Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 jewellery margin of 10.9% was flattered by ₹407 cr customs-duty gain and 75-80 bps MTM gains that will reverse; management held the ~11% centre-of-gravity margin and double-digit growth targets without new numbers.

name: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd
gLine: Casting volume growth: 15%+ overall; castings 17-20% (remaining 3 quarters of FY27)
thesis: Casting volumes up 19% and pig iron output up 5% with pricing improving, but tube sales down 14% and power-cost regulation hurting; supply additions are heavy and capex guided to Rs 600-700 crore this year.

name: Tata Elxsi Ltd
gLine: EBIT margin: Sequential ramp toward Q4, no numeric target
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,021 crore, up 6.5% YoY constant currency, but EBIT margin fell 330 bps QoQ on one-offs and onshore ramp costs; management guides to recovery over four quarters without a number.

name: Great Eastern Shipping Company Ltd
thesis: Record quarter on Hormuz-driven tanker spike, but management is holding cash, replacing rather than expanding fleet, and says new orderbook is rising (crude tankers 27%) so supply risk is building.

name: Zuari Industries Ltd
gLine: Zuari Agro ICD repayment: INR258 crore in current quarter (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Zuari Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA fell to INR31.3 cr from INR36.9 cr and PAT was a loss of INR9.5 cr; profit depends on Dubai repatriation (INR142 cr received of ~INR900 cr guided) and a sugar price rally that is not yet in the numbers.
top: Sugar prices up 10% in a month

name: Britannia Industries Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 9.5% with volume near 9% and June exit in mid-teens after dual-pricing disruption ended; but LPG, palm oil and sugar inflation only half offset by price, so margin defence is uncertain.
top: Price offset only half of inflation

name: Can Fin Homes Ltd
gLine: Cost-to-income: around 19.5% for the year (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursements beat at INR 2,609 crore (+29% YoY), but rundown rose to INR 1,857 crore, so AUM growth stayed ~10.8% against a 14% FY target; spread 2.83%, NIM 3.81%.

name: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd
gLine: Domestic market growth FY27: flat to 6-7% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 38% to INR18.4bn and EBITDA 25.1% held in mid-20s guide, but order intake fell 30% to INR11.4bn and two large RPT orders (INR3,000cr on hold, INR1,300cr unbooked) slipped.

name: Transport Corporation of India Ltd
gLine: Seaways EBITDA margin Q2: 25-30% (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up ~9% with standalone ~7% and EBITDA margins flat; supply-chain growth slowed, Seaways bunker costs compress margins, and guidance (10-12% freight, 12-15% supply chain) rests on H2 pipeline.

name: Birlasoft Ltd
gLine: FY27 effective tax rate: 29% to 30%
thesis: Birlasoft Q1 FY27 revenue flat in USD ($145.2M, +0.3% cc QoQ) with TCV up 20% YoY to $168.7M, but management refused any numeric guidance and pricing pressure is squeezing revenue conversion.

name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
gLine: Industry tariff architecture: ARPU growth of 4-5% a year over 5-7 years (5-7 years)
thesis: Telecom pricing is still the lever: ARPU Rs.264 with no tariff hike, but capex is rising into data centres and homes FWA churn is hurting quality of adds.

name: Welspun Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR8,000 crore to INR10,000 crore
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue soft at INR774 crore on execution delays, with 22.9% EBITDA margin and INR1,800 crore cash; management targets about 15% growth, closer to 15% than 20%, and order book slipped to INR18,700 crore.
top: Q1 revenue soft; order book declined

name: Paisalo Digital Ltd
gLine: AUM, income and PAT: approximately double in 3 fiscal years (3 fiscal years)
thesis: Paisalo's Q1 FY27 is a growth-led NBFC print (disbursements +128% YoY, AUM +28%) with no supply-side evidence; management guides to doubling AUM, income and PAT in three years, but leverage is rising and PAT beat hinges on a 40% cost-to-income.

name: Maan Aluminium Ltd
gLine: Pithampur Italian line contribution: significant contribution by mid of next year
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR232 cr (+10% YoY, -9% QoQ) with EBITDA INR7 cr (~3% margin); volumes flat at ~1,558 t, export share down from 60-70% to 45% on duties, and capex back-ended.

name: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Ltd
gLine: Services export growth: around 7.5% growth, expected to remain at this level
thesis: Q1 FY27 CV brake-systems maker grew sales 9.3% with CV>6T volumes +8.6% and aftermarket +15.6%, but reported PAT fell 14.7% on a prior-year FX gain; margins squeezed by aluminium and pass-through lags.

name: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd
gLine: Core EBITDA margin: 1.2% to 3% in 1-3 years (1-3 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR753 crore on weaker freight car execution, with EBITDA margin 10.8% and order book INR9,923 crore; supply-side signals are mixed, with freight car output of 1,054 units and no capacity commentary.

name: Rushil Decor Ltd
gLine: Jumbo laminate utilisation FY27: 55% to 60% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 7.9% on resin and freight inflation; MDF utilisation 66% and jumbo laminate utilisation only 29%, with management pointing to 55–60% for the year but no numbers in the guidance box.

name: Triveni Turbine Ltd
gLine: US subsidiary break-even: break-even in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 PBT margin fell to 15.7% from 23.5% on weak domestic mix, freight-delayed exports and low-margin NTPC CO2 storage order; order book up only 5.1% to ₹21.8bn, management guides full-year growth but no numbers.

name: Thomas Scott (India) Ltd
thesis: Digital apparel retailer with no capacity-discipline signal; Q1 revenue +22% to INR 66 cr with EBITDA margin 13.07%, but growth was bought via marketing and wholesale aggregator sales, and a fire-insurance claim keeps debt elevated.
top: Finance cost ~3x YoY on working capital

name: S Chand and Company Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs1,145m (+12% YoY) with EBITDA loss Rs97m; management reiterated 10–15% growth and 17–19% EBITDA margin guidance, while stockpiling ~25% of annual paper needs ahead of price rises, lifting working capital.

name: Indian Energy Exchange Ltd
gLine: RTM volume growth: 25-30% CAGR (CEO gut feel) (medium term)
thesis: IEX Q1 FY27 volume rose 16% to 37.5 BU and PAT 134.8 crore (+12%), but the Grid India market-coupling order threatens the core DAM franchise and management gave no timeline.

name: CSB Bank Ltd
gLine: Wholesale growth: 35% to 40% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 profit up 27% YoY to Rs150cr with NIM 3.66% and ROA 1.09%, but management guides FY27 NIM ~3.75% and ROA 1.3-1.5% while gold stays ~50% of book and bulk deposits ~52% of term deposits.

name: SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd
thesis: Credit-card cycle turning: gross credit cost down 301 bps YoY to 6.5% and PAT up 20% to INR664 crores, but receivables only +3% YoY and management gave no numeric guidance.
top: Gross credit cost 6.5%, down 301 bps YoY

name: Craftsman Automation Ltd
gLine: Sunbeam Q4 EBITDA margin: mid-teens (Q4 FY27)
thesis: Capex rising to ~INR 1,500 cr (standalone ~1,000 + DR Axion 430 + Sunbeam maintenance) with Powertrain at ~70% utilisation and Aluminium above 80%; supply expansion is management's own call, with Hosur capacity pending orders.

name: Nazara Technologies Ltd
gLine: NODWIN organic growth FY27: 30%+
thesis: Gaming revenue up 14% to INR 275 crore with 19.5% EBITDA margin, but margins are deferred by UA spend and Bluetile margin fell to ~11%; the $303m all-cash Bluetile deal and a funding gap make this a capital-allocation story rather than supply-discipline.

name: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd
gLine: AUM growth: 20%-25% per year over 3-4 years (3-4 years)
thesis: Wealth manager reports 24% PAT growth (ex-fair-value) to INR116 crores with 1.1 lakh crore AUM, but supply-side levers are absent and about a quarter of the FY27 guidance is a function of mark-to-market gains.
top: AMC licence application approved by Board

name: Veefin Solutions Ltd
thesis: Standalone revenue up 128% YoY to Rs 23.14 cr with 55.4% EBITDA margin, but no capacity or supply metrics; pipeline flat at ~$80m after $15.3m conversion and debt-funded working capital raises balance-sheet caution.

name: Redtape Ltd
gLine: New store openings FY27: 150+ stores (aspiration)
thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT up 19.4% to INR47 crore on 3.7% standalone revenue growth, driven by no price hikes and retail mix; e-commerce fell to 22% of sales from 30% as management refused deeper discounting.

name: Vishal Mega Mart Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +18.7% to INR 3,727 cr with 10% SSG and gross margin up 28.4%→28.7% on lower promotions, but no capacity-discipline signal; store adds (27) and small-format rollout keep expanding.

name: National Securities Depository Ltd
industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
gLine: Operating leverage to normalise margins: normalised margins over medium term
thesis: NSDL Q1 FY27 standalone PAT up 7.9% to INR89.1 crore while EBITDA margin moderated to 57.8% on front-loaded tech and headcount spend; incremental demat share rose to 17.6% from about 14%.

name: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd
thesis: Asset manager with market share steady at 13.4% and equity share 14%; growth is mark-to-market led, SIP flows flat QoQ at ~INR 31,781 cr in June, and no supply-side capacity signals since AMCs have no capex cycle.
top: SIP rebound in June vs May

name: Dachepalli Publishers Ltd
gLine: FY27 turnover: INR130-150 crore
thesis: Q1 FY27 total income up 159% to INR45.18 crore with PAT up 42% to INR6.3 crore, but management gave no capacity data and receivables rose to about INR100 crore, with EBITDA margin falling from 40% to 20% year-on-year.

name: Kusumgar Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: similar to FY25-FY26 levels, moving a few percentage points (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR247.2 cr (+102% YoY, -21% QoQ) with management declining formal guidance and order-book disclosure; utilisation only 55-60% with no large capex planned, so supply is not yet a constraint.

name: Laser Power & Infra Ltd
gLine: Interest saving on debt repayment: ~INR40 crore per year at PBT level
thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +15% to INR5,215m and EBITDA +26% to INR659m, but finance cost absorbed 55% of EBITDA; capacity utilisation cited at 62% (manufacturing), with no new capex guidance and a stated focus on utilisation.

name: Shankesh Jewellers Ltd
gLine: Volume outlook / margin range: none quantified
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 55% YoY to INR424 cr with EBITDA margin ~14%, but management attributed margin gains to mix without quantification, volumes flat, and no capacity or capex discipline evidence.

name: Purple Style Labs Ltd
thesis: Luxury omni-channel retailer in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA at negative INR11 crores vs negative INR4 crores a year ago, PAT loss INR88 crores, and debt rising to INR436 crores despite inventory falling to INR159 crores.

name: Saksoft Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue flat at ~INR 249 crore with muted Q2 outlook; management holds FY27 INR 1,200-1,250 crore guidance (~25% growth) but pipeline claims rest on unquantified deal conversion.

name: Cummins India Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 18% to INR3,375 crore on data-centre gensets, but PBT fell 0.7% as commodity inflation squeezes margins; utilisation only 70–75% and capex kept in line with past years, so supply discipline is not the story.
top: One price hike taken into Q2

name: Schaeffler India Ltd
thesis: Q2 revenue up 17.5% YoY to INR 2,681 cr with EBITDA margin 19.1%, but working capital rose to INR 2,029 cr on planned inventory build and FCF weakened; capex held at ~INR 500 cr CY26 plan.
top: Working capital up to INR 2,029 cr

name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
gLine: Market growth: 4% to 5% industry growth; company aims to grow in line with market
thesis: Q1 FY27 (June quarter) sales up 23% with EBITDA margin 10.5% vs 8.3%, but management gave no capacity or utilisation number and part of the sales lift is customer inventory build ahead of price rises.

name: Himatsingka Seide Ltd
thesis: Home-textile maker pivoting to yarn, fabric and apparel verticals while Sheeting utilisation sits at 52% and revenue fell to INR634 crores from INR661 crores; no numeric guidance, so the read is a transition with volatility ahead.

name: Symphony Ltd
gLine: Australia capital deployment: No further capital allocation
thesis: Q1 FY27 consol EBITDA ex one-offs up 39% to ₹53 crore with channel inventory cleared, but management warns of near-term margin pressure from elevated input costs and only partial price pass-through.

name: Bank of Baroda
thesis: Q1 FY27 underlying profit ~5,528 cr ex a USD 600m NMC settlement that cut reported PAT to 1,278 cr; guidance held but full-year ROA guidance withdrawn, ECL transition ~110 bps CRAR hit ahead.

name: Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd
gLine: Sugar season 2026-27 operating performance: Significantly better operating season; Shamli bounce back expected
thesis: Q1 FY27 PBIT up on sugar and distillery margins, but distillery volumes fell 19% and crush fell 9%; sugar closing stock 3.59 lakh MT vs 4.45 lakh MT a year ago supports prices.

name: Union Bank of India
gLine: Advances growth: industry plus 1% (FY27)
thesis: Union Bank's Q1 FY27 call stresses CASA/RTD stability and NIM defence at 2.80%, but credit growth is soft, bulk deposits are being shed, and ECL transition (about INR11,300 crore) remains unquantified on run-rate.

name: Strides Pharma Science Ltd
gLine: Product launches: about 10 launches by 31 March 2027 (FY27)

name: PCBL Chemical Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: ~INR300 crore +/- INR50 crore
thesis: Q1 FY27 carbon black EBITDA/t ~INR22,900 lifted by low-cost inventory (~INR70 cr, INR40-50 cr to reverse); management held FY27 EBITDA/t guidance at INR16,500-17,000 and Q2 volumes soft on timing.

name: Birlanu Ltd
gLine: Parador profitability: more than breaking even this year (FY27)
thesis: Consolidated revenue up 11.6% to Rs 1,174 cr and EBITDA up 35% to Rs 80 cr, but Pipes volumes fell 27% on PVC resin whipsaw and Parador swung to a Rs 13 cr EBITDA loss.

name: SG Mart Ltd
gLine: Capex: INR400-500 crore FY27; INR1,500 crore over 2-3 years (2-3 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes of 160,000 t service centres and 30,000 t profiles/solar at ~INR2,000 and INR3,000-4,000/t EBITDA, with an unquantified EBITDA trajectory; capex plan of INR1,500 cr over 2-3 years versus INR700 cr on books, and a 50% CAGR target.
top: Capex plan INR1,500 cr vs INR700 cr on books

name: Salzer Electronics Ltd-$
gLine: Q3-Q4 FY27 EBITDA margin: 9% to 9.5% (Q3-Q4 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 6% (from ~9.5% a year ago) on copper/silver lag; management cut FY27 EBITDA target to 8–8.5% from 10% while capex stays minimal at ~INR15–16 crore maintenance.

name: Havells India Ltd
gLine: A&P spend FY27: around INR700-800 crores (management said 'somewhere around that number') (FY27)
thesis: Havells Q1 FY27 shows price hikes of about 7-8% absorbed and channel kept lean, but switchgear fell 4% and cables are flat in volume, with A&P more than doubling and margins down.

name: Kilburn Engineering Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue ~INR117 crore with 20.1% EBITDA margin, but FY27 INR700 crore guidance held on an H2-weighted assumption with only ~INR485 crore closing order book and 3-4 projects slipping.
top: FY27 INR700 cr held despite Q1 INR117 cr

name: Control Print Ltd-$
gLine: Core Coding & Marking standalone growth: 10%-15% by year end (FY27)
thesis: Standalone coding & marking steady but Q1 FY27 operating revenue up only ~5% (₹105cr vs ₹100cr) while subsidiaries V-Shapes/Track & Trace keep burning cash; breakeven pushed to H1 FY28.
top: Packaging breakeven slips to H1 FY28

name: Orchid Pharma Ltd
gLine: Jammu 7-ACA ramp-up: 80% to 100% utilisation by end of first year (first year post start)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR304 crore (+15% YoY) and gross margin 33% (from 30%), but management calls the industry overcapacitated with cutthroat competition and gives no FY27 numeric guidance.

name: Premier Explosives Ltd
gLine: Export revenue Q2: INR150-200 crores (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 28% to INR102.6 cr and EBIT margin to 4.7% on export and import delays; order book INR1,393 cr (94% defence) and FY27 INR600 cr target rests on export licences arriving, with no new capacity capex quantified.

name: NRB Bearings Ltd
gLine: FY31 revenue vision: INR3,000 crores aspirational; INR2,700 crores on trailing growth
thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 19.2% to INR370 crores and PAT up 15% to INR38 crores; capex of INR270 crores (INR60 crores spent) with a INR130 crore capacity from INR110 crore Unitec JV, but no utilisation or pricing data.
top: Capex INR270 crores; INR60 crores spent

name: Goodluck India Ltd
gLine: Standalone capex FY27-28: INR100-150 crore
thesis: Standalone volume +8.8% to 122,718 t at 98% utilisation, but management pushed Defence expansion 6-9 months and gave no numbers on the cut-off; the consolidated EBITDA +46% is Defence-led and the capital story is diluted by subsidiary stake sale.

name: Arman Financial Services Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 AUM up 36% YoY to INR2,925 crores with PAT INR45 crores, but management stresses caution, volumes below expectation and credit cost guidance of 3-3.5% not formally given.

name: VST Tillers Tractors Ltd-$
gLine: Bajaj Finance retail financing share: 15% to 20% of retail this year (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 11% to ₹313.4 cr but operational EBITDA margin fell ~45bp to 12.85% on raw-material inflation; tractor volumes weak and FY27 outlook explicitly withheld.

name: Capri Global Capital Ltd
gLine: AUM FY28: INR65,000 crores, 30%+ CAGR (FY28)
thesis: Capri Global Q1 FY27 shows strong growth and ROA above 4%, but gold-loan Stage 2 jumped INR385 crores and the company raised FY28 AUM target to INR65,000 crores with no prior guidance list to check against.

name: Century Plyboards (India) Ltd-$
gLine: Particle board EBITDA margin: close to 15% (next year)
thesis: Plywood volume and revenue surged on a 7% April price hike and pre-buying; management withdrew guidance, cited no large capex, and is tracking MDF margin toward 15%+ and particle board toward ~15% next year.
top: No large capex planned near term

name: AIA Engineering Ltd
gLine: Capex: INR350-400 crore FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume 64,644 t (vs ~60,000 a year ago) with no guidance on FY27 volume; management held status quo on tonnage, margin and realisation while capex guidance was raised to INR350-400 crore.

name: Godawari Power and Ispat Ltd
gLine: Captive ore full use: 100% captive in FY28
thesis: Q1 FY27 pellet plant shut on gas cost up 40-45% and merchant ore buying; Q2 pellet output guided ~500 kt, mining ramp deferred to Q3-Q4, steel plant put on hold.

name: Hubtown Ltd
gLine: Pre-sales FY27: ~INR6,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 17% YoY to INR156 cr under project completion accounting; pre-sales INR535 cr and collections INR320 cr, with FY27 pre-sales guided at INR6,000 cr back-ended to Q3–Q4.

name: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd
gLine: Central Vista billing FY27: INR700 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 4.29% from 8.59% on AIIMS Jammu bill cut (2.6pp), NCR labour wage hikes and staff costs; double-digit margin for FY27 ruled out and inflow guidance cut.

name: Fortis Healthcare Ltd
gLine: Bed additions: ~400 beds in remaining 3 quarters of FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Hospital margin fell to 21.5% from 22.1% as ESOP, ramp-up units and legal costs weighed; management holds 25% FY28 target while occupancy stays ~69%, with no supply discipline signal, just more beds (400 more in FY27).

name: Kuantum Papers Ltd
gLine: Peak debt: INR760-770 crore max; under INR300 crore in 3 years (3 years)
thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA flat at INR40 crore (13.2% margin) as cost rose INR4,200/t against NSR gain of INR3,400/t; guidance trimmed to INR1,300 crore+ revenue, with EBITDA margin target 16-18% pushed to year-end.
top: FY27 revenue cut to INR1,300 crore+

name: Kiri Industries Ltd
gLine: Copper tube plant start: 35 KT operational June 2027 (FY28)
thesis: Dyes realisations drove standalone revenue up 63% to INR 295 cr and material margin to 31.9%, but PAT of INR 270 cr was mostly treasury/other income; copper project remains capital-heavy and pre-revenue.
top: FY28 INR 20,000-25,000 cr revenue guidance dropped

name: VA Tech Wabag Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 13% to 14% (FY27)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR 887 crore (+20.8% YoY) and order book INR 19,400 crore (over 4x revenue), but EBITDA margin is guided only 13-15% and capex is not a constraint since the model is asset-light.

name: PTC India Financial Services Ltd
gLine: AUM by end FY27: around INR 5,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursement just INR 117 crore with loan book INR 2,946 crore and Stage III INR 190 crore, 187 crore in one NCLT account; growth recovery is promised but not yet evidenced.

name: Rhi Magnesita India Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin gain (EBITDA 14.5% vs 10.8%) rests on price and mix with no capacity signal; capex run-rate at INR8 crore vs INR150 crore guide is unexplained, and management reiterated 13% margin and 7-8% volume guidance.

name: Speciality Restaurants Ltd
gLine: Walters QSR store additions: 10 to 15 in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Restaurant chain reports 11.35% same-store sales growth and gross margin up to 71.1% from 69.9%, but gives no numeric guidance on revenue or store count; store-opening plans are vague and capital cycle signals are mostly qualitative.

name: PDS Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 15% to ₹3,444 cr and EBITDA margin up to 2.8% (from 1.7%), with order book up 23% to ₹6,095 cr, but guidance stays qualitative and the order-book growth is not yet capacity-led.

name: Monte Carlo Fashions Ltd
gLine: Home textile growth FY27: 20-25% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 8% to INR149 crore with EBITDA loss of INR13 crore as sales returns pulled forward (~INR180 crore provision cited); management guides low double-digit growth and ~100bp margin dip for FY27.

name: SG Finserve Ltd
gLine: AUM target: INR10,000 crore by FY30 (FY30)
thesis: Nil-NPA supply-chain NBFC posts record Q1 PBT of INR72 crore and loan book INR4,552 crore; management guides FY27 PBT ~INR300 crore, but no capacity or supply-side cycle signal since this is a lender, not an industrial.

name: IDFC First Bank Ltd
gLine: Full-year NIM: ~5.8% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 profit INR1,075 crore (+132% YoY) on credit cost falling to 1.53%; management now guides FY27 ROA about 1% and credit cost 150-160bp, with NIM guide lifted to 5.8%.

name: K.P. Energy Ltd
gLine: IPP capacity by end FY27: 100 MW (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~126% to Rs 521 cr but gross margin fell to ~20% from 28% in Q4; order book cut to Rs 2,250 cr and FY27 growth guided to 30-40%, with no margin guidance.

name: PNB Housing Finance Ltd
gLine: ROA FY27: around 2.4% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursement optics distorted by check-realisation switch (reported +18% YoY vs 56% on handover basis), NIM down 19bps to 3.50% with management calling bottom and guiding ROA ~2.4%, FY27 book growth 18-20% held.

name: Laurus Labs Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: INR2,000 crores (from INR1,500 crores; FY27-28 earlier INR3,000 crores) (FY27)
thesis: Laurus raised FY27 capex to about INR2,000 crores (from INR1,500 crores) with Q1 capex of INR394 crores, while Q1 revenue grew 29% to INR2,026 crores and EBITDA margin hit 31.8%; capacity is being built ahead of customer demand.
top: Capex guidance raised to INR2,000 crores

name: Housing & Urban Development Corporation Ltd
gLine: FY27 disbursement: ~INR65,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: HUDCO guides FY27 disbursement of about INR65,000 crore and a INR3 lakh crore loan book by 2030, with spreads held near 2%, but the call offers no hard supply-side evidence and sanctions are being chased with lengthy project timelines.

name: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd
gLine: Overall operating expenses growth (ex-ESOP, one-offs): 18% to 20% for 6-8 quarters (6-8 quarters)
thesis: AMC gaining share: MF market share 9.04% (highest since June 2019) with QAAUM up 22.7% YoY; opex guided to grow 18-20% ex-ESOP for 6-8 quarters as tech and brand spend ramps.
top: MF market share 9.04%, up 54 bps YoY

name: IFGL Refractories Ltd
gLine: Hofmann Ceramic losses: breakeven by end FY27
thesis: Standalone EBITDA fell 17% YoY to INR31 crore as gross margin slid to 43% from 47% on raw material and LPG costs; consolidated EBITDA flat at INR40 crore, with price hikes only partly recovering input costs.

name: Bandhan Bank Ltd
thesis: Bandhan cut its Q4 FY27 ROA aspiration to 1.2–1.4% from 1.6–1.8%, citing funding costs and tech costs; Q1 PAT ₹502 cr (+35% YoY) with NIM held at 6.2% and credit cost 1.8%.

name: Yasho Industries Ltd
gLine: FY28 revenue: >Rs 1,600 crore (FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jumped to 24.2% on 42% volume growth and utilisation near 65%, but management is capex-raising (Rs 125cr to Rs 250cr), working capital stress surfaced in Q&A, and guidance is loosely quantified.

name: Varroc Engineering Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 20-25% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~30% YoY to INR2,634 crore but EBITDA margin fell to 8.5% from 9.5% on war-related costs and low-margin tooling; management guides 20-25% FY27 growth as an "ambition", not guidance.

name: Sky Gold And Diamonds Ltd
gLine: Advance Gold share: 15% FY27, 20% FY28, 25% FY29, 30% FY30 (FY27-FY30)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,013 cr (+78% YoY) and gross margin 9.3%, but utilisation is only ~55-60% with capacity added only after 2028, and management declined to revise FY27 guidance until after Diwali.

name: Manorama Industries Ltd
gLine: Fractionation utilisation FY27: ~80% (management internal target 80-85%) on 52,000 t (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +39.5% YoY to INR 404 cr, volume-led (~85% YoY volume growth); utilisation guided ~80% on 52,000 t capacity after 4,500 t debottleneck due Q3, while management declined to quantify most numbers.

name: Affle 3I Ltd
gLine: Larger M&A closing: early 2027 (early 2027)
thesis: Affle Q1 FY27 revenue up 20.4% y-o-y to INR 7.47bn with EBITDA margin flat at 22.4%; no capacity signals, and management guides ~20% organic growth with a large M&A targeted for early 2027.

name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd
gLine: O&M revenue: INR400 crores to INR450 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR1,590 crores (down YoY and QoQ) as new orders slipped; UOV hit a record INR13,000 crores, but domestic awards only INR6,400 crores vs ~INR20,000 crores expected, and FY27 growth guide cut to 10-15%.
top: Q1 revenue INR1,590 crores, down YoY

name: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: >60% YoY (potential) (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR115.41 cr (+138% YoY) and ~64% EBITDA margin on dredging spillover; management guides FY27 growth above 60% from 30-40%, but Q1 margins are called non-repeatable and the order book is mostly charter.
top: Dredging order book INR750 → INR240 cr

name: United Foodbrands Ltd
thesis: Restaurant demand is volume-led with SSSG 28.7% and no price hikes, but no supply discipline signal: 300-store target and capex of INR140 crores imply continued expansion, and the company is a restaurant operator, not a supply-constrained industry.

name: Deep Industries Ltd
gLine: Standalone revenue growth FY27: 18-20% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR278.92 cr (+40% YoY), EBITDA margin 43.6%, order book INR3,047 cr; growth hinges on PEC ramp from H2 and offshore fleet adds, with capex only against firm orders.

name: Krsnaa Diagnostics Ltd
gLine: EBITDA positive: Q2 FY27
thesis: Krsnaa Q1 FY27 revenue up 22% to INR2,355m but EBITDA margin fell to 25% from 27% on Rajasthan ramp costs; management guides EBITDA-positive by Q2 with no hard numeric margin guidance, and receivables from Himachal and Karnataka remain uncollected.

name: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd
gLine: Deposit growth: 18% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 total business up 23% to ₹1,21,715 cr and record net profit ₹412 cr, but growth is gold-led and funded by term deposits, with CASA down 2.95% QoQ and FY guidance raised.

name: Ksolves India Ltd
gLine: FY28 guidance: to be revisited (March 2027)
thesis: Revenue fell 3.7% QoQ to Rs 41.4 cr after two large T&M clients cut headcount and guidance was withdrawn; margin guided 25–30% holds, with EBITDA at 30.3% and revenue growth now capped at 4–5% for FY27.

name: Yatra Online Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 gross bookings up 17% to INR21,007m but adjusted EBITDA fell 39% to INR151m (12.3% of gross margin) on MICE disruption and Kanoo cost build; management gives no FY27 guidance and expects only a H2 recovery.

name: Max Estates Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 pre-sales Rs 1,100 cr (5x YoY) with Rs 13,500 cr contracted portfolio, but management withdrew sales guidance and consol PBT was only Rs 11 cr, so the read is cash-backed pipeline rather than hard earnings.

name: ASK Automotive Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: high-teens (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +52% headline but only ~25% ex alloy pass-through and wheel-assembly exit; EBITDA Rs 164 cr at 12% margin, capex raised to ~Rs 700 cr with debt rising.

name: Jana Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: Cost of funds: 7.3% to 7.4% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT Rs155 crore with NIM 7.5% and credit cost 0.45%, but MFI stress is easing rather than gone; cost of funds guided flat at 7.4% and deposit growth flat QoQ.

name: J.G.Chemicals Ltd
gLine: Dahej EBITDA margin (consolidated target): 14-15% (FY29)
thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR315.7 cr (+44.8% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.5%, with utilisation in early 80s and Dahej capacity (15-17k t Phase 1) slipping to November; part of margin tied to inventory gains.

name: Popular Vehicles and Services Ltd
gLine: Revenue FY27: INR8,200-8,300 crores (~20-25% growth)
thesis: Dealership (auto retail) with reported revenue +44% to INR1,890 cr and EBITDA margin 3.8%; organic growth strong but no supply discipline signal, and capacity/acquisition growth is debt-funded with PAT still marginal.

name: Stanley Lifestyles Ltd
gLine: Same-store growth for mature stores: 15% to 20% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR 9,935 lakhs from 10,861 (about -8.5%) on B2B freight disruption and delayed residential handovers; utilisation 68-70% and store network being reshaped, with no capacity addition signalled.

name: Jungle Camps India Ltd
gLine: Mathura hotel opening: FY28 (FY28)
thesis: Small wildlife-camp operator with flat-ish ADR (+5% YoY) and occupancy 45% in Q1 FY27; EBITDA fell to 27% from 32% and growth depends on debt-funded Mathura and Sheopur projects, a weak supply-side signal.
top: New capacity debt-funded: ₹32 cr HDFC loan

name: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Ltd
gLine: Gross block by end FY27: approximately double current (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR108 cr (+71% YoY) with 58% plant utilisation, yet management is pulling capex forward and gross block to double by FY27 on Saudi JV, aerospace qualifications and Hobel; supply is expanding ahead of confirmed demand.
top: Capex pulled forward; gross block ~2x by FY27

name: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Ltd
gLine: Peak revenue FY28: exceeding 1100 crore (FY28)
thesis: Q1 FY27 profit spike (PAT +79% to ₹18.57 cr) is partly one-off: management says ~50% came from inventory gains and called the quarter "special"; R32 plant slipped from Dec-26 target and FY27 contribution cut from ₹250 cr, with new equity/debt raise now under consideration.

name: Network People Services Technologies Ltd
gLine: International revenue share: around 50% in about 2 years
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue about INR 61.4 crore, down quarter-on-quarter from about INR 68 crore, yet management reiterated 60-70% annual growth and about 30% EBITDA margin with no numbers on supply or capex.
top: Q1 revenue down QoQ to INR 61.42 crore

name: Digitide Solutions Ltd
gLine: Normalised quarterly D&A: INR55-57 cr per quarter
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR775 cr (+5.3% YoY, -3.1% QoQ), EBITDA margin 9.9% with TCV down to INR205 cr; management self-selecting out of low-margin accounts and targeting 200 bps margin expansion in FY27.

name: Crizac Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 4% YoY to INR2,012m on a less favourable university mix despite enrolments up 15%; management now guides FY27 flat with FY26 after Q2 hit, versus earlier 15-17% growth view.

name: Laxmi India Finance Ltd
gLine: ROA: 3.5% to 3.75% target (end of FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 NBFC print strong on margin (NIM 11.36%, cost of borrowing 10.66%) but credit cost rose to 0.95% from 0.58%, driven by vehicle finance and a 10% extra provision on up-money cases; PAT +70% YoY.

name: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Ltd
thesis: Ayurveda hospital and products operator reports 29% YoY revenue growth and 41% EBITDA margin, but management's answers were evasive on the revenue-to-volume gap, with ~INR14cr other income and ~INR7cr one-offs flattering PAT.

name: JSW Cement Ltd
gLine: North EBITDA breakeven: Q2 FY27 at EBITDA level (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes up 15% to 3.81Mt with North ramp, but consolidated EBITDA fell 7.5% YoY to INR299cr on fuel costs and INR33cr North marketing; North utilisation 55%, company guides high-teens FY27 volume growth.
top: GGBS growth cut to high single digits

name: Vikram Solar Ltd
gLine: DCR volume growth: 2 to 2.5x every quarter
thesis: Q1 FY27 volume record 1,006 MW but EBITDA margin fell to 8.06% (INR1.25/W) as non-DCR pricing failed to pass through costs; management withdrew FY27 guidance pending H1 results.

name: Anand Rathi Share And Stock Brokers Ltd
gLine: MTF book by FY27 end: ₹1,750-1,800 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 22% YoY to ₹2,461m and PAT pre-exceptional up 71% to ₹391m, but a ₹210m fraud restoration charge cut reported PAT growth to 2.35%; MTF book ₹13,318m up 55%.

name: SKF India (Industrial) Ltd
gLine: Underlying margin after one-offs: around 12%
thesis: Q1 FY27 sales Rs9,708m (+18.3% YoY on assumed comparison, +2.6% QoQ) but PBT margin ~9% on FX loss (~Rs147m) and ~Rs150m demerger IT costs; management guides 12% underlying and capacity-constrained until new Pune plant in 2028.
top: Capex INR900-950cr for new Pune plant

name: Capillary Technologies India Ltd
gLine: Organic growth FY27: ~17% full-year organic after ~6% FX (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR256 crore (+43% reported, ~17% organic, ~6% FX) and adjusted EBITDA INR44 crore (~17%); no capacity or capex signal, so the read rests on NRR 111%, new ACV and margin mix.

name: Excelsoft Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR350-360 crore
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR802.63m with EBITDA margin down to 16.24% from 18.02%; management guides 24-25% FY27 EBITDA margin, a cut from the earlier ~30% view, and FY27 revenue of INR350-360 crore.

name: Navneet Education Ltd
gLine: Domestic Stationery revenue growth FY27: 15-17% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue slipped to Rs 785 cr on late state textbook release; management guides Publication growth ~10% and Export Stationery -5%, with 26% domestic stationery growth offset by a 30%-utilised polymer plant and margin pressure.

name: TeamLease Services Ltd
gLine: Staffing EBITDA margin: Flat for Q1-Q2, expansion from Q3-Q4 (FY27)
thesis: Staffing volume growth has slowed to mid-single digits with business EBITDA up 18% YoY but group EBITDA only up 3% on higher corporate cost; management guided no EBITDA margin expansion until Q3 and dropped FY27 20% EBITDA growth confidence.

name: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Ltd
gLine: FY28-29 revenue growth: more than 10% YoY; EBITDA margin closer to 25-26% (FY28-FY29)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 4% to INR 6,776m and EBITDA to INR 600m on a deferred order; management guides single-digit FY27 growth, with capacity utilisation and capex not discussed.

name: Go Digit General Insurance Ltd
thesis: Go Digit chose profitability over growth: GWP down 8% (about -2% ex inward health/crop), motor OD loss ratio rising, combined ratio 107.2% with DAC, and management declined to give guidance.

name: ZEN Technologies Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to Rs141.6 Cr (down 11% YoY) and order book net-shrank to Rs1,239 Cr; management blames demand timing, with simulator tenders still pending and no capacity signals.

name: Fino Payments Bank Ltd
gLine: Net interest margin for SFB: 8% to 9% (post-SFB)
thesis: Q1 FY27 was weak: EBITDA fell to INR 43.1 crores from INR 56 crores in Q4 FY26 after the UPI P2M B2B pause, with throughput down 10% year-on-year and no B2B relaunch before Q4 FY27.

name: Anthem Biosciences Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: ~Rs 700 crore
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue soft with Unit 2 utilisation near 50% and customer deferrals; management keeps full-year growth "intact" without a number, while Unit 4 (Rs 1,200 cr) adds capacity ahead of demand.

name: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd_DVR
gLine: Hi-Tech revenue growth FY27: double digit (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue about flat near Rs 1,500 crore but EBITDA fell on lost fixed-cost absorption; NCD repayments of about Rs 680 crore due in FY27 hinge on refinancing and internal accruals.

name: Jindal Drilling & Industries Ltd
gLine: Pioneer refurbishment completion and deployment: completion by first week of September; deployment in October 2026
thesis: Offshore jack-up contractor faces H2 FY27 revenue decline as three of six rigs dehire with 4-6 month refurbishment gaps; new ONGC contract at ~INR45 lakh/day fixed, well below the $62k bid, and redeployment of the other three is unconfirmed.

name: Orient Green Power Company Ltd
gLine: Quarterly interest cost: around Rs. 13 crores per quarter
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue down 7% to Rs 81.43 cr and EBITDA down 9% to Rs 60.01 cr on weak wind; management guides FY27 only "equal to or better than last year" and 1 GW plan has no funding yet.
top: Q1 wind availability weak, revenue down 7%

name: India Pesticides Ltd
gLine: FY27 top-line growth: lower single-digit growth (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 9.2% to INR 256 crore on a ~13% volume drop, with inventory building to ~200 days and FY27 top-line guided only to lower single-digit growth.

name: Dhanuka Agritech Ltd
gLine: Dahej FY27 revenue: Rs 65 cr (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 12.56% to Rs 461.93 cr on weak monsoon and price reversal; management cut FY27 guidance to small single-digit growth and no supply cut, with Rs 200 cr Nagpur plant adding capacity.
top: FY27 guidance cut to single-digit growth

name: Solex Energy Ltd
gLine: FY27 module utilisation assumption: around 55% (FY27)
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 1.8% to INR265.6 crore and PAT margin fell to 3.1% as ALMM-2 delays pushed module offtake into H2; FY27 guidance held at 5-6% PAT margin with 55% utilisation assumed.

name: SRG Housing Finance Ltd
gLine: Business recovery: Q2 slowdown, Q3 and Q4 good
thesis: Management denies a Rs 400 crore siphoning report and says NHB red-flagged the account with no reasons given; disbursements slowed, credit rating under watch, and no audit findings disclosed on a Rs 1,100 crore book.
top: NHB red flag on account, reasons undisclosed

name: Yash Highvoltage Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue invoicing: INR360-400 crore (FY27)
thesis: Transformer bushing maker guides FY26 EBITDA margin held near 24-25% and FY27 revenue of INR360-400 crore on a 15,000-bushing capacity, with utilisation of 75-80% in FY26 and 65-70% guided for FY27.

name: Stove Kraft Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: upwards of 15% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 32.4% to INR414.5 cr on induction and small-appliance surge, but EBITDA margin only 9.5% and management leans on unquantified capacity and margin promises; capex cycle largely complete.

name: Afcom Holdings Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: minimum double FY26 (conservative) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR191.88 cr (+87.8% YoY) on two-aircraft dry-lease fleet with charter-driven yields; FY26 PAT INR121.90 cr, but FY27 growth hinges on unproven 777 induction and fuel pass-through.

name: Sanathan Textiles Ltd
gLine: Punjab revenue FY27 (from Q2 onwards): ~INR 2,600 crores (FY27)
