thesis: Consolidated Q4 EBITDA ₹94.4 cr at 8.1% margin as Punjab ramps, but FY27 target of >₹500 cr EBITDA implies a big step-up; Phase 2 capex (end-FY27) and high working-capital build make execution the key test.

name: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Ltd
gLine: Tire-crush capacity: 235,000 tons per annum by FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Tinna expanding tire-crush capacity 9% to 185,000 t with a 235,000 t target by FY27 and ~INR100 cr capex over FY27-28, while margins held at ~17% and FY27 revenue guided up 20-25%.

name: JSW Energy Ltd
gLine: RE capacity addition FY27: ~3 GW (35-40% wind) (FY27)
thesis: Capacity 13.45 GW after 2.6 GW added in FY26, with ~3 GW RE additions guided for FY27 and 14 GW under construction; Q4 EBITDA up 72% YoY to ₹2,602 crore, but commissioning delays and curtailment remain the swing factor.

name: Awfis Space Solutions Ltd
gLine: Coworking & allied revenue growth FY27: 25% to 27% (FY27)
thesis: Awfis FY26 coworking revenue +35% to INR1,237 cr with EBITDA margin 36.8%, but seat adds fell to ~22k net from 30k gross and guidance is now a 22-25k gross seat target with capex flat, so supply discipline is strong but growth is slowing.

name: Asahi Songwon Colors Ltd
gLine: Blue EBITDA run-rate: Rs 50-55 crore standalone EBITDA peak (analyst-framed, management 'goal')
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin jumped to 15.6% (from 8.58% in Q3) on price pass-through and partly one-off gains, while FY26 revenue fell 4.78% to Rs 535 crore; capacity discipline is stated but no new capex is planned for Blue.

name: Borosil Renewables Ltd
gLine: Rooftop solar first-year sales: INR75 crores (first year)
thesis: Solar glass pricing near peak at ~INR150/mm with supply gap; new 600 TPD furnaces targeted in FY27 (+60% capacity), but Q4 sales flattered by Ind AS timing and management guides run-rate ~INR400-410 cr/quarter.

name: Finkurve Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Co-lending share of AUM: 20% by year end (FY27)
thesis: Gold loan NBFC grew AUM 149% YoY to INR 1,096 crore with 0.13% GNPA, but cost of borrowing is held at about 11.2% with no capex or pricing disclosure beyond branch rollout.

name: NGL Fine Chem Ltd
gLine: Phase-II capex: ₹210 cr total (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue up 57% YoY to ₹149.23 cr with EBITDA margin 14.35%, but Phase-II commissioning slipped to early Q2 FY27 and margins are only partially price-recovered; China pricing is turning.

name: Seamec Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~15% (FY27)
thesis: Seamec's FY26 record year (consol revenue Rs1,000cr, +47%; EBITDA Rs447cr) rests on DSV charters, but management guides ~15% FY27 growth with 40-42% margins, Paladin idle and no fleet capex beyond ANANT (~$70m).
top: Paladin idle in Dubai, Q4 and Q1 lost

name: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd
gLine: Debt reduction FY27: Rs 400-500 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 28% YoY to Rs 1,216.78 cr with EBITDA margin 17.1%, but forging utilisation near 70% and management guides capex only Rs 300-400 cr with Rs 400-500 cr debt cut in FY27.
top: FY27 capex capped at Rs 400 cr

name: MTAR Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 80%+ (±5%) (FY27)
thesis: MTAR guides FY27 revenue growth to 80%+ (±5%) and EBITDA margin ~24%, backed by INR250-300 crore two-year capex and a clean-energy build-out; margin delivery is the unproven leg after FY26 margin slipped to 19.5%.

name: Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem Ltd
gLine: SDA revenue FY27: INR250-300 crore, growth at least 20% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 214% YoY to INR281m (~21% margin) with management holding FY27 guidance of ~25% revenue growth and 20-22% EBITDA margin; capacity is still bottlenecked at ~80-85% utilisation, with Jolva capex only from FY28.

name: S.J.S. Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Export share of consolidated revenue: 14% to 15% by FY28 (FY28)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR2,601.2m (+29.7% Y-o-Y) with EBITDA margin 30.3%; capacity additions are in commissioning and the company guides 1.5x–2x industry growth for FY27, with capex of about INR260–270 crore over three years.

name: Atlanta Electricals Ltd
gLine: Vadod utilisation: 65% in FY27, 100% in FY28 (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 81.7% YoY to INR747.6 cr with EBITDA margin near 20%, but Vadod ran at ~39% utilisation and management is preparing a capex-led EHV build-out with working-capital needs rising to 80-90 days.

name: Jindal Steel Ltd
gLine: Production FY27: 11–11.5 Mt (FY27)
thesis: Capacity ramp to 15.6 Mt with capex program essentially finished; FY27 guide 11–11.5 Mt production, Q4 ASP up ₹4,743/t sequentially, but value-added mix fell and Australia written down ₹1,433 cr.

name: PVR Inox Ltd
gLine: FY27 gross screen additions: over 100 screens (120 visibility) (FY27)
thesis: PVR INOX shifted to capital-light expansion with net debt cut to INR161 crores and FY26 FCF of INR790 crores; FY27 capex guided INR375-400 crores, 120+ screens planned, occupancy 26.2% FY26.
top: Net debt INR161 crores; gross debt to INR500 crores

name: Veranda Learning Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: approximately INR 670 crores (FY27)
thesis: Education company (not a capital-cycle business) posts FY26 PAT of INR 130 crores vs loss of INR 252 crores, with FY27 guidance of INR 670 crores revenue and INR 144 crores PAT; capacity build-out is opex-led and the commerce demerger is pending.

name: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd
gLine: Operating EBITDA FY27: INR700 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue Rs1,477 cr (+56% YoY) and FY26 operating EBITDA Rs545 cr at 11.3%, but FY27 margin guided down to 10.5–11% and PCB capex of ~Rs800 cr adds a supply-side build-out.

name: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd
gLine: Commissioning of generation capacity FY27: 1.5 GW (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up 59% to INR2,507 crore with ~90% EBITDA margin, but growth is now BESS merchant arbitrage (2.3 GWh, ~INR2.2 crore/day) and capex timing is being deferred around transmission delays; no numeric prior guidance was supplied to test against.
top: Solar capex deferred until CTU ready

name: HFCL Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20% to 25% (FY27)
thesis: HFCL's Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin was 18.47% on Rs1,824 crore revenue, with management guiding to a 3-4% blended margin gain and 20-25% revenue growth for FY27, though most of this is unquantified and hinges on price rises and the NFS contract turning to AMC.

name: Lords Chloro Alkali Ltd
gLine: Capacity utilisation: 80% to 85% (next one year)
thesis: Caustic soda volumes up 29.7% to 84,690 t in FY26 with EBITDA margin 16.89%, but Q4 margin slipped to 14.03% on grid power repricing; capacity expansion to 360 TPD is on track, with 80–85% utilisation and no North India capacity additions announced.

name: GEE Ltd
gLine: Revenue CAGR: 25-30% till FY29; INR 1,000 crore by FY29-30 (FY29)
thesis: GEE's utilisation rose from 48% to about 57% with management guiding to 25–30% revenue CAGR and 10%+ EBITDA margin, but capacity additions are small and the story rests on unverified targets and a land monetisation.

name: HEG Advanced Materials Ltd
gLine: Price increase on unbooked orders in H2: Quantum undetermined; targeted for H2
thesis: Graphite electrode maker at >90% utilisation with H2 price hikes planned, but Q4 volumes fell ~1,000 t and FY27 H1 EBITDA guided only ~17–20% versus 22% prior.

name: Capri Global Capital Ltd
gLine: AUM FY28: INR57,000 crore (revised up ~INR2,000 crore) (FY28)
thesis: Capri Global's Q4 FY26 shows record PAT of INR283 crore and gross Stage 3 down to 0.9%, but the read is growth-led, with gold mix rising to 46% and a 350-branch gold expansion, so supply-side discipline is absent.

name: Kuantum Papers Ltd
gLine: Volume: 2,30,000 tons annually (medium term)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin rose to 15.9% on NSR of INR3,700/t, but management admits price hikes partly reversed in May and PM3 upgrade slipped; FY27 guided lower revenue of INR1,400-1,500 crore.
top: Price hike partly reversed in May

name: Greenlam Industries Ltd
gLine: Laminate revenue growth FY27: 10-12%
thesis: Greenlam FY26 revenue crossed INR3,046 cr (+18.6%) but PAT fell 18% to INR56 cr; laminate utilisation 86% with 2 MMSF capacity due late FY27 and management says no further capacity needed, with ~20% headroom.
top: No new capacity beyond 2 laminate lines

name: Epigral Ltd
gLine: Volume growth FY27: 10% to 12% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue record INR736 cr with utilisation above 80% and EBITDA margin 23%, but management gave no FY27 value or margin guidance and war-driven price gains are expected only in Q1.

name: Sirca Paints India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 25-30% CAGR (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue +33% and FY26 EBITDA margin 20.08% (vs 18.05%), but Sirca is pushing 2 price hikes (~10%) to offset crude-linked RM spikes, and working capital is stretched (inventory and debtors up).

name: Onesource Specialty Pharma Ltd
gLine: Second line availability: next quarter (Q2 FY27) (Q2 FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue rebounded 47% QoQ to INR4,282m on Semaglutide launches, but capacity is fully committed and a new line only comes online next quarter, with FY28 guidance of $400m and ~40% EBITDA margin reiterated.

name: ArisInfra Solutions Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 35% to 40% (FY27)
thesis: Asset-light materials platform: Contract Manufacturing utilisation 39%→50% YoY and FY26 revenue +39% to INR 1,068 cr, but Q4 EBITDA was flattered by a non-cash INR 5 cr unwinding gain and a INR 5 cr extra ECL, and PAT came off a low base.

name: Aditya Infotech Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs6,000-6,500 crore (FY27)
thesis: Own-brand share reached about 45.4% with 2.5m unit capacity and FY27 guidance raised to Rs6,000-6,500cr revenue and 14-15% EBITDA margin, but Q4's 31.8% gross margin was partly one-off low-cost inventory.

name: KSH International Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume growth: at least last year's growth rate of ~21%
thesis: Capacity-led growth: installed capacity 43,445 t rising to ~59,000 t, utilisation ~70% in Q4, EBITDA/ton ~INR 74,000 in Q4 and ~67,600 for FY26, with 65-70k guided as sustainable.

name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd-$
gLine: Net working capital days FY27: 75-80 days
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 80% to INR321 crore at 34.2% margin, driven mainly by capacity coming on stream and volumes; new capacity (R32, Chemours, Dahej debottleneck) is due in FY27 with 30% margin guided ±1-2%.
top: R32 competitor capacity ~120,000 MT by FY27

name: Inox Green Energy Services Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: ~75% over FY26 (FY27)
thesis: Inox Green's FY26 Q4 EBITDA of INR57 crores rests heavily on about INR40 crores of acquisition-linked other income; management guides FY27 EBITDA above INR600 crores contingent on pending acquisitions closing.

name: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: surpass 36% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue INR 3,416m (+47% YoY) and occupancy 71%, but group is in heavy bed expansion (3,200 beds, target 5,000) with 70% of new beds via acquisition and ramp-up losses at new hospitals.

name: Happy Forgings Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume growth: late-teen % (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 volume +20.6% and gross margin 59.4%, with 2 years of capex (~Rs.800 crores) and a Rs.950 crore order book at Rs.340-350/kg versus Rs.245/kg today; FY27 margins guided flat.

name: Diffusion Engineers Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: >20% (FY27)
thesis: Capacity-constrained niche consumables and wear-parts maker: standalone wear plates, wear parts and heavy engineering at 85-90% utilisation, new capacity from Q1 FY27 supports guided >20% growth, with margins guided up 80-100bp and debtor days (98) the watch item.

name: Krishival Foods Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~50% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue INR304.41 cr (+48%), EBITDA margin 13.78%, PAT 7.59%; nuts plant utilisation ~70% in FY26 rising to ~90%, ice cream utilisation ~25% with capacity expansion phased to Q1 FY29.

name: Shaily Engineering Plastics Ltd
gLine: Pen capacity by end FY27 / FY28: 40-60 million pens at ~30 months (FY28)
thesis: Healthcare pen-injector capacity is ramping: 25M pens added in March running ~45% efficiency, FY27 target 36M pens, while consumer fell 31% in Q4 and utilisation rose to 47.6%.

name: Steel Strips Wheels Ltd-$
gLine: EBITDA per wheel FY27: close to INR 300 (FY27)
thesis: Management guides FY27 EBITDA/wheel near INR 300 (vs INR 262 FY26 reported) and EBITDA INR 650 crore+, with INR 500 crore Bhuj capex adding aluminium capacity; utilisation target 95% is the key test.
top: Bhuj capex INR 500 crore, 2.3m units added

name: Sanghvi Movers Ltd
gLine: Crane yield: 2.1% +/- 5% deviation
thesis: Crane rental utilisation 79% and yield 2.12%/month on a 474 cr FY26 capex plan vs 639 cr planned, with 165 cr carried into FY27; KSA capex and EBITDA breakeven timing slipping with West Asia shipping disruption.
top: Fresh capex 190 cr India + 200 cr KSA

name: V2 Retail Ltd
gLine: Store additions FY27: 170-200 stores (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +60% to Rs 797 cr with SSSG 7.74% and FY26 EBITDA margin 14.9%, but management guides 50% growth with 50-60% new area, so margins stay flat and no operating leverage until FY28.

name: Godrej Properties Ltd
gLine: Residential bookings FY27: over INR39,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: Record Q4 bookings of INR10,163 crore and FY26 bookings INR34,171 crore (105% of guidance); FY27 guided to over INR39,000 crore, a 20% rise, with launch-led growth and cautious Middle East-related demand commentary.
top: FY27 bookings guided over INR39,000 crore

name: Fineotex Chemical Ltd
gLine: CCT revenue: US$200 million (FY28 (pulled forward from 2030))
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 162% to INR314 cr and PAT up 118% to INR44 cr on acquired CrudeChem (CCT); supply-side evidence thin, Ambernath utilisation only 60-62%, and management gave soft targets (US$200m by 2028, 18-20% EBITDA) without hard numbers.

name: Sportking India Ltd
gLine: Top line growth (next three quarters): 7% to 10% (next 3 quarters)
thesis: Cotton yarn spreads near 3-year highs (~$1/kg vs $0.65–0.70 prior) with Chinese demand and consolidation; management guides top line up 7–10% and QoQ margin expansion of 15–20% over next 2–3 quarters, with greenfield 150k spindles only from Q3.

name: Pritika Auto Industries Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: around 15% a year for next two years; INR600 crore medium-term revenue target (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Utilisation ~73% of 72,000 t capacity with 7,800 t added in H1 FY27; Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 12.02% on raw-material and gas cost spikes, with management guiding a return to 15-16% if the war does not disrupt further.
top: Q4 EBITDA margin 12.02% on RM spike

name: Endurance Technologies Ltd
gLine: Inverted front fork monthly sales: 75,000 by June 2026; 100,000 by end FY27
thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin 14.5% and standalone revenue up 31% YoY, but ₹73.7 crore aluminium/steel cost inflation is unrecovered and standalone margin would be 13.3% ex-impact.

name: Sansera Engineering Ltd
thesis: Q4 revenue record INR 9,987m (+28% YoY) and EBITDA margin 19.3%, but new order booking soft and capex held at ~INR 5,097m for FY27 with forging capacity the binding constraint.

name: Modis Navnirman Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: return to prior levels in FY27
thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer with revenue up 84% to INR189 cr and EBITDA margin compressed (EBITDA INR38.5 cr, ~20%); management calls margin dip temporary, with no capacity or capex discipline evidence, and debt-free.
top: Raw material cost hit on two projects

name: Aeroflex Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 total revenue growth: about 35% growth (FY27)
thesis: Aeroflex FY26 EBITDA INR99.7 crore at 22.6% margin, with skid assemblies only 5% of sales; the 15,000-unit skid expansion is targeted at 60% utilisation by March 2027, against a 2,000-to-6,000 capacity ramp that is still gated by design and customer audits.

name: Rishabh Instruments Ltd
gLine: Consolidated adjusted EBITDA FY27: INR150-160 crore (FY27)
thesis: Rishabh's FY26 margin recovery is real (consolidated EBITDA ₹1,264m, 16.3% margin), but FY27 guidance is EEI 20-25% growth at 20-22% margin and Alucast revenue below ₹200cr with no loss, while capacity is doubling at Nashik.

name: R R Kabel Ltd
gLine: FMEG value growth: 20%-25% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue +33.7% to INR2,964 cr with volume only ~10% and price-led growth; inventory days rose ~8 and April demand called "normal" despite Middle East disruption and capex of INR1,200 cr FY26-28 still rising.

name: Platinum Industries Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: >40% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue INR 132 cr (+37% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.6%, but FY27 guidance of 40%+ growth rests on a new Palghar CPVC additive line and an Egypt plant starting Q3 FY27, with capacity and utilisation largely undisclosed.

name: Shree Refrigerations Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 20% to 24% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue roughly 50%+ higher with H2 EBITDA margin 26.3% on operating leverage, but a 250-day receivables and 370-day working capital cycle still tie up cash; FY27 guidance is 20-24% EBITDA margin.

name: DSM Fresh Foods Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 70-80% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up ~69% to ~INR 221 crore with EBITDA ~INR 31 crore, but H2 EBITDA margin fell to 13% from 17% on B2B mix shift; FY27 revenue growth target 70-80% is unquantified in profit terms.

name: Shadowfax Technologies Ltd
gLine: Hyperlocal growth: 45% to 50% (FY27)
thesis: Shadowfax grew FY26 revenue 69% to INR 4,200 crores+ with adjusted EBITDA near INR 159 crores, but management is raising capex and guiding 100–120 bps margin gains to FY28 with no supply discipline evidence.

name: Hero MotoCorp Ltd
gLine: Industry volume growth FY27: high single digit (FY27)
thesis: Hero FY26 record year (EBITDA ₹6,871 cr, +17%) but commodity shock from March: ₹2,000/unit cost inflation vs ~2% price hike, medium-term 14-16% margin guide held without FY27 number.

name: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd
gLine: Birla Tyres top line: INR 3,000 crore in next 4 years (4 years)
thesis: Record Q4 and FY26 with consolidated PAT INR 755 crore (+36%), but supply additions are company-led (70,000 t carbon black, LFP and anode capex) and no FY27 numeric guidance was given.

name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
gLine: Exit savings run rate: $200 million (FY26 exit)
thesis: Hindalco's India aluminium upstream EBITDA of $1,756/t and record copper EBITDA of INR907 cr ride on a West Asia supply shock, but management expects copper to fall back to INR600-700 cr a quarter and India capex to rise to INR12,000 cr in FY27.

name: Shalibhadra Finance Ltd
gLine: AUM: 500 crores by FY29 (FY29)
thesis: Rural two-wheeler lender guiding AUM 220cr to 500cr by FY29 with branch expansion, while ROA is guided down from 8.65% to about 7% and yields fell from 25.4% to 20.8%.

name: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Paracetamol utilisation on new 10,800 MT plant: 70-75% in FY27; full in FY28 (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 17.4% to INR619 cr and EBITDA margin 15.2% on price uptick and utilisation near 90%; management guides FY27 mid-teens growth and 14-14.5% EBITDA margin, with a 100-acre greenfield site and INR1,200-1,400 cr outlay.

name: KDDL Ltd-$
gLine: Watch components growth (medium term): slightly below 25% CAGR; 11-12% dials growth
thesis: Standalone Q4 EBITDA margin hit 25.1% and FY26 revenue rose 31.9% to INR506 crores, but management gave no volume data, flagged a currency-driven margin tailwind, and guided margins flat; bracelet utilisation is 75-80%.

name: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Ltd
gLine: Lead volume FY27: 125,000-130,000 t (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 with EBITDA ₹218 cr (7.4% margin) and PAT ₹139 cr, but copper cathode capex (₹200 cr, Dec-26 Phase 1) is funded from internal accruals against negative operating cash flow from ₹265 cr receivables.

name: Nitin Spinners Ltd
gLine: Revenue uplift from new capacity and yarn normalisation: 30% to 35% over existing revenue (post capex)
thesis: Yarn spread up to ~INR120-125/kg from ~INR110 with spinning at 98%+ utilisation and ~INR1,100 crore capex (fabric +35m m, spinning +22k t) commissioning H2 FY27 — supply adds ahead, demand and spreads firm.

name: Solar Industries India Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR14,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Record Q4 FY26 revenue INR3,053 cr and EBITDA margin ~28.5% led by defence (INR1,008 cr, +134%); FY27 guide INR14,000 cr revenue at current margins, with working capital days rising to build inventory.

name: Gallantt Ispat Ltd
gLine: Revenue after INR 3,000 cr capex: INR 5,300-5,400 crore (post-expansion)
thesis: FY26 volume growth only 1.7% and revenue up 3.95%; EBITDA/ton rose to INR 8,785 from 8,300, but management offers no capacity utilisation data beyond 88% and no peer capacity commentary, with 1.0→1.3 Mt expansion and INR 3,000 cr capex underway.

name: Godawari Power and Ispat Ltd
thesis: Captive iron ore and pellet ramp (new 2 Mt pellet plant at 70%, pellet capacity 4.7 Mt) drove Q4 EBITDA up 91% QoQ to INR 439 cr, but FY27 mining guidance was cut to 3.4 Mt usable ore from ~4.5-5 Mt.

name: Skipper Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% (FY27)
thesis: Record Q4 and FY26 with order book INR8,502 cr and utilisation above 85%, but FY27 revenue guided only 15% (vs 20-25% historically) as bidding slipped on transformer/HVDC and ROW constraints.

name: Monte Carlo Fashions Ltd
gLine: Home textile share of revenue: 13% to 14% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 36% to ~INR280 cr with EBITDA margin 9.2% on lower discounts and summer mix, but no FY27 numeric guidance until Q2; inventory days fell to 144 from 169, and returns rose to 17%.

name: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Ltd
gLine: FY27 capacity utilisation: ~95% of 11,000 MT (10,200-10,400 MT) (FY27)
thesis: Capacity jumped 6,500→11,000 MT (+69%) with FY27 utilisation guided at ~95%, but FDC phase 2 is pushed to FY29-30 and management flagged possible ECB-only funding for it.

name: Rossari Biotech Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: at least 15% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 record revenue (Rs 684.9 cr, +18% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 11.3% and management guided FY27 margins flat at 12–13%, with capex cut to Rs 50–75 cr from Rs 192 cr plan.
top: Capex rephased Rs 192 cr → Rs 50–75 cr FY27

name: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd
gLine: New showroom openings FY27: 150 across Kalyan, Candere and regional brand
thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue up 66% to INR10,275 crores and PAT up 118% to INR410 crores, with India PBT margin held at 5.5-5.6% and non-GML debt heading to zero in FY27.

name: United Foodbrands Ltd
gLine: Pre-Ind AS adjusted operating EBITDA margin FY27: 9% to 10% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 SSSG 14.4% volume-led with 43% dine-in growth, but gross margin fell ~300bps to 65.5% and pre-Ind AS restaurant margin flat at 12.6%; capacity expansion is 15% a year, not capped.

name: Kross Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~22% (subject to demand) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue +22% YoY to INR 225.4 cr with EBITDA margin 14.9%, but a ~5% steel/commodity pass-through lags one quarter, so Q1 margin pressure is flagged; capex shifts to seamless tube (~INR 100 cr FY27).
top: Extruded axle plant demand exceeds supply

name: Senores Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 30% to 40% (FY27)
thesis: FY27 guided to 30-40% revenue and 50-60% PAT growth with EBITDA margin held at 29-31%, plus Apnar plant ramp to INR80-100 crore; supply additions are real but management gave no capacity-discipline evidence.

name: SKF India (Industrial) Ltd
gLine: EBITDA/PBT margin: ~13% near term; ~15% by FY29-30; 16-18% aspiration (FY29-30)
thesis: Q4 FY26 sales up 9.8% QoQ to INR 9.5bn with OEM mix rising to 50% and margin ex one-offs at 11.5% (down from 13.1%), guided back to ~13% near term and ~15% by FY29-30 with ~INR 800 crore capex, new Pune plant by end-2028.

name: Piramal Finance Ltd
gLine: Total AUM growth FY27: ~25% (FY27)
thesis: Piramal Finance Q4 FY26: Growth RoAUM rose to 2.1% (from 1.7% a year ago) with AUM up 25% and FY27 guidance of ~25% AUM growth and ~2.5% exit RoAUM; capital consumption only 50 bps in the quarter.

name: Gabion Technologies India Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR200 crores (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up only 14% to INR115.6 cr with H2 margin 15.9% helped by services mix; capacity doubling to 18,000 t by Sep-26 and FY27 target INR200 cr, but working capital tripled inventory and management's answers on raw-material pass-through were loose.
top: Inventory INR13 cr → INR35 cr since FY24

name: Hindustan Zinc Ltd
gLine: Zinc COP excl. royalty FY27: $975–1,000/t (FY27)
thesis: Record Q4 zinc cost of $903/t and 315 KT mined output drove EBITDA margin to 57%, but silver-led profit is commodity-driven and FY27 COP guidance rose to $975–1,000 with capex of $500–600M.

name: Shree Cement Ltd
gLine: Full-year FY27 cement volume: about 40 million tons (FY27)
thesis: Shree Cement's Q4 FY26 volume rose 11% YoY, but utilisation at 66% and planned capex cut to ~INR1,500 crore for FY27 point to a supply-side slowdown while management pivots to chasing volume.

name: Tata Consumer Products Ltd
gLine: A&P to sales: 7.5% to 8.5% (going forward)
thesis: Q4 consolidated revenue +18% with EBITDA +27% and margin +100 bps to 14.6%; management guides 50–75 bps FY27 margin expansion and 30% growth-business growth, while flagging A&P stepping up to 7.5–8.5%.

name: EFC (I) Ltd
gLine: Design & Build revenue growth: ~40% (FY27)
thesis: Flexible-workspace operator with strong FY26 growth (revenue +58%, PAT +67%), but working-capital build and right-issue funding raise cash-conversion questions; no capacity cut, capex stated as light.
top: Working capital build in receivables, inventory

name: Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd
gLine: Iron ore production FY27: 26 million tons (FY27)
thesis: Iron ore volume doubled to 22Mt with pellet plant at 100% utilisation and FY27 guided to 26Mt ore, 7.75-8Mt pellets; capex still rising to ~INR15,000 crore consolidated, with 49% Chemaf debt consolidated.

name: KEI Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: 10.5-11% (FY27)
thesis: Capacity-led volume ramp: FY27 volume guided +17-18% from Sanand and Chinchpada, with Q4 volume only ~2% due to capacity constraint and Sanand delayed six months.

name: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd-$
gLine: Capex: INR 300 cr for global plant; ~INR 50 cr this year for India coating line
thesis: Mayur Uniquoters Q4 FY26 standalone PAT up 73% to INR 60.71 cr on export mix and FX gain, but margin sustainability is hedged and FX-aided; capacity add is a single coating line of ~5 lakh meters/month.

name: Puravankara Ltd
gLine: Presales FY27: INR11,200 crores (FY27)
thesis: Presales hit record INR7,407 crores (+55%) with Q4 at INR3,547 crores, but collections lag and interest cost rose to about INR600 crores while net debt is INR2,321 crores; FY27 targets INR11,200 crores presales and INR750 crores debt cut.

name: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd
gLine: FY27 ferrochrome output: about 400,000 tons (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT rose to INR103 crore from INR47 crore on realisation of ~INR109,000/t vs ~INR87,000/t; KNR 1 and 2 ramp to ~400,000 t in FY27 with management guiding Q1 FY27 prices firmer and sales ~80,000 t.

name: Globus Spirits Ltd
gLine: Bulk volume: well over 20 crore litres (FY27)
thesis: Globus Q4 FY26: bulk EBITDA INR8.3/l and 80% utilisation, but Q4 volume dented by ENA inventory build; capacity now 334 MLPA with no fundraise needed, net debt INR627 cr.
top: Q4 ENA inventory build, liquidates Q1

name: Protean eGov Technologies Ltd
gLine: ASK full rollout: all 190 centres live by September-October 2026 (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue INR 998 cr (+19%) and EBITDA margin 17.6%, but Q4 flattered by INR 44 cr one-off storage income; management guides ASK timing mismatch margin dip and lower revenue next year.
top: Storage income INR 44 cr is non-recurring

name: Gala Precision Engineering Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: 20-25% overall; wind fasteners 25-30% short term
thesis: Chennai fastener plant ramping from ~35% utilisation toward INR80cr FY27 (67-70% of INR120cr capacity) while Phase 2 adds capacity; margins dipped to 16.5% on INR3.23cr forex loss, with price pass-through lag.

name: Arkade Developers Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 27-28% stabilised; ~25% also cited
thesis: Real estate developer; FY26 pre-sales Rs 901 cr (+17%) and Q4 pre-sales Rs 303 cr (+40%), but PAT only Rs 5 cr after Rs 182 cr one-off tenancy-rights write-off; no supply or capacity discipline evidence.
top: PAT Rs 5 cr after Rs 182 cr write-off

name: Shanti Gold International Ltd
gLine: Volume growth FY27: 30% to 40% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue up 121.65% to INR 658.93 cr on gold price and outright gold buys; management guides 4% core PAT margin with capacity rising to ~7,900 kg, but FY26 PAT was helped by inventory gains.

name: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd
gLine: FY27 pre-sales: INR1,800–2,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Luxury Mumbai developer reports Q4 pre-sales INR462 cr (+177% YoY) and FY27 pre-sales guidance of INR1,800–2,000 cr, but collections (INR82 cr vs INR308 cr revenue) lag and all four new launches are still in basement.
top: Collections INR82 cr vs revenue INR308 cr

name: Vikran Engineering Ltd
thesis: Vikran is an EPC contractor pivoting to solar, with FY26 revenue of INR1,249 crore and EBITDA margin near 14%, while operating cash flow stays negative and receivables reached about INR1,000 crore.

name: WeWork India Management Ltd
gLine: Operating seats by March 2027: ~155,000 desks (10.3-10.4 million sq ft) (FY27)
thesis: Flex operator filling faster than it builds: occupancy 86.9% (from 76.8%) with ~28,000 new seats in FY27 at 'similar or slightly higher' margins, but capex guided up to INR500-600 crores versus INR456 crores spent.

name: Msafe Equipments Ltd
gLine: Revenue CAGR: approximately 50% (FY27 onward)
thesis: Msafe's FY26 revenue rose about 45% to Rs 103.5 crore with 39.5% EBITDA margin, but management guides to lower-margin steel and formwork mix and rising debt, and its rental yields and utilisation claims are unaudited on the call.
top: FY27 capex ~Rs 130 crore, debt to rise

name: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Ltd
gLine: Same-store sales growth (SIS): 25-30% p.a. (FY27-28)
thesis: Branded diamond jewellery grew revenue 70% to INR439 crore in FY26 with 28% gross margin, but growth is largely gold-price driven (~INR55-60 crore surplus gold) and guidance of 25-30% is tied to gold prices, not capacity discipline.
top: FY26 SSG ~40% on gold price spike

name: Permanent Magnets Ltd-$
gLine: Relays commercial ramp-up: from H2 FY27; INR 25-50 crore revenue in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Permanent Magnets' FY26 growth rested on a new Alloys furnace and Relays/rare-earth lines that slipped; Relays commercial ramp moved to H2 FY27 and rare-earth revenue was nil in FY26, so FY27 guidance of 20-30% growth is unproven.
top: Relays ramp slips to H2 FY27

name: Tilaknagar Industries Ltd-$
gLine: Combined volume growth FY27: high-single digit to low-double digit (FY27)
thesis: Volumes up 135% in Q4 on Imperial Blue acquisition, but growth is acquisition-driven; ex-IB Q4 volume flat and utilisation/capacity signals are thin, with FY27 guidance of HSD-LDD volume growth and 16-18% EBITDA margin over 24-36 months.

name: Vinati Organics Ltd-$
gLine: ATBS volume growth: ~15% p.a. for next 3 years
thesis: Q4 volumes softened from October 2025; management guides ~15% company volume growth in FY27 and capex of INR200-250 crores, while ATBS utilisation is only ~75-80% and AO revenue grew ~5% in FY26 against Chinese undercutting.

name: Piccadily Agro Industries Ltd
gLine: Alco-Bev revenue growth FY27: 60% to 70% (FY27)
thesis: Piccadily guides FY27 Alco-Bev growth of 60-70% value on 450 KLPD capacity, but Q4 IMFL-led growth relies on capacity just added, with short-term borrowings up 132% and DSO near 90 days.

name: NRB Bearings Ltd
gLine: International business growth FY27: 10-14%, maybe 15% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin 19.5% and FY26 PAT up 77% to INR146 crore; management says reported utilisation ~85% with bottlenecks, brownfield capex of INR200 crore over 18 months, and FY27 capex closer to INR120 crore.

name: Century Plyboards (India) Ltd-$
gLine: Plywood growth FY27 planning: 10% to 12% growth, 80% utilisation planning basis (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 record revenue ₹1,492 cr (+24.5% YoY) with consolidated EBITDA margin ex-forex at 13.6%, but FY27 guidance withdrawn and chemical-driven price increases of 7–15% still unproven.

name: Regency Fincorp Ltd
gLine: Cost of funds: 11%-12% from current 13%-14% (FY27)
thesis: Small North India NBFC pivoting from JLG/unsecured to secured MSME lending; AUM up 45% to INR261.2 cr, but net NPA rose to 0.74% from 0.31% and cost of funds is 13-14%, with no supply-side or capacity signal.

name: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd
gLine: Revenue CAGR (next 3 years): 14% to 15% (3 years)
thesis: Diagnostics chain guides 14-15% revenue CAGR and 27-28% EBITDA over 3 years; FY26 organic margin 25.9% (+140bps) with capex now throughput-led, not expansion-led.
top: Capex shifts to throughput; FY26 capex INR 65 cr

name: Jubilant Ingrevia Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 record revenue Rs 1,179 crore (+12% YoY) and EBITDA Rs 172 crore, led by Specialty; supply discipline is not discussed, while acetyls spreads face a likely inventory-driven fall after Q1.
top: Agro CDMO volume visibility only for Q1

name: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 9-10% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue INR823 crore (+18%) and EBITDA margin 10.4%, but management guides only 35-40% CAGR and a 9-10% margin, with compressor capacity trimmed from 7.5m to 6m and AC capacity still ramping.

name: Jyoti CNC Automation Ltd
gLine: Huron normal revenue: INR300-350 crore standalone level (FY27)
thesis: Capacity-constrained CNC maker (utilisation above 100% in peak months) with 10,000-machine expansion due September, but Huron export-control probe reversed INR67 crore revenue and a Q4 consolidated EBITDA margin of 24.6%.

name: Standard Engineering Technology Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: better than FY26 (no number)
thesis: FY26 revenue and cash growth but Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 15.5% on metal costs and hiring, with no numeric FY27 margin guidance and export guidance slipping (5.3% vs 12-13% guided).

name: M & B Engineering Ltd
gLine: FY27 exports: ~INR300 cr / 10,000 MT (FY27)
thesis: Order book INR1,083 cr (+35% YoY) and record inflow INR1,539 cr support ~25% FY27 growth, but Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 11.9% from 14% on steel (+20%) and freight shocks, with no margin guidance given.

name: JD Cables Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 50-60% (FY27)
thesis: Capacity doubling and 50-60% FY27 growth guided, but unit utilisation is already 82-85% and operating cash flow was negative (about INR70-74 crore) as EPC pushes working capital up, with margin guided flat at 12-13%.
top: Inventory days up sharply, cash burn

name: Tata Capital Ltd
thesis: Tata Capital FY26 book grew 20% (28% ex-motor finance) with Q4 credit cost down to 0.9% and cost-to-income 38.3%; FY28 targets of 23-25% growth and ~2% ROA reiterated, but no quantified capex or supply signal.

name: Physicswallah Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: >30% (FY27)
thesis: Edtech with no physical capacity cycle; FY26 pre-Ind AS EBITDA INR300 crores (3x) and Q4 EBITDA INR9 crores vs minus INR139 crores, with FY27 guided to 30%+ revenue growth and ~100% EBITDA growth.

name: Tenneco Clean Air India Ltd
gLine: Peak volumes from new plants: mid-28 to 29 (FY28-FY29)
thesis: Q4 VAR up 17.5% to INR14,058m with EBITDA margin 18.3% and FY26 margin a record 18.8%; capacity is being added (North and West India plants, ~INR1,400m capex) but no explicit capex cut or deferral.
top: New West India shock absorber plant

name: Fujiyama Power Systems Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~50% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue Rs 9,008mn (+87.5% YoY) and FY26 EBITDA margin 18.5%, but capacity additions are ramping slowly, inventory days rose to 83 from 71, and FY27 guidance is +50% revenue with PAT margin 11-13%.

name: Finolex Cables Ltd
thesis: Electrical volumes and pricing strong (~14 upward price changes, 24-25% effective), while OFC preform capacity only just commissioned and fixed-price contracts delay benefit; FY26 segment EBIT ~6% with no guidance given.

name: Century Enka Ltd
gLine: Operating EBITDA margin: 7% to 10% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 margin jump (EBITDA margin 11.46%, +948bp YoY) rode on price pass-through and cheap inventory; management now guides operating margin 7-10% vs prior 6-8%, with capex only ~Rs 100 crore and cash piling up.

name: Vardhman Textiles Ltd
gLine: Q1 FY27 performance: Better than Q4 (qualitative)
thesis: Industry spinning capacity fell ~11-12m spindles to ~41-42m working as of the industry estimate, and yarn spreads rose to $0.90-0.95 from $0.60-0.65, though management gave no numeric Vardhman guidance.

name: Eldeco Housing & Industries Ltd
gLine: Imperia 2 revenue recognition FY27: INR 130-150 crore (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 bookings of INR 744 crore (up 120%) and a ~INR 2,000 crore GDV land addition, but Q4 margins were hit by ~INR 14 crore one-offs and revenue recognition depends on possession timing, not supply discipline.

name: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd
gLine: ROA: gradually moving strength to strength (next few quarters)
thesis: Poonawalla Fincorp's Q4FY26 shows NIM up to 9.05%, credit cost down to 2.51% and ROA 1.81%, but this is a consumer-lender credit-cost and margin story with no supply-side discipline to speak of.

name: Carysil Ltd
gLine: India revenue: INR500 crores in under 5 years (5 years)
thesis: Carysil's Q4 FY26 shows EBITDA margin 20.3% and PAT up 42%, with a 250,000-unit quartz sink expansion due Q4 FY27 and stainless capacity raised to 250,000 units, though management guides 15-20% growth and 18-20% margin.

name: Indo Borax & Chemicals Ltd-$
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20% to 35%, about Rs 250 cr+ (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 25.7% to Rs 63.01 cr with EBITDA margin 20.4%, but boric acid capacity is near peak and management gave no capex numbers, so supply-side upside is limited to debottlenecking and DOT.

name: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd
gLine: Raw material cost Q1FY27 vs Q4: up 18-20% (Q1FY27)
thesis: Supply-side expansion of ~Rs 4,980 cr for TBR/PCR (+24% capacity) on top of Rs 1,130 cr already underway, with utilisation above 90% and price hikes of 4-5% taken, with 5-6% more planned against an 18-20% raw material cost rise.

name: Sejal Glass Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: INR 500+ crore
thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin 17.5% and FY26 PAT INR 29.03 cr, but India utilisation is low (tempering 13-64%) and management guides UAE growth ~20% with FY27 India ~INR 200 cr, a plan that depends on Glasstech ramp-up.

name: Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Ltd
gLine: Keys added in FY27: >1,000 (FY27)
thesis: Holiday-club operator: standalone Q4 EBITDA margin 34.9% (+180bp) and resort utilisation ~81%, but a INR234 crore standalone impairment on Finland/HCRO and weak member-acquisition cash flow temper the read.
top: INR234 cr impairment on Finland book

name: Cantabil Retail India Ltd
gLine: Store additions: 90-100 gross, 725 stores total (FY27)
thesis: Cantabil is a debt-free, self-funded men's apparel retailer; FY26 EBITDA margin 31% and gross margin ~60%, with 91 stores opened and 725 stores targeted in FY27, but no capacity-discipline signal and no price-hike plan beyond cost pass-through.

name: TD Power Systems Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR2,400-plus crores (FY27)
thesis: Order inflow up 51% to INR22.38bn in FY26 with INR19.73bn order book; management guides FY27 revenue INR24bn-plus and says current 33-34% gross contribution margin is being hit by a one-off Turkey LD penalty.
top: Large-generator capex to be sized later

name: V-Mart Retail Ltd
gLine: Capex: INR170-180 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +24% with 12% LTL (10th straight quarter) and EBITDA +56% to INR106 cr at 10.9% margin, but gross margin fell 1% and capex is guided up to INR170-180 cr.

name: Meghna Infracon Infrastructure Ltd
gLine: Upcoming GDV pipeline: INR2,100 crore GDV
thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer with no supply-side disclosure; FY26 revenue INR46.2 cr (+15.8%) but PAT fell ~43% and operating cash flow negative, with pipeline claims unquantified by capacity or cost discipline.
top: Operating cash flow negative despite profits

name: Yasho Industries Ltd
gLine: Utilisation FY27: over 75% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 volume-led growth with utilisation above 60% in FY26 and a target of over 75% in FY27; management guides FY27 volume growth of 35-45% and FY28 revenue of INR1,500 crores, but working capital and import delays are watch items.

name: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Ltd
gLine: Top-line growth FY27: ~15% (target 20% if raw material and energy stabilise) (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 turnover INR1,208.6 cr (+12.5%) and order book INR2,290 cr, but management guides only ~15% growth and capacity is not the constraint; raw-material and energy supply are. Supply-side signals are capex-light and vague.
top: Order book INR2,290 cr at Apr-26

name: Manorama Industries Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 25%-30% growth implied; 30% volume growth plus 5%-10% price (FY27)
thesis: FY26 standalone revenue INR 1,357 cr (+76%) and 27% EBITDA margin, but capacity expansion of INR 460 cr is funded internally with inventory at INR 710 cr and a consolidated margin dip from new subsidiaries.

name: Neogen Chemicals Ltd
gLine: FY28 standalone revenue: INR 1,100 crore plus (FY28)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 22% to INR 247 crore with 17.8% EBITDA margin, but growth is volume-led while battery capex rose and the Pakhajan and Dahej start dates have slipped into FY27.
top: Pakhajan Phase 2 cost revised to INR 1,367 cr

name: Hindware Home Innovation Ltd
gLine: Bathware revenue growth FY27: 15% to 20% (FY27)
thesis: Bathware steady at 10.3% FY26 EBITDA margin with 15-20% FY27 growth guided, but pipes ran into resin spike and March supply shortfall, and Roorkee capacity is adding to a sub-par utilisation base.

name: Max India Ltd
gLine: AGEasy exit monthly revenue run rate FY27: INR14-16 crore per month
thesis: Max India's senior-living business is growing fast off a small base (FY26 revenue INR213cr, +30%) but EBITDA is still negative at INR83cr; care-home occupancy fell as 2 new homes ramped, and management gave no firm breakeven date beyond a loose FY27 hope.
top: Care-home occupancy declined on new beds

name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd
gLine: AUM growth FY27: ~25% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Home First Q4FY26: AUM up 24.9% YoY to INR5,878cr with 30+ DPD down 50bps to 3.2% and spread held at 5.3%; guides ~25% AUM growth FY27 and credit cost 30-40bps.

name: Deep Industries Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 25-30% YoY (~INR950-1,100 crores cited) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue up 49% to INR248.7 crores and FY27 growth guided at 25-30%, but order book flat near INR3,000 crores for 4-5 quarters, a INR208 crore Kandla receivable write-off, and INR160 crore Dolphin receivables still held.

name: Shriram Properties Ltd
gLine: Sales volume FY27: 5-5.5 million sq ft (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR1,357 crore (+39%) and PAT INR101 crore, but FY26 sales value only INR2,354 crore, flat, and FY27 sales guidance of INR3,300-3,500 crore needs a big step-up.

name: Metro Brands Ltd
gLine: E-commerce share of revenue: 12% to 15% of business in near term (near term)
thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone growth 20%, PAT +18%, 1,032 stores after net 42 adds; management kept FY27 growth framing at ~15% but gave no numeric guidance, and cited ~10% input-cost inflation with six months of inventory cover.
top: Input costs up ~10%, no price hikes

name: Maiden Forgings Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: up at least 1% to 2% within FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 output of 35,546 MT on 53,000 MT installed capacity (~70%), with management guiding ~42,000 MT this year; H2 revenue grew 17.46% but EBITDA only 3.52%, and no hard margin or capex numbers were given.

name: Fedbank Financial Services Ltd
gLine: ROA expansion: 20-30 bps over FY26 average (FY27)
thesis: Gold-loan-led growth with AUM up 27% to ₹20,153 Cr and credit cost down to 0.7% in Q4, but Q4 margins were squeezed by back-ended disbursals and ST LAP recovery is unproven.

name: Vishal Mega Mart Ltd
thesis: Q4 SSSG 13.2% and FY26 revenue INR 12,906 cr (+20.4%), but management flagged input inflation from May and promotions lifted to clear stock, so gross margin pressure is the watch item.

name: Ather Energy Ltd
gLine: AURIC Phase 1 capacity: 42,000 units/month incremental; full operationalised before end of FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Ather is capacity-constrained at 90-95% of 35k/month Hosur capacity, with AURIC Phase 1 adding 42k/month; commodity inflation of 40-50% is a near-term margin headwind, mostly unpassed.

name: Sambhv Steel Tubes Ltd
gLine: EBITDA per ton Q1 FY27: INR7,500-8,000 (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA/ton hit INR9,500 on inventory-cost lag and HR coil spike, but management guides Q1 FY27 to only INR7,500-8,000 while adding 1.2 MMTPA Kesda capacity and INR200cr more capex.
top: Kesda Phase 1 adds 3.6 lakh t SS

name: BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Ltd
gLine: A&P spend: not below 6% of revenue (ongoing)
thesis: Q4 SSSG of 34% and 340 stores, but inventory turns fell from 1.34x to about 1.13x and management guided no FY27 revenue target; supply side is loosening, not tightening.

name: LG Electronics India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teen digit (FY27)
thesis: Record Q4 revenue of INR80.54bn (+8.1% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell ~250bps YoY to 11.7% on FX, promos and commodities; FY27 guide is mid-teen growth and early double-digit EBITDA margin.

name: Vidya Wires Ltd
gLine: FY27 capacity: ~36,000 t by Diwali / Sept-Oct 2026 (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up 24.2% to ₹18,396mn with EBITDA margin 4.66%, but growth leaned on copper pass-through; ALCU capacity (~6,000 t installed of 18,000 t) only started Feb-26, and OCF conversion weak with 60-day working capital.
top: ALCU capacity ~6,000 t of 18,000 t added

name: Pajson Agro India Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin (steady state): 15% to 16% (FY27)
thesis: Capacity is expanding from 18,000 to 70,000 MT by FY30 with INR76 crore capex, but FY27 guides only ~20% growth from existing plant and a 15-16% EBITDA margin after an FX-driven fall from ~18%.

name: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth band: 25% plus/minus 2% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA up 29% to INR157 crore at 26.2% margin on tariff relief, but FY27 guide of minimum INR2,500 crore revenue (~18% growth) rests on new sun-control capacity arriving only mid-FY28 and on a pending anti-dumping decision.

name: Indian Hotels Company Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: double-digit, 12% to 14% (FY27)
thesis: Hotel operator guides FY27 double-digit revenue growth of 12-14% and sees tight supply, but West Asia disruption cut ~INR40-50 crore consol revenue and April was weak. Mostly demand and asset-light narrative, with no capacity-cut signal.

name: Rathi Steel & Power Ltd-$
gLine: Rolling mill utilisation: 65% to 70% in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Rolling mill utilisation ~51% and melt shop ~53% in FY26 after a restart, with management targeting 65–70% rolling utilisation this year; the spare capacity is the story, not capex.

name: Adf Foods Ltd-$
gLine: Ashoka brand growth: 30-35% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 consolidated revenue INR196.7 cr (+23.7%) and standalone EBITDA margin 24.3%, but utilisation of 70-75% and a Surat greenfield ramping, with GCC (under 15% of revenue) shut since March; FY27 guide of INR925-1,000 cr now conditional on Middle East reopening.

name: Indo Count Industries Ltd
gLine: Sales volume FY27 (mn meters): 105-110 vs 94.1 FY26 (FY27)
thesis: Home textiles exporter guiding FY27 revenue ~INR5,500cr (+30%) and ~13% EBITDA margin, but Q4 volumes fell to 20.5mn meters on tariffs, and utilisation of US utility bedding plants is only ~65%.

name: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd
gLine: Export order from RPT: close to INR1,400-1,500 crores (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Q4 orders INR86.1bn (+188% YoY) and backlog INR214.6bn (+49%) with EBITDA margin 27.2%, but management guides only to mid-20s margins and capacity adds run through 2028.

name: Somany Ceramics Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: at least 150 bps from FY26 9.3% base (FY27)
thesis: Gas-cost shock from the March 2026 war lifted tile prices 15-17%, Morbi capacity is shut and 10-15% may never restart, and management guides EBITDA margin up 150 bps+ from 9.3%, though April demand was slow and utilisation only ~79%.

name: City Union Bank Ltd
gLine: ROA FY27 exit: 1.65% to 1.67% (FY27 exit)
thesis: Bank grew advances about 26% YoY to INR66,698 crore with gross NPA down to 1.91% and CASA at 28%, but management flagged it was pushing growth and margin commentary is guidance-driven, not supply-side.

name: Punjab & Sind Bank
gLine: NIM: 2.65% to 2.70% by end of FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 profit of Rs1,322 Cr (+30%) and business +14.94%, but NIM a low 2.55% and Q4 slippages rose to Rs355 Cr; management guides NIM 2.65–2.70% by year-end.
top: Q4 slippages Rs355 Cr vs Rs168 Cr

name: Indiabulls Ltd
gLine: Real estate profit FY27: at least 2x FY26 level (FY27)
thesis: Former fintech/broking group now real-estate-led; Q4 PAT INR194 cr mostly one-off-like first real-estate revenue recognition, with 2x/3x profit targets unsupported by quarterly guidance and no capacity/supply discipline data.

name: Speciality Restaurants Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~15%, top line closer to INR600 crore (FY27)
thesis: Restaurant chain with asset-light-ish growth: 32 new outlets planned in FY27 (INR37 cr capex), SSG 2.25% in Q4 and 11.57% in April, but ~4% price hike only and LPG-to-induction switch under way.

name: JTL Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 sales volume growth: about 30% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Q4 volume record 1,23,262 t (+47.5% YoY revenue) driven by Mangaon utilisation rising to 35-40%; FY27 volume guided ~30% growth with capex delays pushing the 2 mt capacity target and prior 6 lakh t FY27 outlook lower.

name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
gLine: Mobile volume FY27 (ex-Vivo): flat / similar to FY26 (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue flat on smartphone demand and memory-cost headwinds; management guides FY27 non-Vivo volumes flat with 12-15% price-led mobile revenue growth, PLI roll-off trims margins ~50-70bps, and display/camera backward integration is the margin lever for FY27-28.

name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd
gLine: NGC contract signing: current quarter (June 2026)
thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 7,002 crore (+38%) and PAT INR 748 crore, but order book fell to INR 15,324 crore, with NGC (~INR 33,000 crore, L1) contract signing still pending and no revenue before FY28.
top: Order book down to INR 15,324 cr

name: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Ltd
gLine: Fluoropolymer growth FY27: 15% to 20% volume growth
thesis: Fluoropolymers capacity near full utilisation drives new capex (INR250 cr), R-32 at 10,000t of 20,000t target, but battery materials revenue is pre-qualification and EV spend (~INR2,000 cr to date) is heavy against thin revenue.

name: Artemis Medicare Services Ltd
gLine: Gurgaon revenue growth (3-4 years): 15% to 17% YoY (3-4 years)
thesis: Gurgaon occupancy 64.6% with 546 beds; Raipur 300-bed capex INR 110-120 crores and INR 18-20 crores loss in first 18 months, ROCE target 16-18% on new capital. Supply additions are company-led, with no peer capacity commentary.

name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd
gLine: Beauty margin direction: each business to keep improving margin profile; similar trajectory in coming years (FY27+)
thesis: Nykaa Q4 FY26 shows GMV and revenue growth of 28% with EBITDA margin 8.4% and fashion breakeven; capex is light at about 1% of revenue, but no capacity or supply-side metrics were disclosed.

name: PNGS Gargi Fashion Jewellery Ltd
gLine: New stores: at least 20 in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Fashion jewellery retailer grows stores fast (32 added in FY26, 126 touchpoints) with zero debt and ~INR78 cr cash; capital-light FOCO model, guides ~35% revenue CAGR but supply signals are retail expansion, not industry capacity.
top: Stores added 32 in FY26, 18 in Q4

name: GHCL Textiles Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 15% to 18% within next 3 years (FY29-FY30)
thesis: Yarn spreads rose to INR148/kg in Q4 from INR123 in Q3 and management expects Q1 FY27 to hold, but 120 days of cotton inventory and a 15-18% EBITDA margin target by FY29-30 leave execution and working-capital risk.
top: Spread INR123 → INR148/kg Q3 to Q4

name: R K Swamy Ltd
thesis: Integrated marketing services firm with consolidated income up ~15% and EBITDA margin ~15.5% vs 13.5%, but no numeric forward guidance, CX utilisation ~83% and capacity expansion (~50%) noted, zero debt.

name: J.G.Chemicals Ltd
gLine: Gujarat plant utilisation: 35% to 40% in first six months; 65% to 70% in FY28
thesis: Zinc oxide utilisation in the late 70s (~77%) with Gujarat capacity due in H1 FY27; FY26 record revenue of INR972.9 cr but Q4 EBITDA margin only 10.26% as March raw-material and energy spikes hit before pass-through from 1 April.
top: Dahej capacity add; Naidupeta debottleneck by Dec 2026

name: Nukleus Office Solutions Ltd
gLine: Operational area (sq ft): More than 1,000,000 by end FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Flex-workspace operator guiding to ~10 lakh sq ft operational by FY27 end (from ~3.5 lakh), but gave no revenue numbers, and fixed assets up 160% with debt-funded expansion and thin disclosure quality.

name: Bluspring Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Organic revenue growth FY27: 15% to 16% (FY27)
thesis: Facility-services margin rose 3.1% to 4.2% in FY26 on pricing discipline and collections, but supply-side evidence is thin: no capacity or utilisation data, and the STEAG and LSG acquisitions reset the story.

name: Raymond Realty Ltd
gLine: FY27 blended EBITDA margin: 16%-18% (FY27)
thesis: Pre-sales-led growth with JDA mix now 54% of FY26 bookings and FY26 EBITDA margin ~16%, guided 16-18% for FY27; management expects cash-negative operations for two years and Thane pre-sales flat at INR1,300-1,500 crore.

name: Kalpataru Ltd
gLine: FY27 deliveries: 5.5 million sq ft (FY27)
thesis: Real-estate developer with record FY26 pre-sales of INR 5,280 cr (+17%) and collections of INR 4,960 cr (+34%); no FY27 numeric guidance yet, net debt held at about INR 8,100 cr.

name: Anthem Biosciences Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: about Rs 700 crore, then about Rs 500 crore
thesis: FY26 revenue grew about 15% to Rs 2,124 cr with EBITDA up 31% to Rs 990 cr; management refused FY27 guidance but disclosed Unit 4 capex of about Rs 700 cr next year, lifting capacity sharply.
top: Unit 4 capex ~Rs 1,200 cr over two years

name: GNG Electronics Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~25% (FY27)
thesis: Refurbished-PC seller reports Q4 PAT up ~3x and FY26 revenue +34%, but inventory swelled to INR743 crore and debtors rose to INR206 crore, so margin gains rest on a bet on rising component prices.

name: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Ltd
gLine: Mangalsutra sales growth FY27: 33% to 35% (FY27)
thesis: Mangalsutra maker guides ~30% value CAGR for 2-3 years, but FY26 capacity use was 87% on a mid-year expansion to 4,000 kg, while working capital absorbed cash and FCF was negative.
top: Working capital absorbs cash, no FCF

name: Epack Prefab Technologies Ltd
gLine: Prefab revenue FY27: 30% growth, INR1,920-1,950 cr (FY27)
thesis: Capacity rising from 147k to ~220k MT by FY27-end with order book ~INR1,100-1,127 cr and 30% FY27 growth guided; Q4 utilisation 83% but sandwich panel line ran ~25% and margins fell 70-80 bps on steel costs.

name: Aequs Ltd
gLine: Aerospace revenue growth FY27: 25% to 30% (FY27)
thesis: Consumer capacity is ramping into 23% utilisation with INR500 crore more capex in FY27 and Hasbro exit, while aerospace grows 27% with 20% margin guided; supply side is expanding ahead of demand.

name: Aye Finance Ltd
gLine: AUM growth FY27: 25% to 30% (FY27)
thesis: Aye Finance is a micro-MSME NBFC where credit costs fell for a fifth straight quarter to 4.3% and PAR X improved to 6.9%, but FY27 guidance of 3.5–4% credit cost and 25–30% AUM growth is management's own framing rather than hard supply evidence.

name: Aegis Logistics Ltd
gLine: Capex by March 2027: $1.2 billion aggregate (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 with LPG distribution margin ~INR7,000/t vs ~INR4,000 prior year, but management attributes it to a war-driven price spike and guides capex up sharply (~$1.2bn by Mar-27, ~INR5,000cr in FY28) with no numeric utilisation disclosed for terminals.

name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
gLine: AUM growth FY27: 20% to 24% (FY27)
thesis: Bajaj Finance guides FY27 AUM growth 20-24%, credit cost 145-160 bps (down from 175 bps FY26 on new presentation), ROA 4.4-4.6%, ROE 19-20%, with no NIM expansion needed; MSME and captive 2W/3W drag winding down.

name: Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd
gLine: TAN production FY27: 1,60,000 - 1,70,000 tons (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone EBITDA up 56% to Rs 255 crore on urea mix and ammonia, but receivables jumped to Rs 2,075 crore and TAN capacity ramp (240,000 tpa) is the main new supply-side driver.

name: Arvind Ltd
gLine: Dalco revenue growth: mid-teens (medium term)
thesis: Arvind buys 61% of US needle-punch nonwovens maker Dalco-GFT at 7.75x CY25 EBITDA (EV ~$136m) with 85% utilisation, adding a line for ~$5m capex a year and targeting mid-teens growth.

name: Apollo Tyres Ltd
gLine: India raw material cost change Q1 FY27: mid to high teens sequential increase
thesis: Q4 FY26 India volumes up high teens with capacity utilisation at 90%, but raw-material basket up mid-to-high teens forces 6-8% price hikes; Europe margin still 14.6% versus historic 16%+.
top: Utilisation at 90% across India and Europe

name: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Ltd
gLine: Vehicle Finance asset growth: approximately 18%
thesis: Vehicle finance recovery showing up in April collections: early defaults and non-starters lower than April 2025, with FY27 credit cost guided to ~1.5% from 1.6% pre-overlay and a INR200 crore overlay held as buffer.

name: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd
thesis: Record FY26 revenue above INR 1.25 lakh crore (+11%) and leverage at an all-time low 0.8x, but capex of INR 6,000 crore planned for FY27 keeps supply expanding; the consumer electronics ramp is still unproven, with GF3 the key test.

name: Sterlite Technologies Ltd
gLine: Enterprise and data centre share of revenue: 30% of revenues in current fiscal (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR 1,441 crore (+37% YoY) and EBITDA margin 15.1%, but management gave no capacity or utilisation numbers and declined to comment on spot pricing or hyperscaler contracts.

name: Paisalo Digital Ltd
thesis: Paisalo, a last-mile NBFC, posted record Q4 PAT of Rs.722 million (+56% YoY) and reaffirmed doubling AUM in three years, but there is no supply-side or capacity signal and the call is management-led with little hard data.
top: Doubling AUM and profit in 3 years reaffirmed

name: NHPC Ltd
gLine: Subansiri Lower units commissioned by Mar'27: Remaining 4 of 8 units (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT Rs 1,460 Cr was inflated by a one-off Rs 1,156 Cr DTL reversal (about Rs 900 Cr net), so adjusted earnings are weaker; FY26 generation up 16% but PAF down to 74.75%.

name: Oil India Ltd
gLine: Oil and oil-equivalent production: 4 MMT with 100 wells (FY27)
thesis: Upstream volumes near record (80k+ bpd, 74 wells, 100-well plan) but FY27 capex rollover at ~₹10,000 cr and NRL 3→9 MMTPA expansion on track for March 2027 with ~₹46,000 cr combined capex; gas uplift depends on pipeline authorisations.

name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd
gLine: Kagal capex and capacity: INR1,400 cr over next two years for 20,000 engines; asset turn 4-5%; peak revenue INR5,000-6,000 cr (2 years)
thesis: Standalone Q4 sales up 24% to INR1,522 cr with EBITDA margin 12.6%, but capacity push of INR1,400 cr over two years and INR700 cr already underway; management withheld volume/price split and RM pass-through quantum.
top: Capex INR1,400 cr over two years

name: L&T Finance Ltd
gLine: Credit cost exit Q4FY27: 2% to 2.2% (Q4FY27)
thesis: Retail NBFC with supply-side discipline in credit: Cyclops underwriting, prime mix at 90%+ in two-wheeler, and credit cost guided down to 2–2.2% by Q4FY27, but ECL Stage 1 provisioning raised to 80bps.

name: SRG Housing Finance Ltd
gLine: FY27 disbursements: ~INR 600 crore (FY27)
thesis: Small-ticket housing lender growing AUM 37% to INR 1,042 cr with GNPA 1.77% and CRAR 38.6%, but no capacity or supply-side signal; guidance of ~INR 600 cr disbursements and INR 1,300-1,400 cr AUM is management's own demand read.
top: Mgmt contradicts itself on cost of borrowing

name: Steel Exchange India Ltd
gLine: Quarterly finance cost: around INR 12-13 crore (coming quarters)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA jumped to INR 50.10 cr (17.41% margin) from INR 22.97 cr in Q3, with rebar volume 49,760 t, but management gave no formal guidance and sustainability rests on an unfunded 1 mt green steel plan.

name: Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 incremental revenue from new capacity: INR300-500 crore over FY26 (FY27)
thesis: Manaksia added 36% alu-zinc capacity (132k→180k t) and is ramping, with Q4 EBITDA margin squeezed to 6.84% by energy and raw-material shock; management says new orders pass through full cost increases.

name: Aster DM Quality Care Ltd
gLine: Bed additions: ~2,500 beds over coming years; capacity to 8,150+ beds (3-4 years)
thesis: Aster Q4 FY26 revenue up 18% to INR 1,182 cr with operating EBITDA up 26% and margin 20.7%; capacity adds are disciplined (~2,500 beds over 4 years, INR 2,700 cr) with no sign of supply glut in the sector.

name: Sandhar Technologies Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15%+ (excluding price re-trigger) (FY27)
thesis: Sandhar guides 15%+ FY27 revenue growth excluding price re-trigger, capex 5-7% of revenue (INR 275-310 cr), but margins flat-ish: +0.25% EBITDA target, with aluminium pass-through lag and April manpower shock dragging near term.

name: Lemon Tree Hotels Ltd
gLine: Cost drag (renovation, tech, GST) as % of revenue: 3.7% by FY28, from 5.8% in FY26 (FY28)
thesis: Hotel margins fell 126 bps to 48.1% in FY26 on renovation, tech and GST costs; management expects 3.7% of revenue cost drag to ease by FY28, but occupancy-led pricing in Q4 left ARR flat.
top: Q4 ARR flat; occupancy over price

name: Indostar Capital Finance Ltd
gLine: Disbursement CAGR FY26-FY29: 35% (FY29)
thesis: Q4 FY26 disbursements up 17% QoQ to INR1,306 cr and an INR326 cr SR provision reset the balance sheet, but Stage 3 rose to 4.8% and FY29 targets (35% disbursement CAGR, INR450-500 cr PAT) are aspirational.

name: India Pesticides Ltd
gLine: Shalvis revenue FY27: INR 70-80 crores (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue +27.9% to INR 1,078 cr with 18% EBITDA margin; management guides 15–20% growth and 18–20% margin, but the capex plan is mostly in a subsidiary and utilisation of the key PEDA/Pretilachlor block is only 70–75%.

name: Sigachi Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR 650-675 crores (FY27)
thesis: Post-accident MCC capacity loss keeps utilisation near 75-82%; supply rebuild via 12,000 t Dahej MCC (COD end-FY27) drives FY27 guidance of INR 650-675 cr revenue and 18-20% EBITDA margin, which is unproven against Q4's 12.6% margin.

name: Pyramid Technoplast Ltd
gLine: EBITDA FY27: 75-80 crore (per Q&A)
thesis: Capacity up 22% to 76,931 MTPA with utilisation at ~69% and capex falling to ~20 crore in FY27; Q4 EBITDA up 68% to 20 crore, but margin gains are partly inventory-driven and utilisation remains well below 80%.

name: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: Advances growth FY27: 22% plus (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 NIM rose to 4.06% and cost of deposits fell to 5.75%, but credit cost guided 0.15–0.25% with agri NPAs sticky at 2.76% and PCR raised to 51.89%.

name: Entero Healthcare Solutions Ltd
gLine: Consolidated revenue growth (ex new acquisitions): 23% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Entero is a pharma and MedTech distributor guiding FY27 revenue +23% (about 11% from calendarisation) and 5% EBITDA margin, with margin expansion driven by gross margin and commercial-role MedTech contracts rather than capacity.

name: JNK India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 25% to 30% (FY27)
thesis: Order book Rs 1,961 cr (~2.3x FY26 revenue of Rs 838 cr) with management guiding 25–30% FY27 growth and 14–15% EBITDA margin; utilisation not disclosed, capacity constrained by manpower and working capital, not plant.

name: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd
gLine: PAT margin FY27: 7% to 7.5% net (FY27)
thesis: Capacity-constrained PEB maker: FY26 revenue Rs 1,898 cr (+31%) with full utilisation, order book Rs 1,700 cr, and five plants adding ~20,000 tons by Aug, but EBITDA margin flat at 9.3% and operating cash flow turned negative.
top: Gujarat PEB plant commercial production July

name: Manba Finance Ltd
gLine: AUM growth: 25-30% annually; AUM INR 2,300-2,400 cr by year end (FY27)
thesis: Small two-wheeler-led NBFC growing AUM 29% to INR 1,713 cr with NIM 13.63% and ROE 11.65%; supply-side signals are thin, and it is raising equity at a discount to its prior trading level.

name: Dr. Agarwals Health Care Ltd
gLine: Facility additions: 60 (40 surgical, 20 clinics) (FY27)
thesis: Dr. Agarwal's is still expanding aggressively: 60 greenfield openings planned for FY27 (40 surgical, 20 clinics) and capex of INR 380-400 crores, with new facilities dragging ~INR 30 crore losses; supply is growing, not disciplined.

name: Zelio E Mobility Ltd
gLine: FY27 unit volume: more than 125,000 units (FY27)
thesis: Zelio claims FY26 revenue INR313 cr (+81.8%), EBITDA margin 12.2%, capacity 72k→240k units and FY27 guidance of 125k+ units, but supply-side claims are unaudited management assertions with thin disclosure on utilisation, pricing and receivables.

name: Midwest Ltd
gLine: Granite organic volume/revenue growth: 10-12% p.a. (FY27 and 3-4 years)
thesis: Granite core steady at 27.6% EBITDA, but consolidated margin slipped to 27.0% as new Quartz plant runs at low utilisation; management targets 60% of 250-300kt capacity this year.

name: Studds Accessories Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 17%-18% (FY27)
thesis: Capacity rising ~33% to over 12 million units by FY28 with 8-9% price hikes offsetting near-term raw material inflation, but management guided EBITDA margins flat and cut the 22-23% margin path this year.

name: Park Medi World Ltd
gLine: Acquired-asset revenue contribution / CGHS uplift: CGHS net impact 5-6% of revenue; ~7-7.5% rate appreciation for nine months of FY27
thesis: Network occupancy rose to 64.1% for FY26 (Q4 62.5%) while capex is guided at ~INR500 crore over two years for 1,500 beds, a capital-light expansion with debt near zero.

name: Nephrocare Health Services Ltd
thesis: Dialysis platform grew revenue 32% to INR998.8 cr with 17% treatment growth and margin up 100bp to 23.8%, but Q4 margin dipped to 20.9% on a INR10 cr one-time ECL provision and capex rose ~50% to INR165 cr.

name: Dachepalli Publishers Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR 150 crore plus; 160-165 crore possible (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT Rs 5.16 cr (+122.5% YoY) on 93.8% income growth, but FY26 gains come from new states and e-commerce; management guides FY27 Rs 150 cr with capacity headroom and no dividend.

name: Kiaasa Retail Ltd
gLine: Store network: 250 EBOs by 2028; 300 by FY30 (per analyst) (FY28)
thesis: Kiaasa is a small SME-listed ethnic-wear EBO roll-out story with FY26 revenue of Rs134.63 cr and EBITDA margin of 17.8%, but no supply-side evidence (capacity, utilisation, pricing) and a 35% revenue CAGR vision to FY30 that management did not tie to capex.

name: Omnitech Engineering Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 30-35% (historical range) (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up 49.1% to INR 511.3 cr with PAT margin 15.5%, but working capital rose to INR 294 cr, receivable days 153, and Q4 gross margin fell ~450 bps; supply-side capacity is expanding with no peer-capacity read.

name: Arihant Superstructures Ltd
gLine: FY27 pre-sales growth: 25% to 30% CAGR
thesis: Real estate developer with Q4 revenue Rs 181 cr (+18.5% YoY) and FY26 pre-sales Rs 977 cr, but no capacity or supply discipline evidence; margin pressure and rising debt (net debt/equity 1.81x) with FCF negative for four years.

name: RACL Geartech Ltd
gLine: Revenue vision: 1000 cr in 3-5 years, possibly by 2029 (2029-2030)
thesis: FY26 consolidated revenue ₹512 cr (+20%) with EBITDA margin 25.2% and debt down to ₹221 cr; supply side shows capex of ₹77.45 cr planned for FY27 with no capacity cut, while management reiterates ~20% growth and a ₹1,000 cr vision by 2029-2030.

name: Apcotex Industries Ltd
gLine: Volume growth FY27: double-digit to low double-digit volume growth (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 42% to INR 55 cr on Nitrile latex margin spike that management calls partly a March war blip; NBR at 100% utilisation, no major capacity until FY28, ADD not notified.

name: Greenply Industries Ltd
gLine: Plywood volume growth: 10% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated core EBITDA margin 12% (+150bps YoY) on MDF operating leverage and price hikes of 4-10% from April, but part of the volume was channel stocking in late March and MDF capacity is still being added.

name: Stylam Industries Ltd
gLine: New plant commercial production: end June to mid July 2026 (FY27)
thesis: Third greenfield laminate plant delayed again to end-June/July; management guides FY27 revenue up 20-25% and new plant ~INR250-300 crore, with capex of INR334 crore already spent and no prior numeric baseline to test against.
top: New plant delayed again to June/July

name: Ashapura Minechem Ltd
gLine: Guinea bauxite volume FY27: 10 to 12 million tons (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR5,237 crores (+91%) but Q4 EBITDA margin fell to about 11% as freight and bauxite prices corrected; management guides Q1 similar or worse and FY27 Guinea volume 10–12 Mt versus 15 Mt target.
top: FY27 Guinea volume 10–12 Mt, below 15 Mt

name: India Cements Ltd
gLine: Efficiency programme: higher than INR300 per ton by FY28 (FY28)
thesis: Document is UltraTech's Q4 FY26 call, not India Cements' own call; India Cements' EBITDA/t reached INR497 in Q4 with INR1,000 target by FY28, while sector pricing rose ~2.5% and bag costs hit INR90 crore in March.

name: UltraTech Cement Ltd
gLine: Volume growth: 7% to 8% per annum sustainable (FY27 and beyond)
thesis: UltraTech's Q4 FY26 call shows pricing and cost-efficiency gains with 200 Mt capacity, but supply is still expanding (242.5 Mt by FY28) and management pushes shareholder returns over capacity discipline; West Asia cost headwinds are being offset by price hikes.

name: NTPC Ltd
gLine: FY27 capacity addition (group): 9,557 MW (thermal 1,070; hydro 250; RE 8,237) (FY27)
thesis: NTPC added a record 9,618 MW in FY26 and plans 9,557 MW in FY27 and 10,039 MW in FY28, with coal PLF at 72.04% against the rest-of-India average of 63.20%.

name: Gokaldas Exports Ltd
gLine: FY27 margin improvement: couple of percentage points Y-o-Y (FY27)
thesis: Management says tariff shock is behind them and guides FY27 margins up a couple of points, but capacity adds are small (~INR300-odd crore each at steady state) and working capital rose ~INR200 crore, so the supply-side read is neutral-to-positive.
top: Tariff burden share gone from mid-Feb

name: Suzlon Energy Ltd
gLine: Industry installations FY27: 8 GW (plus/minus leeway) (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 deliveries of 2,456 MW (+58%) and Q4 commissioning of 332 MW, but order book flat at 5.9 GW and FY27 delivery guidance left to trend language; capex run-rate guided to about INR600 crore.

name: Sobha Ltd
gLine: Launches FY27: close to 10 million sq ft (FY27)
thesis: Sobha FY26 presales hit record INR8,136 cr (+30%) with net cash INR800 cr, but Q4 EBITDA of INR194 cr and margin recovery pushed to FY27 H2 on delayed occupancy certificates.

name: Brigade Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Residential pre-sales FY27: at least 20% growth on FY26; aiming for INR 9,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: Residential pre-sales fell 5% to INR 7,424 crore on launch slippage (8.3 mn sq ft vs 12 mn plan); FY27 guided to at least 20% growth to INR 9,000 crore, leaning on H2 launches and approvals.
top: FY27 pre-sales ≥20% growth to INR 9,000 cr

name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
gLine: EBITDA per kg FY27: 42.5 (range 42-43) (FY27)
thesis: Capacity utilisation is only about 68% (43,000 of 63,000 tonnes) with FY27 capex cut to INR80-85 crore, while EBITDA/kg guidance rises to 42.5 from 40.7 and EBITDA is targeted at INR210 crore from INR173 crore.
top: FY27 capex cut to INR80-85 cr

name: Suyog Telematics Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 15%-20%
thesis: Passive telecom tower IP with 6,008 towers and Vodafone 5,000-tenancy order unconfirmed; FY27 growth guided only 15-20% and revenue per tower steady at INR31,000-32,000, so the capex cycle is still pending.

name: HealthCare Global Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Internal net debt to EBITDA ceiling: 2.5x (medium to long term)
thesis: Oncology chain reports FY26 revenue up 15% to INR2,545 crore and adjusted EBITDA margin up 70 bps to 18.5%, but Q4 growth slowed to 11.3% as management deliberately pruned low-margin volume.

name: Sheela Foam Ltd
gLine: Consolidated FY27 capex: INR125-150 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated core EBITDA margin 11.5% (+400bp) on 24% revenue growth and 15% FY26 volume growth, but no capacity additions tied to demand; supply side is not the story.

name: Mufin Green Finance Ltd
gLine: AUM FY27: minimum ~₹2,500 crore (FY2026-27)
thesis: Mufin pivots from EV/solar lending to Mediclaim premium financing (39% of AUM, ROA 7-9%), targeting PAT ₹80-90 cr in FY27 from ₹28.21 cr, with no supply-side or capacity evidence and heavy reliance on management projections.

name: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: ~30% YoY for FY27 and FY28 (FY27-FY28)
thesis: FY26 revenue ₹256 cr (vs ₹201 cr) and EBITDA ~₹97 cr at ~38%, but ~₹60 cr of Q4 revenue slipped to Q1 and capex of ₹400–500 cr is planned against ~₹300 cr free cash.

name: Nazara Technologies Ltd
gLine: NODWIN fundraise: $100-200 million, mix of primary and secondary
thesis: Gaming is now 90% of EBITDA (FY26 gaming EBITDA ₹265 cr, 24.7% margin); no hard FY27 guidance, only qualitative growth and margin expansion claims with Bluetile pro forma EBITDA "at the least would double".
top: Bluetile acquisition consolidates from Q1 FY27

name: Uniparts India Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: in line with FY26 (~21%) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +31% YoY to INR339 crore and EBITDA margin 24% on volume recovery; management guides FY27 growth in line with FY26 (~20%) with capex held at 2.5-3.5% of revenue, though Q4 margin included warehousing mix and FX gains.

name: Signatureglobal (India) Ltd
gLine: New launches FY27: >INR150bn (FY27)
thesis: Presales fell YoY to INR82.5bn and supply is pipelined at 6.5m sq ft; guidance calls for >INR150bn launches, INR100bn sales and INR50bn revenue, with net debt near zero.

name: Honasa Consumer Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth (5-year CAGR): high-teens CAGR (next 5 years)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 28% YoY to INR682 crore with EBITDA 11.3% and PAT INR69 crore, but growth is demand-led brand execution with no supply-side or capacity disclosures; FY27 guidance is a 5-year high-teens CAGR.

name: ASK Automotive Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens (FY27)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 12.1% hit by alloy pass-through lag (80 bps, Rs 5 Cr loss); management guides mid-teens FY27 growth and ~Rs 400 Cr capex, with Karoli utilisation only 65%.

name: DOMS Industries Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: INR250-275 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue +18.7% to INR604 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 16.7% on a 15-20% raw-material inflation against only 4-5% pass-through; Q1 margins guided slightly under pressure.

name: Jana Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: Gross loan portfolio growth FY27: 19% to 21% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 credit cost fell to 0.47% with slippages at INR334 crores and SMA at 3.66%; management guides FY27 gross loans +19-21%, deposits +23-25%, PAT +80%+ but no credit cost guidance beyond "same range or slightly better".

name: Juniper Hotels Ltd
gLine: Westin Bengaluru Phase 1 opening: Q2 FY27, 238 keys
thesis: Hotel owner-operator with FY26 revenue up 11% to INR1,047.7 crores and EBITDA margin up 400bp to 42%; supply pipeline of ~1,400 keys by FY30 with capex ~INR1,800 crores, so capital discipline and returns are the test.
top: Pipeline cut: ~4,000 keys FY29 to 3,320 FY30

name: Raymond Lifestyle Ltd
gLine: Top-line growth FY27: double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 15% to INR1,810 crore with EBITDA up 53%, but no numeric FY27 guidance; management calls FY27 a 'Year of Consolidation' with net 30-40 store adds and double-digit growth targets.

name: Srigee Dlm Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: more than INR100 crores (management's personal target) (FY27)
thesis: Srigee DLM says existing capacity is over 100% utilised and growth is space-capped until a new 10,850 sq m Greater Noida plant (~INR25cr capex plus land) is commissioned around August 2026; FY26 revenue INR72.31cr, PAT INR6.87cr.

name: Aegis Vopak Terminals Ltd
gLine: FY28 capex: close to INR5,000 crores (FY28)
thesis: Aegis Vopak is scaling storage ahead of demand: liquid capacity up 3.75x and a ~USD5bn capex plan to 2030, with JNPT's 318,100 cbm expansion starting next month and FY26 revenue up 17% to INR923.1 crores.

name: Indiqube Spaces Ltd
gLine: VAS share of revenue: 17-18% (FY27)
thesis: Flex-office operator adding 1.5-2.0 mn sq ft a year at ~INR 1,650/sq ft capex with guided 25-30% revenue growth; Q4 end-month occupancy fell to 81% while management blamed timing and cited an 84% full-year average.

name: JSW Cement Ltd
gLine: UAE grinding unit commissioning: April 2027 end
thesis: JSW Cement Q4 volume +7% to 3.99 Mt and operating EBITDA +46% to INR365 cr, but April demand soft; Nagaur ramp and Punjab delay shift grinding capacity to Rajasthan, with the FY30 43.5 Mtpa target kept.
top: April demand soft, volumes recovering May

name: Uflex Ltd
gLine: FY27 performance: better than FY26 (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin hit 15.3% (highest in 14 quarters) on March spread spike, but management says spreads have since fallen significantly; FY27 margin guidance withheld, consolidated leverage 4.35x.

name: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: just above 12.5% (FY27)
thesis: Pig iron volumes fell 3% in Q4 and Hiriyur BF was idle 3.5 months, but management sees pig iron prices recovering (+INR4,000/t since December) and targets 1.85 lakh t castings in FY27.
top: Pig iron prices up INR4,000/t since Dec

name: Birla Corporation Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume: mid-single digit growth
thesis: Capacity held near 21.5 Mtpa until Maihar Line-II (6 Mtpa total to 27.5 by FY29) with ~INR4,300 crore net capex; utilisation near 99% ex-Mukutban, but FY26 EBITDA flagged flat-ish and cash flow weakened on incentive receivables and fuel stock build.

name: Sagar Cements Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 volumes: ~7 million tonnes (FY27)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA/tonne ₹445 vs ₹218 a year ago on cost savings; FY27 volume guided ~7 MT (+15%) with ~₹25/bag hike sticking in South but flat-to-negative in Central/East.

name: Eicher Motors Ltd
gLine: Q1 FY27 material cost headwind: 3% to 3.5% of material costs (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Eicher Q4 FY26 PAT of INR1,520m on 6,080m revenue at record volumes, but Q1 faces a 3–3.5% material-cost headwind with only ~50% recovered via a 1.75% price hike; Royal Enfield capacity to rise 1.4m→1.6m/yr via INR958m Cheyyar brownfield.

name: Gufic Biosciences Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: ~18% in FY27; above 20% by 2030 (FY27 to FY30)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR252cr (+15% YoY) and EBITDA margin 17.7% vs 13.2%, but FY26 PAT fell to INR63cr and management guides ~15% revenue growth and 18% EBITDA margin for FY27 with debt flat near INR400cr.

name: Ashiana Housing Ltd-$
gLine: Pre-sales FY27: Rs 2,200 crore (FY27)
