thesis: Ashiana FY26 booking value Rs 2,421 cr (+25%) and EAC +30% to 226.19 lakh sq ft, but supply signals are mixed: land pipeline ~96 lakh sq ft and mgmt says no capital returns, with Gurugram/Pune oversupply signs and a class action risk.
top: Gurugram unsold inventory rising two quarters

name: Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth (standalone): ~20% in coming year (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue +22% with ~6.5% volume and ~8% price; capacity rises to 54,000 MT after Phase 1 by June 2026, guidance of 20% growth and 20%+ EBITDA margin, but Q4 gross margin dipped and capex ramp is calibrated.

name: Asian Energy Services Ltd
gLine: Kuiper top line FY27 (full year): $60M to $65M (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 57% to INR338 crore, but management admits it missed prior FY26 guidance on timing; FY27 standalone growth 30–40% and Kuiper $60–65M rest mostly on existing INR1,750 crore order book.
top: Prior FY26 guidance missed on timing

name: Orient Bell Ltd-$
thesis: Orient Bell took ~20% cumulative price hikes in March–April on gas-cost pass-through, with Q4 EBITDA up 66% and utilisation near 65%; management refused numeric FY27 guidance.

name: Eveready Industries India Ltd
gLine: Alkaline market share: about 20% exit (FY27)
thesis: Eveready closed FY26 with 8.2% revenue and 8.9% EBITDA growth at 11.5% margin, but zinc inflation and a new INR200 crore Jammu alkaline plant (5-6 year payback) add supply and margin risk; management guides to similar margins.
top: Jammu plant INR200 cr, 360m units peak

name: IIFL Finance Ltd
gLine: Gold loan AUM growth FY27: 20-25% (FY27)
thesis: Gold loan AUM ₹52,581 cr (+150% YoY) with 62 t tonnage; FY27 gold AUM growth guided at 20–25% and credit cost to fall to 1.5–1.7%, but tax assessment overhang and no capacity-discipline signal.

name: Yes Bank Ltd
gLine: Advances growth FY27: 13% to 15% (FY27)
thesis: Yes Bank exits FY26 at ~1% ROA with NIM 2.7% and GNPA 1.3%, but advances growth of 11% and a 14-15% FY27 target are the swing factors; RIDF rundown to ~INR 28,000 cr is a margin tailwind.

name: SMS Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% (FY27)
thesis: Management guides FY27 revenue growth of 15% with EBITDA margin above FY26's 20%, citing ibuprofen backward integration and an 800 MT/month capacity build by FY27 end; a Middle East-driven solvent cost squeeze already dented Q4 gross margin by 2%.

name: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: ₹37,000 crore initial (FY27)
thesis: Transmission capex delivered ~₹40,000 cr in FY26 vs ₹28,000 cr initial guide, capitalisation ₹28,206 cr; FY27 capex guide ₹37,000 cr and capitalisation up to ₹30,000 cr, with growth-led execution rather than supply discipline.
top: FY26 capex ~₹40,000 cr vs ₹28,000 cr guide

name: Renaissance Global Ltd
gLine: US D2C revenue: INR375 crores by end FY27 (organic growth 35-40%) (FY27)
thesis: Jewellery D2C-led growth with FY26 revenue up 29% to INR2,572 cr and net debt cut to ~INR200 cr, but no supply-side data (capacity, utilisation, pricing) and a retail-expansion capex story with no dividend.

name: Minda Corporation Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: at least 1.5x industry growth, 15%+ if industry ~10% (FY27)
thesis: Record Q4 revenue INR 1,704 cr (+29% YoY) and FY26 EBITDA INR 721 cr with 11.7% margin; capacity utilisation is only 75-80%, so supply discipline is not the story, and capex rises to INR 400-450 cr in FY27.

name: Arvind SmartSpaces Ltd
gLine: FY27 bookings growth: 35% to 40% (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 bookings of INR1,550 crore (+22%) and BD of ~INR3,140-3,200 crore, but revenue fell to INR564 crore from INR713 crore on OC deferrals; FY27 revenue growth left unquantified.

name: Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Ltd
gLine: Net PAT margin: 8-8.5% in Q1 FY27 (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Management has deliberately stopped sales since mid-March and deferred Unit 5/6 start-up (Rs 1,500cr FY27 target cut to Rs 1,250–1,300cr) as ammonia and sulphur prices roughly tripled; no Kharif revenue from new capacity.

name: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd
gLine: Double-digit growth aspiration: Double-digit growth aspired to
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 22% YoY to INR 2,034m with EBITDA margin steady at 31%, but management gave no numeric FY27 guidance, capacity expansion is deferred to September, and US demand is weak.
top: Pricing constant; cost pass-through from New Year

name: Share India Securities Ltd
gLine: MTF book: INR 650 odd crores by FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q4 standalone PAT up 368% to INR 75 crore on prop/MTF growth, but management concedes RBI curbs on intraday prop limits could cut limits ~20%, and no capacity or supply discipline is discussed.
top: RBI bars intraday limits for prop

name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: Advances growth FY27: around 25% (FY27)
thesis: Microfinance book rebuilt to INR20,709 cr with growth guided to high single digits and secured mix rising to ~56%; FY27 ROA guided to 1.6% from exit ~2.1%, with NIM held near 8.5%.

name: Medplus Health Services Ltd
gLine: Net new stores FY27: 800 including franchisee outlets
thesis: MedPlus adds 218 net stores in Q4 (800 planned for FY27) with store-level margins of 13.1% and mature-store SSSG of 17.8%, but management refuses margin guidance and is shifting growth to franchisees.
top: Franchisee model launched, 310 stores in FY26

name: Bondada Engineering Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 60-70% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue ~INR2,843 crore with order book INR7,147 crore and 1.5 GW commissioning target; management guides 60-70% FY27 growth but gives no capacity-discipline signal and leans on a new 120-130 crore plant plus data-centre and defence diversification.

name: ESAF Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: Steady-state credit cost: 2% (FY28)
thesis: Credit-led recovery at a microfinance-heavy SFB: Q4 PAT only INR 24 crore, GNPA 5.4% and credit cost 1.08% in the quarter, with management guiding to 2% steady-state credit cost by FY28.

name: Popular Vehicles and Services Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: high double-digit top line growth (FY27)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin only 3.3% with FY26 PAT still a loss of INR12.5 crores; management guides FY27 EBITDA to 4.8–5% but acquisitions and cess are eroding margins and debt rose on acquisitions.

name: SRM Contractors Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 45%–55% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue ₹1,026 cr (+94%) with 8.1% EBITDA margin, but management guides FY27 margins of 16–18% and ~₹250 cr capex funded partly by project debt, with a messy call on order book definitions.

name: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd
gLine: Capex: INR 150-200 crore per year (FY27 onwards)
thesis: Q4 volumes up 20% YoY to 1.17 lakh t and FY26 at 4.58 lakh t (+33%), but gas cuts to 35% in March and a 50%+ blended gas escalation weigh on Q1 FY27 EBITDA/t; capex capped at INR 150-200 crore.

name: KRN Heat Exchanger And Refrigeration Ltd
gLine: New facility utilisation: 50% FY27, 80% FY28 (FY27-FY28)
thesis: New Neemrana HVAC plant only ~15% utilised last year; management targets 50% in FY27 and 80% in FY28, but Q4 inventory ~3x YoY and receivables up, with a Rs 500 cr QIP enabling resolution pending.

name: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Ltd
gLine: Merchant capacity: 900 to ~1,130 tpd in next 12 months (12 months)
thesis: Capacity additions are the growth lever: merchant capacity to ~1,130 tpd and on-site to ~1,000 tpd in 12 months, with Q4 EBITDA 30% reported (35% adjusted) and argon still below H1 FY26 levels.

name: Gem Aromatics Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue rose 40% QoQ to INR110 crore but utilisation fell to 60-65% from ~80% a year ago, with FY27 guidance withdrawn and Dahej phenol lines held back on raw-material costs.

name: Tipco Engineering India Ltd
gLine: Revenue FY26-27 (incl. Pune): INR180 crore plus (FY27)
thesis: Tipco's FY26 revenue rose about 10% to INR146 crore with H2 up 66% and EBITDA margin 26.6%, but a debtor-days jump (72 to 169) and a Pune capex plan of INR60 crore offset the supply-side read.

name: CMR Green Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume growth: similar to FY26 (~25%) (FY27)
thesis: Recycled aluminium leader with FY26 volume up 24% to 80,381 t and EBITDA up 50% to INR449 cr, but no quantified guidance and capex of about INR200 cr for FY27 with capacity rising to about 7 lakh t.

name: Ester Industries Ltd
gLine: BOPET margin sustenance: 18 to 24 months (FY27-FY28)
thesis: BOPET film margins look to have troughed: Q4 consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin 15.5% and Filmtech utilisation 85%, but Specialty Polymers volumes softened and reported EBITDA ex-MTM was still only 12.6%.
top: Anti-dumping duties on China BOPET imports

name: John Cockerill India Ltd-$
gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin: ~3% now, >10% within three years (3 years)
thesis: Standalone revenue INR2,000m (+162% YoY) and order book INR13bn (+101%), but EBITDA only INR114m; consolidated EBITDA margin 1.4% with management targeting ~3% and >10% in three years.

name: Ganesh Benzoplast Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin recovery post rental reset: recovery over 2 to 3 years (2-3 years)
thesis: JNPT tank utilisation near 95% with a ~50,000 kL expansion due by calendar year-end, but a 30-year rental reset cut margins and Goa is near zero utilisation.

name: Tata Power Company Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: about INR25,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: Tata Power FY26 capex came in well below the earlier ~INR22,000-25,000 crore guide, with FY27 reset to about INR25,000 crore on a 2.5 GW commissioning plan, while Mundra SPPA settles and Odisha loss reduction runs.

name: Talbros Automotive Components Ltd
gLine: Marelli Talbros revenue growth: 35% to 40% (FY27)
thesis: Record Q4 EBITDA margin 18.7% and FY27 guidance of 15-20% revenue growth, but capacity and order conversion are back-loaded; forging margin dipped on pass-through lag and capex is rising to INR 103 crore in FY27.

name: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Ltd
gLine: Equipment business share of total: 20% to 25% (near term)
thesis: Q4 FY26 sales up 21% to INR706 crores and FY26 EBITDA margin 21.7%, but management says 18-20% is sustainable; order board up 15% to INR1,863 crores with ~INR500 crores executing beyond FY27.

name: Sunteck Realty Ltd
gLine: Presales growth FY27: similar to ~25% growth (FY27)
thesis: Presales up 25% to INR3,157 crore and FY27 growth guided at similar ~25%, with BD spend rising to over INR800 crore and no discounts claimed; supply-side signals are expansionary, not disciplined.
top: BD spend INR200 cr → INR800 cr+

name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd
gLine: Shunt revenue from US key customer: Return to prior peak levels in FY27, surpass in FY28 (FY27-FY28)
thesis: FY26 consolidated revenue +12.3% to ₹570.9 cr and EBITDA margin 22.9%, but much of the contacts growth is silver pass-through and utilisation is only ~60%, so supply discipline is strong while volume is flat.

name: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd
gLine: Debt-to-equity: 1.00x (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 presales of INR1,701 cr (+57%) and collections INR1,103 cr (+71%); FY27 presales target INR2,200 cr with debt-to-equity guidance rising to 1.00x from 0.53x actual.

name: Rico Auto Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: above INR3,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Rico FY26 revenue INR2,477 cr (+12%) and adjusted EBITDA margin 10.25% before INR19 cr lag and INR11 cr labour-code hits; management guides revenue above INR3,000 cr with no capacity-discipline evidence, only utilisation of 65-75% on ferrous and aluminium.

name: BCL Industries Ltd-$
gLine: 150 KLPD Bathinda unit utilisation: at least 75% from Q2 FY27; rated capacity by first week of July (FY27)
thesis: FY26 ethanol volumes rose ~74% to 53,000 KL as diversion to ENA/SBF offset lower OMC allocation; realisations under pressure, but 150 KLPD Bathinda unit adds ~INR300 crore revenue at full run-rate, with ~75% utilisation targeted from Q2.

name: Premier Explosives Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR600-700 crores (FY27)
thesis: Record INR1,569 cr order book (4.04x FY26 revenue) but FY26 revenue fell 7% to INR388 cr on raw-material and plant-accident delays; FY27 guided INR600-700 cr, a 50-80% jump that depends on unproven alternate materials and Katepally commissioning.
top: Katepally commissioning slipping to Q3 FY27

name: Rishi Laser Ltd
gLine: Malur plant revenue FY27: ₹60 crore (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue ₹160 cr (+7%) and PAT down 55% to ₹3.67 cr as Malur commissioning ran late; management now targets ₹60 cr from Malur in FY27 and an EBITDA band of 8–11%, with little evidence yet of supply discipline.

name: Radico Khaitan Ltd
gLine: P&A volume growth FY27: 20% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 gross margin 48% (+450bp) and EBITDA margin 19% on premiumisation; guides FY27 P&A volume +20% and 120–125bp margin expansion, with capex only INR 150–175 crores and no supply constraint flagged.

name: Lumax Auto Technologies Ltd
gLine: Capex: INR 275-300 crore (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 4,870 crore (+34%) and EBITDA margin 14.5%, but no capacity cut or deferral; management is adding capex of INR 275-300 crore and guiding to 20% CAGR, with a 3-6 month pass-through lag on input costs.

name: Fortis Healthcare Ltd
gLine: Hospital revenue growth FY27: 15%+ (FY27)
thesis: Hospital margins rose to 22.2% in FY26 and management reaffirmed 25% by FY28, but occupancy slipped to 68% and CGHS/ECHS onco price caps are cutting volume in Punjab, with capex guided at about INR900 crores a year.
top: Onco price cap hits Punjab volumes

name: Refex Industries Ltd
gLine: Ash & coal handling revenue: double-digit growth FY27
thesis: Refex's ash & coal handling service mix lifted Q4 EBITDA margin to 20.1% on revenue of INR701 crores, but FY26 revenue fell to INR2,039 crores from INR2,259 crores and wind is only just ramping (EBITDA ~8%).

name: Bansal Roofing Products Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 26.8% to Rs45.89 cr but EBITDA margin only ~9%; management leans on unbuilt solar MMS capacity (25,000 t/month claim) with thin 2.5–3% net margins and 30–45 day credit, while utilisation of existing lines is low (roofing 50.7%, PEB 81%).
top: Solar credit 30–45 days, receivables to rise

name: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: INR21,000-22,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: Transmission-led capex ramp (FY27 guide INR21,000-22,000 crore, transmission ~15,500) with leverage held at 4.5x-4.7x; EBITDA growth depends on capitalisation of locked-in projects over 36-40 months.

name: Bigbloc Construction Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume growth: 10-20% (FY27)
thesis: Volumes up 40% in Q4 but EBITDA margin only 7.36% and FY26 net loss ~INR 9 crore; management says pricing pass-through is lagging raw-material costs up 5-15%, with utilisation at 78% in Q4 and no capex committed.

name: Aditya Vision Ltd
gLine: Store additions: around 25 stores per year (when asked) (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up 18% to INR2,672 crore despite weak summer; Q4 revenue +28% and PAT +36%, but Q4 EBITDA margin 8.1% and inventory swelled to ~INR840 crore ahead of a summer that management says is cold-starting.

name: Tube Investments of India Ltd
gLine: TI Medical growth: 20% YoY growth (FY27)
thesis: Engineering volume tracking revenue growth with no major Q4 price moves; Q4 consolidated PBIT-type profit up ~8% on revenue up 21%, while EV three-wheeler supply was disrupted by a body-in-white supplier and CDMO plant nears commercial output next quarter.
top: Western tube utilisation ~30%, target 100% by mid-FY27

name: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd
gLine: Lucknow Gomti Nagar capacity: 426 to 570 beds over next 2 quarters (2 quarters)
thesis: Q4 network EBITDA margin fell to 26.8% (vs 27.2% a year ago) as chemo-drug discontinuation cut oncology share to 21% and ALOS rose 9%; capacity adds are phased, with ~INR 1,400 crore Lucknow greenfield approved.

name: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd
gLine: FY27 operating growth: close to 30% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes up 22% YoY with EBITDA up 33%, but management is adding a fresh INR2,700 crore capex plan (stainless downstream, long wire mill) and guided ~30% FY27 growth; working-capital days were stretched via 130 payable days and 123 inventory days.

name: Devyani International Ltd
gLine: Net new stores FY27 (DIL standalone): 200 to 225 (FY27)
thesis: QSR operator with KFC SSSG +4.9% and brand contribution up ~20%, but Pizza Hut SSSG -3.7% and net store closures in Q4 leave supply discipline and pricing unproven; no capex-per-store change guided.

name: Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Ltd
gLine: Industry volume growth FY27: 7% to 9% (FY27)
thesis: Record Q4 volume of 6 Mt and EBITDA of INR590 crore, but a fuel and packaging cost shock of about INR200/t against only partial price hikes of INR8-15/bag leaves margins under pressure for 1-2 quarters.
top: Price hikes INR8-12 trade vs ~INR200/t cost rise

name: Acutaas Chemicals Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 25% (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 revenue INR1,339cr (+33%) and PAT INR356cr; management guides 25% FY27 revenue growth and similar EBITDA margin (~35%), with capex falling to ~INR100cr-odd and utilisation of key plants at 31-75% in Q4.

name: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 40% (more than 40% expected) (FY27)
thesis: Vijaya Diagnostic Q4 FY26 revenue up 26.6% on 18.5% volume, EBITDA margin 43.5%; capex guided INR 140-150 crore for FY27 with 4-5 hubs and 10-12 spokes, a volume-led expansion rather than a supply-discipline signal.

name: Insolation Energy Ltd
gLine: FY27 module revenue growth: 50-60% / at least FY26 growth (FY27)
thesis: Solar module maker scaling to 4.5 GW cell line (COD Q3/Q4 FY27) with FY27 module volume guided ~2 GW; margins guided 14-15% FY27 and 20%+ later, but receivables up 156% and FCF deeply negative.

name: Global Health Ltd
gLine: Mature hospital margin: 24%–25% range
thesis: Medanta FY26 supply build-out continues: 623 beds added, ~2,700 greenfield beds and FY27 capex INR 800–900 crore; mature-hospital margin 24.4% and Noida losses narrowing (Q4 loss INR 236m vs Q3 INR 320m).

name: Netweb Technologies India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth (organic): 35% to 40% over next couple of years (2 years)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 86.6% to INR7,737m with 13–14% EBITDA margin guided, but inventory days jumped 60→86 and management gave no quantified capacity or supply-side detail; base order book only ~INR800-900m ex-strategic orders.

name: Tata Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 organic revenue growth: double-digit cc, ex ES-Tec
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 12.4% QoQ cc (8.8% organic) with EBITDA margin 16%; management guides double-digit FY27 cc growth and 18%+ exit margin, but no supply-side capex or capacity data disclosed.

name: GPT Healthcare Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Mature hospitals earn 23.06% EBITDA margin ex-Raipur, but Raipur's FY26 EBITDA loss of INR13.8 crores drags the reported margin to 18.84%; guidance hinges on Raipur breakeven by Q3 FY27.

name: Gopal Snacks Ltd
gLine: FY27 incremental sales delta: Rs 330-350 cr (FY27)
thesis: Gopal Snacks Q4 revenue Rs 409.6 cr (+29% YoY) with Rajkot plant back and Modasa integrated; FY27 EBITDA guided 8-9% while palm oil/packaging inflation of 4-4.5% is being offset via grammage cuts and price hikes.
top: FY27 capex Rs 40-45 cr, mostly maintenance

name: Waaree Energies Ltd
gLine: Operating EBITDA FY27: INR7,000-7,700 crore (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 but Q4 margin fell to ~18.6% on commodity, freight and mix; FY27 operating EBITDA guided to Rs7,000-7,700 crore on 10 GW cell ramp, with capex of ~Rs30,000 crore raising supply risk.

name: Rajesh Power Services Ltd
gLine: FY27 closing order book: above INR 5,000 Cr
thesis: FY26 revenue up 52% to ₹1,628 Cr with order book ₹3,326 Cr, but receivables jumped to ₹350 Cr, payables stretched to ~58 days, and the ₹2,200 Cr L1/bid book is still unawarded.

name: Carraro India Ltd
gLine: FY30 revenue: ₹3,500cr to ₹4,000cr (FY30)
thesis: FY26 revenue up 25% to ₹2,255cr and EBITDA margin 10.8% (vs 10.2%), but FY27 guidance softened to 4–8% growth from 8–12% amid West Asia energy and supply risk; capex ₹130cr held.

name: Ventive Hospitality Ltd
gLine: Medium-term revenue growth India: low-teen revenue growth and high-teen EBITDA growth (medium to long term)
thesis: Hospitality-led growth with rate-led India (ADR +13%) and Maldives occupancy gains, but Q4 EBITDA growth was 8% ex-FX gain and management gave no numeric guidance, with April–May Maldives traffic data contested.

name: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Ltd
gLine: Store expansion capex: INR 250-300 cr (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue +12% to INR 2,174 cr with EBITDA margin 17.2%, but growth is demand-led with capex trimmed to about INR 300 cr and store net adds guided stronger; supply discipline is mixed, not a capital-cycle signal.

name: Solarworld Energy Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue from order book: ~INR2,000 crore (70% of INR2,800 crore order book) (FY27)
thesis: Solar EPC-plus-module integrator guides FY27 revenue near INR2,000 crore (70% of INR2,800 crore order book) with margins 8–11%, but module line utilisation is only ~40–45% on captive orders and the cell line is not until June 2027.
top: Margin range cut to 8-11% from prior 11% PAT

name: Infinity Infoway Ltd
gLine: ZeroTouch share of revenue: 20% to 22% in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Small-cap SaaS/ERP firm guiding ZeroTouch to 20-22% of revenue and FY27 growth of 60-70%, but no capacity, utilisation or pricing data backs it; supply-side evidence is absent.

name: Om Power Transmission Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~50% (FY27)
thesis: Maiden call of a T&D EPC: FY26 revenue INR 449 crore (+61%), order book INR 621 crore (book-to-bill 1.38x), EBITDA margin steady at 12.7%, with management guiding 50% growth in FY27 and 12-13% EBITDA margin.

name: Steel Authority of India Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: INR15,000 crore (FY27)

name: Tata Steel Ltd

name: Greaves Cotton Ltd

top: Q4 gross margin down on commodity costs

name: Triton Valves Ltd

top: Spot price hikes taken from March

name: Jyoti Resins & Adhesives Ltd

name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd

name: Health X Platform Ltd

name: GPT Infraprojects Ltd

name: Gujarat Energy Ltd

name: Mobavenue AI Tech Ltd

name: BLS International Services Ltd

name: SIS Ltd

name: Sky Gold And Diamonds Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR8,100 crores (FY27)
thesis: Sky Gold is shifting to advanced-gold (job-work) model, cutting working capital days to 59 from 71 and targeting 50%+ debt reduction in FY27, but utilisation is only ~55% and margin claims rest on mix shift and guidance credibility.

name: Kranti Industries Ltd
gLine: Plant-4 (Jaipur) revenue FY27: ₹12-14 crore (FY27)
thesis: Standalone FY26 revenue up 30% to ₹93.88 cr and EBITDA margin 10.5%→13.3%, but Pune utilisation only ~65% and new Jaipur plant under 40% utilised, so capacity is running ahead of demand.

name: SMC Global Securities Ltd
gLine: NBFC AUM growth: 15% to 20% in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue +22.6% YoY and EBITDA margin 17.4% (+250bp) on broking and insurance leverage, but FY26 EBITDA fell 10.3% and PAT 29.9% as NBFC AUM shrank to INR 1,119 crore and finance costs rose to INR 221.3 crore.

name: Laxmi Organic Industries Ltd
gLine: Dahej Phase 2 chemical charging: Q1 FY27 (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Acetic-acid-driven ETAC spreads spiked to ~$250 in April then eased to $150–160, with FY26 revenue down 6% and Specialties recovery dependent on Dahej and Hitachi ramp-ups in H2 FY27.

name: Lodha Developers Ltd
gLine: FY27 presales: about INR240 billion (FY27)
thesis: Lodha guides FY27 presales ~INR240bn (mid-teens growth) with 32-34% embedded EBITDA margin, shifts focus to PAT (20% CAGR to >INR85bn by FY31) and cuts BD spend; supply discipline strong but Middle East shock caused March closure deferrals.

name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 combined ratio improved to 95.7% and loss ratio fell to 65.2% (from 69.2%), but management gave no numeric FY27 guidance and the gain is still being tested across cycles.

name: AWL Agri Business Ltd
gLine: Food volume growth FY27: mid-teens (double digit)
thesis: Q4 volume +14% to ~1.9mt and EBITDA/t near INR 3,400, but management flags Q1 cost inflation from crude-linked inputs and softer April demand; food guided EBITDA-neutral to FY27.
top: April demand sluggish, Q1 to pick up

name: eMudhra Ltd
gLine: FY27 organic revenue growth: ~18% (FY27)
thesis: Software/PKI firm, not a capital-cycle story: FY26 PAT ₹1,100m (+26%) with FY27 guided at 18% top line and 25–30% PAT growth, but Q4 PAT rose only 21.6% and no capacity discipline is discussed.

name: Five-Star Business Finance Ltd
gLine: AUM growth FY27: ~20% (18–20% range over 2–3 years) (FY27-FY29)
thesis: Q4 FY26 collections recovered (slippage 1.9%→0.7%, UCCE 98.1%) but credit cost guided up to 1.7–1.75% for FY27 and 1.5–1.6% steady state; FY27 AUM growth ~20% on disbursement push of INR6,500–7,000 cr.

name: DIVGI TORQTRANSFER SYSTEMS Ltd
gLine: Components annual revenue from newly secured programs: nearing INR100 crore (not specified)
thesis: FY26 revenue hit a record INR375 crore (+56%) and Q4 hit INR113.8 crore, but the EV unit runs at only 25-30% utilisation and management gave no capacity discipline or capex figures.

name: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: double-digit, early teens (FY27)
thesis: Asset-light 3PL with Q4 revenue Rs 3,032 cr (+21.3% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA margin 7.3%; GFS margins stay thin at 2.4% and management guides FY27 margin flat at 7.3-7.4%.

name: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Ltd
gLine: EM Bypass cash flow improvement: close to 70 crores this year (FY27)
thesis: Hotel operator with FY26 revenue ₹707 cr (+12%) and PAT margin 9.21%, but Q4 ARR growth slowed to 3% on Middle East cancellations in Delhi and Hyderabad; capex expansion via asset-light and owned keys adds to capital demand.

name: Rossell Techsys Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: similar to FY26 (~87%) (FY27)
thesis: Revenue up 87% to INR485 crore with EBITDA margin compressing to about 13.6%, management attributes it to qualification investment and guides FY27 growth similar to FY26 with a QIP planned, no numeric margin guidance beyond 17-22% band.
top: EBITDA margin down: FY25 ~15% to FY26 ~13.6%

name: International Gemological Institute Ltd
thesis: Diamond certification volumes up 16% in Q4 with LGD certification revenue up 35%, but no supply-side or capex data; growth framed around LGD capacity build in Surat and ND jewelry softness from gold prices.

name: Capitalnumbers Infotech Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: gradual recovery towards 33% (FY27)
thesis: Services firm with no capacity cycle: FY26 revenue up ~5% to INR105 crore, EBITDA flat at INR35.8 crore, and FY27 guidance of minimum 35% growth rests on acquisition plus unproven organic adds.
top: H2 contract closures slipped into FY27

name: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Ltd
gLine: FY27 city hotel occupancy: mid-70s (FY27)
thesis: Luxury hotel operator: FY26 PAT Rs403cr with 49% EBITDA margin, but Q4 RevPAR up only 6% on March war disruption to international occupancy; 966 new keys in pipeline add supply, not yet tested by demand.

name: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: ~INR430 crore (INR336 cr order in hand + ~INR100 cr channel), minimum 25% growth (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue fell 35% QoQ to INR105 cr as execution slipped into Q1 FY27; management guides FY27 ~INR430 cr (INR336 cr order-in-hand plus ~INR100 cr channel) and EBITDA 12–13%, but working capital days jumped to 185 from 68.

name: Travel Food Services Ltd
gLine: Passenger traffic FY27: about 5% (industry expectation cited) (FY27)
thesis: Travel F&B concessionaire grew system-wide sales 25.4% to INR32.1bn in FY26 on 1.2% airport traffic, but Q4 PAT was flattered by a one-time reclassification and a INR212m litigation provision pulled in, with INR1bn receivables build from EATS.

name: Urban Company Ltd
thesis: Urban Company is a demand-led marketplace story, not a capital-cycle one: no capacity or capex signals, NTV up 42% YoY in Q4, and InstaHelp losses of ₹119 Cr drive the reported loss.

name: Capillary Technologies India Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR1,000-1,050 crores (FY27)
thesis: SaaS loyalty platform, not a capital-cycle story: FY26 revenue INR734 crores (+23%), 110% NRR, adjusted EBITDA margin ~14.7%, plus debt-free M&A roll-up (SessionM closed at ~0.5x revenue).

name: EPL Ltd
gLine: Tax rate (steady state): 18% to 22% (steady state)
thesis: Q4 revenue +17.6% and FY26 EBITDA margin 20.4% with capex of INR 480 crore+ ahead of demand, but management gave no numeric Middle East cost-recovery figure and guided only 11-13% growth long term.

name: Kajaria Ceramics Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 18% to 19% (current scenario)
thesis: Q4 FY26 volume +11% and EBITDA margin 19.19% (vs 10.01%) as Morbi gas shutdown removes a key competitor's supply, but Morbi restart from 1 May and gas-price pass-through add uncertainty; no volume guidance given.

name: Pidilite Industries Ltd
gLine: UVG FY27: about 100 bps higher than FY26 (~11.1%) planned (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone UVG 15.3% and EBITDA margin 23.4% (+280bps), but management is passing through 40–50% raw material inflation with VAM-driven price hikes of ~12–15% on Fevicol and no FY27 volume guidance.

name: Cummins India Ltd
gLine: FY27 sales growth: moderate growth across segments (FY2026/27)
thesis: Cummins India FY26 sales up 18% to INR11,950 crore with data centres at 30-35% of domestic power gen, but management guided only moderate growth, flagged commodity and supplier cost pressure, and gave no new capacity; utilisation about 70%.
top: Data centre share 30-35% of power gen

name: Voltas Ltd
gLine: RAC industry growth FY27: 15-20%
thesis: Voltas RAC channel inventory cut to under 45 days (near 30) and April ran close to record March, but UCP margin fell to ~3.2% in FY26 from 8.4% and management gave no hard margin number.

name: The Phoenix Mills Ltd
gLine: Retail rental growth FY27: mid-to-high double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Retail rentals up 10% to Rs 2,157 cr against consumption up 21%, with ~36-50% of area up for renewal; no new retail capacity added in FY26, so supply discipline is strong and rent growth is the lagging catalyst.

name: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin: ~15% (FY27)
thesis: Own-brand IMFL grew 32% in FY26 with 22% Q4 margin, but management guides FY27 EBITDA to ~15% and IMFL margin to 15–17%; ethanol volumes fell 35% on industry oversupply.

name: Bhagyanagar India Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: ~5% maintained through next year (FY27)
thesis: Copper recycler posted Q4 FY26 revenue ~735 cr, PAT ~18.5 cr and guides ~5% EBITDA margin with 20% volume growth, but capacity expansion is modest (~40 cr capex over 2 years) and no peer-capacity discipline is discussed.

name: Carborundum Universal Ltd
gLine: Consolidated sales growth FY27: 4% to 4.5% (FY27)
thesis: Standalone sales up 8.6% to INR 3,024 crore with H2 up 14%, but consolidated PBIT fell 25% on VAW, Foskor and Awuko losses; FY27 guide is 4–4.5% consolidated growth with capex stepping up to about INR 400 crore.

name: NMDC Ltd
gLine: FY27 production (incl. NSL): 60 Mt (FY27)
thesis: NMDC guides FY27 to 60 Mt (from 53 Mt FY26) via existing mines, capex stepping to ~INR6,000 cr with EBITDA held at 42-43% and prices range-bound; execution risk on 100 Mt by 2030.

name: TVS Motor Company Ltd
gLine: FY27 industry growth: strong single-digit
thesis: TVS Motor posted record FY26 (volume 5.9m, +24%; EBITDA margin 12.9%) and is adding 1.5m units of capacity to ~8.3m, but Q1 faces 3-5% commodity inflation and supply-chain disruption that channel stock is absorbing.

name: Balaji Telefilms Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: close to INR800-odd crores (FY27)
thesis: Balaji's FY26 revenue fell to INR210 crore from INR453 crore with an EBITDA loss of INR65.8 crore; management guides FY27 to ~INR800 crore on a motion-pictures and OTT order-book ramp with no supply discipline evidence.

name: Suprajit Engineering Ltd-$
gLine: Group revenue growth FY27: double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Restructuring-led margin story: SCS turned EBITDA positive in Q4 FY26 and management guides FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin 12-13.5% with GCM at 10-12%, but tariff leakage and Middle East commodity risk are unresolved.

name: Vodafone Idea Ltd
gLine: Cash EBITDA margin: north of 35% in next 3-4 years (ambition) (3-4 years)
thesis: Vi's Q4 FY26 is a capex-led recovery story, but the headline profit is an AGR one-off (Rs 55,622 Cr exceptional gain); cash EBITDA grew only 4.8% and FY26 cash EBITDA was flat at Rs 9,217 Cr.
top: AGR dues cut to Rs 64,046 Cr

name: V-Guard Industries Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: at least 10% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue +14.1% and EBITDA +19.3% on volume, but FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 8.8% from 9.2%; ~75% of an 8–13% input-cost pass-through landed, with the balance pending as high-cost inventory arrives.

name: VRL Logistics Ltd
gLine: FY27 tonnage volume growth: 6% to 7% full year; at least 2% sequential growth per quarter (FY27)
thesis: Volume decline narrowing: Q4 tonnage up ~3% YoY after FY26 down ~7%, management guides 6-7% FY27 growth, but relies on fuel pass-through and a fleet adds plan of ~500 vehicles, not a capacity cut.

name: PNC Infratech Ltd
gLine: Standalone revenue FY27: ~30% growth, ~INR 6,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: FY26 standalone revenue fell short on delayed HAM appointed dates; management guides ~30% FY27 revenue growth to ~INR 6,000 crore and ~12% EBITDA, but FY26 execution misses weigh on credibility.

name: TCI Express Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume growth: 10%+ (10-11%) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 6% to INR 327 crore with volume up 4% and PAT margin 6.3%; FY27 guidance of 10%+ volume and 100-150bp margin recovery rests on fuel pass-through, with April-May softness flagged.

name: Godrej Agrovet Ltd
gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: early double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 volume-led growth with Crop Care guided to recover from Q2 FY27 after co-marketing inventory overhang; FY27 guide is early double-digit revenue and mid-teens PBT growth, with capex about INR350 crore and ~INR100-125 crore surplus.
top: Crop Care co-marketing inventory clears by Q2

name: Adani Total Gas Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: Same as FY26 growth rate (FY27)
thesis: CGD volumes strong (CNG +17%, PNG +5% in Q4) but gas cost pass-through is capped by consumer-first pricing; FY27 EBITDA guided loosely at ~INR1,500 crore vs FY26 INR1,225 crore.

name: BMW Industries Ltd
gLine: Bokaro project ROCE: 15%+ blended (Steady state)
thesis: Legacy tube/CRM conversion runs at ~34% utilisation with no new capex; Bokaro greenfield (~INR803 crore) starts phased commissioning Q1 FY27, with management guiding ~75% revenue CAGR FY25–FY28 and blended EBITDA margin 12–13%.
top: Bokaro ~INR803 cr greenfield, phase one Q1 FY27

name: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Ltd
gLine: FY27 closing AUM: ~₹6,500 cr (Mar-27)
thesis: Spandana returned to profit (PAT ₹5 cr vs ₹95 cr loss) with AUM up 12% QoQ to ₹4,420 cr and X-bucket CE 99.7%; FY27 exit AUM target ₹6,500 cr needs disbursals to rise to ₹550-600 cr/month.

name: Antony Waste Handling Cell Ltd
gLine: Revenue CAGR: 15% to 20% over next 5 years (5 years)
thesis: Waste management company with Rs.18,000 crore order book (60% processing) and Rs.650-750 crore capex for AP WTE projects; volumes up strongly but underlying non-CIDCO revenue growth only ~8%, EBITDA margin ~22% and PAT growth tied to interest and depreciation.

name: Dodla Dairy Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: low to mid-teens (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 5% as milk procurement rose to INR41/l vs INR37.4 a year ago and prices lagged; management guides 50-100bps gross margin recovery in FY27, but adjusted FY26 PAT is only ~INR215 cr after one-offs.

name: Windlas Biotech Ltd
gLine: Plant 6 commercialisation: H1 FY27 (H1 FY27)
thesis: Windlas grew FY26 revenue 19% to INR904 crores with a CDMO-led mix, but codeine loss hit trade generics and the company is not planning organic capex beyond Plant 6 until FY27-28.

name: Sapphire Foods India Ltd
gLine: KFC gross margin investment if vendor support ends: 50-70 bp headwind
thesis: QSR operator (KFC/Pizza Hut) with Q4 SSSG 4% (6% ex-Navratri) and restaurant EBITDA up 110bp to 16.8% on value-led recruitment, but capex and FY27 spend held flat and Pizza Hut still declining.

name: Eureka Forbes Ltd
gLine: FY27 adjusted EBITDA margin: at least hold FY26 margin (12.2%) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue +11.6% to INR 684 cr with 13.2% adjusted EBITDA margin, but management guided only to holding FY27 margins amid 6-7% price hike and rising input costs; no capacity or capex signal.

name: Hariom Pipe Industries Ltd
thesis: FY26 volume growth fell short of the 30% guided last quarter; management now guides FY27 volume of 350,000–360,000 t (~20–25%) with blended EBITDA/t near ₹7,200–7,800 and no firm margin target. Capacity is not the constraint, and the Perundurai closure is a freight and sourcing issue.

name: Bikaji Foods International Ltd
gLine: Core market growth FY27: about 13% plus/minus
thesis: Bikaji reports ~18% Q4 top-line growth and FY26 revenue of ~INR 2,994 crore at 9.5% volume growth, but management flagged a 3% price rise, packaging cost spikes and a supply disruption, with no capacity added in FY26.

name: Dharmaj Crop Guard Ltd
gLine: FY27 top-line growth: 18% to 20% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue Rs 1,138 cr (+20%) and EBITDA margin 9%, but technical plant only at PBT breakeven with 65-70% utilisation, and inventory build of Rs 2,074 mn stretched cash cycle to 87 days.

name: Landmark Cars Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: around INR 50 crore (ballpark) (FY27)
thesis: Dealer Landmark Cars posts record FY26 EBITDA of INR 283 crore but in a consolidation year; inventory was held near 30-36 days ahead of price hikes, and capex guided to roughly INR 50 crore.

name: IKIO Technologies Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20-22% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue up 47% YoY to INR165 cr and FY26 EBITDA margin ~13%, but management guides FY27 growth of 20-22% with working capital stretched and no order book; supply-side evidence thin.

name: Shelter Pharma Ltd
gLine: Annual revenue: around INR 200 Cr by FY2030 (FY2030)
thesis: Herbal pharma with FY26 revenue ₹73.13 Cr (+44%) and EBITDA margin 17.39% (down from ~20%+); working capital cycle 234 days and operating cash flow of -₹12.48 Cr signal growth funded by credit to distributors, not capacity discipline.

name: Suraj Estate Developers Ltd
gLine: Net debt FY27 year-end: INR600-650 crore (FY27)
thesis: Real estate developer with no capacity-cycle signal; FY26 presales up 23% to INR615 crore but net debt rose to INR579.91 crore, weighted cost ~13%, and FY27 guidance deferred.
top: FY27 presales guidance deferred to next call

name: Muthoot Microfin Ltd
gLine: FY27 AUM growth: 12% to 15% (FY27)
thesis: Muthoot Microfin is pivoting from monoline JLG to diversified retail: FY26 AUM ₹14,005 cr (+13%), GNPA 3.89%, credit cost 3.5%, and a ₹30,000 cr AUM by 2030 target needing ~21% CAGR.

name: Innova Captab Ltd
gLine: Volume growth at group level: 20% plus (FY27)
thesis: Revenue up 31% to INR1,630 cr and Q4 up 42%, but PAT up only 10% to INR140.9 cr; Jammu ~INR300 cr FY26 near EBITDA breakeven, with management guiding 20%+ volume growth for FY27 and a new Baddi block of INR150-170 cr capex.
top: New Baddi block capex INR150-170 cr

name: Suraksha Diagnostic Ltd
gLine: Blended EBITDA margin FY27: ~33% (FY27)
thesis: Diagnostics roll-out keeps adding centres (68 at FY26 end, ~14 more in FY27) but new-centre margin is -5.5% and blended EBITDA margin fell to 31.7% from 33.8%; patient growth slowed to low single digits in Q4.
top: FY27 capex ~INR70 crores for new centres

name: B.R.Goyal Infrastructure Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: 20% to 25% growth rate (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up 61% to INR820 crore and EBITDA margin 9.13%, but order book fell to INR1,235 crore from INR1,313 crore and no capacity or capex discipline signals were given.
top: Order book down to INR1,235 cr

name: Patel Retail Ltd
gLine: Store additions: 8 to 10 stores per year
thesis: Retail-plus-processing story with weak supply signals: utilisation only 50-55%, Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 6.7%, working capital ballooned to INR259 crore inventory and INR161 crore receivables, and management guides FY27 EBITDA margin 8-9%.
top: Inventory INR259 crore, receivables up to INR162 crore

name: Vikram Solar Ltd
gLine: FY27 production: 7.5-8 GW (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR4,800 crores and 3.3 GW shipments, but per-watt EBITDA falling from ~INR6 toward INR1.75–2 on non-DCR volumes as cell costs rise and captive cell is delayed to FY28.

name: Karbonsteel Engineering Ltd
gLine: Production volume: about 40,000 tons annually (FY26)
thesis: Heavy fabricator guides to 40,000 tons and 12-13% normalised margin on a 54,000-ton expansion, but the expansion slipped from March to October and FY25 revenue missed the 340-crore target.

name: Dev Accelerator Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue run rate: INR330-350 crore (FY27)
thesis: Flexible workspace operator (DevX) FY26 revenue INR226 crore (+42%) with standalone EBITDA margin 60.5%, but supply is expanding via debt/preferential funding; mature-centre occupancy metric was redefined, flattering the trend.

name: Shankara Buildpro Ltd
gLine: Steel volume FY27: 1.2 million tonnes (~20% growth) (FY27)
thesis: Steel-led distributor with 30% FY26 revenue growth and EBITDA margin up to 3.35%, guiding FY27 volume +20%, non-steel +25% to INR 750 cr, and margin ~3.3–3.5%; Q1 demand softening from price hikes.
top: Q1 FY27 demand softening from price hikes

name: Ivalue Infosolutions Ltd
gLine: Short-term gross margin on gross sales: around 10% (short term)
thesis: FY26 gross sales up 19.5% to INR 2,914 crore and PAT INR 102.3 crore pre-exceptional, but no capacity or supply-side signal; management guided FY27 at 18-20% top line and 20-22% PAT, with Q4 gross margin of 12.5% flattered by Q4 rebates.

name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd
gLine: FY27 industry & company growth: mid to high single digit
thesis: Lead-acid core growing ~12% with 4W OEM volumes up 30%+, but raw-material inflation (lead ~₹2 lakh/t) squeezes margins; FY27 capex ₹1,500–1,700 crore, mostly New Energy, with ₹2,000 crore-plus cell plans still unproven on returns.

name: Blue Star Ltd
gLine: Annual capex: Rs 250-350 Crore (FY27)
thesis: Blue Star's FY26 cost pass-through is only ~8% of a 13% required price rise, with management guiding UCP margin 8-8.5% and Sri City RAC plant at ~100% utilisation, with the next line decision deferred to October.
top: Sri City RAC plant at 100% utilisation

name: Exide Industries Ltd
gLine: Core business growth FY27: high single-digit to early double-digit growth (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +9.4% YoY with gross margin down ~90bp to 30.1% on a Rs 150 crore commodity hit, offset by cost control and 3-4 rounds of price hikes totalling ~5-6% plus ~3% in April; Rs 1,400 crore FY27 lithium-ion capex with no cell revenue yet.

name: Kirloskar Brothers Ltd-$
thesis: Q4 consolidated revenue up 10% to Rs14.15bn but FY26 flat at Rs45.38bn; UK SPP margin mix hit EBITDA, while domestic order book up 30% to Rs24.68bn with no numeric FY27 guidance.

name: Supreme Petrochem Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume growth: 8% to 10% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 volumes up 5.4% and EBITDA margin 15.9% on inventory-heavy March pricing; management refuses to quantify inventory gains/losses, ABS running at 65% of design, and FY27 volume guidance of 8-10% is conditional on normalcy by June.

name: Styrenix Performance Materials Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA ₹128 cr at 15.3% margin on mix and opportunistic pricing, but India GPPS volumes fell and management gave no numeric guidance and no new PS capacity timeline, with ABS capacity "second half" unchanged.
top: Profit lift partly opportunistic, not sustainable

name: Supreme Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 piping volume growth: 15% to 17% (FY27)
thesis: Supreme guides FY27 piping volume +15-17% and margin 14-14.5% on ~1.10 lakh MT capacity add, but industry volumes fell 9% in FY26 and channel inventory is unverifiable.
top: Capacity +1.10 lakh MT to ~1.35 mn MT

name: Can Fin Homes Ltd
gLine: FY27 disbursement: INR13,000 crore
thesis: Q4 FY26 disbursements hit record INR3,245 crore and FY27 guidance of INR13,000 crore disbursement with 14% AUM growth, spreads held at 2.75% guided, but growth is in housing-finance rundown-heavy book with prepayments elevated.

name: Shriram Finance Ltd
gLine: AUM growth FY27: 18% (FY27)
thesis: Shriram Finance Q4 FY26 AUM up 14.85% YoY to INR3.02 lakh cr with NIM 8.61% and PAT up 40.9%, but gross Stage 3 edged up to 4.58% and FY27 AUM growth budgeted at 18% is not yet reconfirmed beyond Q1.

name: Ugro Capital Ltd
gLine: Opex, combined annualised: INR 490-500 cr in FY27 (from ~INR 750 cr) (FY27)
thesis: Ugro is shrinking its high-volume prime DSA book (~15-20% run-down a year) to swap into higher-yield branch LAP and embedded finance; AUM flat, opex cut to INR 490-500 cr, FY27 a transition year with no ROA guidance.

name: Nava Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 35-40%
thesis: Standalone PAT up 116% to INR 911 crore on overseas dividends and buyback proceeds, not operations; ferro-alloy prices under pressure while power PLF guided higher on cheaper Singareni coal.
top: Ferro-alloy pricing pressure from surplus supply

name: Centum Electronics Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: INR 40-45 crore (FY27)
thesis: Standalone FY26 revenue up 25% to INR 973 cr and Q4 EBITDA margin 13.22%, but FY26 margin of 12.42% missed the 13-15% target and the BTS order book is the key swing factor.

name: Frontier Springs Ltd
gLine: FY27 gross revenue: ~₹500 crore, ~30% growth (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up 39% to ₹322 crore with EBITDA margin 26.8%, but management guides ~30% FY27 growth to ₹500 crore gross and sees margin drifting to 23-24%, with capacity utilisation only ~70%.

name: DCM Shriram Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: INR1,000-1,200 crore (FY27)
thesis: Chemicals capex cycle concluded with FY27 capex guided at INR1,000-1,200 crore, but PVC and sugar margins are squeezed; caustic utilisation ~85% with ECU INR32,000-33,000/MT.

name: Menon Bearings Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 revenue: more than INR360 crore (FY27)
thesis: Management guides ~25% annual growth toward INR500 crore by FY28 and 20-22% EBITDA margin, with utilisation rising (Bi-Metal 85%, Alkop 65%) but no hard capacity expansion beyond modest capex of about INR35 crore over two years.

name: Marksans Pharma Ltd
gLine: Revenue FY27 growth: 15% to 20% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 record quarter (revenue INR856 cr, EBITDA margin 22.8%) with petroleum-linked raw material inflation of 20-30% partly buffered by 5-6 months inventory; FY27 margin guided flat at 20-21%, growth 15-20%.

name: Shilpa Medicare Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin 35%: aspirational, not immediate (1-2 years)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR439 cr (+30% YoY) and FY26 EBITDA INR445 cr at 29% margin, but no numeric FY27 guidance and capex flat versus FY26 INR361 cr; supply signals are muted.
top: Q4 revenue +30% YoY to INR439 cr

name: Saregama India Ltd
gLine: FY27 new content budget: INR 300-350 cr (FY27)
thesis: Music-catalogue company, not a capacity business: Q4 revenue INR 287 cr (+19% YoY) and record adjusted EBITDA INR 133 cr, but management concedes content spend is ramping and FY27 content budget INR 300-350 cr with no step-up after.
top: New content spend FY27 INR 300-350 cr

name: Cera Sanitaryware Ltd
gLine: Sanitaryware volume growth FY27: 7% to 8% (FY27)
thesis: Cera's Q4 volume recovery and Morbi gas disruption support near-term share gains, but margins fell to 15.2% from 18.3% on brass costs and trade discounts, and sanitaryware utilisation is only 70%.

name: Alldigi Tech Ltd
industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens (FY27)

name: Vibhor Steel Tubes Ltd
gLine: New products share of revenue: 25-30% this year (FY27)
thesis: Vibhor is diversifying from ERW pipe into higher-margin transmission towers, poles and guardrails, with 2,300-2,400 t tower orders and Maharashtra/Hyderabad pipe capacity running at 74%/67%.

name: Aelea Commodities Ltd
gLine: FY27 top-line and bottom-line growth: similar growth rate to FY26, no numbers (FY27)
thesis: Cashew processor Aelea reports H2 FY26 revenue of Rs189.5 cr and 13.1% EBITDA margin, but management gave no numbers for FY27, inventory rising to Rs100 cr and finance cost up sharply on deeper supplier-chain buying.

name: Godavari Biorefineries Ltd
gLine: Bio-based chemical market outlook: stronger outlook from this quarter onwards
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA rebounded to INR92 crores (16.2% margin) on sugar crushing, but bio-chem and ethanol commentary is qualitative with no capacity-utilisation or pricing numbers; the 60 million litre grain distillery is still unproven and maize economics are undisclosed.

name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Ltd
gLine: IFRS combined operating ratio FY29: ~99% (FY29)
thesis: Niva Bupa FY26 GWP up 27.4% to ₹9,433 cr with IFRS combined ratio improving 160bp to 101.4% on expense ratio cut to 33.7%; management targets ~99% COR by FY29, but commission regulation is an open overhang.

name: Transrail Lighting Ltd
gLine: FY27 new order intake: INR10,000 crores to INR11,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue +30% to INR6,880 cr with EBITDA margin 11.92%, but FY27 guided to ~20-22% growth and ~11% margin, and tower capacity expansion (1,72,000 to 1,96,000 MT) is near complete, adding supply.

name: Desco Infratech Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 70-80% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Small CGD EPC player with H2 revenue up ~99% to INR 118.8 cr, but margins squeezed by new power/solar EPC, operating cash flow still negative (~INR 18-19 cr) and unsecured NBFC debt at 16-17%; FY27 growth targets are unsupported by any capacity or order data.
top: Operating cash flow negative INR 18-19 cr

name: Oswal Pumps Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 20% to 25% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue INR2,064cr (+44%) and PAT 18% margin, but FY27 H1 revenue may decline, EBITDA margin guided to 22-23% from 24.9%, and receivable days stuck at 152-155 with KUSUM 2.0 timing unconfirmed.

name: Indogulf Cropsciences Ltd
gLine: Barwasni capacity: +30-40%, operational by FY27 end
thesis: Agrochemical maker grew FY26 revenue 19% to INR705 crore with PAT up 27%, but utilisation is only 52% and Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 13.5% from 16.5%, with no numeric FY27 guidance.

name: Tata Motors Ltd
gLine: Q1 FY27 volume growth: single-digit growth, if not more (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes up 25% and EBITDA margin 13.9%, but management flagged 100bps commodity hit in Q4, more in Q1, only a 2% price rise with partial pass-through, and no FY27 guidance beyond single-digit Q1 growth.
top: Commodity hit 100bps Q4, more in Q1

name: SK Minerals & Additives Ltd
gLine: Polymer additives commercial ramp: contribution in FY27; full capacity in 3-6 months (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue Rs 318 cr (+50%) with EBITDA margin ~10%, but H2 margins fell on raw-material inflation; manufacturing only 23% of revenue and the new polymer plant is still in teething trials.

name: INDO SMC Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR450-500 crore (FY27)
thesis: Order book ~INR237 cr at March 31 plus ~INR125 cr added since April; management targets INR450-500 cr FY27 revenue and EBITDA above 15%, but H1 inflow target cut to INR200 cr+ from INR250 cr and resin supply is strained.
top: H1 inflow target cut to INR200 cr+

name: Powerica Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: Double-digit top-line growth (FY27)
thesis: Powerica Q4 FY26 revenue INR801 crore (+10.9% YoY) with FY26 revenue INR3,012 crore (+13.5%); management guides double-digit FY27 top-line growth and 11-12% DG organic growth, but flags Q1 FY27 demand pressure and no numeric capacity discipline beyond 50 MW wind addition.

name: Crisil Ltd
gLine: Industry bank credit growth FY27: around 13% (FY27)
thesis: Crisil Q1 FY26 revenue jumped 30.1% and PAT 45.9%, but management flagged FX gains and a USD4.5m timing pull-forward in RAS, so underlying growth is weaker than headline and no numeric guidance was given.

name: Lupin Ltd
gLine: US sales FY27: USD 1 billion plus
thesis: Lupin posted record Q4 with 29.4% EBITDA margin and 75% gross margin, but guides FY27 to ~25% margin and high-single-digit growth as Tolvaptan and Mirabegron face competition; US revenue guided to high-single or low-double-digit erosion.

name: Grasim Industries Ltd
gLine: Pivot EBITDA: Exit FY27 at EBITDA break-even (FY27 exit)
thesis: Grasim's Q4 FY26 story is paints and Pivot scaling with losses still heavy; capacity discipline is absent (Lyocell and caustic expansion, 110k tpa Lyocell), and Opus price hikes face elasticity risk after 20-25% COGS inflation.
top: Opus price hikes in Q1 FY27

name: Bharat Forge Ltd
gLine: India business growth FY27: close to 25% (FY27)
thesis: Bharat Forge is pivoting to defence and aerospace growth while exiting loss-making German steel forging (CDP) over 15-18 months; standalone revenue fell 5% in FY26 with India growth guided near 25% for FY27.

name: Zuari Industries Ltd
gLine: Net debt at year-end FY27: ~INR700 crore (end FY27)
thesis: Record sugar crush of 159.7 lakh quintal and 101.7% utilisation, but holding-company debt guided down ~INR1,200 crore to ~INR700 crore via Dubai and associate inflows, which management has promised for several quarters.

name: Finolex Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume growth: higher single digit to lower double digit (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA nearly doubled to INR332 crore on flat volumes (101,772 t) helped by inventory gains of INR35-40 crore; management guides FY27 margin sub-15% and volume growth higher single to lower double digit, with agri demand soft.

name: Siyaram Silk Mills Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~12% (FY27)
thesis: Fabric-led Siyaram grew FY26 revenue ~15.5% with ~10% fabric volume, but margin guided ~14% and retail drag of ~150bp, with inventory and debtors up ~25% and operating cash flow of only ~INR 93 crore vs PAT of INR 228 crore.
top: Operating cash flow ~INR 150 cr vs PAT 228

name: Singer India Ltd
gLine: Bhiwadi factory production: Production to commence from second half of the year
thesis: Q4 revenue up 37% to Rs 166.3 crore and FY26 EBITDA up 70%, but appliances is loss-making, PMY orders are fixed-price with raw-material inflation absorbed, and no capacity discipline signal.
top: PMY orders fixed-price, RM inflation absorbed

name: Kanpur Plastipack Ltd
gLine: FIBC Unit 3 output FY27: about 1,800 tons; run rate 2,400 tons by end FY27 (FY27)
thesis: FIBC utilisation ~83% on 18,000 t capacity with order lead times cut from 6-8 to 3-4 weeks; management guides ~10% top-line growth and flat margins, with DFIA reversal hitting Q4 and PP prices up ~65% to USD1,700/t.

name: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Ltd
thesis: Pharma branded-generics player (Jagsonpal) grew 14.2% in Q4 vs IPM 10.5% but FY26 revenue only ~7%; supply-side signals absent (MR count flat, asset-light), with ₹66 crore cash return and no capex discussion.

name: Steelcast Ltd
gLine: Volume/revenue growth FY27 and FY27-29: 20%+ per year (FY27-FY29)
thesis: Steelcast FY26 revenue ₹423.17 cr (+13.3%) with EBITDA margin 30.64%; management now guides 25–26% sustainable margin and 20%+ volume growth, with capex decision pulled forward to end-July 2026 at ~63–64% utilisation.
top: Capex decision pulled forward to July 2026

name: Sangam India Ltd
gLine: Renewable power share: 70%+ of power by June 2027 (June 2027)
thesis: Record Q4 FY26 (INR880cr revenue, INR33cr PAT) on high utilisation and lower inventory, but management guides no new capex benefit until FY28 and FY27 growth is "similar" to FY26 top-line.

name: Elgi Equipments Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: about 200 crore (FY27)
thesis: Elgi FY26 sales up ~12% with volume only 3-4% and pricing thin; management plans a 2.5-3% price correction in June as ~80% of projected material cost inflation already hit in Q1, while capex is modest at ~200 crore.

name: Patel Integrated Logistics Ltd-$
gLine: Rajpat Logistics revenue: adds another 25% to the ~INR400 crore base (3-5 years)
thesis: Q4 FY26 profit rose on margin and cost control, but the call gave no capacity, utilisation or inventory data; management leaned on promotional claims and a Rajpat subsidiary with no numbers beyond an unsupported 25% revenue add.

name: Vaibhav Global Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 9% to 11% (FY27)
thesis: Vaibhav Global's FY26 margin rose to 10.8% and FCF hit a record INR272 crores, but Q4 volumes fell 9-10% and FY27 guidance of 9-11% growth and 50-100bps margin gain lacks supply-side evidence.

name: Tips Music Ltd
gLine: FY27 content spend: INR80-90 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue up 32% YoY to INR103.9 cr and PAT up 93%, but management attributed it to a repertoire surge with no one-offs; FY27 target is 20% top-line and 20% bottom-line, with content spend guided to INR80–90 cr.

name: Indian Overseas Bank
gLine: Industry credit growth: 14% to 16% (FY27)
thesis: Advances up 24.16% to Rs 3,10,423 crore and net profit up 56% to ~Rs 5,208 crore, with GNPA down to 1.42%; management guides 14-16% industry credit growth and NIM 3.30-3.35%, but no supply-side lever applies to a bank.

name: Action Construction Equipment Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27 total: ~INR200 crore incl. land
thesis: Action Construction is still capacity-heavy at ~60% utilisation, with management pushing 9-10% price hikes (targeting 11-14% total) against steel up 20-22%, while guiding FY29 revenue of INR6,000-6,200 crore and pausing a INR400 crore tower-crane plant.

name: DCB Bank Ltd
gLine: Employee count: around 13,000 by end of year (FY27)
thesis: DCB Bank Q4 FY26: record PAT INR 206 cr, NIM 3.39% (+12bp QoQ), GNPA 2.45%, slippage 2.28% vs 3.09%, but management guides 18–20% growth and CASA growth flat in CA.

name: Technocraft Industries (India) Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 margin lift mostly one-off: INR20 crore steel quantity discount in scaffolding; management won't guide FY27 and says Mach One utilisation is only 60-70% with no significant capex this year.

name: Kiri Industries Ltd
gLine: Dyes business standalone revenue: Cross Rs.1000 crore in FY27 (+20%) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 standalone revenue up 29% to Rs.241 crore but Rs.114 crore non-cash closing adjustments drove a reported loss; management's adjusted FY26 standalone EBITDA of Rs.79 crore is unverified, and the copper/fertiliser capex (~Rs.13,000 crore) rests on unsecured concentrate tie-ups.

name: Adani Power Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: near INR25,000 crore
thesis: Adani Power's Q4 FY26 PLF was 74% and FY26 PLF 66.5%, with 95% of operating capacity tied to PPAs and capex guided to INR25,000 crore in FY27, though Mahan and Korba timelines slipped and merchant exposure fell to 5%.

name: Muthoot Finance Ltd
gLine: New gold branches (Muthoot Finance): 200-300 (FY27)
thesis: Muthoot Finance Q4 FY26: gold AUM at record INR 1,65,000 crore and yields up ~50bp on pricing, but management gives no supply-side discipline signal and competition from new AAA-funded entrants is dismissed rather than quantified.

name: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: low double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Alembic guides FY27 low double-digit revenue growth and 100-150bps Pivya drag, with R&D rising to INR750-800 crores; API pricing still a headwind and no capacity-discipline signal beyond capex of INR300-350 crores.

name: Fredun Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: Top-line growth FY27: 25% to 30% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Fredun guides 25-30% top-line growth for FY27 with margin expansion, but working capital stress and rising debt cost remain; no supply-side capacity discipline, instead capacity adds (12-13 packing lines, new wing).

name: Dilip Buildcon Ltd
gLine: FY27 standalone revenue growth: 30% to 40% growth over FY26 (FY27)
thesis: FY26 standalone revenue fell 22% to INR7,005 crore while mgmt guides FY27 revenue up 30-40% on a INR28,000 crore order book; mining and InvIT pivot is the story, EPC margins under inflation pressure.

name: PNB Housing Finance Ltd
gLine: Loan book: >INR 1 lakh crore in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Housing finance with no capacity signal; spread fell 10 bps to 2.12% on yield cuts, GNPA 0.93% and negative credit cost carry FY27 ROA guide of 2.4-2.5% (down from 2.66%).

name: Capacite Infraprojects Ltd
gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR4,500–5,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue up only 6% and FY26 margin 16.3% with a 15.5–16.5% FY27 guide cut for input inflation; labour shortfall (~3,000 workmen short) cost ~INR125 crore FY26 revenue, cash-flow and debt paydown are the story, not supply.

name: Mahindra Logistics Ltd
gLine: Express revenue growth: mid- to high-teens (FY27)
thesis: Turnaround logistics story: FY26 reported PAT ₹2.3 crore vs ₹35.8 crore loss, Express GM positive at 1.3% but still EBITDA-negative (₹31 crore loss); management gives no hard EBITDA timeline.
top: Express GM turned positive, Q4 ₹6.6 crore

name: Bandhan Bank Ltd
gLine: NIM improvement: 10-20 bps over next 2-3 quarters (2-3 quarters)
thesis: Bandhan Q4FY26 shows EEB stress easing: slippages fell to INR 1,028 crore from 1,314 crore and credit cost 2% vs 3.3%, with NIM up to 6.2%, but ROA of 1.1% is still far from the 1.6-1.7% exit-FY27 target.

name: KPIT Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: 20.5% to 21.2% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 growth was only 1.8% constant currency QoQ-ish with two large SDV programs rolling off; management guides FY27 EBITDA 20.5–21.2% and medium-term 22–24%, with no supply-side capacity signal.

name: Polycab India Ltd
gLine: EHV capacity: Revenue contribution in FY28
thesis: Polycab grew Q4 revenue 27% with cable and wire volumes only low single digit, price-led growth; utilisation mid-70s, capex steady at INR 14.8bn for FY26 with market share gains to 30-31%.

name: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd
gLine: Catering revenue growth: ~15% (FY27)
thesis: IRCTC FY26 revenue grew 11.6% to Rs 5,475 cr total but PAT only ~6% as CSR and ECL one-offs hit Q4; management reiterates ~30% EBITDA margin aspiration with no capacity or supply-side signal.
top: Segment growth targets: catering ~15%, tourism ~20%, IT ~10%

name: Hitachi Energy India Ltd
gLine: Greenfield transformer plant commissioning: production by last quarter of CY2028
thesis: Record backlog Rs 29,555 Cr (+53.6% YoY) and a new Rs 2,000 Cr greenfield transformer plant (30-40 GVA) signal capacity expansion, while FY26 orders were flat at +1.6% and non-HVDC domestic orders weakened.
top: Extra Rs 2,000 Cr capex; total ~Rs 4,000 Cr

name: Computer Age Management Services Ltd
industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
gLine: Total expense growth FY27: sub-9%, aiming sub-5% employee cost
thesis: CAMS Q4 FY26 quality beat: EBITDA margin back to ~46.5% and non-MF revenue +24.5% YoY, but MF revenue flat (+0.5% QoQ) with yield drift, KRA pricing cut ~20% and FY27 KRA guided flat.
top: KRA industry price down 20% from April

name: Fairchem Organics Ltd
gLine: EBIT / operating margin: ~8% for FY27
thesis: Chinese dumping has eased since Feb-end, with realisations up 8-10% and utilisation guided to 75-80% in FY27 from ~65% now, though no capex is planned and FY26 volume fell to 44,000 tonnes from 54,000.

name: C.E. Info Systems Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: Above 20% / confident of 25% (not formally quantified) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 rebound (revenue +54.8% QoQ, EBITDA margin 44.6%) but FY26 revenue only INR474 crores vs INR463 crores; management still targets INR1,000 crores by FY28 with a INR1,750 crores order book, while receivables rose to INR176 crores from INR133 crores.

name: Supriya Lifescience Ltd
gLine: Working capital days: 170 to 180 days (FY27 onward)
thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR828 crores (+19%) and 35.5% EBITDA margin, but capacity build is ahead of demand: utilisation near 76%, debtor and inventory days rising, and FY27 growth guided as non-linear.

name: CMS Info Systems Ltd
gLine: Services revenue CAGR FY27-30: 13-14% (FY2027-FY2030)
thesis: FY26 services revenue grew 6% to Rs 2,312 Cr with EBIT margin down 360 bps to 15.6%; Q4 recovered to 19% EBIT, but FY27 Rs 2,700-2,800 Cr services guide needs ~Rs 200 Cr beyond the Rs 2,600 Cr run-rate.
top: Capex Rs 100 Cr → Rs 350 Cr in FY26

name: Ideaforge Technology Ltd
gLine: FY27 blended gross margin: 50-55% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue Rs141 cr (7x YoY) on ~40% conversion of Q3 open book; FY27 opening book Rs310 cr is all slated for execution in three quarters, with no new order guidance given.
top: Q4 revenue Rs141 cr vs Rs20.3 cr

name: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: Loan book growth: 25-30% in coming years (medium term)
thesis: Legacy MFI stress peaking: Q4 fresh slippages fell to ~INR170 crores from ~INR710 crores a year earlier and GNPA 7.7%, but FY27 credit cost guided at ~3% with no capital-cycle supply signal.

name: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Ltd
gLine: Dombivli EBITDA burn: INR2-3 crore per month average for FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Capex-heavy expansion to ~2,900 beds funded by accruals and debt capped at 3x EBITDA; Dombivli opened early but Indore occupancy only ~45-50% and Dombivli burns INR2-3 crore a month, so supply is rising while utilisation is still ramping.

name: Samhi Hotels Ltd
gLine: Interest cost: INR 135-140 crore (FY27)
thesis: Samhi FY26 same-store RevPAR +9.5% and net debt/EBITDA ~3.07x, but supply is expanding with 2,200 crore capex pipeline; Q4 EBITDA margin flat ex-one-offs and GST drag is permanent.

name: INOX India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 18% to 20% (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR1,632 crore (+21.2%) and order book INR1,514 crore, but operating cash flow has lagged sales as project contract assets build; management guides 18-20% FY27 growth without numeric capex or capacity changes beyond Kandla.

name: Rashi Peripherals Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue up 51% to INR4,489 crore with price hikes ~20-22% of H2 growth; management plans 20% CAGR but PES units may degrow 5-10% in CY26 and inventory days were not cut.

name: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: low to mid-teen (FY27)
thesis: Emcure FY26 revenue +16.6% to INR9,204 cr with EBITDA margin 19.4% (+80bps), but Q4 domestic growth slowed to 5.2% on Zuventus restructuring; FY27 guided low-to-mid teen growth and 75-100bps margin expansion.

name: Ceigall India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: minimum 15% in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: FY27 guidance of minimum 15% revenue growth and 11–12.5% EBITDA margin, with order book at INR18,554 crores, but receivables and unbilled revenue stretched and FY26 growth cushioned by asset monetisation.

name: Bajaj Housing Finance Ltd
gLine: FY27 ROA compression: ~10 bps
thesis: Bajaj Housing Q4 FY26: AUM up 23% and opex/NTI 19.2%, but spreads fell 10 bps to 1.7% and management guided ROA compression of ~10 bps in FY27 with no Q1 guidance yet.

name: Crizac Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 15% to 17% (FY27)
thesis: Crizac is an asset-light student-recruitment platform with strong FY26 growth (revenue +22.7%, PAT +41%), but FY27 guidance was withheld amid geopolitical uncertainty and margin gains were partly FX-driven.
top: FY27 firm guidance deferred to next quarter

name: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd
gLine: Installed module capacity by FY27 end: 16.3 GW modules and 8.9 GW cells (end FY2027)
thesis: Solar module/cell maker with cell utilisation up to 69.9% (FY26) and 79% in Q4, but a 6 GW expansion adds capacity by FY27 and working capital absorbed INR636 crore of inventory build.

name: Excelsoft Technologies Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: 20% to 25% overall (medium term)
thesis: Q4 revenue up 16% to Rs812m but EBITDA margin fell to 30.3% (from 40.5%) on a one-off ~Rs8.5cr/quarter US nearshore consultant cost; no capacity or pricing signal, growth guidance of 20-25% is a verbal recovery target.
top: UK examination body contract goes live

name: Nanta Tech Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 40-50% (FY27)
thesis: Nanta Tech's H2 FY26 margin jump (EBITDA 17.3%) and 52% H2 growth coincide with rising working capital and receivables, with FY27 guidance of ~40-50% revenue growth lacking supply-side evidence.
top: Working capital rising, invoices not raised

name: Dabur India Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: high single to low double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 India volumes strong (HPC +17%, domestic +9.5%) but RM/PM inflation near 10% forces 4% price hikes; management guides high-single to low-double-digit revenue and margin expansion, with international hit by Middle East.

name: India Glycols Ltd
gLine: Performance chemicals growth: in excess of doubling this year (hoped, not projected) (FY27)
thesis: Mixed quarter: group EBITDA margin up to 15.5% on Bio-Fuels and Chemicals, but Chemicals sales fell 10.4% and Q4 had a catalyst shutdown; no capacity-discipline or pricing-cycle signal beyond management commentary.

name: Sundrop Brands Ltd
gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin expansion: 150-225 bps p.a., ~200 bps midpoint; double-digit margin by FY29 (FY27-FY29)
thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated growth 11% with EBITDA margin ~7.2% ex one-offs, but no capacity or capex discussion; margin gains are cost-led, and management is reinvesting heavily in advertising and promising 100 bps plus 150-200 bps further expansion.
top: Margin expansion 150-225 bps p.a. for two years

name: Banswara Syntex Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR1,450–1,500 crores (FY27)
thesis: Yarn utilisation fell to 77% on labour shortages while Fabric and Garment carry growth; FY27 revenue guided to INR1,450–1,500 crores with EBITDA margin 10.5–11%, but net debt rose to INR483 crores with no long-term debt reduction until FY28.

name: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd-$
gLine: Sellable thermal units FY27: about 400 crore units vs 375 crore in FY26 (FY27)
thesis: Energy-led integrated miner: FY26 thermal generation up 84% to 4,155 MU and EBITDA INR2,025 crore, but Q4 EBITDA INR352 crore was hit by planned shutdowns, and the 600 MW IPP expansion slips to FY31 with capex unannounced.

name: Westlife Foodworld Ltd
gLine: Restaurant openings: 60+ per year (FY27 onward)
thesis: Westlife (McDonald's India, West & South) delivered 1.5% SSSG on mid-single-digit guest count, but supply-side signals are expansion-led (60+ openings FY27) with no capacity discipline; pricing held, margins guided lower to ~67%.

name: Coromandel International Ltd
gLine: Crop protection standalone revenue growth: 20%-25% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA up 16% to INR 494 crores despite fertiliser margin compression; subsidy receivables fell to INR 2,199 crores from INR 3,785 crores in September, but Middle East raw-material spike leaves Q2 margins unclear.
top: Fertiliser EBITDA/t below INR 3,500 in Q4

name: Viyash Scientific Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: 15% annual growth possible over 5 years (5 years)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA crossed INR200 crore (21.7% margin) on merger synergies, but capital-cycle signals are thin: no capacity cut, management plans R&D and capex build and quotes INR800 crore FY27/28 EBITDA-style targets loosely.

name: Hindustan Foods Ltd
gLine: Footwear FY27 sales: INR700-800 crore (FY27)
thesis: FY27 PAT guided at INR200-220 crores (vs FY26 INR149 crores) while footwear margins are hit by 50-60% polymer cost spikes and working capital is stretched; sales guidance withdrawn and the GST gross-to-net shift has slipped to Q2-Q3 FY27.

name: Sharat Industries Ltd
gLine: Annual export revenue FY27-28: up to Rs 1,000 crore (FY27-28)
thesis: Q4 hit by Middle East war rerouting (about 20 containers, half rerouted) and fishmeal cost spike; FY26 revenue up 38% to Rs 524.7 crore but no capacity discipline or utilisation figure disclosed.

name: HLE Glascoat Ltd
gLine: Consol EBITDA margin FY27-28: 14-15% consolidated; 15%+ India; Omeras to double-digit margin in FY27
thesis: FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 11% (Omeras loss INR15.3 cr); management says ongoing business ~13.5% and GLE India utilisation near 75%, but Q4 EBITDA only grew with a sub-15% margin and the June quarter faces gas-cost and deferral headwinds.

name: Control Print Ltd-$
gLine: CP Italy/V-Shapes loss: about EUR1.5 million this year (FY27)
thesis: Core coding and marking India is steady but FY26 consolidated profit is being absorbed by CP Italy/V-Shapes losses (EUR1.5m target vs EUR2-2.5m prior), with no firm breakeven timeline and a new Guwahati capex outlay added.

name: Neuland Laboratories Ltd
thesis: Q4 record revenue was lumpy and FX-aided; FY26 revenue INR2053.1 crores (+37.1%) but FCF negative INR49.4 crores as working capital days rose to 137, with capex INR397.1 crores and no formal guidance.

name: KRBL Ltd
gLine: Domestic volume growth FY27: ~10% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Q4 domestic revenue record INR1,230 cr (+22%) but exports fell 33% to INR279 cr on Middle East disruption; paddy and rice inventory fell to 657k tonnes and no export run-rate or guidance was given.
top: Q4 exports down 33% to INR279 cr

name: Arman Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Cost to assets (MFI): around 7% this year, from ~9% (FY27)
thesis: Microfinance lender exiting credit stress: Q4 disbursements INR738 crores (+88% YoY) and PAT INR41 crores, but opex/asset near 9% and FY27 credit cost guided around 3%.

name: Sanjivani Paranteral Ltd
gLine: Base business revenue FY27: INR 80-85 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q4 base-business revenue fell as March exports to the Middle East were lost to the Iran conflict; management guides FY27 base at INR 80-85 crore and Pune IV at INR 60-65 crore, with no capacity or capex signals.

name: South Indian Bank Ltd
gLine: Advances growth FY27: 15% to 16% (FY27)
thesis: Bank posted record FY26 profit of INR1,455 crore (+12%) with GNPA down to 1.43% and Q4 credit cost of 3bp, but management flags credit cost troughed and guides FY27 loan growth of 15-16%.

name: UCO Bank
gLine: RAM share: 62-65% (FY27)
thesis: Strong FY26 beat on credit growth (19.44% vs 12-15% guide) and asset quality (GNPA 2.17%, credit cost 0.62%), but FY27 guidance held at 12-14% and CD ratio rising toward 80-82%, so the supply-side read is pricing discipline on corporate loans, not capacity expansion.
top: Corporate pipeline held back on pricing

name: Petronet LNG Ltd
gLine: Petchem project capex FY27: about INR 7,500 crore
thesis: Dahej utilisation fell to about 53% in March on Qatar supply disruption, with Jan-Feb near 108%; management says April-May are at the same depressed level, so volumes at risk persist into FY27.

name: UNO Minda Ltd-$

name: JK Cement Ltd
gLine: Gray cement volume growth FY27: 2.5 mt incremental volume, maybe more

name: Tanla Platforms Ltd
gLine: Market share growth: CPaaS industry growth 8-10%; Tanla share gain at more than 10% a year
thesis: Tanla's CPaaS volumes grow faster than price in SMS, with OTT revenue share flat near 31-32%, and management offers no quantified guidance; margins described as range-bound with a ₹12 crore FX loss.

name: Embassy Developments Ltd
gLine: FY27 own presales: INR6,000 crores (FY27)
