name: J. Kumar Infraprojects Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~15% (above INR6,500 cr) (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue flat at INR5,723 cr with Q4 down 3%; order book of INR18,554 cr plus ~INR6,300 cr year-to-date inflows and a FY27 guide of ~15% top-line growth, but bid discipline has left FY25-26 inflows weak.

name: VA Tech Wabag Ltd
gLine: Kuwait order: order expected within quarter (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Order book INR 17,200 crore (over 4x revenue) and net cash ~INR 950 crore, but management guided only to 15–20% growth and 13–15% EBITDA with no new numbers; India-cluster margin slippage is glossed over.

name: Ceinsys Tech Ltd
gLine: Subsidiary (VTS) revenue FY27: more than INR 20 crore with positive EBITDA (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 20% with margins up 475bp, but order inflow is weak (about INR 62 crore in Q4, FY26 inflow near INR 350 crore vs revenue INR 661 crore), unbilled revenue ballooned to about INR 330 crore and management pushed order recovery into Q2.

name: Inox Wind Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: ~75% over FY26 (FY27)
thesis: Inox Wind Q4 FY26 revenue flat at INR1,306 crore with FY26 top line INR4,600 crore vs INR5,000 crore guidance; FY27 guided up ~75%, but working-capital slippage and PSU receivable delays persist.
top: FY26 revenue INR4,600 cr vs INR5,000 cr guide

name: InterGlobe Aviation Ltd
gLine: CASK ex fuel ex forex growth: mid- to high single digits (coming quarters)
thesis: Q4 FY26 net loss of Rs25.4bn driven by FX mark-to-market; underlying profit ex-FX and exceptionals fell to Rs19.2bn, with Q1FY27 PRASK guided up mid-teens while CASK ex-fuel ex-FX rises mid-to-high single digit.

name: Quess Corp Ltd
gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin (immediate term): 2%+ margin; medium term 2.4% (FY27 / 3-year)
thesis: Quess FY26 EBITDA up 19% to INR 312 cr on margin mix shift (Professional Staffing 12%, General Staffing 1.5%), but revenue grew only 2%; General Staffing supply-side growth still muted.

name: L&T Technology Services Ltd
gLine: EBIT margin: mid-16% by Q4FY27 or prior (Q4FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 USD revenue $305.9Mn (+0.3% YoY, -1.7% QoQ) after portfolio pruning; EBIT margin 15.2% with mid-16% target pulled to Q4FY27 or earlier, but no annual guidance and no capacity signals.
top: Mid-16% EBIT margin by Q4FY27 or prior

name: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd
gLine: SIP-based stable market share and growth: slightly better net sales growth (near term)
thesis: AMC posted record FY26 PAT of INR 15.29 bn (+19% YoY) and market share of 8.89%, but Q4 SIP net inflows have flattened and Q4 PAT fell 5% QoQ on negative other income.
top: SIP book flat, net inflows stalled

name: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 81% to INR293 crore and order book INR1,432 crore, but management gave no numeric FY27 guidance, deferred large orders pending customer approvals, and working capital remains stretched at 359 days.
top: Working capital cycle 359 days in FY26

name: Inflame Appliances Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 chimney demand fell sharply (Q4 revenue about INR35-37 crore vs INR55-60 crore expected) with raw material share rising 70% to 75%; management guides 50% FY27 growth and 4 lakh chimneys, but no numeric margin guidance and heavy China dependence persists.
top: Q4 revenue INR35-37 crore vs INR55-60 expected

name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 10% to 12% minimum (double-digit) (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up 7% to INR33,050 crore with 30% EBITDA margin; LCA Mk1A deliveries slipped to Aug–Sep and FY27 guidance is only 10–12% growth, with 15–20 LCA deliveries dependent on GE engines.
top: LCA deliveries hinge on GE engines

name: Dalmia Bharat Ltd
gLine: FY27 total capex: INR3,200-3,400 crore (FY27)
thesis: Dalmia Bharat (cement) posted record Q4 EBITDA of Rs 902 crore and FY26 EBITDA Rs 3,083 crore, but West Asia cost shock of Rs 125-150/ton hits Q1 and FY27 capex is Rs 3,200-3,400 crore with no new capacity announced.
top: Industry adds 110-120 Mt over two years

name: KPI Green Energy Ltd
gLine: Interest/ROE recovery: ROE back to earlier levels next year (FY27)
thesis: KPI Green FY26 PAT Rs509cr (+57%) on IPP ramp, but inventory up ~4x, interest up ~130% and CPP order book (Rs5,246cr) fell short of the Rs6,000cr cited last quarter; execution risk rising.

name: Spencers Retail Ltd
gLine: Spencer's store EBITDA: 8% target in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Spencer's Q4 sales up 8% YoY to INR380 crore on same-store growth after FY25 footprint exits, but consolidated FY26 EBITDA only INR15 crore and management is targeting operational EBITDA breakeven in FY27.

name: Aartech Solonics Ltd
gLine: Order book by end June 2026: Rs 25 crore (Jun 2026)
thesis: Small, debt-light energy-equipment firm (FY26 revenue ~Rs 40 cr, 12-15% organic growth) with no capacity or utilisation disclosure, vague guidance and an order book of only Rs 10 cr at year start, so the supply-side read is thin.
top: New Narmadapuram plant, ops early next year

name: IIFL Capital Services Ltd
thesis: Q4 operational revenue up 20% YoY to INR644 crore, but operational PBT fell 22% for FY26 on employee costs; no capacity or supply signal, and management was evasive on the fundraise and Fairfax stake.

name: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd
gLine: Biscuits revenue growth FY27: low to mid-teens (FY27)
thesis: Biscuit and bakery demand soft but guided to low-to-mid-teens FY27 growth; ~3% input inflation covered by pricing and Project IMPACT, with EBITDA margin improvement targeted QoQ from Q4's 12.7% bakery margin. Capacity added, no capex discipline signal.

name: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Ltd
gLine: Quarterly slippages: ₹75-90 crore per quarter (FY27)
thesis: Microfinance credit cycle behind it: slippages fell to ₹106 crore in Q4 and FY27 guidance targets ~1.2% ROA rising to 1.6%, 30%+ growth, and credit cost ~70-80 bps, with no capacity or supply data disclosed.

name: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue (ex FV gains and ESOP): INR 1,415 crores (FY27)
thesis: Wealth manager posts FY26 PAT of INR 386 crores (+28%) on AUM crossing INR 1 lakh crore; FY27 PAT guide of INR 460 crores implies about 19% growth, below the stated 20-25% range.

name: Softtech Engineers Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 25-27% (FY27)
thesis: Software/permitting company, not a capacity-driven business: Q4 revenue up 50% YoY to INR 46.6 cr and FY26 EBITDA margin 24%, with a INR 300 cr FY29 target that is not backed by a disclosed order-book bridge.

name: Venus Pipes & Tubes Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: >20% (FY27)
thesis: Venus Pipes Q4 FY26 shows record revenue (Rs302.2 cr, +17% YoY) and a seamless capex wave fully commissioned, but welded utilisation of ~60-65% and PAT margin of 8.4% argue against capacity-led upside; FY27 guide of 20%+ growth and 17-18% EBITDA margin are unproven.

name: Keystone Realtors Ltd
gLine: FY27 presales: INR5,000 crores (FY27)

name: KFin Technologies Ltd
industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries

name: Khazanchi Jewellers Ltd

name: Redtape Ltd

name: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd

name: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Ltd

name: Nisus Finance Services Co Ltd

name: Jash Engineering Ltd

name: Digitide Solutions Ltd

top: FY27 ~100bps margin expansion by Q4 exit

name: Creative Newtech Ltd

name: Federal Bank Ltd

name: Ador Welding Ltd

name: Canara Bank

name: Divis Laboratories Ltd

name: Karnataka Bank Ltd

name: HT Media Ltd
thesis: Print ad yields drove a 10% Q4 ad revenue rise and 14% FY26 print margin, while Radio and OTTplay losses were cut by exiting six loss-making frequencies and OTTplay; volumes flat, no numeric guidance.

name: Bajaj Finserv Ltd

name: D. B. Corp Ltd

name: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Ltd

name: SG Finserve Ltd

name: AvenuesAI Ltd

name: PSP Projects Ltd

name: Sudeep Pharma Ltd
gLine: Net working capital days: 150-160 days (FY27)

name: Exato Technologies Ltd
gLine: Revenue and PAT growth FY27: 50% to 60% (FY27)
thesis: Revenue up ~35% to ₹168 Cr and PAT up ~67% to ₹16.09 Cr, but Q4 purchase-of-software/hardware jumped to ~81% of revenue from 67% as margins compressed, with no capacity or supply-side metric disclosed.
top: Q4 purchase cost ~81% of revenue vs 67%

name: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd
gLine: TER / regulatory yield impact from 1 April: 3 to 4 bps gross impact, crystallised impact in two months
thesis: Industry equity AUM fell 0.4% QoQ while ICICI Pru AMC equity AUM grew 2% QoQ to INR6.2tn, with Q4 PAT down 16.8% QoQ on mark-to-market losses and ESOP timing; no supply-side levers apply to an AMC.
top: Equity AUM share up 2% QoQ vs industry down

name: Admach Systems Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: above 20% (FY27)

name: Amagi Media Labs Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue and margin: No numeric guidance; aspiration to 'continue to kind of grow at a healthy clip'
thesis: Amagi FY26 revenue up 30% to INR 1,506 cr with adjusted EBITDA margin ~10% and PAT INR 72 cr; a SaaS/media-tech platform with no capacity-cycle signals, so supply-side read is largely not applicable.
top: Gross margin compressed QoQ on pricing

name: Fractal Analytics Ltd
gLine: License-driven revenue share: 3% to 20% by 2030 (2030)

name: Accord Transformer & Switchgear Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR120–180 crore (FY27)

top: Revenue deferred from FY26 to FY27

name: Sai Parenterals Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: INR750 crore (FY27)
thesis: FY27 guided to INR750 crore revenue at 17% EBITDA margin while none of the INR440 crore capex adds FY27 output; Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin was only 15%, so the margin step-up is unproven.
top: INR440 cr capex, zero FY27 output

name: Saksoft Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 30% target; 14-15% seen as bare minimum

top: Renewals to be repriced lower for AI

name: Titan Company Ltd
thesis: Titan Q4 FY26 demand strong (buyer growth back to 8% from flat), but margins under pressure from gold-price mix and Damas/Middle East losses; management gave a 15-20% 3-5 year CAGR but no FY27 guidance.

name: Kansai Nerolac Paints Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 paints call: management is passing through steep crude-led inflation with decorative price hikes of about 2% in March then 5-6% per step (higher single digit net), but no volume hit yet and no capacity expansion signalled. Margin guide 13-14% held.
top: Deco price hikes ~higher single digit net

name: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Ltd
gLine: Production: 10,000–11,000 boe/d (2027)
thesis: Production ~15k boe/d locked behind infrastructure; FY27 target 10,000–11,000 boe/d hinges on rigs, funding and pipeline access, with HPCL crude sale reversed and INR260 crore tied up in receivables.
top: INR260 crore tied up in crude invoices

name: NIIT Ltd
gLine: Q1 FY27 revenue growth: double-digit YoY (Q1 FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up 9% to INR3,902m (organic core roughly flat in Q4) with EBITDA about -INR40m; order intake up 17% to INR4,209m gives book-to-bill above 1, but management guides an investment cycle to continue.

name: Rallis India Ltd
gLine: Seeds revenue growth FY27: high double-digit (mid-teens), volume plus price (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue up 6% to ₹456 cr with EBITDA at ₹-1 cr (vs ₹-19 cr); management sees industry shifting to seller's market on 15–25% input cost inflation, pricing hikes announced, but Q4 B2C volume was pushed via placement and Benzilla/Clasto inventory liquidation.

name: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd
gLine: Gopalpur TAN utilisation on TPD basis: 90-95% by end FY27 (end FY27)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell to INR354 crores on fertiliser input-cost squeeze, IPA price pressure and a ~INR75 crore ammonia shutdown hit; management points to firming TAN/ammonia spreads, Equinor gas and Gopalpur commissioning in Q2 FY27.

name: Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Ltd
thesis: FY26 sales up 15% to ₹10,827 cr and PAT up 14% to ₹652 cr on 12% volume growth, but Q1 FY27 outlook is mixed with NPK margins guided ±5–10% and sulphur supply constrained.

name: Automotive Axles Ltd
gLine: Phase 1 and 1A capacity completion: by end December 2026 (Dec-26)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up ~18.7% YoY to INR6,643m with 8% PAT, but capacity is ~90% utilised in Q4 and April-May softened to 70-80%; Phase 1/1A capex completes by Dec-26 with next phase to be decided.

name: Navneet Education Ltd
gLine: Publication revenue growth FY27: around 15% in a single year, at least first 2 years (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Q4 revenue flat at INR394 crore vs INR389 crore while FY26 fell 3% to INR1,683 crore; management guides FY27 publication growth ~15% on curriculum change, but stationery margins compress to ~9% and capex is minimal.

name: GRP Ltd
gLine: Reclaim Rubber US volume restoration: entirely restored in FY27
thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell to INR 94m (7% margin) from INR 331m as export volumes dropped ~15% and EPR income shrank; capex is shifting to Pyrova, with FY27 growth capex of INR 90-100 crore and debt-equity up to 1.15.

name: SG Mart Ltd
gLine: Service centres added in FY27: 3 more, 11-12 total (FY27)
thesis: Q4 business EBITDA ~INR50 crores ex-INR6 crores inventory gain, with FY27 INR300-350 crores annualised EBITDA guide reaffirmed but hedged on Middle East and steel supply; capex of ~INR600 crores over two years is a growth bet, not discipline.
top: Capex ~INR600 crores approved over two years

name: Jtekt India Ltd
gLine: Incremental revenue from new capacity: INR800 crore additional over FY27 (theoretical, 10% market growth plus exports) (FY27)
thesis: Capacity built ahead of demand: CVJ line 2 at 27% utilisation and MS Gear line 6 at 21%, with management targeting full use in 1–1.5 years; FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 7.5% from 7.6%.

name: JM Financial Ltd-$
gLine: Private Markets core loan book growth FY27: 15% to 20%, ~INR5,000 crore by March 2027 (FY27)
thesis: JM Financial's FY26 PAT rose 46% to INR1,202 crore, but CACM and wealth volumes are stalled by FPI selling; management is guiding to a second-half recovery and 20% wealth book growth, with no capacity cuts discussed.

name: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd
gLine: FY27 keys operationalised: 150 to 200 additional keys (FY27)
thesis: Hotel operator with no capacity discipline issues; Q4 revenue up 19% to INR 110 cr and EBITDA margin 29%, but FY27 top line faces ~INR 50 cr loss from IRA Mumbai exit and no numeric guidance was given.
top: IRA Mumbai exit removes ~INR 50 cr revenue

name: Trishakti Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 crane hiring revenue: INR 62.5 crore (per slide; management says FY26 INR 33 crore is actual) (FY27)
thesis: Crane rental capex-led expansion: FY26 capex INR 210 crore vs INR 100 crore guidance, but receivables near 200 days, subvention income of INR 4.58 crore inflates EBITDA, and payables of INR 159 crore sit off the debt line.
top: FY26 capex INR 210 cr vs INR 100 cr guided

name: Bank of Baroda
gLine: Loan growth FY27: 12-14% (FY27)
thesis: Bank of Baroda raised FY27 loan growth guidance to 12-14% and NIM to 2.75-2.95%, but Q4 NIM of 2.89% leans partly on IT refund interest and deposit costs are sticky at 4.78%.

name: ICICI Bank Ltd
gLine: Opex growth vs top-line: opex growth below top-line growth (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 PBT ex-treasury up 10.1% to ₹18,209 crore on provisions of just ₹96 crore (0.03% of advances), but guidance is only "range-bound" NIMs and no loan or deposit growth numbers; the provision drop is partly one-off recoveries.

name: Sonata Software Ltd
gLine: Domestic growth: back to growth trajectory this fiscal year
thesis: Sonata's international USD revenue was flat QoQ in Q4 FY26 and down 2.1% for FY26, with utilisation at 91.8% and management guiding only to similar EBITDA, so no supply-side capacity signal and growth is still pending.

name: Wockhardt Ltd
gLine: Zaynich global peak revenue: $1.5bn–$2bn per year (peak)
thesis: Investor-meet pitch for Zaynich US/India/EM launch with no supply-side evidence; FY26 EBITDA ~INR630 crore (18.6% margin) but management guides to 12–18 months of launch losses and gives no utilisation or capacity data.
top: Zaynich FDA approval, first Indian NCE

name: Axiscades Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: 1,377 crore (52% growth on retained base) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 PAT of 0.4 crore and a 142 crore revenue slip; management frames FY26 as a building year and guides FY27 revenue to 1,377 crore, which the call does not support with hard numbers.
top: Negative OCF from 100 crore land systems WIP

name: PTC India Ltd
thesis: Power trader PTC India: volumes up 12% to 92.8 BU in FY26 but margins flat and management guides to volume-led growth with no margin expansion; FY26 PAT flat at ₹397 crore ex-PEL sale.

name: Kamdhenu Ltd
gLine: Royalty rate growth: +10% to 15% per year (FY27 onwards)
thesis: Asset-light TMT franchisor: FY26 franchisee volume +10% to 37.9 lakh t and royalty +25% to INR175 cr, but PBT only +31% on a flat own plant and softer TMT prices; no capacity-discipline evidence either way.
top: Royalty rate INR398 → INR435 per ton

name: Indian Bank
gLine: Deposit growth: 9% to 11% (FY27)
thesis: Indian Bank FY26 beat most guidance with advances +13.43% and gross NPA down to 1.98%, but FY27 guides NIM 3.10–3.25%, ROA 1.20–1.30%, and ECL absorption is still unquantified.

name: Page Industries Ltd
gLine: Marketing spend: close to 5% of revenue (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 volume grew 10.8% to 54.5m pieces, with inventory days up to 73 from 64 as management built stock ahead of input inflation; EBITDA margin guided 19-21% versus 22% in FY26.

name: eClerx Services Ltd
industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
gLine: Q1 FY27 sequential revenue: stronger than Q4 (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 soft sequentially (operating revenue +0.5% cc QoQ, utilisation 74% vs 76.5% peak) but management held FY27 guidance of top-quartile growth and 24-28% EBITDA margin, with no supply-side capacity signal.

name: Hindustan Media Ventures Ltd
thesis: Print ad yields drove a 100bp consolidated margin gain to 23% in Q4 on flat volumes, while Radio and OTTplay losses were cut by surrendering six loss-making frequencies and exiting OTTplay; no formal guidance given.

name: Jupiter Wagons Ltd
gLine: Stone India commercial production: July 2026, profitable this year (FY27)
thesis: FY26 PAT Rs166 crore on Rs2,961 crore income; wagon execution moderated and inventory rose ~40% to Rs1,079 crore while management guides to Q2 FY27 recovery pending a railway tender that has slipped.

name: Rupa & Company Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 10% to 12% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +6.3% on 9% volume, but margins rebounded on Athleisure mix and a 4-5% April price hike; FY26 EBITDA fell 11.6% and FY27 guides 10-12% growth with 9-10% margin.

name: Triveni Turbine Ltd
gLine: Order book growth / minimum growth: ~9% growth in enquiry closing order book cited as minimum growth indication
thesis: Q4 revenue record ₹6.8bn (+26%) but margin compressed on NTPC low-margin order and MTM loss; receivables swelled to ₹6.39bn (84 days vs 49), closing order book +8% to ₹20.54bn.

name: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd
gLine: Credit cost FY27: below 2% (FY27)
thesis: Small-ticket MSME NBFC in stress: GNPA fell to 3.59% from 6.61% and credit cost guided below 2%, but AUM grew only 6% on an ARC sale and FY26 PAT was just INR1.34 crore.
top: Disbursements down; some decline in demand

name: PDS Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-single-digit (FY27)
thesis: PDS Q4 FY26 is a cautious sourcing-services read: FY26 GMV up 5% to ₹19,666 crores, net debt cut to ~₹105 crores, guidance only mid-single-digit revenue and ~10% profit growth, with no volume-capacity or utilisation disclosure.
top: Capex more than halved vs FY25

name: K.P. Energy Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 40% to 50% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue INR 1,506 cr (+57%) and Q4 EBITDA margin 21%, but operating cash flow fell on inventory build; order book ~2 GW worth ~INR 3,000 cr with ~50% from group entities.
top: Operating cash flow down on inventory build

name: Mahanagar Gas Ltd

name: Star Cement Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: INR600-700 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q4 volume up ~10% and per-ton EBITDA up to INR1,871, but FY27 guides 10-12% cement volume growth and capex stepping to INR600-700 crore amid fuel-cost and East-entry pressure.

name: Rolex Rings Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 15-17% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue flat at INR1,144 cr despite US exports down ~30%; management guides FY27 growth 15–17% and utilisation only 62–63%, with a 25% US tariff now accepted by customers.

name: Tarsons Products Ltd

name: Ddev Plastiks Industries Ltd

top: Capacity ~315k t vs 231k t volume guide

name: Prospect Consumer Products Ltd

name: Mankind Pharma Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: 6% to 7% of FY27 revenue (FY27)
thesis: Mankind Q4 FY26 revenue up 11.8% to INR3,443 cr with adjusted EBITDA margin 27.1%, but capex guided up to 6-7% of FY27 revenue and FY27 tax rate rising to 25-26%, so the supply-side read is mixed.
top: Capex guided to 6-7% of FY27 revenue

thesis: Medi Assist is a TPA/tech platform with no capacity cycle; FY26 operating EBITDA margin 19.3% rising quarterly (Q4 19.9%), debt-free, but retail TPA premium grew only 4.2% and group retention slipped to 93.2%.

name: Signpost India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: double digit (around 20% plus per Q&A) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 46% YoY to INR162 cr with EBITDA margin 25.5% for FY26, but receivables up ~80% to INR317 cr and no supply-side capacity discipline disclosed; cash-cycle fix is promised, not shown.

name: Go Digit General Insurance Ltd
gLine: Specialty commercial lines premium: about INR1,000 crores in 3-5 years (3-5 years)
thesis: Digit reports FY26 IndAS-basis post-tax ROE of 17.7% and combined ratio 105.7%, but gross loss ratios are stable and motor OD loss ratio is rising amid retention cut to 89.6% from 95.9%.

name: Black Buck Ltd
thesis: Core tolling and telematics compound (core revenue +34% FY26), but growth-business burn is widening, adjusted EBITDA margin slipped from ~36% to ~31%, and management gave no guidance.
top: West Asia drag on intercity trucks

name: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Ltd
gLine: Hobel revenue growth: 15% to 17% over next 3-4 years (3-4 years)
thesis: Acquisition of Hobel Bellows for about INR450 crore (~25% pre-tax EBITDA yield on price, 50%+ margins, INR129 crore revenue) with core utilisation at 50-60%; organic business described only qualitatively.

name: HDB Financial Services Ltd
thesis: HDB Financial Q4 FY26 shows credit-cost and Stage 3 improvement (GNPA 2.44% vs 2.81%) and record disbursements of ₹19,922 crore, but book growth of 3.4% QoQ and no supply-side discipline story; a growth-recovery read, not a capital-cycle trigger.

name: Umiya Mobile Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: up to 3% (about two years, FY28)
thesis: Umiya Mobile is a mobile retailer expanding store count aggressively with no capacity discipline; management guides EBITDA margin to 3% by FY28 from ~1.8-1.9%, but offers no numbers on capex, and the call shows no supply-side signals.

name: NIS Management Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: 12% to 15% (FY27)
thesis: Security and facility manager with a FY26 consolidated revenue growth of 7.74% to INR436.70 crore and a one-time labour-code provision of INR27.82 crore; management guides 12-15% FY27 growth and receivables rose to INR124 crore at NIS Management standalone.

name: VMS TMT Ltd
gLine: Solar cost saving: INR5 crores annual from 15 MW
thesis: Integrated TMT maker in Gujarat: CCM/hot-charging cut reheating cost ~INR1,500/ton and utilisation is only 70-75%, with no expansion planned; the margin story rests on integration and a 15 MW solar plant, not on supply discipline.

name: Saatvik Green Energy Ltd
gLine: Cell capacity commissioning: 2.4 GW cell production from 2H FY27; 6 GW by June-July 2027
thesis: Q4 margins compressed to ~7% EBITDA on input-cost and rupee shock with fixed-price orders; FY26 EBITDA margin 12.78% on 3,138 MW sales, while cell capacity (2.4 GW) only starts production in 2H FY27.

name: True Colors Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth (medium term): 20-22% CAGR (medium term)
thesis: Digital textile printing consumables roll-up with ~50% recurring revenue; FY26 revenue Rs 301.55 cr (+29%), EBITDA margin 15.58%, but operating cash flow negative (~Rs 35 cr) and receivables ballooned to Rs 111 cr at March-end.

name: Telge Projects Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: 60–70% CAGR, FY27 and beyond (FY27 onwards)
thesis: Asset-light BIM/structural engineering firm with no capacity or utilisation disclosure; growth is acquisition-aided, receivable days jumped 73→108, and 60–70% CAGR guidance is unsupported by a Rs 25 cr order book.

name: Pace Digitek Ltd
gLine: FY27 PAT margin: 10% to 11% (FY27)
thesis: BESS capacity doubling from 2.5 to 10 GWh by October, but FY26 EBITDA fell to Rs455 crore and receivables reached Rs2,442 crore, with cell costs up about 20% from April.

name: Fabtech Technologies Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~25% (management said 25–30%) (FY27)
thesis: Turnkey pharma/healthcare facility builder; margins compressing (contribution ~43.8% vs 45.9%) with receivables up to ₹204 cr and no capacity discipline data, so the cash-conversion story is unproven despite ~25% growth guidance.

name: Recode Studios Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: at least 50% (FY27 and H1 FY27)
thesis: Asset-light beauty brand reports FY26 revenue ₹80 cr (+67%) and PAT ₹11.22 cr, but the IPO cash is funding working capital (receivables ~₹15 cr vs ₹8 cr) and management gave no supply-side or pricing evidence, with 50% growth guided without numbers for the quarter.

name: Procter & Gamble Health Ltd
thesis: FY26 sales up 16% to about ₹1,400 crore and PAT up 30% to ₹327 crore, but management gave no numeric guidance and no capacity or capex commentary, so supply-side evidence is absent.

name: Escorts Kubota Ltd
gLine: FY27 domestic tractor industry: flattish; 2-3% up or down (FY27)
thesis: Escorts guides FY27 tractor industry flat to ±2-3% with H2 a substantial de-growth on high base and monsoon, while input costs (tyres, steel, base metals) rise 5-6% and only ~1.5% price taken in April.

name: Bosch Ltd
gLine: Margins held steady for next ~5 years: stable (5 years)
thesis: Bosch Ltd is buying related-party Bosch Chassis Systems (RBIC) for INR9,068.7 cr at 10.6x FY25 EV/EBITDA, all-cash, with ~5% pro forma EPS accretion; no quarterly results discussed, and no capacity or utilisation numbers given beyond "lines are full".

name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
thesis: Flexible packaging margin story with no capacity or capex signal: EBIT 8% ex a INR 88 million prior-year depreciation charge, sales flat at +10 bps, and management says raw-material pass-through is locked in.
top: Raw-material costs passed through to customers

name: Mastek Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: better than FY26, no number (FY27)
thesis: Mastek Q4 FY26 was stable: revenue up 3.6% QoQ in INR, EBITDA 16.1%, 12-month backlog $300.4M (+13.5% YoY USD), but management gave no numeric FY27 growth guidance and flagged heavy renewal price cuts.

name: Ipca Laboratories Ltd
gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: 12-13% (FY27)
thesis: Ipca guides FY27 consolidated growth of 12-13% and EBITDA margin rising to 22-22.3% from 20.7%, but raw-material inflation of 10-12% and 25% freight spikes cloud Q1 despite a supply-side-neutral capex picture.

name: Mphasis Ltd
thesis: Mphasis Q4 FY26 revenue $463 Mn, +7.1% YoY cc, FY27 guided high single-digit to low double-digit growth; supply-side signals are absent, with no capacity or utilisation disclosure and OCF/net income guided down to about 80%.

name: Zydus Wellness Ltd-$
gLine: Seasonal brands growth: consistent double-digit growth over three to four years (3-4 years)
thesis: Q4 domestic growth only 1.7% with seasonal brands down 9.8% as delayed summer left the trade pipeline unbuilt; consolidated growth of 62.1% is acquisition-driven, and management gave no numeric guidance.

name: Marico Ltd
gLine: EBITDA growth FY27: high-teens (FY27)
thesis: Marico guides FY27 double-digit revenue to cross INR15,000 crore and high-teen EBITDA growth, helped by copra down ~35% from peak, but crude-linked inputs still rising and no capacity signal.

name: Engineers India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: minimum 10% to 15%
thesis: Record order book Rs.15,109 cr (vs Rs.11,717 cr) but FY26 inflow fell to Rs.7,979 cr from Rs.8,214 cr; Middle East awards slowing, guidance held at about Rs.8,000 cr inflow.

name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
gLine: Dividend per share: Rs.24 (FY26) (FY2026)
thesis: Telco is supply-disciplined but ARPU stalled: Q4 ARPU Rs.257 up only Rs.3 QoQ, management "not happy", with radio capex moderating and FY27 capex guided "in the ballpark" of FY26's ~Rs.31,000 Cr.

name: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd
gLine: Operating margin FY27: Tighter range, move towards 26% longer term
thesis: Q4 FY26 constant-currency revenue grew 1.2% QoQ after three sequential gains, FY26 CC revenue fell 2.4%, and margin reached 25% with no hard capacity signal; supply-side read is neutral, demand improving modestly.

name: Everest Kanto Cylinder Ltd
gLine: Egypt ramp-up target: around 40% initially, ~80% later (6 months after start / medium term)
thesis: FY26 consolidated EBITDA up 15.7% to Rs 203 cr with margin 13.8%, but capacity is ramping (Mundra live, Egypt near) with utilisation ramp guided only after ~6 months, and US order book ~US$75m over 18-24 months.

name: Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd
thesis: Royal Orchid guided nothing numeric for FY27 after a post-war demand hit; FY26 PAT of INR33 crore absorbed ~INR16 crore notional Ind AS hit, and management is asset-light, adding ~500 revenue-share keys with no timeline.

name: Hubtown Ltd
gLine: Pre-sales FY27: ~6,000 crore
thesis: Mumbai developer guiding FY27 pre-sales of ~6,000 crore and collections of 3,000 crore against ~15% legacy debt cost, with the 4,000 crore 25 South/Downtown debt pool targeted to fall at least 35%; no supply-side discipline data, and the equity raise was cancelled.

name: ICRA Ltd
thesis: ICRA is a credit rating and analytics business where ratings grew 10.6% in Q4 and the company gave no numeric FY27 guidance; supply-side signals are absent and the call was mostly Q&A on Fintellix disclosure and capital return.

name: Insecticides (India) Ltd
gLine: Revenue and profit growth FY27: Decent growth; top line and bottom line positive, visible from Q1 (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue up ~19% and FY26 sales up ~7% with flat PAT, but working capital at 140-150 days, rising finance cost and no capacity cut; supply-side signals are mixed with price-led upside unproven after a weak May.

name: Thomas Scott (India) Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: similar to FY26 growth, no number
thesis: Thomas Scott grew revenue 58% to Rs 255 cr in FY26 with EBITDA margin 13.1%, but no capacity discipline or guidance was given, and receivables, short-term debt and the shift to wholesale sales raise working-capital questions.

name: Brahmaputra Infrastructure Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: Maintain ~50% growth for 2-3 years, same profitability (2-3 years)
thesis: Management reports FY26 revenue +50% to INR365 crore and PAT nearly doubled to INR59.61 crore, but gives no capacity, capex or utilisation data; order book INR1600 crore (4.46x revenue) is the only supply-side anchor.

name: Dynamic Cables Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 growth slowed to 7% reported (20% core) as greenfield plant slipped about 15 months to September 2026 and order book rose only 11% after March price-driven deferrals; capacity constrained in H1.

name: Amber Enterprises India Ltd
gLine: Electronics revenue growth FY27: ~40% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 consolidated revenue up 22% to INR12,186 crore, but management guides 50–100 bps margin pressure from copper clad laminate, gold and wage costs; net working capital days jumped to 29 from 9 on inventory build.

name: RITES Ltd
gLine: Revenue: Aspire to break all-time high revenue in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Order book hit record INR 9,416 crore with over 50% young, but management guided profits will not break the all-time high this year, with margins diluted by low-margin turnkey and export mix.

name: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd
thesis: Paying suppliers fell 1,200 in Q4 as Silver churn rose to ~7% monthly and gross adds slowed; growth now rests almost entirely on ARPU (8-9%) with customer growth only 1-2%.

name: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd
gLine: Standalone revenue CAGR: 20-30% over 3-5 years (3-5 years)
thesis: Anupam reports record FY26 revenue of INR2,384 crore (+65%) and operating cash flow of INR334 crore, with capex ended and no major capex planned, but the read is dominated by a debt-funded Bliss GVS acquisition and promotional Q&A.

name: Chemplast Sanmar Ltd
thesis: Suspension PVC (CCVL) hit by China carbide dumping and a ₹898 Cr investment impairment; spreads now at variable-cost breakeven, while specialty is the stated capital-allocation priority.

name: PB Fintech Ltd
gLine: Paisabazaar costs: Roughly similar cost base this year
thesis: Q4 FY26 premium up 42% to ₹29,934 Cr with PAT ₹670 Cr, but this is an insurance distribution platform with no capacity or utilisation to read; the supply-side framework largely does not apply.

name: One 97 Communications Ltd
thesis: Paytm's Q4 FY26 call is a consumer-fintech growth story with no capacity signal; net payment margin above 3% and lending distribution are the drivers, but cost step-up is flagged and the transcript is garbled in places.

name: HMA Agro Industries Ltd
thesis: Record FY26 standalone revenue of INR 67,689 mn (+39.2%) and EBITDA margin 3.12%, but no capacity, capex or utilisation figure given; Q4 revenue growth only ~4% and Q&A dodged several numeric questions.

name: NIIT Learning Systems Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: high single digits (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue INR5,252m (+22% YoY reported, +2% QoQ cc) with a low-single-digit QoQ rebound promised; FY27 guided only to high single-digit growth and 18–20% EBITDA margin, with a sharp Q4 budget miss from two large clients.
top: Q4 revenue miss: two clients cut L&D budgets

name: Max Estates Ltd
gLine: FY27 collections: INR2,500-3,000 crore
thesis: FY26 presales INR5,305 crore, Q4 bookings INR3,300 crore, but no FY27 presales guidance given; net debt about INR100 crore and INR16,310 crore of launch revenue yet to be recognised.

name: Krystal Integrated Services Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: upwards of 20% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue fell ~12% YoY to INR364.94 cr on deliberate bid discipline; no capacity or supply signal, FY27 guided to 20%+ growth with working capital stretched by loans and advances of INR146.45 cr.

name: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Ltd
gLine: Net debt to zero by end FY30 if target not delivered: INR3,000 cr target (FY30)
thesis: Transformational debt-funded acquisition of TruBridge (EV ~$557m, ~3x EBITDA on $69m adjusted EBITDA) to take IKS into US RCM and EHR; no supply-side or capacity signal, and management declined to quantify synergies.

name: AJAX Engineering Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume growth: mid to early double-digit (FY27)
thesis: FY26 SLCM volumes fell about 4% vs industry ~11%, EBITDA margin 12.6% vs 15.3%; Q4 price hike of 2% and 76% April share, but demand guidance is only "mid and early double-digit" and no FY27 numbers given.

name: Scoda Tubes Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 25% (FY27)
thesis: Scoda Tubes FY26 revenue up 7% to INR518.7 crore with Q4 flat and EBITDA margin down to 13.5% after a 15-17 day gas-driven plant shutdown; FY27 guided at 25% growth and 14-15% margin, with 13,000t welded capex slipping.

name: GK Energy Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: ~INR 3,000 cr+ (pump 1.2-1.4 lakh units; rooftop INR 600-1,000 cr) (FY27)
thesis: FY26 standalone revenue INR 1,532.5 cr (+40%) and EBITDA margin 20.4%, but Q4 installs 17,018 fell short of the 70,000+ FY guide (61,000 delivered) and FY27 target of ~INR 3,000 cr rests on unconfirmed PM-KUSUM 2.0.

name: Anand Rathi Share And Stock Brokers Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth: 15% to 20% YoY (multi-year)
thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT up 126% YoY on ₹416m, but MTF book fell 10.5% QoQ to ₹11,019m after RBI funding curbs, missing the ₹15,000m target; broking revenue fell 6.8% for FY26.

name: Xpro India Ltd
gLine: Barjora new line utilisation FY27: at least 50% (FY27)
thesis: Barjora dielectric line commissioned 27 March 2026 with utilisation target of at least 50%; Q4 revenue fell to INR134.37 crore from INR158.2 crore while polymer price hikes lift replacement costs.

name: Bajaj Electricals Ltd-$
gLine: Industry-average EBIT margin ambition: 6-8%, 9% (FY28-FY29)
thesis: Consumer Products loss on operating deleverage and channel still elevated in coolers; Lighting record 8.5% EBIT margin, capex to fall below half of past levels, but no numeric FY27 guidance.
top: Capex to fall below half of past

name: Bata India Ltd
gLine: Turns target: about 3 (currently ~2.7)
thesis: Bata's second straight quarter of ~5% value growth is volume-led, but inventory cut 13% YoY and 28% over two years, margins diluted by franchise mix and one-offs, and raw-material inflation of 5-6% is not yet priced.

name: Surya Roshni Ltd
gLine: Steel volume FY27: 11 lakh tons (FY27)
thesis: Q4 steel EBITDA/ton fell to ₹5,121 from ₹6,708 and FY27 guidance implies ~₹4,700/ton on 11 lakh tons, a sharp downshift management has not reconciled with its own export margin claims.

name: Excel Industries Ltd
gLine: Fixed asset turnover on new capex: 1 to 1.5 times
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 13% to INR281 cr and FY26 adjusted EBITDA margin 10.1%, but management gave no numeric guidance and capacity figures were withheld, leaving supply-side read thin.

name: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: around INR 2,800 crores
thesis: Q4 chemical realisations rose sequentially (6% to 28% product-wise) and TDI is running near 80%, but methanol and acetic acid volumes are constrained by gas costs and fertiliser losses persist pending urea cost and energy norm revisions.

name: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Ltd
gLine: Acquired group EBITDA: EUR 35 million FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q4 volume rebound as insolvency destocking ends and Heubach inventory cut €29m vs €20m plan; but reported EBITDA flattered by ₹82cr overhead release and ₹37cr PPA gain, with FY27 acquired EBITDA guided at €35m.

name: Alkyl Amines Chemicals Ltd-$
gLine: Volume growth: 5% to 10% in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Post-war ammonia cost doubling (INR50 to INR100+/kg) passed to customers, margins temporarily widened; management sees bottom but methylamine overcapacity from Aarti caps recovery and volume guided only 5-10%.

name: Havells India Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes soft on channel destocking and mild summer; cables volume +6% with 14% value growth on price, but no FY27 guidance and management refused to quantify outlook.

name: Onward Technologies Ltd
gLine: Capex: ~INR 25 crores over two years for existing clients (FY27-FY28)
thesis: FY26 record revenue of INR 550 crores (+10.5%) and 13.2% gross margin, but no capacity or pricing signal; management deflects AI-substitution questions and gives only double-digit guidance.
top: Evasion on AI disruption and FX growth

name: Ganesh Housing Ltd-$
gLine: Million Minds Phase 1 annual lease rental: INR 75-77 crore, from FY28 full year
thesis: Land-bank monetisation drove FY26 profit (PAT INR316 crore vs FY25 strong year); no FY27 revenue/EBITDA guidance given until Q1, with Million Minds rent ~INR72-77 crore/yr from FY28 and Malabar Retreat completion targeted FY27.

name: Kriti Industries India Ltd-$
gLine: Volume growth FY27: Positive growth, above industry average, no number given (FY27)
thesis: FY26 volume fell 13% to 58,630 MT and revenue fell 19%, but Q4 turned profitable with EBITDA margin 12.91% on a PVC inventory gain; management has put capex on hold for two quarters.
top: Capex on hold for two quarters

name: Container Corporation of India Ltd
gLine: EXIM volume growth FY27: 8% (FY27)
thesis: CONCOR handled a record 5.58 million TEUs in FY26 (+9.6%) but PAT fell 4.5% and Q4 domestic EBIT margin collapsed to 0.2%; FY27 guidance is EXIM 8%, domestic 15%, overall 9.5%.

name: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd
gLine: Credit growth FY27: 12% (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 PAT of INR2,363 cr (+13.5%) with GNPA 2.50% and zero-ish credit cost, but NIM fell to 3.60% and FY27 guidance is conservative (NIM ~3.5%, credit growth 12%, GNPA <2.25%).

name: Union Bank of India
gLine: Credit growth: 13-14% for FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Union Bank's Q4 FY26 call shows NIM down to 2.64% QoQ on rate cuts, LCR squeezed to ~114%, and deposits up only 2.72% YoY; management guides 13-14% credit growth and says NIM can be defended, with no capacity lever at play.

name: R Systems International Ltd
thesis: Revenue up 29.9% YoY to INR 574.8 cr but organic growth was flat QoQ and utilisation fell to 80.5% from ~84% as bench was built for AI; margin gain partly FX-driven.

name: Info Edge (India) Ltd
gLine: 99acres medium term: Double billings over 3 years; 25-30% EBITDA margin
thesis: Naukri billings slowed to 10% in FY26 with recruitment hiring stuck in a lukewarm market; Q4 margin held near 58% but 99acres billings grew just 2% after a one-time ₹20.5 cr warranty write-back flattered revenue.

name: Camlin Fine Sciences Ltd
gLine: FY27 Blends revenue: above INR1,400 crores
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue hit by shipping disruption and a ~INR50 crore Middle East impact; vanillin realisation rose to above $12.5 but was helped by liquidating channel stock, and FY27 guidance of 12-14% EBITDA margin is unchanged despite a Q4 EBITDA margin of about 5%.
top: Q4 vanillin sales from channel stock

name: PPAP Automotive Ltd
gLine: Battery business FY27 utilisation: 100% of plant and machinery utilised
thesis: Q4 revenue INR175.5 cr (+18.6% YoY) with utilisation ~78%, but FY27 guidance withheld, FY26 guidance missed, and battery still loss-making; supply discipline is not evidenced.

name: Orient Cement Ltd
gLine: Cost per tonne reduction: INR250/t in FY27 (average), INR500 over two years (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Document is an Ambuja Cements Q4 FY26 call transcript (filed under Orient's listing), with Orient only a minor part; cost per tonne peaked at INR4,500, FY27 capex cut to INR6,000–6,500 crore and capacity end-state pushed out, with volume guidance of 80 MT in FY27.

name: Snowman Logistics Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: ~INR50 crore (FY27)
thesis: Snowman's warehousing is running at 86–87% utilisation with price hikes sticking, but Q4 margins fell on start-up costs and West Asia disruption; management gave no numeric FY27 guidance beyond ~INR50 crore capex.
top: West Asia volumes subdued into April

name: Matrimony.com Ltd
gLine: Q1 FY27 PAT: more than double YoY (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Matchmaking billing up 10.5% YoY in Q4 with paid profiles down 4.3% YoY; ARPU-led growth, while Marriage Services losses widened to INR 5.7 crore and FY26 PAT fell to INR 34.2 crore.

name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd
gLine: Industry growth FY27 Motor: higher single-digit
thesis: Growth reaccelerated in H2 (GDPI +15.7%, Q4 +18.2%) but commercial lines share fell and Motor CR is elevated industry-wide; FY26 1/n combined ratio rose to 103.4% from 102.8%.

name: IRIS RegTech Solutions Ltd
gLine: Receivable days: 75 to 80 days comfortable (near term)
thesis: Software/RegTech call with no capacity or utilisation content; management guides INR500 crore revenue aspiration (~30% CAGR over 4-5 years), IRIS CARBON ARR growth ~35% target, and flags possible Middle East SupTech pipeline delay after June.

name: Dollar Industries Ltd
gLine: Debt reduction: Debt to zero by FY28 (FY28)
thesis: Dollar Industries took a 4–6% price hike in Q1 FY27 after ~2 years, Q4 gross margin fell 169bp to 28.1% on economy mix and yarn costs, and FY27 guidance was deferred to Q1 call.

name: Greenpanel Industries Ltd
gLine: FY27 MDF volume growth: With the market or better; industry early double digit to mid-teens (FY27)
thesis: Greenpanel FY26 reported EBITDA fell to 6.3% with PBT -INR43.8 crore; management gave no FY27 margin or volume guidance, citing Middle East chemical cost shock, a 15% price hike being discounted, and 40-45% chemical cost inflation.
top: No FY27 margin or volume guidance

name: Craftsman Automation Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens, double digit (FY27)
thesis: Powertrain utilisation only ~65-70% and alloy wheels at ~3M annualised exit vs 5.5M capacity, with management deferring further alloy expansion; FY27 growth guided mid-teens and capex undecided until September.

name: Go Fashion (India) Ltd
gLine: Square feet growth FY27: at least 10% (FY27)
thesis: Go Fashion is shutting small EBOs and pivoting to 700+ sq ft stores while SSSG is negative (~-3%) and Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 25.3%; management guides no degrowth and margin recovery only from Q2, with no numeric guidance.

name: Tega Industries Ltd
gLine: Molycop debt to 3x leverage: 3-4 years (3-4 years)
thesis: Consumables flat in FY26 as orders slipped to Feb-Mar and FG built by ~INR50 crore on shipping disruption; pending orders up ~18% and Molycop acquisition adds ~$838m debt and a 3-4 year deleveraging path.
top: FG up ~INR50 crore on shipping delays

name: Data Patterns (India) Ltd
gLine: Cash conversion cycle: 320 to 340 days (going forward)
thesis: FY26 revenue INR925cr (+31%) and EBITDA INR371cr (40% margin) on record INR1,121cr inflows, but Q4 revenue fell 13% YoY and no capacity or utilisation data was given; order conversion hinges on government timing.

name: Prudent Corporate Advisory Services Ltd
gLine: Employee cost growth for existing base FY27: approx 14% (FY27)
thesis: Prudent's MF-distribution AUM hit a record 1.33 trn by May 5 (9.7% above FY26 average) and equity net sales hit a record INR 4,300 cr, but yield and payout changes from SEBI TER rules add uncertainty.
top: Equity net sales record INR 4,300 cr

name: Infobeans Technologies Ltd
thesis: Services-led IT firm with no capacity or pricing disclosure; management gave no guidance, revenue ~539 cr and PAT ~87 cr with AI-led delivery at 43% and receivables rising.

name: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Ltd
gLine: CCL first production: November 2026 (Nov-26)
thesis: Stainless washer maker pivoting into a new copper-clad laminate (CCL) plant (₹338 cr ECMS-approved, Nov-26 start) with 1,078 cr FY26 base and a 2,500 cr FY28-29 target; capex, QIP and the working-capital build are unproven, and OCF was negative.

name: Cello World Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin expansion FY27: 2% to 2.5% above FY26 (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue record INR654 cr (+11%) but glassware sits at ~60% utilisation and breakeven, steel ware lines ramp only from July, and FY27 guidance is cut to 10-12% growth with 2-2.5% margin expansion.

name: Brainbees Solutions Ltd
gLine: India multi-channel FY27 GMV growth: better than FY26 (11%) (FY27)
thesis: India multi-channel GMV +11% with diapering price war cutting gross margin ~140 bps; management guides FY27 growth superior to FY26 and says margin loss recovers from Q2, but no capacity or supply signals.

name: Star Imaging And Path Lab Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 25-30% (FY27)
thesis: Diagnostics operator with revenue up only 6% to INR88.5 crore in FY26 after guiding 30-35%; FY27 growth now guided at 25-30% with capex of INR20-25 crore and no new debt, but execution delays undercut credibility.

name: Amanta Healthcare Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin (blended, post SteriPort): 24% to 25% (FY27 onward)
thesis: Capacity doubling from 6.6 to ~12 crore bottles (SteriPort line 3) due ~20 June; management targets 24-25% EBITDA margin, but commissioning, 4-month polymer buffer and inventory build point to a slow ramp.

name: HeidelbergCement India Ltd
thesis: Central India cement pricing under pressure from new capacity (JK, UltraTech ramp); management expects Q1 cost push of INR100-160/t to be passed on, but concedes near-term price weakness before monsoon ends; 95% utilisation and debottlenecked clinker give limited volume headroom.

name: SKF India Ltd
gLine: Sustainable PBT margin: 11-12% near term
thesis: Post-demerger SKF India auto margins guided to 11-12% PBT (vs ~20% FY25 cited by analysts), with FY26 sales +12.8% but PBT down 694bp, capex ~INR 500cr over FY26-28 and industrial trading filling capacity gaps.

name: NOCIL Ltd
gLine: Volume growth: double-digit (coming years)
thesis: Q4 volumes up 7% QoQ to 150 index, but EBITDA margin fell to 6.4% as RM spike and legacy inventory costs squeezed spreads; Rs.130 cr new capacity adds to supply, offset by pending antidumping duties.

name: GMM Pfaudler Ltd
gLine: Medium-term consolidated EBITDA margin: 15% minimum (medium term)
thesis: Order intake up 20% to INR 3,714 crore and opening backlog up 34%, but management declined numeric FY27 guidance, Q4 gross margin slipped and EBITDA margin target is only 15% medium term.
top: Order intake up 20% to INR 3,714 crore

name: Kalyani Forge Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 15% floor; target 20% in about a year (FY27 end / early FY28)
thesis: Margins up to 15.2% EBITDA on exits from low-margin business, but FY26 revenue flat at Rs 238 cr, working capital stretched (CCC peaked 176 days) and D/E rising to 1.11 with equity raise in the works.

name: Kilburn Engineering Ltd
gLine: Order intake FY27: INR800-1,000 cr group (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 consol EBITDA 22.95% on INR189 cr revenue; order intake shifted a quarter with FY27 INR800-1,000 cr target, but receivables and working capital days rose from 169 to 184, weakening cash conversion.
themes: Waste heat recovery in steel and ferrous alloy

name: Aarti Drugs Ltd
gLine: Methylamine utilisation: 55-60% in June quarter; 70% within a year (Q1 FY27 / 12 months)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 13.4% with Sayakha methylamine utilisation ~40% in March and FY27 margin target 13.5–14%, but salicylic acid shut and export revenue down 7% YoY.

name: Hester Biosciences Ltd
gLine: Animal Healthcare recovery: recovery from this quarter onwards (qualitative)
thesis: Poultry-led profit recovery (Q4 revenue +22%, PAT +174%) with Animal Healthcare tender delays unresolved and no hard FY27 guidance; capacity built, BSL-3 underused, receivables rising to INR 92 crore.

name: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd
gLine: FY27 powder volume growth: small increase (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 PAT above Rs100 cr on sales of Rs767 cr (up 58%), driven by bird-flu-led export pricing; management says capacity is full and FY27 volume growth will be small, with a Rs400 cr EC-shed capex aimed at cutting purchased-egg costs rather than adding top line.

name: Cyient Ltd
gLine: Semiconductor FY27 revenue: $100 million (FY27)
thesis: DET Q4 revenue fell 2.4% QoQ in constant currency to $163.5M with normalised EBIT 12.4%; management reiterates FY27 mid-to-high single digit growth and 15% EBIT exit, but Strategic Units fell 12.4% QoQ and no capacity signals were given.

name: National Aluminium Company Ltd
gLine: Alumina production and sales FY27: ~25 lakh tonnes (FY27)
thesis: NALCO guides FY27 alumina to 25 lakh tonnes on a 2 lakh tonne fifth stream, but expects alumina at $300-310/t vs $376 in FY26, with metal near $3,000-3,100/t offsetting; capex steps up to Rs4,000-5,000 crore in FY28.

name: GE Power India Ltd
thesis: Order book fell to INR 1,628 cr from INR 2,662 cr as FGD-EP contracts were terminated; core services orders up 32% and FY26 PBT of INR 340 cr is inflated by one-offs (BHEL ECL reversal ~INR 116 cr), with underlying EBITDA ~11%.

name: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Ltd
thesis: FY26 revenue up 12% to INR1,424 crores with EBITDA margin 10.2%, but Q4 margin fell to about 9% on cost pressure; new opex/as-a-service model is adding lease debt and ROU assets with little disclosure on returns.

name: Granules India Ltd-$
gLine: Remediation spend FY27: substantially lower than FY26
thesis: Granules FY26 revenue INR53,656m (+20%) and Q4 gross margin 65.7%, but management withdrew gross-margin guidance and flagged raw-material and freight inflation with no committed price increases yet.
top: No price increases yet despite input inflation

name: LT Foods Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: around 12% (FY27)
thesis: Basmati volume up ~19% and FY26 EBITDA margin around 11.8% normalised, but management guides margins back to ~12% with gross margin held at 33-33.5% and RTH capacity delayed to Q2 FY27.

name: Rhi Magnesita India Ltd
gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: 13% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 margin fell to 12.1% and FY27 guided to ~13% EBITDA on price hikes of 1-3% and coke-oven order book, but no capacity discipline is discussed and industry overcapacity persists.

name: Indus Towers Ltd
thesis: Indus Towers' Q4 FY26 supply-side picture is steady, not cyclical: 4,892 macro towers and 6,192 co-locations added, tenancy stable at 1.62, but EBITDA margin slipped to 55.1% and management pays out full FY26 FCF.
top: Full-year FCF fully distributed as dividend

name: Repco Home Finance Ltd
gLine: FY27 disbursement: Rs.5,000 Cr (FY2026-27)
thesis: Record Q4 FY26 disbursements of Rs.1186 Cr, but AUM growth lags because of pre-closures and run-down; FY27 AUM target Rs.18,000 Cr implies ~13% growth with CoF guided to fall only 10-15 bps via NHB refinance.

name: UFO Moviez India Ltd
thesis: Q4 revenue up 43% YoY to ₹1,342m but EBITDA fell 13% QoQ and DSO rose to 147 days from 121, largely from Dhurandhar revenue booked late in March.

name: Alkem Laboratories Ltd
gLine: Operating EBITDA margin FY27: 20% to 21%
thesis: Alkem FY26 revenue up 13.5% to INR147bn with EBITDA margin 20.4%, but management flagged geopolitical cost pressure, trade generics growth slowing to ~4.3%, and CEO exit with no FY27 margin expansion assured.
top: API and packaging cost inflation flagged

name: Parag Milk Foods Ltd
gLine: Core category volume growth: Double-digit aspiration (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 core volumes fell 3% (branded -5%) on lapped institutional and export sales; gross margin rose to 28% but EBITDA margin slipped to ~8.1%, with no capacity discipline signal and inventory up ~INR150 crore on rate variance.

name: HPL Electric & Power Ltd
gLine: C&I revenue FY27: around 1,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: FY26 C&I revenue grew 26% to Rs 784 cr with wires up 50%, mostly volume-led; smart metering order book over Rs 3,200 cr, but management flagged margin pressure from commodity costs and lower smart-meter realisations.

name: Apex Frozen Foods Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume growth: ~30% envisaged, not firm (FY27)
thesis: FY26 EBITDA up 145% to INR73 crore on a flat ~10,300 MT volume base, helped by FX gains, lower debt and inventory use; management guides FY27 volume up ~30% but wants to see quarterly progress.

name: Indian Energy Exchange Ltd
gLine: Electricity volume growth FY27: 15% to 20% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes hit a record 39.4 BU (+24.3% YoY) and FY26 profit rose 14.9%, but DAM prices fell 12.2% YoY to INR 3.89/unit and market coupling is a live threat to the exchange's price-discovery role.

name: Shalby Ltd
gLine: Hospital revenue growth: minimum 15% CAGR long term (long term)
thesis: Shalby's Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA rose 43% to INR37.4 crore on a 9.4% revenue gain, but standalone EBITDA fell and PAT was lifted mainly by a tax-regime change, not operations.

name: Affordable Robotic & Automation Ltd
gLine: Humro EBITDA margin target: 15-18%
thesis: FY26 standalone EBITDA margin rose to 14.45% from 8.96% on selective, margin-led execution, but revenue fell and the Humro US/AMR book is small (about $25k/month billed) against a 225-robot FY27 target.

name: Fine Organic Industries Ltd
gLine: US plant commissioning: 18 to 24 months from construction start, target 18 (post construction start)
thesis: Specialty additives maker at full utilisation with FY27 guided flat on volumes until SEZ commissioning in 2H FY28; sustainable EBITDA 18-20% reiterated, while capex and acquisitions expand.

name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~15% (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 turnover INR 7,548 cr and UOV above INR 11,800 cr, but Q4 revenue fell to INR 1,946 cr as developers deferred ordering, and EPC margin guide held at 8-10%.
top: Q4 order inflow muted, shifted to Q1

name: CSB Bank Ltd
gLine: RoA / RoE: ROA ~1.5%, ROE ~15% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 profit up 32% QoQ to Rs202cr with GNPA 1.66%, but NIM fell 2-3bps QoQ, CTI guided 60-65% through FY27, and retail asset growth pushed to FY28.

name: G R Infraprojects Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~15% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 standalone revenue up 27% to INR2,521 cr but adjusted EBITDA margin fell to ~11% from 15.5%, with execution slowed by land delays and fuel-linked cost spikes; FY27 guidance is 15% growth and INR20,000-22,000 cr order wins.
top: Margin hit by fuel and bitumen costs

name: Prevest Denpro Ltd
thesis: Dental materials maker grew revenue 13.9% to INR71.81 cr with 38.6% EBITDA margin, but traditional capacity sits at only 67-68% utilisation and no capex or capacity-addition guidance was given.

name: Unicommerce Esolutions Ltd
gLine: Shipway revenue growth: double digits, faster than Uniware (FY27)
thesis: Software/SaaS for e-commerce ops: FY26 revenue +51.6% to INR204.3cr but Q4 standalone growth only 11.7% and management guides lower EBITDA for two quarters on investment, with no FY27 growth number given.
top: Near-term EBITDA/PAT to fall on investment

name: Premier Energies Ltd
gLine: Total capacity by July 2026: 16.75 GVA (July 2026)
thesis: Premier Energies' cell and module capacity heads to 16.75 GW by July 2026 with a ₹5,100 crore FY27 capex plan, while management declined to guide on margins despite rising cell and silver costs.

name: Swiggy Ltd
gLine: Quick commerce contribution margin path: steady state/positive CM; 3% positive CM in top city
thesis: Swiggy's Q4 FY26 call shows quick-commerce losses still near INR700 crore per quarter, with management trading growth for profitability; no supply-side discipline signals, and MTU growth is softening on lower AOV and frequency.

name: Indo Farm Equipment Ltd
gLine: Overall revenue growth FY27: 20–25% (FY27)
thesis: Crane capacity expansion is delayed and under-utilised, with FY27 guidance of 20–25% revenue growth, tractor utilisation near 35–45%, and cash-flow and working-capital questions left unanswered.
top: New crane plant start slipped to Q2 FY27

name: Meta Infotech Ltd
gLine: PAT FY29: up to 4x FY26 levels (aspirational)
thesis: FY26 PAT fell to INR11 crore from INR14 crore and H2 PAT was INR0.4 crore; management guides only an aspirational 4x PAT by FY29 with no numeric FY27 guidance, and attributes the miss to a vendor sale and FX.

name: Glen Industries Ltd
gLine: FY28 turnover: INR500 crore plus (FY28)
thesis: Glen is adding ~3x plastic food-container capacity and paper food packaging (~750 MT, INR130-135 cr capex, INR500 cr turnover target by FY28) while PLA/paper straw utilisation is only 28-34% and EBITDA margin has compressed to 18-19% on pass-through of PLA costs.
top: Capex raised INR100 cr → INR130-135 cr

name: Laxmi India Finance Ltd
gLine: AUM CAGR (medium term): 30% to 35% annually (medium term)
thesis: Secured MSME/rural lender guiding 30-35% AUM CAGR and ~40-45% PAT growth; cost of borrowing fell to 10.8% but incremental cost is 10.25-10.30%, and Q4 PAT was flattered by an INR 8.66 cr DA upfront gain.
top: DA pool sale lifts Q4 NIM

name: Highway Infrastructure Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR 950 crore (EPC ~300, Toll ~650)
thesis: Tollway-led infra firm with record INR 1,143 cr order book and FY27 revenue guide of INR 950 cr, but no capacity or capex discipline data, and management evaded margin and Kaza profitability questions.

name: Jinkushal Industries Ltd
gLine: HexL share of revenue FY27: 11% to 12% of revenue; ~150 units
thesis: Q4 revenue up 89% to INR133 crore standalone but FY26 PAT of INR12.4 crore reflects logistics and HexL costs; management declined FY27 guidance and working capital is stretching with no cash-conversion improvement guided.
top: Cash conversion cycle to stay elevated

name: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd
gLine: FY27 presales: No numeric guidance; new launches ~INR 9,000 cr plus ~INR 7,000 cr sustenance (FY27)
thesis: Record Q4 presales of INR 4,288 crores (+69% QoQ) and FY26 presales of INR 8,136 crores, but BD of only ~INR 1,600 crores in FY26 and no FY27 presales guidance leaves pipeline lumpy.
top: INR 15,000 cr launch target may slip to FY29

name: Infosys Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth cc: 1.5% to 3.5% (FY27)
thesis: FY27 revenue guided 1.5%–3.5% cc with 20–22% margin; AI deflation offsets growth, volumes flattish, and no supply-side capacity cuts disclosed — a demand-and-pricing-led read, not a capacity-discipline one.

name: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up only ~4% to about INR1,800 crore after a March polymer price shock (~INR200-250 crore lost); management guides FY27 better and says ~INR600 crore operating cash flow, but ~INR40 crore reported PAT loss and large debt repayments due Sept and March 2027.
top: Q4 revenue short by INR200-250 crore

name: Patanjali Foods Ltd
gLine: Edible oil volume growth FY27: 3% to 5% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 edible oil EBITDA margin only 2.58% on 23% revenue growth as palm/soy prices rose 15-23%; management guides 2-4% edible oil margin and FY27 FMCG-led EBITDA growth of 12-15%, with plantation EBITDA of INR357 crores as the swing.

name: Ambuja Cements Ltd
gLine: Cost reduction FY27: INR250/t reduction, another INR250 in FY28 (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Ambuja's Q4 FY26 cost hit ~INR4,500/t with FY27 cost reduction of only INR250/t and capex cut to INR6,000–6,500 cr; utilisation at acquired Sanghi (57%) and Penna (46%) is the drag, and pricing is still under pressure.
top: Industry price up only ~INR10 in March

name: Siemens Ltd
thesis: Record ₹450bn backlog and Q6 orders up 33%, but EBITDA margin fell 290bp to 9.7% on commodity and Euro-driven material cost (74% of revenue); price hikes lag 3–4 months.

name: Colgate Palmolive (India) Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 9% to Rs 1,583 crore with domestic growth 9.2%, but full-year sales flat at Rs 5,984 crore; no capacity or capex signal, and management guides to balanced volume-price growth with EBITDA not guided.

name: Castrol India Ltd
thesis: Q1 FY26 revenue +9% to INR1,545 cr, EBITDA +7% to INR329 cr, but management flagged raw-material and FX costs flowing into Q2 with only one price round taken; margin guidance of 21-24% kept.
top: Raw-material cost hit deferred to Q2

name: Balkrishna Industries Ltd-$
gLine: Total capex FY27: INR1,500-1,800 crore (FY27)
thesis: Record Q4 OHT volumes (85,820 MT, +5% YoY) and FY26 highest-ever, but management stopped volume guidance, RM costs set to rise 7-8% in Q1 FY27, and capex raised to INR6,800 crore through FY29.

name: Simplex Castings Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs300 cr (200 existing, 50 casted railway, ~50 power) (FY27)
thesis: Simplex Castings FY26 revenue ~Rs202 cr (+18%), PAT Rs21.26 cr (+40.5%); FY27 target Rs300 cr with management admitting Q4 dispatches slipped into Q1 as customer sites stalled, and capacity build is ahead of confirmed orders.

name: Salzer Electronics Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 existing business revenue: INR 2,000-2,100 crore (FY27)
thesis: Margins squeezed by plastic and copper inflation (2-3% hit); FY27 EBITDA guided 9-9.5% after a June 7-10% price hike, while working capital ran near 30% of revenue vs a 25% target.

name: TCPL Packaging Ltd-$
thesis: Flexible packaging running well-utilised with a fourth line due by year-end, carton utilisation lower, FY27 capex ~INR 100 crore; paper cost increases still rolling through with no margin guidance, export recovery contingent on Middle East.

name: Mahindra EPC Irrigation Ltd
thesis: Management reports record FY26 revenue of INR315.8 crores (+14.8%) and PBT of INR16.99 crores, but Q4 PBT fell to INR6.4 crores on a March PE pipe price spike and receivables are high at INR217 crores.
top: Raw material prices spike in March

name: Emami Ltd-$
gLine: International business growth: good double-digit growth from Q2 (Q2 FY27 onwards)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue down 4% and EBITDA down 15% on weak summer and Middle East disruption, though gross margin rose 250bps to 68.4% and receivables fell over INR100 crores.
top: Receivables cut by over INR100 crores

name: 3B BlackBio Dx Ltd
gLine: Coris revenue FY27: around INR50 crore, EBITDA slightly positive (FY27)
thesis: FY26 consolidated revenue ~INR142 crore with PAT ~INR60 crore; management guides 15-20% growth for FY27 but domestic 3B molecular sales grew only ~7% ex-exports, with Chinese low-price competition and Coris EBITDA near breakeven.

name: Redington Ltd
gLine: Outside Arena EBITDA: 2.2% to 2.4% (FY27)
thesis: Record Q4 revenue up 25% to INR33,269 cr and PAT ex-exceptional at 1.4% margin, but Middle East war hits Q1 and FY27 guidance is only soft, with management conserving cash for large deals and M&A.
top: AR provisions elevated, working capital may rise

name: Central Bank of India
gLine: Deposit growth FY27: 10% to 12% (FY27)
thesis: Advances up 18.8% to ₹3.45 lakh crore and CD ratio 73.8%, but Q4 PAT of ₹724 crore was hit by a ₹632 crore one-time DTA charge; ECL transition and treasury drag weigh on FY27 earnings.

name: Bajaj Auto Ltd
gLine: Motorcycle industry growth: 7% to 9% near term
thesis: Record Q4 with 20.8% EBITDA margin, but management flags 3.5–4% of revenue commodity inflation in Q1 with only ~40% priced back and motorcycle industry growth guided down to 7–9% from ~20%.

name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd
gLine: TCNS breakeven: end FY27 breakeven; profitable FY28
thesis: Demand-led apparel recovery at Pantaloons (+17% core, 14% LTL) with flat pricing and rising costs; capital-cycle picture is cash burn of ~INR1,000 cr standalone in FY26 with management guiding stores to only 20-22 for Pantaloons in FY27.

name: Zim Laboratories Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: upper teens / mid-teens once regulated markets start (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Zim is a sub-scale, EU-GMP-constrained pharma exporter: FY26 revenue flat at INR 3,744m, EBITDA INR 414m, with regulated revenue gated by an unresolved May 2026 re-inspection and no capacity-discipline signal.

name: Angel One Ltd
gLine: Employee cost incl. ESOP: about ₹11 billion, flat vs FY26 (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 broking volumes rebounded (orders +13.3% QoQ to 431m, EB/DAT margin 41.7%, normalised 44.4%), but cash market share fell 117 bps QoQ and management guided only to flat employee cost and a 2.5-3% new-business drag.

name: Alivus Life Sciences Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: about INR540 crores, funded internally (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 margin of 33.6% (+360bp) and revenue +6.9%, but capex stepping up to INR540 crores for FY27 with capacity planned to reach 2,690 KL by FY28; Solapur utilisation guided at only 40-50% at start.

name: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd
gLine: Market share recovery: Reasonably close to market growth momentum very soon
thesis: Asset manager with flows still below market growth; Q4 equity yield fell 2-3 bps and PAT dropped to ₹187 crore on lower other income, while management claims flows are improving from a low base.

name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
thesis: LIC's FY26 VNB rose 41.6% to ₹14,179 crore with margin up 360bp to 21.2%, but about 2.8pp of the gain came from one-off operating-assumption and economic changes, and the company is withholding payout-ratio guidance pending risk-based capital.

name: Enviro Infra Engineers Ltd
gLine: FY27 PAT: INR270-280 crore (13.5-14% margin) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue up 8.8% and FY26 revenue missed the prior ~35% growth guide; FY27 guided to ~INR2,000 crore revenue and PAT INR270-280 crore on 1,200 crore-plus order book conversion, with working capital stretched to 166 days.

name: Orkla India Ltd
gLine: Kerala distribution restructuring completion: by 1 January 2027
thesis: Spice deflation has bottomed: Q4 price uptick (~4% realisation) and chilli up 20-30%, but volume growth slowed to 2.2% in Q4 and no PLI income was booked in FY26 (FY25: INR 20.5 cr).

name: Meesho Ltd
thesis: Meesho is an asset-light marketplace with no capacity to add; the read is margin repair from logistics normalisation (CM exit rate 4%) and ad monetisation, but LTM FCF and CFO remain negative with no guidance given.

name: Digilogic Systems Ltd
thesis: FY26 revenue up 8.4% to INR78.27 cr, missing the 20-25% guidance; management blames delayed imported hardware and a INR22 cr spillover, with FY27 relying on a September order-book target of INR100 cr-plus.

name: CSM Technologies Ltd
gLine: Revenue and margin direction FY27: upside qualitative, no numbers
thesis: GovTech software firm with no capacity or pricing signals; FY26 revenue up 12% to Rs 226 cr, Q4 revenue down YoY to Rs 60 cr, DSO stretched 58 to 129 days, and order book Rs 357.63 cr is the only hard visibility.

name: DCW Ltd
gLine: Finance cost FY27: Rs50cr or sub-50cr
thesis: C-PVC capacity doubled to 50kt and sold out, but realisations fell over 20% and PVC-C-PVC spread compressed, so FY26 EBITDA rose only 11% to Rs240cr and FY27 Rs400cr target was effectively abandoned.

name: LMW Ltd
gLine: Textile offtake: much larger offtake of machines expected
thesis: Textile machinery order book rose to Rs 3,300 cr (all booked in Q4) with textile utilisation only 50-55%, while machine tool utilisation 70-75% and ATC order book flat near Rs 360 cr.

name: Britannia Industries Ltd
gLine: Domestic growth recovery: Expected normalisation in the quarter
thesis: Q4 FY26 consol sales +7.1% to INR 4,686 cr with PAT +21% helped by tax case releases; domestic growth ~9-9.5% ex dual-pricing and West Asia, with price hikes and no capacity-discipline signal.
top: Calibrated price increases from Q1 FY27

name: EIH Ltd
gLine: Owned-hotel capex: ₹600–700 cr per year for next one or two years (FY27–FY28)
thesis: Hotel supply-light, ARR-led FY26 with EBITDA up only 3% and PAT hit by a ₹30 cr wage-code charge; Q4 occupancy fell to 67–69% on West Asia, while 825 owned keys arrive only from 2027–2030.

name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd-$
gLine: Q1 FY27 profitability vs Q4: better than Q4 (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin rebounded to 18% from 11% on phenolics spreads (EBIT margin 20%), but nitric acid ran at ~45% utilisation and management guides only to Q1 beating Q4 with no numeric guidance.

name: Som Distilleries & Breweries Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: INR1,400-1,500 crores (FY27)
thesis: Bhopal licence suspension wiped out about half of volume; FY26 revenue fell 14.8% to INR1,233 crores and beer volume fell 20%, with FY27 guided at INR1,400-1,500 crores contingent on licence restoration.

name: Pennar Industries Ltd-$
gLine: PAT growth FY27: at least 20% (FY27)
thesis: PEB India utilisation at 70% with backlog ₹810 crores, but Q4 revenue growth only 2.3% and working capital rose to 82 days; management guides 20% PAT growth and 75 days working capital.

name: PI Industries Ltd
gLine: ETR: rise to 24% (FY27 onwards)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue ₹15,652m rose sequentially, FY26 ₹67,137m with 25% EBITDA; capex ₹1,100 crore and asset turns fell from ~2.5x to ~1.5x, but management gave no volume or margin guidance beyond "growth for sure".

name: Filatex India Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 standalone revenue: around INR 4,500 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 13.9% YoY to INR 86.3 cr on lower volume, but March spread fell to roughly EBITDA-neutral and management sees Q1 FY27 output 20-25% below 1 lakh tons per quarter.

name: CSL Finance Ltd
gLine: FY27 AUM growth: 15%-25% (FY27)
thesis: CSL Finance's wholesale book grows but SME retail stalled: AUM up 21% to Rs 1,448 cr, yet SME share fell to 31% and Q4 disbursements dropped 16% QoQ to Rs 301 cr.

name: Shilchar Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 dispatch volume: around 7,000 MVA (FY27)
thesis: FY26 dispatches ~6,000 MVA of 7,500 MVA capacity (79% utilisation on dispatches), Q4 margin hit by ~INR35-40 cr stranded Middle East exports and oil up ~100%; FY27 guide INR800-850 cr with price revisions unconfirmed.

name: Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd
thesis: QSR operator prioritising volume over margin: 5-7% SSSG and 230-250 store adds held, but management gave no margin timeline as energy, wage and commodity inflation hit, with Q4 LFL at 0.2%.

name: GTPL Hathway Ltd
gLine: Capex per annum: ~INR350 crore for FY27-FY29 (FY27-FY29)
thesis: Cable/broadband operator posted a Q4 loss on one-offs, subscriber growth stalled, and management guides capex to ~INR350 crore a year with no near-term reduction, so supply is expanding into a flat base.
top: Capex ~INR350 cr/yr, no cut for 3 yrs

name: The New India Assurance Company Ltd
gLine: Motor premium growth FY27: single digit
thesis: Insurer's FY26 combined ratio hit 122.57% on wage-revision charges (116.67% ex-wage), with motor TP and OD ICRs worsening; management guides motor to single-digit growth and better ratios, but commentary on pricing is competitive and unhedged on rate relief.

name: Galaxy Surfactants Ltd
gLine: Q1 FY27 volume growth: close to higher end of 6% to 8% (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell to INR122 crore (INR20,114/t vs INR21,715/t) on AMET volumes down 15% and RoW down 7%; management guides only Q1 volume at 6–8% high end and EBITDA/t INR19,000–21,000.

name: Chalet Hotels Ltd
gLine: Planned capex FY27-FY29: ~INR30 billion, funded through internal accruals (FY27-FY29)
thesis: Q4 RevPAR fell 3% on a 7.7pt occupancy drop, mostly Mumbai and West Asia cancellations (~10-12% disruption per management); FY27-29 capex ~INR30bn guided, funded from accruals, with no supply discipline signal.

name: MSTC Ltd

thesis: MSTC is an e-auction platform pivoting from trading to e-commerce and new platforms; revenue hit a four-year high of INR359 crore, but no capacity or pricing metrics and management declined to quantify new revenue streams.
top: EPR trading platform ready, awaiting go-ahead

name: Eternal Ltd

top: Dark stores 3,000 by March; no FY27 store number

name: Latent View Analytics Ltd
gLine: FY27 organic revenue growth (high-visibility): 12% to 13% (FY27)

name: Azad Engineering Ltd
gLine: Inventory days: ~200 days in H1 FY27, 160-170 days in H2 (FY27)
thesis: Azad's FY26 revenue rose ~30% to INR590 cr with 36.9% EBITDA, but capacity is ramping from a low base: inventory is building, receivables sit at INR309 cr, and the 25%+ growth guide is held without new numbers.

name: KP Green Engineering Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 40–50% YoY minimum (FY27)

name: One Mobikwik Systems Ltd
gLine: Merchant businesses EBITDA breakeven: by FY28 (FY28)

top: Gross take rate falling on mix

name: Sugs Lloyd Ltd
gLine: FPI share of revenue: around 10% in FY28
thesis: FY26 revenue up ~70% to INR300 crore with margins held near 14%, but receivables are stretched, Q4 carried 40% of sales, and the INR600+ crore order is 18-24 month execution with thin disclosure on capex and working capital.

name: Chatterbox Technologies Ltd

thesis: Influencer-marketing platform grew revenue 42.5% to INR84.22 cr in FY26 but PAT margin fell to 10.9%; no capacity or pricing data, no formal guidance, and the call was evasive on governance and merger questions.

name: EID Parry India Ltd
gLine: CPG EBITDA breakeven: breakeven within 6-8 quarters; single-digit EBITDA by end of decade
thesis: Refinery (PSRIPL) shut after Q4 loss of Rs 293 cr; parent infused ~Rs 600 cr to clear loans by 30 June 2026, while Karnataka sugar stays the core profit engine and dividends remain unresolved.
top: Refinery shut; loans cleared by June

name: Ratnamani Metals & Tubes Ltd-$
