thesis: Standalone Q4 sales fell to INR893 cr from INR1,575 cr on muted orders and Middle East shipping disruption; management guides FY27 standalone INR4,800-5,000 cr assuming normalisation within a month.

name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
gLine: Synergies (cost): about $350 million over 2-4 years (2-4 years)
thesis: Sun is buying Organon for $3.99bn equity / $11.75bn EV, funded with $2–2.5bn cash plus debt, taking net debt/EBITDA to 2.3x; a capital allocation shift, not a supply-side read.

name: VST Tillers Tractors Ltd-$
gLine: Zetor tractor volume FY27: 1,000 units
thesis: FY26 revenue up 25% to INR1,240 crore with operational EBITDA margin up 220bp to 13.4%, but management declined to guide FY27 volume growth and flagged fuel/commodity inflation and monsoon risk.

name: Birlasoft Ltd
thesis: IT services firm with no capacity lever: Q4 revenue flat QoQ in INR at INR 1,348.6 crore, FY26 revenue down 1.2%, and margin gains came from walking away from low-margin deals and one-offs, not demand.

name: TVS Electronics Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: Double-digit growth (verbal, no range) (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 margin expansion (EBITDA 5.96%, +413bp YoY) came from cost control while revenue grew only 2% YoY; management gave no numeric guidance, but EMS SMT lines run at 30-40% utilisation and CSS grew 13%.

name: Strides Pharma Science Ltd
gLine: Tangible + intangible capex: around INR300 crores run rate (next 2 years)
thesis: Strides FY26 revenue up 6.4% to INR48.6bn with ex-US up 21% and EBITDA margin 19%, but US weakened, cash-to-cash cycle lengthened 7 days on 21 days higher inventory, and US growth pushed to H2 FY27.

name: Entertainment Network (India) Ltd
gLine: Gaana breakeven: FY27 breakeven, could be defining year
thesis: Radio volume share held at 25.2% but non-FCT events fell in Q4 and Gaana quarterly growth slowed to roughly 10-15%; digital now 48% of radio revenue with breakeven targeted in FY27.

name: Hinduja Global Solutions Ltd
industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
thesis: FY26 revenue flat at Rs 4,307 cr with EBITDA margin 13.4% and ~200bp cost-led improvement; no capacity signal, media losses of Rs 175 cr and a Rs 5/share dividend despite negative standalone EPS.

name: Kaveri Seed Company Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 15% to 20% (FY27)
thesis: Kaveri built inventory 17% y/y on purpose, mgmt says prices may not rise in FY27 and revenue growth should be 15-20% on volume; channel and company inventories both high, a supply-side caution.

name: ZEN Technologies Ltd
gLine: Subsidiaries UTS+ARI revenue FY27: Rs365 Cr (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue flat QoQ at Rs178.1 Cr, down 45% YoY, with Rs1,336 Cr order book (~Rs1,000 Cr for FY27 execution) and management reiterating Rs4,000 Cr cumulative FY27–28 revenue; no order inflow number disclosed yet.

name: PG Electroplast Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: better than industry revenue growth (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA fell 43% to INR131.5 crore on LPG and truck disruptions and ~250bp unrecovered gross-margin hit, while management guides FY27 growth and ~8% EBITDA margin without hard numbers.

name: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd
thesis: Exchange volumes ran hot in FY26 (ADT ~2.5x, revenue more than doubled to INR2,302 crores), but management gave no numeric guidance, declined April-May participation data and flagged cyclicality and rising expenses.

name: Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 execution: not quantified; order book 2.8 GW executed over 12-15 months
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR1,102 cr (+131% YoY) and FY26 execution of 2,727 MWp, but order book fell to 2.83 GW and management gave no numeric guidance, with margin defended only by a 'around 15%' threshold.
top: Order inflow ~2.3 GW vs 2.4 GW prior year

name: IFGL Refractories Ltd
gLine: Domestic volume growth FY27: At least double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Domestic refractory volumes grew 20% in FY26 with margins squeezed (EBITDA 11.3% standalone, Q4 gross margin 43.1%); no supply discipline shown, Khurda greenfield still under evaluation, pricing pass-through unresolved.
top: Accepting lean pricing in new accounts

name: Bharat Parenterals Ltd
gLine: Innoxel revenue growth FY27: 35% to 45% (FY27)
thesis: Standalone BPL revenue fell 23% to INR 234 cr with utilisation at 48%/21%/24%, so supply is loose; FY27 guide of 10-15% growth rests on a INR 171 cr order book and two pending audits.
top: Standalone revenue down 23% to INR 234 cr

name: HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd
gLine: Dividend payout: INR54 per share, 81% payout
thesis: Asset manager with QAAUM up 20% to INR9.3tn and FY26 PAT up 16% to INR28.6bn; flows strong but TER/BER regulation trims distributor economics, with gross impact 3-4 bps on existing book.
top: Gross TER impact 3-4 bps on existing book

name: Borosil Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth (medium term): 15% to 20% year-on-year (medium term)
thesis: FY26 EBITDA flat at INR176.7 crores with margin down to 15.1%; Hydra supply disruption under BIS QCO and West Asia gas costs hit Q4 margin to 11.5%, with no volume recovery guided beyond muted growth for a year.

name: UTI Asset Management Company Ltd
gLine: Standalone employee cost run rate per quarter: Rs 90-95 crore (FY27)
thesis: Asset manager with no capacity cycle; FY26 core PAT up only 3% to Rs 460 cr, equity net sales near zero, cost base growing 15% with growth-led guidance and flat-to-weak yield outlook.

name: Krsnaa Diagnostics Ltd
gLine: Retail share of revenue: double digits FY27; 25-30% in 3-5 years (3-5 years)
thesis: FY26 sales up only ~8% to INR7,728m with Q4 PAT boosted by a INR222m Apulki valuation gain; receivables still 139 days, Rajasthan guided conservatively at INR100-150 crore vs earlier INR250-300 crore.
top: Rajasthan revenue cut to INR100-150 cr

name: Dev Information Technology Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: around INR200 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q4 margin rose to 8.99% but FY26 EBITDA margin fell to about 3.7% on a ~5% revenue rise; management guides FY27 revenue of about INR200 crores with 15–20% growth, with no capex or capacity discussion.

name: Macfos Ltd
gLine: Own-brand (Robu 2.0) gross margin: about 10% above core gross margin
thesis: Macfos (Robu.in), an online electronics distributor, reports FY26 revenue of about INR312 cr, up ~67% like-for-like, with no capacity or capex signal; debt funds inventory and margin is the key watch item.

name: Blue Jet Healthcare Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: approximately INR400 crore (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue fell 8% to INR947 crore as PI/API dropped 35% on customer destocking; PI inventory now normalising, but Q4 PI revenue was only INR2.4 crore and FY27 capex of about INR400 crore keeps the cycle investment-heavy.

name: Bharti Hexacom Ltd
gLine: Dividend per share FY26: Rs.18 per share (vs Rs.10)
thesis: Hexacom Q4 FY26 shows steady telecom operating leverage (47.9% margin, 148k homes net adds) but ARPU is soft (Rs.252 reported, ~Rs.257-258 EDB) and capex is stepping up to Rs.586 Cr in the quarter.

name: TBO TEK Ltd
gLine: Q1 FY27 GTV and GP vs Q4 and vs Q1 FY26: Better than Q4 and better than same period last year, not quantified (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA hit by March war washout (Rs 110 cr reported) while SG&A still grew 16%; management guides Q1 better than Q4 and YoY but gives no numbers, with cash conversion timing-driven and expected to recover by Q2.
top: Q1 better than Q4 and YoY

name: Stanley Lifestyles Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: Aspirational double-digit, conservative (FY27)
thesis: Stanley is a COCO-led furniture retailer with flat revenue since FY23, Q4 B2B pulled down by ~Rs 15 crore, and only a qualitative FY27 "double-digit aspiration"; supply discipline is weak as stores keep expanding.
top: B2B pulled down ~Rs 15 crore in Q4

name: ECOS (India) Mobility & Hospitality Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 18% to 20% (FY27)
thesis: Asset-light corporate mobility grew trips 29% to 5.23m, but EBITDA margin fell to about 11.6% on ETS price competition and cost build; management guides 11-13% margin and 18-20% growth.

name: Solarium Green Energy Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 10% to 12% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up 60% to ₹368 cr but PAT only ₹20.5 cr as gross margin fell to ~30% and finance cost rose to ₹10.5 cr; module plant running at ~45% utilisation with ALMM-II and captive-demand dependence unresolved.

name: Chembond Chemicals Ltd
gLine: Quarterly revenue: Rs100 cr+ in next four quarters (possible, seasonality) (FY27)
thesis: Water-treatment chemicals volume up 50% H2 over H1 to 4,813 MT and Q4 revenue Rs101.4 cr, but management flags a ~3% margin hit from raw-material spikes and public-sector units refusing price changes.

name: National Securities Depository Ltd
industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
gLine: Technology capex and opex: Broadly similar to FY26; next year capex to decline (FY27)
thesis: Standalone PAT up 5% YoY in Q4 to INR79.7 crore on subdued capital markets; FY26 PAT INR360 crore (+12.1%), with market share on net account adds at 15.4% and Q4 net share slipping sequentially.

name: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Ltd
gLine: Cost-to-income ratio: 40% to 50%
thesis: Asset manager with 91% equity AUM; FY26 revenue up 17% to INR424.9 crore but SIP flows and AUM softer on mark-to-market, with no capacity or supply metrics applicable, and cost guidance vague.

name: Highness Microelectronics Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR30-32 crore (FY27)
thesis: Micro-cap display maker guides FY27 revenue INR30-32 crore and 35% EBITDA, but utilisation is about 20% and the stated capacity case rests on Goa capex with no prior guidance to test.

name: Bharat Electronics Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: >28% (FY27)
thesis: BEL guides FY27 revenue growth above 15% and EBITDA margin above 28%, with order inflow above INR55,000 crore, though QRSAM timing and a flat order book cloud visibility.
top: FY27 order inflow above INR55,000 cr

name: Nirlon Ltd
gLine: Final dividend FY26: Rs 15 per share
thesis: Fully leased NKP park (99.7% occupancy) with contracted escalations; FY26 PAT +59% flattered by Rs 69.5 cr deferred-tax write-back, ex-item growth ~27%; management evasive on cash of ~Rs 278-287 cr parked in FDs and on the 5% debt amortisation.

name: Tata Elxsi Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR993.8 cr, up 0.9% QoQ cc, with healthcare down 13.1% and FY27 growth cut to high single digit; margin gain mostly currency, not capacity discipline.
top: FY27 growth cut to high single digit

name: Foods & Inns Ltd
gLine: FY27 volume growth: ~18% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 volume grew only ~4% with realisations down ~25% on low-cost 2025 crop inventory; management guides ~18% FY27 volume growth but gives no EBITDA quantum, and a 45-day spray-dryer outage hit Q4.

name: Duroply Industries Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth (volume 10–12% plus price): 9–12% p.a. for next two years (FY27–FY28)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 5% YoY to ₹111.6 cr with gross margin down to 34.3% from 37% in Q3; management guides 9–12% growth for two years but cites rising petrochemical and imported raw material costs and no capacity signals.

name: Heritage Foods Ltd
gLine: EBITDA median target: ~9% median; 6.5%-7% bad year, 10%+ good year (medium term)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 4.5% as procurement rose 8% to INR 46.67/litre while milk volume growth was only about 1%; price hikes are muting volumes and no supply relief is yet visible on prices.

name: Geojit Financial Services Ltd
gLine: Investment spend for next 3 years (IT): INR30 crores (3 years)
thesis: Geojit is spending through a 20% sales-force expansion (about 650 sales hires, INR29 crore cost) and has paused field hiring, with FY26 profit hit by investment and brokerage income down while distribution rose; no numeric guidance given.

name: Indoco Remedies Ltd
gLine: Debt repayment: ~INR 140 cr per year for next 3 years, prepay a little more (FY27-FY29)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 25.8% YoY to INR 4,291 mn and standalone EBITDA margin 14.7%, but receivables up ~45% against ~9% revenue growth, debt near INR 960 cr, and capex tightly controlled.

name: AIA Engineering Ltd
gLine: Realisation per kg: INR165/kg for full year FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 profit lifted by one-off ~INR65 crore FX gain and mix; management guides ~INR165/kg realisation, utilisation ~55% with capacity expansion paused, and a single mine-trial win with no volume guidance.

name: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 sales flat at INR590 crore and margin hit by ~2.5% commodity drag; management held Q4 orders selectively and cited customer-requested delivery deferrals of 10-12%, with FY26 orders up 27.4%.

name: S H Kelkar and Company Ltd
gLine: Adjusted EBITDA margin: ~13% in H1 FY27 (12-13% floor) (H1 FY27)
thesis: Fragrance maker guides adjusted EBITDA margin ~13% for H1 FY27 and FY27 capex of Rs 140 crore, but refuses full-year guidance amid raw-material inflation; Rs 350 crore capex plus Rs 80-85 crore annual dev-centre opex still not earning returns.

name: Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd
gLine: Cayman insurance quarterly losses: losses to decline over next 3 quarters
thesis: Q4 FY26 call: India margins up on case mix and high-end procedures, but UK acquisition dilutes consolidated margin (~20% reported, ~22% normalised) and greenfield capex delivered only INR 109 crore vs INR 424 crore plan.
top: Greenfield capex INR 109 cr vs 424 cr plan

name: ICICI Life Insurance Ltd
thesis: Life insurer grew VNB 10.9% to ₹26.29bn with margin up 190bp to 24.7%, but APE grew only 2.2% and RoEV fell to 11.9% on negative persistency and assumption changes; growth guidance withheld.

name: Pricol Ltd
gLine: Debt-equity: About 0.5 to 0.6 (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR 1,077.9 cr (EBITDA 13.29%) but management flags West Asia-driven input inflation and softer earnings ahead; FY27 capex INR 680-700 cr signals capacity expansion into a soft cycle.

name: S Chand and Company Ltd
gLine: Operating revenue growth FY27: 10%-15% (FY27)
thesis: S Chand guides FY27 revenue growth 10-15% and EBITDA margin 17-19% (down from 18.1%), with receivables at 160 days and paper cost pressure of 10-15% limiting upside; capex is small at Rs20m.

name: Orient Electric Ltd
thesis: Q4 revenue up 10% to INR948 cr and EBITDA margin 8.2%, but gross margin fell to 31% on commodity inflation; calibrated price hikes (~6% in April) only partly offset costs and double-digit margin path is deferred.

name: Sumitomo Chemical India Ltd
gLine: Monsoon: IMD forecast 92% of LPA (FY27)
thesis: Record FY26 profitability (PAT INR543 cr, up 7%) on 3% revenue growth; supply-side signals are mostly inventory build and a modest capex pipeline, with FY27 margins guided as cost-pass-through dependent and monsoon-exposed.
top: Price hikes three times since March

name: SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd
gLine: Credit cost: moderate further in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Credit cards: credit cost falling (7.7% gross, down 55bps QoQ) and GNPA 2.41%, but receivables growth only 2% YoY, revolver on downward bias, and cost-to-income guided 55-58%.

name: Gateway Distriparks Ltd
gLine: Snowman capex FY27: ~INR50 cr (FY27)
thesis: Rail volumes stay subdued on West Asia disruption with no clarity on recovery; Q4 volume about 188,000 TEUs (96,000 rail, 91,000 CFS), double-stacking averaged 40%, and Snowman margins fell on start-up costs.

name: Aether Industries Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 29% to 30% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell QoQ to INR3,051m (from INR3,188m) on logistics slippage and a one-off Q3 claim, while management guides FY27 EBITDA margin 29-30%, capex INR3,000-3,500m and CRAMS/CEM rising toward 70% of sales.

name: Tracxn Technologies Ltd
thesis: Tracxn Q4 FY26 shows revenue of ₹20.5 cr with EBITDA at -6.6 cr and near-breakeven PAT; the call is a demand-led pitch with no supply-side discipline, and mgmt concedes blended ASP is falling on mix.

name: Updater Services Ltd
gLine: IFM growth: healthy high single-digit growth
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 3% to INR750 crores with FY26 adjusted EBITDA margin 5.9% after Avon provisions; management refused formal FY27 guidance and cited Athena and Matrix softness, with cash deployment undecided.

name: Le Travenues Technology Ltd
thesis: Travel OTA with 39% contribution margin held flat YoY in Q4 (CM up 0.4%) as train volumes fell 8% and flights CM dipped 3%; management is prioritising market share and AI build-out over margin expansion.
top: Train segments down 8% YoY in Q4

name: Rikhav Securities Ltd
gLine: FY27 brokerage growth: around 20% (FY27)
thesis: Weak H2 FY26 with PAT of INR1.20 crore and EBITDA of INR6.57 crore after cash-market share losses of INR20-23 crore; management guides FY27 brokerage growth of about 20% and offers little new capacity-discipline evidence.
top: Retail and HNI brokerage slack for six months

name: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd
gLine: Cost to operate: Absolute increase in Q1 from appraisals, then stable for Groww platform
thesis: Groww Q4 FY26 call is a retail broking platform update with no supply-side capital-cycle content; management guided margin expansion only if revenue grows above 15%, and gave no numeric guidance.

name: Tata Chemicals Ltd
gLine: FY27 capex: ~INR 1,300 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA fell to INR 274 crores from 327 crores on soda ash price weakness, with a INR 1,837 crore US goodwill impairment; supply exits are real but early, and China inventory sits near 1.8 million tons.

name: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Ltd
thesis: Chola MS general insurance: combined ratio rose to 115.2% (112.2% ex-1/n) on motor OD and TP reserving, with ROE guidance softened to a medium-to-long-term 15%+ and no numeric combined-ratio guide.

name: Avanti Feeds Ltd-$
gLine: Feed sales FY27: ~580,000 MT (FY27)
thesis: Feed PBT fell to ₹139 cr in Q4 (from ₹172 cr QoQ) as fish meal jumped to ₹130/kg from ₹117; management is pursuing price hikes but has not quantified them, and FY27 feed volume guided ~5.8 lakh MT.

name: HCL Technologies Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth (cc): 1% to 4% (FY27)
thesis: FY27 guidance of 1% to 4% cc revenue and 17.5% to 18.5% EBIT margin, with two US telecom and SAP-related clients cutting spend; deflation of 2% to 3% for portfolio flagged as an emerging drag.

name: Nath Bio-Genes (India) Ltd
gLine: FY27 top-line growth: 15-20% (FY27)
thesis: Seed company with FY26 revenue INR 4,316m (+19%) and gross margin down to 56% from 63%; inventory build to INR 4,446m and FY27 guidance of 15-20% top-line growth, with no capacity expansion (capex mainly land and vehicles).

name: Clean Science and Technology Ltd
gLine: Capex budget FY27 (Clean Fino-Chem): INR 80-100 crore max
thesis: Q4 standalone revenue up 8% QoQ to INR193 cr on volume-led recovery, but FY26 standalone fell 12% to ~INR796 cr; MEHQ pricing under China pressure and new capacity still ramping (PC-1 utilisation ~10-15%).

name: Sealmatic India Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue up only 2% to INR103 cr while EBITDA margin fell to 17.4% from 24%, as ~INR8 cr was spent selling API seals below raw-material cost; operating cash flow negative and inventory ~INR62 cr with commissioning deferred 6–9 months.
top: Inventory rose to about INR 62 crores
themes: Middle East oil & gas API seals

name: Veefin Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY27 consolidated capex: lower than FY26 (INR 187 cr); no number (FY27)
thesis: Veefin is a fintech software company, not a capital-cycle story; standalone revenue ~INR 70.7 cr (+90%), but supply-side evidence is thin and management is pitching pipeline and PSB Xchange ramp rather than measurable throughput.
top: FY27 capex to be lower than FY26

name: Cyient DLM Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: Growth expected YoY in all four quarters; no numeric guidance
thesis: FY26 revenue fell 17% to INR12,615m while order book hit a record INR24,166m (book-to-bill 1.5x); management gave no FY27 revenue number, only directional growth.
top: Order book INR24,166m, highest in 10 quarters

name: Mamata Machinery Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~15% above FY26 (conservative) (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue fell 8% to Rs 233.1 cr on a ~50% US collapse; management calls it one-time, targets ~15% FY27 top-line growth and ~20% margin recovery, with order book up 34% to Rs 89.59 cr.

name: Hexagon Nutrition Ltd
gLine: Volume growth: maintain momentum of last 2-3 years; margin expansion expected (FY27)
thesis: Maiden call with no hard supply data; FY26 revenue +17.8% to INR382.63 cr and EBITDA margin 13.83%, but blended utilisation only ~30% with management guiding just 35-40% and no capex plan disclosed.

name: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd_DVR
gLine: FY27 revenue, margins, cash flow, balance sheet: better than FY26 on all parameters, no numbers
thesis: Q4 revenue up only 4% to about INR1,800 crore after a March PVC/PE price shock; management claims ~INR200-250 crore lost, ~INR133 crore adjusted PAT, and debt repayment hinges on government receivables and a Tamil Nadu land sale still unclosed.

name: BASF India Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes up 12-15% YoY but FY26 PBT pressured by input costs and mix; working capital up ~600-800 crore, FCF negative (~-300 crore), capex ~200 crore with Celesto and Dispersion Line 3 adding capacity.

name: WSFx Global Pay Ltd
gLine: Q1 FY27 leisure market: Expect next one or two months to be a little challenging
thesis: FY26 revenue up 26% to ~INR111 crore and PAT up 77% to INR6.14 crore, but management flags Q1 FY27 leisure contraction of ~25% and a 0.6-0.8% net margin under pressure from new AD-II competition.

name: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Ltd-$
gLine: Q1 volumes: fair to assume normal volumes
thesis: Basmati rice exporter built inventory at low paddy prices; rice prices up ~30% since Nov-Dec, but no hard numbers on margins, volumes, or Q1 spillover, and Q4 export volume fell ~9% QoQ to 44,500 MT from 48,900 MT.

name: Patel Engineering Ltd-$
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~10% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 revenue flat at INR 5,102 crore with 13.4% EBITDA margin; FY27 guided +10% and order target INR 8,000 crore, but tender success was only ~12-13% last year and promoter pledge and asset sales remain the core story.

name: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% to 20% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT fell 3.6% YoY to ₹80.1 cr on margin squeeze; management guides FY27 revenue growth 15-20% and inflows ~₹8,000 cr, but has no capacity discipline signal and capex is rising.

name: Route Mobile Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid to high single digit (FY27)
thesis: Route Mobile's FY26 revenue fell 3.7% to ₹4,408 crore while gross margin rose to 22.9% as low-margin ILD exited; FY27 guide of mid-to-high single-digit growth and ~12% EBITDA margin shows no supply-side signal.

name: Concord Control Systems Ltd
gLine: Fusion Electronics revenue: about INR 200 crore at full scale (full scale)
thesis: Concord reports FY26 revenue INR 210.47 crore, EBITDA INR 62.1 crore and a INR 697 crore order book (3.3x revenue), but receivables and short-term debt rose sharply and management gave no capacity, utilisation or cash-conversion numbers.
top: Receivables up sharply, no cash conversion

name: Takyon Networks Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: Meaningfully higher than FY26; ~15% above FY25 level (FY27)
thesis: H2 FY26 revenue fell to Rs 28.97 cr with EBITDA margin 5.3% as management deliberately deferred loss-making fixed-price contracts amid component inflation; FY27 guided to 15-20% growth on a 32 cr order book, margin 11-13%.

name: Seshaasai Technologies Ltd
gLine: IoT growth FY27: above 47% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue INR 404 cr (+9.6% YoY) with EBITDA margin 30.8%, but FY26 revenue fell 1.5% and management declined to guide FY27 until Q1; capacity is being built ahead of demand.

name: Ion Exchange India Ltd-$
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin collapsed to 2.31% on West Asia logistics, input costs and Roha depreciation; chemicals segment EBIT margin fell ~10pts while Roha capacity was fully commissioned with no FY27 guidance.

name: ACC Ltd
gLine: Cost per tonne reduction FY27: Rs250/t minimum, Rs4,250/t target
thesis: ACC's combined Ambuja-group call reset FY27 volume to ~80 Mt (+8%) and capex to Rs6,000-6,500 cr, with cost peaking at Rs4,500/t in March and a Rs250/t cut targeted, but no price recovery yet.

name: JSW Dulux Ltd
gLine: Volume growth: double-digit (FY27)
thesis: Volume up 23% but revenue only 6.2% on price cuts and mix; price hikes of ~9.7% against ~13.5% raw-material pass-through need, with 3-4% still to take and margins at risk.

name: Himatsingka Seide Ltd
gLine: Net debt: approx INR2,000 crores (within next 12 months)
thesis: Home textile maker pivoting to yarn, fabric and apparel using existing capacity with no new capex; utilisation weak (sheeting 56%, terry 63%) and Middle East shipment delays persist into Q1 FY27.

name: Blue Dart Express Ltd
thesis: Blue Dart Q4 FY26 PBT before exceptional fell about 17% on ~8% revenue growth, with tonnage up only 4.6% and margins under pressure; management gave no numeric FY27 guidance.

name: Subex Ltd
thesis: Subex Q4FY26 revenue rose only 3% QoQ to INR 72.96 cr with no numeric FY27 guidance; management leans on 24% order intake growth and a Middle East exposure it calls manageable.
top: Q4 revenue +3% QoQ to INR 72.96 cr

name: LTM Ltd
gLine: Five-year revenue: Double revenue in five years (~15% CAGR)
thesis: IT services read: Q4 USD revenue +1.2% QoQ and 8.1% YoY, but no numeric FY27 guidance and margin fell 100bp QoQ to 15.1% on wage hikes; supply signals are absent, so this is a demand-and-pricing story with hedged tone.
top: Randstad tech unit acquired at €160m EV

name: Music Broadcast Ltd
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell to INR 40.8 cr from INR 54 cr (down ~24%) with flat volumes and cost cuts driving EBITDA to INR 6.1 cr, but reported PAT was a loss; no supply-side discipline discussed.

name: HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd
thesis: FY26 VNB up only 2% to INR 4,034 crores with margin at 24.2% (25.5% ex-GST/SSV); management says growth and VNB to lag, and is not chasing margin, with counter share at HDFC Bank slipping from mid-60s to early-60s.
top: Bank-channel price aggression, counter share down

name: Harshdeep Hortico Ltd
gLine: Growth from current infrastructure: 35-40%
thesis: FY26 revenue of about INR 69 crore missed the INR 85 crore expectation as LPG cuts and a 20-25% raw-material spike hit output, though management still guides 25-30% growth if conditions normalise.

name: Whirlpool of India Ltd
gLine: Long-run revenue growth: early double-digit CAGR ambition (long term)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up ~7-9% and March 2026 a record shipment month, but PBT margin hit by e-waste and energy-upcharge costs not yet priced through; management gives no margin guidance and points to a harder FY27.
top: Energy upcharge not yet priced through

name: Schaeffler India Ltd
gLine: Order book growth exports: minimum 10% (CY2026)
thesis: Revenue up 18.8% YoY to INR 2,507 cr but down 5.1% QoQ; Industrial bearings weak on "recalibration" and price competition, while capex is being moderated and inventory built up.

name: Kellton Tech Solutions Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: more than 10% (FY2026-27)
thesis: IT services read with no capacity signal; Q4 margin 9.8% and FY26 revenue up ~11%, but US receivables slowing and management attributes US softness to the war and AI deal delays.

name: Apollo Pipes Ltd
gLine: Q1 FY27 revenue: INR400 crore+ (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Apollo Pipes guides Q1 FY27 revenue to INR400 crore+ (Q4 about INR350 crore) and 35% CAGR, but Q4 gross margin fell despite 13-14% realisation rise on aggressive pricing and inventory write-downs; channel inventory reported low.
top: Q4 gross margin fell despite realisation up 13-14%

name: Power Finance Corporation Ltd
gLine: Loan book growth FY27: around 10% (FY27)
thesis: PFC is a lender, not a capacity operator: FY26 loan book grew only 7% as prepayments hit, FY27 loan growth guided ~10% and spread cut to 2.40–2.50%, while sanctions of INR 2.85 lakh crore sit mostly undisbursed.

name: VTM Ltd
gLine: Top-line growth FY27: 12-14% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 PAT fell about 75% to Rs 11 crore as US tariff discounts (~18% on US home-textile sales, ~Rs 20 crore) and cotton inflation squeezed margins; FY27 guide is 12-14% top-line growth and 10-11% EBITDA margin against 7.43% in FY26.

name: Mallcom (India) Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 10-12% minimum (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin fell 185bp YoY to 9.34% on raw-material costs and export price concessions; management targets 10-12% growth and a return to pre-investment margins, but gives no numbers for margin recovery.

name: Oriental Aromatics Ltd-$
gLine: Mahad incremental revenue at current capacity: INR 50 crore; INR 60-65 crore at optimum utilisation (FY27)
thesis: FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 6.6% from 10.06% on a triple input-cost shock, Chinese oversupply and Mahad drag; management guides only to a return to ~10% and gives no FY27 revenue number.

name: Electrosteel Castings Ltd
gLine: FY27 pipe dispatch: ~7.4 lakh tons (pipes only) (FY27)
thesis: Ductile iron pipe demand has collapsed as JJM funds froze: Q4 volume down 21% YoY to 1.48 lakh t, FY26 down 25%, with management guiding FY27 dispatch to ~7.4 lakh t pipes and 13-14% EBITDA margin.

name: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd
thesis: Q4 ad revenue fell 4% YoY on a March Middle East slump, adjusted margin 6.9% and a INR4,084m one-off amortisation and impairment hit; no supply discipline signal, cost cuts are the main lever.

name: Shakti Pumps India Ltd-$
gLine: Pump capacity expansion: from Q2FY27
thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 2,698 cr but EBITDA margin fell to ~16% (management cites ~10% in Q4) and receivables are still INR 1,276 cr; no FY27 numbers given.

name: Aurionpro Solutions Ltd
thesis: FY26 revenue grew 20.2% to INR 1,411 cr with Q4 missed on Middle East and hyperscaler timing; management refuses FY27 growth number while front-loading INR 150-200 cr of development spend and INR 200-250 cr working capital.

name: Maan Aluminium Ltd
gLine: Volume FY27: 7,000-7,500 tonnes (analyst figure, flattish year) (FY27)
thesis: Capacity raised to 24,000 tpa but utilisation is lagging; FY26 PBT fell 18% to INR18 crore, FY27 expected flat with INR7-10 crore ramp costs and margin recovery pushed out about two years.

name: Jyothy Labs Ltd
gLine: Tax rate FY27: 25% to 26%
thesis: Q4 FY26 gross margin fell ~400bp to 45.2% on crude-linked input inflation and lower realisations; management gave no FY27 margin guide and flagged near-term pressure, with only ~4% price hikes taken in March.

name: Ashoka Buildcon Ltd
gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR8,000-10,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell 7% to INR168 crores on cost pressure and ECL provisions; management guides FY27 revenue up 20% and EBITDA margin 9.5-10.5%, with a working-capital stretch it expects to unwind after September.

name: Yatra Online Ltd
gLine: ROCE: high teens in 3-4 years (3-4 years)
thesis: Yatra's Q4 FY26 was hit by West Asia conflict: EBITDA fell 46% YoY to INR 126m as MICE bookings were cancelled or deferred, though FY26 adjusted EBITDA grew 37.5% to INR 917m and management says Q1 run-rate is about 20% above Q4.
top: Q4 MICE bookings cancelled or deferred

name: Aztec Fluids & Machinery Ltd
thesis: FY26 revenue grew 9.2% to 96.53 crore with EBITDA margin 14.3% and PAT 7.41 crore; management walked back double-digit growth and is planning undisclosed capex funded by accruals, debt and possibly equity.

name: Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants Ltd
gLine: INR130 cr Northern Railway order execution: 25% to 30% executed in current year (FY27)
thesis: Order book ~INR615-750 cr and FY26 revenue +11.4% to INR171.7 cr, but H2 revenue fell to INR99.8 cr from INR115.9 cr, with receivables ~INR55 cr and no quantified guidance.
top: Receivables ~INR55 cr; operating cash flow negative

name: Gillette India Ltd
thesis: FY26 sales up 8% to ₹3,100 crore and PAT up 23% to ~₹650 crore, but management admits near-term challenges and gives no numeric FY27 guidance; supply-side signals are thin.

name: Newgen Software Technologies Ltd
thesis: FY26 revenue grew 6% to INR1,574 cr with adjusted PAT up 6%, but management declined to guide FY27 and flagged slower large-deal closures in India, Middle East and EMEA, plus a rising receivables problem.

name: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd
gLine: Standalone revenue growth FY27: 15-20% (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone EBITDA margin fell to 5.83% (from 10.36% in Q3) on onerous contracts and JV reconciliation; management guides FY27 revenue up 15-20% with margin recovery, but Q1 expected to be challenging.

name: Western Carriers (India) Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: recover toward ~7% (FY27 onward)
thesis: Western Carriers is a rail-based logistics operator, not a cables maker, so subsector is a poor fit; Q4 EXIM containers fell 3.2% YoY and 11% QoQ, EBITDA margin slipped to 5%, and management gave no numbers but promised sequential improvement.
top: Debtors above INR600 cr; days target <120

name: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd
thesis: KVB delivered record FY26 profit of INR2,500 crore (ROA 1.93%) but guided FY27 NIM to 3.75–3.8% and ROA to 1.7–1.8% as it concedes pricing to protect relationships; credit growth set at industry +1–2%.

name: Praj Industries Ltd
gLine: Quarterly order inflow steady-state: Rs 800-900 crore band (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 PBT before exceptionals collapsed to Rs 15.4m from Rs 582.5m on execution cost overruns and deferred orders; order intake Rs 6,580m is weak, with management guiding FY27 order flow to roughly Rs 800-900 crore a year and no hard capacity discipline.

name: Concord Biotech Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: slightly better than historical ~18% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 API revenue fell 12% to INR 829 crore with utilisation uneven (Unit 2 at 30%, Unit 3 at 53%); management attributes it to timing and geopolitics, but gives no numeric FY27 guidance beyond "slightly better" than ~18% historical growth.

name: Credo Brands Marketing Ltd
gLine: Store count FY27: ~20 openings and ~20 closures; flat store count (FY27)
thesis: Mufti (Credo Brands) is a store-count-flat, throughput-led year: FY27 guided to ~20 openings and ~20 closures, mid-single-digit same-store growth at best, and EBITDA margin seen at 23–24% on higher ad spend.

name: Glottis Ltd
gLine: Revenue / volume outlook FY27: No numeric guidance; management 'very positive' on FY27
thesis: Glottis is a freight forwarder with FY26 revenue down on softer freight rates and volumes (89,098 TEUs), margins thin at 5.2% PAT, and receivables up about 70% from extended credit days, a weak-quality signal.

name: JK Lakshmi Cement Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: INR1,500-1,700 crore
thesis: Capacity additions hit a record 64 Mt in FY26 with utilisation near 69%, and management expects Q1 FY27 cost pressure of INR100-130/t with only partial price recovery, so margins face a near-term squeeze.

name: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Ltd
thesis: FY26 sales flat at about Rs 4,300 crore while PAT rose 19% to about Rs 850 crore on savings; management gave no numeric growth guidance and faced repeated questions on stalled top line.

name: Wipro Ltd
gLine: IT Services revenue Q1 FY27 (cc QoQ): -2% to 0% (Q1 FY27)
thesis: Wipro Q4 FY26 revenue flat sequentially (+0.2% cc) with Americas 2 down 2.6% QoQ and Q1 guided -2% to 0%; book-to-bill weak at ~1.3x on $3.5bn orders, with large deal ramp delays and margin pressure ahead.

name: Nucleus Software Exports Ltd
thesis: Q4 revenue flat YoY at INR 224.77 crore while EBITDA fell to INR 34.62 crore from INR 74.33 crore; order book jumped to INR 1,044 crore but management gives no guidance and lost Bajaj Finance to a competitor.

name: Concord Enviro Systems Ltd
thesis: FY26 revenue fell 6.2% to INR557.8 crores and EBITDA margin halved to 6.6%; order book INR536 crores for FY27 with a 14-16% margin target now unconfirmed, Q1 guidance deferred.
top: Q4 EBITDA margin 9% vs 27.7% a year ago

name: NCC Ltd
thesis: Record INR83,004 cr order book (~4x book-to-bill) but management withheld all FY27 guidance citing uncertainty; standalone FY26 revenue fell 9% and consolidated EBITDA margin in Q4 was 8.83% vs 9.07%.

name: Marathon Nextgen Realty Ltd
gLine: Kanjurmarg launches: more than INR 225 crore launch in next 12 months
thesis: Real estate developer posts record FY26 PAT of INR 206 crore on a INR 900 crore QIP, but Q4 bookings of INR 156 crore vs collections of INR 203 crore show little supply discipline and no capacity or utilisation data.

name: Elecon Engineering Company Ltd
thesis: Gear revenue fell 21% YoY to INR472 crore on deferred dispatches and no FY27 guidance; utilisation only 56-60% with ~INR800 crore idle investments, so supply discipline is strong but demand timing is weak.

name: WPIL Ltd
thesis: Consolidated Q4 revenue fell 11% to INR511 crore while standalone project revenue collapsed to INR92 crore from INR253 crore; FY26 order book ~INR6,000 crore largely from a South African win, with JJM receivables stuck (~INR350 crore overdue).

name: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Ltd
gLine: Specialty chemical utilisation FY27: better than FY25-26 (no number) (FY27)
thesis: Sulfur-driven price pass-through held absolute margins while working capital and ~9% short-term borrowing costs rose; no numeric FY27 guidance, Roha ran ~60% for about 15 days in March.
top: Roha utilisation cut to ~60% in March

name: Muthoot Capital Services Ltd
gLine: AUM FY27 disbursement: close to INR3,000 crores
thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT hit by ~INR76 crore FY impairment and a INR15.5 crore corporate NPA; reported GNPA 6.96% with accrual, co-lending run-off and cost of funds down INR0.60 are the main positives, but no supply or pricing discipline evidence.

name: Modi Naturals Ltd
gLine: Ethanol division revenue FY27: average INR950 crores
thesis: Ethanol Phase 2 took capacity to 282 KLPD late in FY26 with FY27 ethanol revenue guided ~INR950 crores at only ~50% utilisation of the expansion; management dismisses overcapacity risk while a 10% private OMC share limits near-term volume visibility.

name: Viceroy Hotels Ltd
gLine: ADR: Rs 9,000 to 9,500 in immediate term; ~Rs 10,000 long run (near term / long run)
thesis: Hotel operator (Hyderabad Marriott/Courtyard, new Executive Apartments) with Q4 revenue +35% largely from acquisition; ADR softened in March, FY26 EBITDA margin 29.8%, and capex and debt are rising with no supply-discipline signal.

name: Goodluck India Ltd
gLine: Defence FY27 execution: 75-80% of 150,000 shell capacity; INR250-300 crores revenue (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 consol revenue flat-to-down with PAT up 34%, but FY26 revenue growth only ~4% vs 15-20% guided, working capital debt up to INR1,000 crores and inventory days rising; capex overrun unreconciled.

name: Linc Ltd-$
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell 10.6% to INR137.67 cr on muted corporate gifting and Middle East export hit; no FY27 guidance given, with management deferring it another quarter.

name: Allied Digital Services Ltd
gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20% to 25% YoY (FY27)
thesis: Revenue up 20% to Rs 968 cr but PAT growth rests on a Rs 21 cr deferred tax credit after a one-time ECL provision; no supply-side discipline, and management guides 20-25% growth with margins 12.5-13% targeted.

name: Religare Enterprises Ltd
gLine: Care combined ratio: near 100% in 2 years
thesis: Holding-company call with no capacity or pricing data; Care GWP up 24% to INR11,417 crores and combined ratio 101.4%, but the demerger structure and promoter stake questions went unanswered.
top: Care GWP up 24% to INR11,417 crores

name: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Ltd
gLine: Standalone revenue growth FY27: 10% to 12% (FY27)
thesis: FY26 standalone revenue +4.2% to INR5,229 cr, manufacturing EBIT margin 12.46% held; FY27 guided +10-12% with INR7,000 cr opening order book, but input-cost inflation and Philippines accounting noise cloud quality.

name: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd
gLine: Top-line and bottom-line growth FY27: Growth in revenue and profit expected, not quantified
thesis: Freight-car volumes fell to 8,372 in FY26 (2,196 in Q4) with revenue down 14% to ₹4,377 cr; management offered no numeric FY27 guidance and booked a ₹700 cr contingency provision, while wagon-tender timing stayed unclear.

name: PTC India Financial Services Ltd
gLine: AUM growth FY27: 30% to 50% YoY (AUM, net of repayments) (FY27)
thesis: Sanctions surged to INR3,448 crores (vs 825) but disbursements only INR1,235 crores, with about INR2,000 crores undisbursed and AUM shrinking on prepayments; Gross Stage III fell to INR190 crores, though management has repeatedly missed the funding and disbursement timelines it had guided.

name: Emerald Finance Ltd
gLine: Corporate onboarding FY27: 120-150 per year (bare minimum)
thesis: EWA disbursal run-rate slipped to INR10 crore from guided INR11.5-12 crore as corporate rejection hit ~60%; management reiterated FY27 EPS above 7 without numbers, against FY26 EPS of 4.36 and an NPA-breakup answer that was evasive.

name: IDFC First Bank Ltd
gLine: Credit cost FY27: 170-180 bps (FY27)
thesis: Reported Q4 PAT Rs 319 cr after Rs 646 cr fraud charge; management says normalised PAT ~Rs 746 cr, FY26 credit cost 2.13% with FY27 guided at 170-180 bps, opex 13-14%, NIM held at 5.75%.

name: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: Rs 150-200 crore minimum (FY27)
thesis: Management guides FY27 revenue of Rs 3,000 crore on a Rs 1,100 crore confirmed order book, with no capacity or utilisation disclosure and a receivables spike, so the read is promotional and unverifiable.

name: Precision Camshafts Ltd
gLine: Incremental revenue from capex: 1.5x-2x of INR100-120 crore capex, peaking in 2.5-3 years (2.5-3 years)
thesis: Capex of INR100-120 crores targets 1.5-2x incremental revenue at peak in 2.5-3 years, with foundry at ~80% and machine shop ~90% utilisation; guidance is qualitative and no prior guidance was supplied.

name: CL Educate Ltd
gLine: L&D segment revenue: flat (next year)
thesis: Group revenue up 55% to ₹570 cr, but the gain is DEXIT acquisition-led; L&D revenue fell ~11% on 12–14% realisation drop and is guided flat for four more quarters, with ₹180 cr acquisition debt still outstanding.

name: Varroc Engineering Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: mid-to-high teens (analyst framing; management answered 'Yes')
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 12.8% with India EBITDA up 14% and overseas up 24%, but group PBT margin only 4.5% and net debt rose to INR 495 crore; FY27 capex guided INR 450-500 crore, next year INR 300-400 crore.

name: Archean Chemical Industries Ltd
gLine: Semiconductor substructure start: Substructure work from July 2026; 27-30 months to completion
thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell 34% to INR66.4 crore on salt pricing down ~10% and logistics shock; bromine production back to ~55 tpd but management gave no numeric guidance and FY27 volume goal is ~25,000 t.
top: Majority of bromine LTCs repriced up

name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
gLine: Growth vs market: Outgrow EMS market at 2x market growth (~15-16%) (FY27)
thesis: Kaynes missed its FY26 revenue guidance (INR4,500 cr cut to ~INR4,000 cr, delivered ~INR3,626 cr) and OCF was about INR600 cr negative, driven by metering receivables of ~INR1,365 cr; no numeric FY27 guidance given.
top: FY26 revenue guide cut INR4,500 cr → ~INR3,600 cr

name: Radiant Cash Management Services Ltd
gLine: Core business revenue growth FY27: mid-teens (working towards)
thesis: Core cash-logistics revenue flat at FY26 with railways and e-com losses; standalone EBITDA margin recovered to 15% in Q4 but consolidated PAT fell to INR280m on fintech losses, with management guiding breakeven targets rather than numbers.

name: Cosmic CRF Ltd
gLine: Installed capacity FY27: 175,000 t by next 12-15 months (12-15 months)
thesis: Installed capacity 133,600 t with ~106,370 t produced (~80%) and FY27 guidance of 122-130k t, but the story leans on Amzen win, unproven margins and rising debt ahead of volume.
top: Capacity to 175k t; Amzen adds more

name: Manoj Ceramic Ltd
thesis: Manoj Ceramic is a distributor-led B2B/B2C tile seller with no owned capacity; H2 FY26 EBITDA margin fell to about 11% from 14% and management gave no quantified FY27 margin path.

name: EPACK Durable Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: Rs 170-200 crore over next 9-12 months
thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA fell 64% to Rs 25.8 cr (4.37% margin) on a Rs 32 cr PLI reversal; RAC utilisation ~20% annualised in FY26 versus 45-50% earlier, with management guiding a Q1 industry rebound of ~15%.

name: Dee Development Engineers Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs 1,500 Cr minimum, possibly higher (FY27)
thesis: Core piping/fabrication EBITDA up 64% to Rs 210.5 Cr with FY27 order inflow guided above Rs 2,000 Cr, but gross margin slipping, working-capital targets shifting and Malwa power plant still under audit qualification.
top: Order inflow guided above Rs 2,000 Cr

name: Fabtech Cleanrooms Ltd
gLine: Order book conversion: About 200 cr order book executable within six months (H1 FY27)
thesis: Cleanroom contractor FY26 standalone EBITDA fell 21.5% to 12.96 cr and PAT fell 24.75% to 9.06 cr; management attributes this to deliberately thin margins on new solar, data-centre and semicon orders, with order book of about 199 cr.

name: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Ltd
gLine: FY27 PAT: about INR 100 crore (FY27)
thesis: Management targets 30–35% revenue CAGR and FY27 PAT ~INR 100 cr off a 10,000 t R-32 plant (Oct-26 start), but Q4 top line was flat at ~INR 110 cr and the quota is unannounced; treat as promise-heavy, not yet proven.

name: Denta Water and Infra Solutions Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~20% (minimum) (FY27)
thesis: Water EPC with FY26 revenue Rs 2,503.8m (+23%) but Q4 EBITDA margin fell to ~19% and management guides only ~20% FY27 revenue growth and an unquantified 25% margin, with order book down to Rs 7,278m and no new supply-side signal.

name: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Ltd
gLine: Operational beds: 2,800-3,000 within 3-4 months; 3,000-3,500 before 31 March 2027 (3-4 months)
thesis: Ayurveda hospitals and products grew revenue 71% to INR801 crore with 44% EBITDA margin, but Q4 EBITDA was cut by about INR21 crore of one-offs, and management's bed-expansion and 4-5x PAT targets rest on unverified government and insurance rate assumptions.
top: Q4 IPD/OPD softness, March bookings delayed

name: Regaal Resources Ltd
thesis: Capacity doubled to 1,650 TPD with capex raised to INR540 crore and no FY27 guidance; margins and volumes unquantified, while the call's own numbers show Q4 EBITDA margin up to 13.3% from 10.7%.

name: Kotyark Industries Ltd
gLine: Capacity utilisation: 60-70% over next few years (few years)
thesis: Biodiesel maker running at 7-8% utilisation on 480,000 KL capacity, with 400 KLPD added at low utilisation; management's 15-20% growth claim is not backed by a current order book of ~Rs 80 crore against FY26 revenue of Rs 314.9 crore.

name: OnEMI Technology Solutions Ltd
gLine: AUM growth: >40% FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Digital consumer lender (Kissht) guiding AUM growth above 40% and ROA 4.5-5% for FY27 while yields compress; asset quality improving on GNPA 2.12%, but the headline GNPA drop is a write-off policy change, not pure credit improvement.

name: Advit Jewels Ltd
gLine: Company-operated retail stores: Minimum three stores in FY27
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell to ~INR43 cr YoY and management gave no numeric FY27 targets; utilisation of ~31% was explained away by product mix, with no capacity-discipline evidence.

name: Best Agrolife Ltd
thesis: FY26 revenue fell 31% to ₹1,257 crore and Q4 EBITDA was negative ₹27 crore, with a ₹50–70 crore March sales deferral and 2 price hikes as the recovery case; no numeric FY27 guidance.

name: KNR Constructions Ltd
gLine: FY27 order inflow: INR8,000-10,000 crores (FY27)
thesis: Order book INR11,903 cr incl. new HAMs but FY27 revenue guided only ~INR2,000 cr and EBITDA margin cut to ~10-11% as awarding slumped and Telangana irrigation receivables of ~INR1,400-1,450 cr stay stuck.

name: RMC Switchgears Ltd
thesis: FY26 revenue Rs 401.59 cr (+26.4%) but Q3 loss of Rs 7.07 cr, receivables rose Rs 148 cr to Rs 205 cr, operating cash flow negative, and no FY27 guidance given.

name: General Insurance Corporation of India
gLine: Dividend payout: 13.25%
thesis: Reinsurer GIC Re enters FY27 with softening pricing and new domestic reinsurers; management guides only 1-2pt combined ratio improvement and expects low single-digit growth, with a 4% obligatory share held for FY27.
top: Two new domestic reinsurers plus GIFT City IIOs

name: Trualt Bioenergy Ltd
gLine: FY27 ethanol volume: at least 40 crore litres, bonus 55 crore litres (FY27)
thesis: Ethanol offtake collapsed to ~26 crore litres vs 72 crore bid, utilisation under 35% and INR460-500 crore inventory built; FY27 volume target of 40-55 crore litres rests on unenforced court orders.

name: Dreamfolks Services Ltd
thesis: FY26 revenue collapsed to INR 660.6 cr from 1,291.9 cr as domestic lounge model reset; Q4 gross profit negative INR 6.1 cr and no quantified FY27 guidance, breakeven pushed out a year.

name: EMS Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: about Rs 1,000 cr (order win target Rs 1,500 cr)
thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone revenue collapsed to Rs 84 cr and consolidated Rs 120 cr, with ~Rs 100 cr stuck in unbilled WIP; management blames permissions and government payment delays, and gave no firm FY27 numbers beyond a ~Rs 1,000 cr revenue plan.

name: Symphony Ltd
gLine: Summer sales runway: 4 to 6 weeks of decent summer sales
thesis: Symphony's Q4 consol revenue fell to ₹338 crore from ₹488 crore and FY26 PAT was negative ₹141 crore after a ₹259 crore Australia impairment, while standalone gross margin held near 45%+ and management says it will stop funding Australia.

name: Tejas Networks Ltd
thesis: FY26 was a loss-making transition year: revenue ₹1,103 cr and PAT loss ₹909 cr, with inventory ₹2,438 cr and receivables ₹3,258 cr; no numeric guidance, only a 'goal' of PAT-positive FY27.

name: Cohance Lifesciences Ltd
gLine: Q1 FY27 revenue and EBITDA: low
thesis: FY26 revenue fell about 13% to INR22.68bn on destocking and the Nacharam disruption; management calls Q1 FY27 the low point with recovery only from H2, and gives no numeric FY27 guidance.
top: Q1 FY27 low on revenue and EBITDA

name: Khadim India Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: around INR400 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell to INR83.6 cr (from 93.8 cr) with PAT margin 0.9%; management guides FY27 revenue ~INR400 cr at 14% EBITDA while inventory was cut ~40% and creditors slashed, signalling demand-led weakness rather than supply-side discipline.

name: Natco Pharma Ltd
gLine: FY27 revenue: INR3,400 to INR3,500 crores (FY27)
thesis: Natco FY26 PAT fell to INR1,418 crores (incl. INR115 crore tax one-off) as lenalidomide faded; management guides FY27 base year at INR700-750 crores PAT with no big US launch until FY28.
top: Q4 revenue down to INR816.9 crores

name: Fino Payments Bank Ltd
gLine: Technology investment: around ₹100 crores (FY27)
thesis: Q4 revenue down 31% YoY and digital UPI P2M business paused with active clients down to 229 from 347; CASA accounts 1.75 crore (+22%), but the business is in a governance-led retrenchment with no formal FY27 guidance.

name: Tolins Tyres Ltd
gLine: EBITDA margin: 10% to 13% acceptable range
thesis: Tolins FY26 revenue +12% to INR327cr but EBITDA fell to INR47.8cr (14.6%) from INR57.9cr; working capital swelled to ~INR300cr as dealer credit stretched, with no FY27 guidance beyond holding FY26 levels.
top: Receivables stretched, credit extended a month

name: IRCON International Ltd
gLine: SPV equity/quasi-equity investment: Rs.700-800 crore total, Rs.500-600 crore in FY27 (FY27)
thesis: Order book ~Rs.24,984 cr (~2.6x FY26 revenue of Rs.9,502 cr) but management guides FY27 revenue flat at ~Rs.9,000 cr and standalone core EBITDA down to 4.0-4.5%, with bids going below estimate and win rate rising to 10% of value bid.

name: Jindal Saw Ltd
gLine: Capex FY27: INR500-600 crore (FY27), INR400-500 crore (FY28) (FY27-FY28)
thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone EBITDA fell to INR413 crore from INR527 crore in Q3 as MENA shipments froze since March and ductile iron pipe demand stalled; management sees ductile iron overcapacity.

name: Afcons Infrastructure Ltd
gLine: FY27 order booking: INR 30,000 crore (FY27)
thesis: Q4 loss of INR 89 crore on payment stalls, one-offs and no margin recognition; FY26 order inflow INR 4,125 crore vs INR 30,000 crore FY27 target, and no revenue or margin guidance.
top: No FY27 revenue or margin guidance
